title: Fusion Spec Kits — First Pass
lead: Every one of the 55 fusions has a first-draft kit: one or two new core mechanics, and all 30 base skills rebuilt to either use them or cross-wire the two parent elements. This table is the one-line version; each kit page holds every skill.
leadHtml: Every one of the 55 fusions has a first-draft kit: one or two new core mechanics, and all 30 base skills rebuilt to either use them or cross-wire the two parent elements. This table is the one-line version; each kit page holds every skill.

groups.title: Pure fusions
groups.lead: One element taken twice. These are the easiest fusions to reach: a character's locked native infusion plus one more of the same element.
groups.leadHtml: One element taken twice. These are the easiest fusions to reach: a character's locked native infusion plus one more of the same element.

groups.title: Fire pairs
groups.lead: Fire with Ice, Water, Lightning, Wind, Poison, Earth, Holy, Unholy and Shadow. Fire + Fire (Dragon) is under Pure fusions.
groups.leadHtml: Fire with Ice, Water, Lightning, Wind, Poison, Earth, Holy, Unholy and Shadow. Fire + Fire (Dragon) is under Pure fusions.

groups.title: Ice pairs
groups.lead: Ice with Water, Lightning, Wind, Poison, Earth, Holy, Unholy and Shadow. Fire + Ice (Apocalypse) is under Fire pairs.
groups.leadHtml: Ice with Water, Lightning, Wind, Poison, Earth, Holy, Unholy and Shadow. Fire + Ice (Apocalypse) is under Fire pairs.

groups.title: Water pairs
groups.lead: Water with Lightning, Wind, Poison, Earth, Holy, Unholy and Shadow. Water's pairs with Fire and Ice are under those tabs.
groups.leadHtml: Water with Lightning, Wind, Poison, Earth, Holy, Unholy and Shadow. Water's pairs with Fire and Ice are under those tabs.

groups.title: Lightning pairs
groups.lead: Lightning with Wind, Poison, Earth, Holy, Unholy and Shadow.
groups.leadHtml: Lightning with Wind, Poison, Earth, Holy, Unholy and Shadow.

groups.title: Wind pairs
groups.lead: Wind with Poison, Earth, Holy, Unholy and Shadow.
groups.leadHtml: Wind with Poison, Earth, Holy, Unholy and Shadow.

groups.title: Poison & Earth pairs
groups.lead: Poison with Earth, Holy, Unholy and Shadow; then Earth with Holy, Unholy and Shadow.
groups.leadHtml: Poison with Earth, Holy, Unholy and Shadow; then Earth with Holy, Unholy and Shadow.

groups.title: Holy & Unholy pairs
groups.lead: Holy with Unholy and Shadow; then Unholy with Shadow.
groups.leadHtml: Holy with Unholy and Shadow; then Unholy with Shadow.

kits.name: Dragon
kits.tagline: Fire at its peak: a wyrm whose burns fill its hoard, whose hoard hardens its scales, and who spends it all on one breath.
kits.taglineHtml: Fire at its peak: a wyrm whose burns fill its hoard, whose hoard hardens its scales, and who spends it all on one breath.
kits.introHtml:
• Dragonfire (Debuff): counts as Ignite, but deals 10 Affliction at the end of its applier's turn instead of 5. Applied to an Ignited unit, it upgrades the Ignite.
  • Hoard (the user's, max 6): +1 each time an Ignite or Dragonfire the user applied deals damage. Every 2 Hoard gives the user 1 Armor. Breath skills spend all of it for +5 damage per Hoard to each target, so breathing trades defense for burst.

keywords.html: Dragonfire (Debuff): counts as Ignite, but deals 10 Affliction at the end of its applier's turn instead of 5. Applied to an Ignited unit, it upgrades the Ignite.

Hoard (the user's, max 6): +1 each time an Ignite or Dragonfire the user applied deals damage. Every 2 Hoard gives the user 1 Armor. Breath skills spend all of it for +5 damage per Hoard to each target, so breathing trades defense for burst.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +5 for every 2 Hoard the user has. Hoard isn't spent.

history.why: Was Fire's Torch Strike with Dragonfire for Ignite; now the claws grow with the hoard without spending it, the counterweight to Breath.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and Dragonfire.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Any of them who is channeling stops and gains Dragonfire.

history.why: Was Fire's Chain Detonation with 5 more damage; now the sweep breaks channels and sets the channelers alight.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Every target that was already Ignited Explodes.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and 1 Focus for the user's next skill. That skill's Ignites land as Dragonfire.

history.why: Was a Hoard rider on Ignited targets; now a dive that primes the next skill to burn as Dragonfire.

before.effect: 15 damage, and 1 Focus for the user's next skill. If the target is Ignited, the user also gains 2 Hoard.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user, and the user gains 1 Hoard per energy each countered skill cost.

history.why: Was Fire's Blisterblade with Dragonfire and Hoard added; now the dragon takes a toll: the pricier the countered skill, the bigger the hoard.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user: its user gains Dragonfire and the user gains 2 Hoard.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might, and 1 Hoard each time an enemy damages them.

history.why: Was Fire's Blazing Fury plus Might and Hoard; now a wounded wyrm hoards its wrath, a new Hoard source that rewards being hit.

before.effect: The user gains 3 Hoard, then Flameborn and 2 Might for 3 turns.

rows.effect: If target enemy is Ignited, 25 damage. Otherwise, 10 damage and Dragonfire.

history.why: Was Fire's Flickerflare with Dragonfire for Ignite; now one skill with two modes: light them, then cash the burn in.

before.effect: 15 damage and Dragonfire. If the target was already Ignited, a random other enemy gains Dragonfire too.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. The user circles overhead, Untargetable until it lands. On the following turn, 35 damage to target enemy, plus Breath.

history.why: Was Fire's Heat Seeker with Dragonfire and Breath swapped in; now the dragon takes to the sky while it lines up the breath.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage and Dragonfire to target enemy, plus Breath.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy gains a Buff, they lose it and gain Dragonfire, which can't be removed for 2 turns.

history.why: Was split between Dragonfire and 2 Hoard; now purely a Dragonfire bait whose burn can't be cleansed.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy gains a Buff, they lose it and gain Dragonfire, and the user gains 2 Hoard.

history.why: Was Fire's Hidden Explosives lasting longer and adding Dragonfire; now the bait is their own Buff, which the dragon snatches for its hoard.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they gain Dragonfire and Explode.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. While it lasts, each Ignite the user applied also deals its damage at the start of its bearer's turn.

history.why: Was Invulnerable plus a mass Explosion of Ignited enemies, Fire's default payoff; now a rule bend that makes the user's Ignites tick twice while they're out of reach.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. When it ends, every Ignited enemy Explodes.

rows.effect: Summons a Drake (40 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, if any enemy is Ignited, it gives the user 1 Hoard. Drake Claw (r): 15 damage and Scorched for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Fire's Dragon Hatchling (a random burn each turn) with Dragonfire; now the Drake gathers Hoard from anyone's fires and fights with anti-heal claws.

before.effect: Summons a Drake (40 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns it gives a random enemy Dragonfire; Hoard from its burns goes to its summoner.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they're Ignited, their Ignite deals its damage twice right now.

history.why: Was tagged Hoard but never touched it; unchanged text, now counted as a Fire expansion that cashes Ignites in early.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they're Ignited, their Ignite deals its damage twice right now.

history.why: Was Fire's Fireball with 5 more damage and a Dragonfire fallback; now it trades the team-wide Explosion for single-target burst that feeds Hoard.

before.effect: 25 damage. If the target is Ignited, they Explode; otherwise they gain Dragonfire.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, plus Breath. Ignited enemies take 10 more.

history.why: Was Fire's Inferno with Dragonfire, damage and Breath added; now it's the payoff for fires already lit instead of another way to light them.

before.effect: 20 damage and Dragonfire to all enemies, plus Breath.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. Then every Ignite on the enemy side ends, and the user heals 10 and gains 1 Hoard for each.

history.why: Was Fire's Feed the Fire with a different reward; now it eats every fire on their side at once, a burst that ends your own burns.

before.effect: 10 damage. If the target is Ignited, the Ignite is removed, and the user heals 20 and gains 3 Hoard.

rows.effect: Summons a Dragon Egg (30 HP) for 3 turns. It does nothing, but if it's still alive when it expires, it hatches into a permanent Wyrmling (30 HP). Wyrmling Bite (r): 15 damage and Ignite.

history.why: Was Kobold Tribute, a near-copy of Drake's passive Hoard; now a 3-turn summon that becomes permanent if the team protects it.

before.effect: Summons 2 Kobolds (15 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of your turns, each gives its summoner 1 Hoard. Pitch Pot (r): Ignites target enemy.

rows.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. 10 damage to all enemies each turn, and a random enemy without Dragonfire gains it. Once every enemy has it, each tick deals 10 more instead.

history.why: Was a Dragonfire channel ending in Breath; now a pure Dragonfire spreader that pays off once the whole team burns.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns, and each turn a random enemy gains Dragonfire. The last turn also Breathes.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they have Dragonfire; the bigger bite tears it out, and their Dragonfire cools back into an Ignite.

history.why: Was a Buff-conditional Hoard stab; now cashes Dragonfire for burst at the cost of the stronger burn.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they have a Buff, in which case the user also gains 1 Hoard.

history.why: Was Fire's Searing Needle's burn bonus with Dragonfire; now the dragon covets what shines and bites whoever is Buffed.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against Dragonfire. The user gains 1 Hoard if the target is Ignited.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, 15 more if they're Scorched. For 2 turns, each time their Ignite deals damage, they're Scorched for 1 turn.

history.why: Was a Breath trigger on Stunned or Scorched targets; now Ignite keeps re-Scorching its bearer, and Scorched sets up the next bite.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage. Against Stunned or Scorched targets, it also Breathes.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, the first enemy skill that costs 3 or more energy is countered, and its gold is taken: next turn, its user generates 1 less energy and the user 1 more.

history.why: Was a counter that Ignited or Stunned by formula; now watches every enemy for their big play and steals energy from it, which no other Mislead does.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered. If they're Ignited, they're also Stunned for 1 turn; otherwise they're Ignited.

history.why: Was Fire's Heat Haze with Dragonfire and a counter; now it escalates: a burning target who takes the bait is Stunned.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Scorched for 2 turns and gain Dragonfire.

rows.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun to target enemy. For 2 turns, the first Explosion the user's side causes Stuns them again for 1 turn.

history.why: Was a Stun plus Intimidated if Ignited; now gives Explosion builds a new outlet, turning their next Explosion into a second Stun.

before.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun. Ignited targets are also Intimidated for 2 turns.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each time an Ignite they applied deals damage, the ally with the least HP heals as much.

history.why: Was a Dance that spread Ignite if any enemy was Ignited; now lets a burn-heavy Fire character heal the team from their Ignites, a support role Fire lacks.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus. At the end of each of their turns, if any enemy is Ignited, a random enemy that isn't is Ignited too.

history.why: Mass-Exploded every Ignited enemy, the same as Take Wing; now the wings fan the flames from one enemy to the next over three turns.

before.effect: Every Ignited enemy Explodes. The user gains 1 Hoard per Explosion, and 1 Focus.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15, plus 10 for each Hoard the user spends, up to 3.

history.why: Was Fire's Flamethirst plus healing; now it's purely a trade of the dragon's scales (Hoard's Armor) for an ally's health.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15 and gains Flameborn for 2 turns. Spends up to 3 Hoard for 10 more healing each.

rows.effect: For 2 turns, target ally's damaging skills also Ignite their targets, or give Dragonfire to targets already Ignited.

history.why: Was Fire's Burning Blood plus Flameborn from another Fire skill; now it lends the dragon's fire to any ally's attacks.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Might and Flameborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy loses all Armor and Shield, gains 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns, and gains Dragonfire.
20 damage to target enemy, and they're Scorched for 1 turn. When that Scorch ends, they Explode if they're still Ignited.

history.why: Was an Ignite-echo Hoard skill much like Wyrmbolt; now Scorched is a fuse that detonates an Ignite as an Explosion.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each time an ally damages them, their Ignite deals its damage once more.

history.why: Was Fire's Searing Brand with 5 more damage and an upgrade to Dragonfire; now the team's hits stoke the target's burn.

before.effect: 20 damage. If the target was Ignited, their Ignite becomes Dragonfire and they gain 2 Weakness for 1 turn.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. Then the user curls up on the hoard: Sleep for up to 3 turns, and all allies heal 20 at the end of each of the user's turns while they sleep.

history.why: Was Brood Scales, a Hoard-scaled heal; now the dragon sleeps on its hoard and the team heals until an enemy wakes it with damage.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield, plus 1 Armor per 2 Hoard the user has, for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Each is Ignited, or gains Dragonfire if they already were.
All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. For as long, each time one of them is healed, they're Ignited.

history.why: Was Intimidated plus Scorched on Ignited enemies; now a new trigger that earns Ignite whenever enemies heal, punishing the sustain Scorched only halves.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; Ignited ones are also Scorched for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user gains 20 Shield and Flameborn for 2 turns, and Ignites every enemy who damages them meanwhile.

history.why: Was Gilded Scales, Shield plus 5 per Hoard; now attackers catch the user's Ignites, which Flameborn heals the user from.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield plus 5 per Hoard, for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Meanwhile, any other enemy who uses a Harmful skill on the user's allies takes 10 damage.

history.why: Was a Taunt on every Ignited enemy plus Armor; now a territorial Taunt that also taxes every other enemy for attacking anyone but the dragon.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy and every Ignited enemy for 2 turns. The user gains 1 Armor for each enemy Taunted, for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Fire's Ring of Fire burn-on-attack with Dragonfire and Hoard; now it draws every burning enemy to the dragon at once.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user, they gain Dragonfire and the user gains 1 Hoard.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and Flameborn, and every Hoard gives 1 Armor instead of every 2.

kits.name: Crystal
kits.tagline: Ice made perfect: flawless for allies, fatally flawed for enemies.
kits.taglineHtml: Ice made perfect: flawless for allies, fatally flawed for enemies.
kits.introHtml:
• Brittle (Debuff, max 3; counts as a Frost debuff): the bearer takes 5 more direct damage per stack. At 3 stacks, the next direct hit Shatters them: 20 more damage, and they're Shattered for 2 turns. Shattering removes Brittle.
  • Diamond (Buff): no single hit can deal the bearer more than 15 damage, counted after Armor and Shield. Ticking damage counts as hits too.

keywords.html: Brittle (Debuff, max 3; counts as a Frost debuff): the bearer takes 5 more direct damage per stack. At 3 stacks, the next direct hit Shatters them: 20 more damage, and they're Shattered for 2 turns. Shattering removes Brittle.
Diamond (Buff): no single hit can deal the bearer more than 15 damage, counted after Armor and Shield. Ticking damage counts as hits too.

rows.effect: 20 damage and 1 Brittle to target enemy. Each of their other Frost debuffs crystallizes: it ends, and they gain 1 more Brittle for it.

history.why: Was Ice's Glacial Hammer with Brittle for Frostbitten; now it turns Ice's lasting debuffs into Brittle stacks, trading control for a Shatter.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 1 Brittle.

rows.effect: 25 damage and 1 Brittle to target enemy. Then their Brittle bursts: it's removed, and each of their allies takes 10 damage per stack.

history.why: Was the base Smash with Brittle on everyone; now the splash comes from the target's Brittle: burst it now, or save it for a Shatter.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Each target gains 1 Brittle.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and 1 Focus for the user's next skill. Any Frost debuff that skill applies lasts 1 turn longer.

history.why: Was a Brittle rider on Frost-debuffed targets; now an enabler that stretches the next Frost debuff for any Ice player.

before.effect: 15 damage, and 1 Focus for the user's next skill. If the target has a Frost debuff, they gain 1 Brittle.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. Its user is Frostbitten for 2 turns, and the user becomes Frostborn for as long, so that enemy can't touch them.

history.why: Was Geode Guard, turning Buffs into Brittle; now Frostbitten sets up Frostborn's invulnerability to Frostbitten units.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. Its user's Buffs crystallize: each one ends and gives them 1 Brittle.

history.why: Was Ice's Frost Spines with Diamond for Frostborn and Brittle added; now it punishes buffed attackers by turning their Buffs into Brittle.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user: its user gains 2 Brittle, and the user gains Diamond for 1 turn.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Diamond and 2 Might, but can't be healed.

history.why: Was the base Rage with Diamond for 1 Might; now it's a trade: burst-proof and strong, but nothing can mend the gem.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Diamond, 1 Might and Immune.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, their Frost debuffs can't be removed and don't count down.

history.why: Was Splinter, Buff removal or 1 Brittle; now a cheap enabler that holds every Frost debuff in place.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they have a Buff, a random one ends; if not, they gain 1 Brittle.

history.why: Was Ice's Icicle with Brittle for Chilled; now it reads the target: it pops a Buff, or cracks them if they have none.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Brittle.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 Piercing damage, plus 10 per Brittle stack on the target.
Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, their Brittle rises to 3.
The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and their Debuffs end. When it ends, they gain Diamond for 1 turn per Debuff removed.

history.why: Was a Brittle cleanse-and-return; now the Debuffs shed harden into Diamond, so the worse the user's state, the longer the shell.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and their Debuffs end. When it ends, a random enemy gains 1 Brittle for each Debuff removed.

history.why: Was the base Maneuver with Diamond added; now the cocoon draws in the user's Debuffs and throws them back as Brittle.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains Diamond for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Summons a Crystal Golem (40 HP) permanently. At the start of each of your turns, the ally with the least HP gains Diamond for 1 turn. Shard Slam (S): 15 damage and 1 Brittle.

history.why: Was Ice's Ice Bear with Brittle for Chilled; now the Golem keeps the weakest ally burst-proof each turn.

before.effect: Summons a Crystal Golem (40 HP, always has Diamond) permanently. Shard Slam (S): 20 damage and 1 Brittle.

rows.effect: 20 damage and a Mark for 1 turn. When the Mark is spent, the target also gains 2 Brittle.

history.why: Was Ice's Icelance with Brittle for Numb; now the spike sets up a teammate: whoever spends the Mark cracks the target.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Brittle, or 2 Brittle if the target has no Buffs.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies, and the frost on each deepens a step: Numb becomes Chilled, and Chilled becomes Frostbitten, each for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Glittering Nova, 25 damage and 1 Brittle to all; now each Frost debuff sets up the next one down the chain.

before.effect: 25 damage and 1 Brittle to all enemies.

rows.effect: 10 damage. Removes all Brittle from the target; the user gains 10 Shield per stack removed.
Summons 2 Sentinels (15 HP, always have Diamond) for 3 turns. Glint (r): 10 damage and 1 Brittle.
Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, every enemy without Brittle gains 1, and every enemy with Brittle takes 10 damage.

history.why: Was Ice's Blizzard with Brittle for Frostbitten; now it works across the enemy team, cracking the clean and hitting the cracked.

before.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns for 3 turns, target enemy takes 10 damage and gains 1 Brittle.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. It chips away one of their Frost debuffs, other than Brittle, for 10 more damage.

history.why: Was Flaw, a plain Brittle-conditional stab; now a new outlet that spends a Frost debuff for damage.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the target has Brittle.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage. If the target has 2 or more Brittle, it Shatters them now.
Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered. For 2 turns after it triggers, every Chilled enemy's skills cost 1 more.

history.why: Was Water's Dunk with Numb in place of Confusion; now a rule bend that turns every Chill on the enemy team into a cost increase, not just a cap on discounts.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered and they're Numb for 2 turns.

history.why: Was the base Mislead with Brittle added; now it counters support instead, and pushes Ice's Numb (no giving Buffs) further.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain 2 Brittle.

rows.effect: 15 damage, then target enemy is encased: Stunned for 2 turns, with Diamond for as long as the Stun lasts.

history.why: Was the base Stun with Brittle added; now a long lockdown whose price is that the encased enemy is burst-proof.

before.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun. Targets with a Frost debuff also gain 2 Brittle.

rows.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 2 Might, 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus. The first single hit of 25 or more damage shatters it: all of it ends, and the user is Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Faceted Grace, a Brittle-spreading dance; now a flawless, oversized Dance that breaks the moment one big hit lands.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each of their damaging skills also gives a random enemy 1 Brittle.

history.why: Was the base Dance with Diamond; now it turns every attack into Brittle for the enemy team.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Diamond and 2 Swiftness, and 1 Focus now.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20. For 2 turns, they can't lose more than 25 HP in a single turn.

history.why: Was a heal plus Numb on the last attacker; now it caps how much HP the ally can lose in a turn, which no other Heal does.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, and the enemy who last damaged them is Numb for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Ice's Freeze Wound with Diamond for Armor; now the heal answers the attacker, stopping them from buffing.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15 and gains Diamond for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Target ally gains Diamond for 2 turns. When it ends, they heal half the damage it prevented, up to 30.

history.why: Was Ice's Boreal Aegis with Diamond for Frostborn; now the diamond banks what it stops and pays it back as healing.

before.effect: Target ally gains Diamond for 2 turns.

rows.effect: For 2 turns, target enemy gains 1 Brittle each time they use a skill.

history.why: Was Ice's Hypothermia with Brittle for two of its debuffs; now every skill the target uses cracks them further.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 2 Brittle and is Numb for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, allies who damage them become Frostborn for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Ice's Chilling Grasp plus a heal on Shatter; now the team's hits earn them Frostborn, pushing Ice's own buff further.

before.effect: 20 damage and Numb for 1 turn. If this Shatters the target, the user heals 15.

rows.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain Diamond for 1 turn.
25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a second enemy, a Frostbitten one if there is any. A Frostbitten enemy hit this way is also Numb for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Cleaving Shards, Brittle to both targets; now Frostbitten steers the second hit and sets up Numb.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to the other enemy with the most Brittle (a random one if none has any). Each gains 1 Brittle.

history.why: Was the base Cleave with Brittle on both; now the second shard seeks the most cracked enemy, steering toward a Shatter.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Each gains 1 Brittle.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. The pitch shatters every Shield on the field, the user's side included: every unit loses its Shield and is Shattered for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Resonant Pitch, Brittle with an Intimidate rider; now a symmetrical glass-breaking note that wipes all defenses on both sides.

before.effect: All enemies gain 1 Brittle; those who already had it are also Intimidated for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user gains 30 Shield for 2 turns, linked to every ally: damage any ally takes comes out of it first.

history.why: Was a Shield sized by enemies with Frost debuffs; now one Shield shared by the whole team, a team-wide pool no other Withstand has.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns, plus 10 for each enemy with a Frost debuff (Brittle counts).

history.why: Was Ice's Permafrost with Diamond added; now it grows with how frozen the enemy team is.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield and Diamond for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, and the user has Diamond against their hits for as long. Each hit it caps extends the Taunt by 1 turn.

history.why: Was Dazzling Facets, a Brittle-on-hit Taunt; now Diamond scoped to one foe, whose capped hits keep them locked on the user.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user, they gain 1 Brittle.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Diamond and Immune. When it ends, the Colossus shatters: every enemy gains 2 Brittle.

history.why: Was the base Titan with Diamond for 1 Armor; now the form ends in a shatter that cracks the whole enemy team.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Diamond, 2 Armor and Immune.

kits.name: Ocean
kits.tagline: Water without limits: every skill rises and falls like a wave.
kits.taglineHtml: Water without limits: every skill rises and falls like a wave.
kits.introHtml:
• Crest and Trough: each Ocean skill has two forms. Its first use is the Crest form (attack); after every use it switches, so the next use is the Trough form (sustain or setup), and so on. Both players can see which form is next.
  • Brimming (Buff): Renew healing that would take the bearer above max HP becomes Shield instead, up to 30.

keywords.html: Crest and Trough: each Ocean skill has two forms. Its first use is the Crest form (attack); after every use it switches, so the next use is the Trough form (sustain or setup), and so on. Both players can see which form is next.
Brimming (Buff): Renew healing that would take the bearer above max HP becomes Shield instead, up to 30.

rows.effect: Crest: 25 damage, and one of the target's Buffs washes away. Trough: 15 damage, and one of the user's Debuffs washes away.

history.why: Was Water's Flowing Fist split in two with bigger numbers; now the wave washes a Buff off them, then a Debuff off you.

before.effect: Crest: 25 damage to target enemy. Trough: 15 damage; the user gains 3 Renew and Brimming for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Crest: 30 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Trough: the sea draws back: 15 damage to target enemy, and every enemy loses their Shield.

history.why: Was Water's Waterfall split in two with bigger numbers; now the Trough is the sea pulling back, stripping Shields before the next Crest.

before.effect: Crest: 35 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Trough: 20 damage to target enemy, and the user's other cooldowns drop by 2.

rows.effect: Crest: 15 damage, +5 for each of the user's turns since the last Trough (up to +20). Trough: 10 damage, and the user gains Flow until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was base Charge with Renew bolted on; now the swell grows the longer you hold the Crest.

before.effect: Crest: 20 damage and 1 Focus for the user's next skill. Trough: 10 damage; the user gains 3 Renew.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user. The user gains Brimming for 3 turns and 2 Renew per skill countered.

history.why: Was a two-form counter; now every blocked attack becomes Renew that Brimming banks as Shield.

before.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. Crest: counters any Harmful skill used on the user, and each one's user gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns. Trough: counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and the user heals 20; healing past their max HP becomes Shield.

history.why: Was the base Riposte on Crest and Water's Riverbend plus Renew on Trough; now it slows attackers down, or turns the blow into overflowing healing.

before.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. Crest: counters any Harmful skill used on the user, dealing 20 damage to its user. Trough: counters any Strategic skill used on the user; the user gains Flow and 3 Renew.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might, and the first time they damage each Stunned enemy, that enemy's Stuns last 1 turn longer.

history.why: Was Water's Quiet Fury (Flow and Might) with rising Might; now carries Water's Stun extension onto every hit, so a Stun-lock team wants it.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Flow, and 1 Might at the start of each of their turns, rising like the tide (up to 3).

history.why: Was Water's Quiet Fury with Brimming and Renew for Focus; now the fury rises every turn.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Flow, 1 Might and Brimming, and 3 Renew now.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gains 2 Renew and Brimming for 2 turns. If they were already Brimming, they spend their Shield instead, dealing as much extra damage (up to 20).

history.why: Was Spray, a bland 20-or-5 Shot; now alternates between building Brimming Shield and firing it off.

before.effect: Crest: 20 damage. Trough: 5 damage, and 1 Focus for the user's next skill.

history.why: Was Water's Splash split in two; now the cheapest skill alternates between a hit and cheaper next turns.

before.effect: Crest: 15 damage. Trough: 10 damage, and a random ally gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. Crest: 45 damage on the following turn. Trough: 30 damage on the following turn, and the catch is shared: allies heal 30, split evenly between them.

history.why: Was Water's Tidal Arrow with more damage and Renew; now the Trough harpoon feeds the team with what it lands.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. Crest: 50 damage on the following turn. Trough: 30 damage on the following turn, and all allies gain 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Invisible, 2 turns. Crest: each time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they take 10 damage and their other cooldowns rise by 1. Trough: each time they use a Helpful skill, the user's ally with the least HP heals as much as it healed.

history.why: Was Water's Whirlpool Trap plus 10 damage; now the Crest drags out their cooldowns and the Trough echoes their healing onto your weakest ally.

before.effect: For 2 turns. Crest: each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they take 10 damage and gain 1 Confusion. Trough: each time they use a Harmful skill, a random ally of yours gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains Flow for 2 turns. Each skill they use with Flow gives the ally with the least HP 2 Renew.

history.why: Was a two-form dive; now Flow sets up Renew: each Flowing skill feeds the weakest ally.

before.effect: Crest: the user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn; when it ends, they breach: 15 damage to all enemies. Trough: the user dives deep: Invulnerable for 1 turn, and their Debuffs wash away.

history.why: Was Water's Dive with Brimming added; now it alternates between a breaching attack and a cleansing dive.

before.effect: The user dives deep: Invulnerable for 1 turn, 3 Renew, and Brimming for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Summons a Kraken (40 HP) permanently. Tentacles (r): Crest: 15 damage. Trough: it grabs target enemy: their non-Strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Water's Rainbow Scale Fish Renew on alternate uses; now the Kraken alternates hits and grabs.

before.effect: Summons a Kraken (40 HP) permanently. Tentacles (r): Crest: 15 damage. Trough: target ally gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: 25 damage and a Mark for 1 turn to target enemy. Whoever spends the Mark gains 2 Renew and Brimming for 2 turns.

history.why: Was a two-form Bolt whose forms barely differed; now the Mark is a Brimming prize for whichever ally follows up.

before.effect: Crest: 25 damage and a Mark for 1 turn. Trough: 15 damage and a Mark for 1 turn; whoever spends the Mark heals 15.

history.why: Was Water's Splash split in two with bigger numbers; now the Trough's Mark heals whichever ally cashes it in.

before.effect: Crest: 25 damage. Trough: 15 damage, and a random ally gains 3 Renew.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. Every ally gains Brimming for 2 turns and 1 Renew for each enemy hit.

history.why: Was Tsunami, 30 or 15 AoE; now trades damage for a team-wide Brimming top-up that scales with enemies hit.

before.effect: Crest: 30 damage to all enemies. Trough: 15 damage to all enemies, and every ally's cooldowns drop by 1.

history.why: Was a damage Crest and a Renew-and-Brimming Trough; now the Trough speeds up the whole team.

before.effect: Crest: 30 damage to all enemies. Trough: 15 damage to all enemies; all allies gain 2 Renew and Brimming for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, and the user heals 5. For 2 turns, each extra energy their Confusion makes them pay heals the user 10.

history.why: Was a Shield-strip drain unrelated to Water's play; now a new outlet that turns Water's Confusion into healing for the user.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy; their Shield washes away, and the user heals as much as it held, up to 30.

history.why: Was Water's Drink Deeply with double healing; now it drains an enemy's Shield into the user's health.

before.effect: Removes all Renew from allies; target ally heals 10 per stack removed, and any overheal becomes Shield.

rows.effect: Summons 3 Jellyfish (10 HP) for 3 turns. Stinging Bell (nc): 5 damage. When an enemy kills a Jellyfish, that enemy is Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Undine, a two-form minion; now a swarm of fragile minions that punish whoever clears them.

before.effect: Summons an Undine (25 HP) for 3 turns. Crashing Wave (nc, Uncounterable): Crest: 15 damage. Trough: target ally gains Flow for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Water's Water Elemental with a Renew form; now its Trough lends Flow, so an ally's next skills ignore counters.

before.effect: Summons an Undine (25 HP) for 3 turns. Crashing Wave (nc, Uncounterable): Crest: 15 damage. Trough: a random ally gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to all enemies. While it channels, allies' Renew doesn't lose stacks when it heals.

history.why: Was Water's Call Rain with healing that ramps; now a rule bend that holds every ally's Renew at full while the tide stands still.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, all enemies take 5 damage and all allies heal 5; both rise by 5 each turn it continues.

history.why: Was Water's Call Rain split into alternating turns; now the tide rises, so every extra turn is worth more.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns, alternating each turn: Crest turns deal 10 damage to all enemies; Trough turns give all allies 2 Renew.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. If they're Confused, they lose their footing: the Confusion is spent and they're Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Barnacle Blade, a two-form stab; now Water's Confusion sets up Water's Stun.

before.effect: Crest: 20 damage. Trough: 10 damage, and barnacles cling on: the target takes 5 damage at the end of each of their next 2 turns.

history.why: Was a damage Crest and a Renew Trough; now the Trough leaves something behind that keeps cutting.

before.effect: Crest: 20 damage. Trough: 10 damage; the user gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: 40 Piercing damage to target enemy and 15 to each of their allies. The wave drags the user under too: they're Stunned on their next turn.

history.why: Its one-on-one lock duplicated Dimension's Pocket Arena; now a huge wave that costs the user their next turn.

before.effect: Crest: 30 Piercing damage, 15 more against Stunned targets. Trough: 20 Piercing damage, and the target is dragged under: Isolated for 1 turn.

history.why: Was the base Ravage plus Water's Drown; now the Trough drags the target away from their allies' help.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage. Against Stunned targets, deals 15 more and extends their Stuns by 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. Crest: if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Taunted by the user for 2 turns. Trough: if they use a Helpful skill, it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was the base Mislead plus Water's Dunk; now the siren lures attackers into Taunts and stuns healers.

before.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. Crest: if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn. Trough: if they use a Helpful skill, it's countered and they gain 2 Confusion.

rows.effect: Crest: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun. Trough: every Stunned enemy's Stuns last 1 turn longer, and every other enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Water's Undertow extending Stuns 2 turns instead of 1; now the Trough is a whirlpool over the whole enemy team.

before.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun. If the target was already Stunned, their Stuns last 2 turns longer instead.

rows.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains Flow, Brimming and 1 Swiftness, and 2 Renew at the start of each of their turns. Each time Brimming gives them Shield, they gain 1 Might for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Tidal Dance, alternating Might and Renew turns; now overflow healing becomes Shield and Might.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains Flow, and at the start of each of their turns alternately gains 2 Might for that turn (Crest turns) or 2 Renew and 1 Swiftness (Trough turns), starting with Crest.

history.why: Was Water's Pull of the River plus Brimming and Might; now the dance itself rises and falls turn by turn.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains Flow, Brimming and 1 Might; now, 3 Renew and 1 Swiftness.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 30. Any of it past their max HP becomes 2 Renew per 10, and they gain Brimming for 2 turns.

history.why: Was a two-form heal; now healing a healthy ally banks the excess as Renew that Brimming turns into Shield.

before.effect: Crest: target ally heals 20, +10 per Debuff they have. Trough: target ally gains 20 Shield for 2 turns; whatever is left of it when it ends heals them.

history.why: Was the base Heal and Water's Renewing Spring on alternate uses; now the Trough is a pool of Shield that drains into healing.

before.effect: Crest: target ally heals 25. Trough: target ally gains 4 Renew and Brimming for 3 turns.

rows.effect: Target ally gains Flow for 3 turns; each time their Flow ignores a counter or reflect, they heal 15.

history.why: Was Water's Touch of Grace plus Swiftness and cooldowns; now it pays off Flow each time it matters.

before.effect: Target ally gains Flow for 3 turns and 1 Swiftness, and their cooldowns drop by 1.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. For as long, each time an ally of the user gains Renew, the target gains 1 more Confusion.

history.why: Was Crushing Depths, a two-form Curse; now the team's Renew sets up the enemy's Confusion.

before.effect: Crest: target enemy takes 10 Affliction damage per Debuff they have (up to 40). Trough: target enemy gains 2 Confusion, and their Debuffs can't be removed, for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Water's Airless Helm and the base Curse on alternate uses; now the depths crush the debuffed, then pin every debuff in place.

before.effect: Crest: 15 Affliction damage and 3 Weakness for 1 turn. Trough: target enemy gains 2 Confusion for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, allies who damage them gain 2 Renew and Brimming for 2 turns.

history.why: Was two forms, one of which already gave Brimming; now just that Brimming reward on a full-strength hit.

before.effect: Crest: 20 damage; for 1 turn, each ally hit on the target washes away one of its Buffs. Trough: 15 damage; for 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain Brimming for 2 turns and 2 Renew.

history.why: Was Water's Aqua Ring with more damage; now the team's hits wash the target's Buffs away, or fill the team with overflowing Renew.

before.effect: Crest: 25 damage. Trough: 15 damage; for 2 turns, allies who damage the target gain Flow.

rows.effect: All allies heal 30; healing past max HP becomes Shield, up to 30 each.

history.why: Was Water's Rainsong with Brimming added; now healthy allies get Shield and hurt ones get healing from the same song.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 3 Renew and Brimming for 3 turns.

rows.effect: Crest: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Trough: 10 damage to target enemy and a random other enemy, and each also gains the other's Debuffs.

history.why: Was Water's Water Lash split in two; now the crosscurrent swaps the two targets' Debuffs onto each other.

before.effect: Crest: 15 damage to all enemies. Trough: 10 damage to all enemies; if the user has Flow, each gains 1 Weakness.

rows.effect: All enemies gain 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns. Every Invisible effect they own is revealed, and any they create in the next 2 turns is revealed as it's made.

history.why: Already revealed enemy Invisible effects once; now its echolocation keeps revealing new ones for 2 turns, a Shout that answers counters and Traps.

before.effect: All enemies gain 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns, and every Invisible effect they own is revealed.

history.why: Was Water's Whale Call with bigger numbers; now the song finds hidden counters and Traps like echolocation.

before.effect: All enemies gain 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns. Stunned or Taunted ones take 20 Affliction, and their Stuns last 1 turn longer.

rows.effect: The user gains 30 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, whatever is left of it crashes outward as damage, split evenly among all enemies.

history.why: Was Seawall, 30 Shield or 10 to all; now any Shield the enemy doesn't break comes back at them as damage.

before.effect: Crest: the user gains 30 Shield for 1 turn. Trough: every ally gains 10 Shield for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Water's Aqua Veil split in two with bigger numbers; now the Trough raises a wall for the whole team.

before.effect: Crest: the user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. Trough: the user gains 3 Renew and Brimming for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each Harmful skill they use while Taunted gives the user 2 Renew.
For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Brimming, and at the end of each of their turns they bite the enemy with the least HP for 15 damage and gain 2 Renew.

history.why: Was Water's Naiad Form with Brimming added; now the Leviathan hunts the weakest enemy every turn.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 2 Armor, 1 Might and Brimming, and 2 Renew at the start of each of their turns.

kits.name: Thunder
kits.tagline: The sound after the flash: every strike lands twice, and the roar drowns out the enemy's tricks.
kits.taglineHtml: The sound after the flash: every strike lands twice, and the roar drowns out the enemy's tricks.
kits.introHtml:
• Resound: damage from a Resound skill echoes. At the start of the user's next turn, each unit it damaged takes half that damage again (rounded up to 5), and the user gains 1 Charge per unit echoed.
  • Deafened (Debuff): counters, reflects and Traps that belong to the bearer can't trigger while it lasts.

keywords.html: Resound: damage from a Resound skill echoes. At the start of the user's next turn, each unit it damaged takes half that damage again (rounded up to 5), and the user gains 1 Charge per unit echoed.
Deafened (Debuff): counters, reflects and Traps that belong to the bearer can't trigger while it lasts.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. It Resounds twice, at the start of each of the user's next 2 turns.

history.why: Was Lightning's Jolt with 5 more damage and Resound; now a small clap that keeps rolling for two turns.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +5 per Charge the user has. Resound.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. Resound, and the echo also hits each of their allies.

history.why: Was the base Smash with Resound; now the splash arrives a turn later, as the echo.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Resound.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and 1 Focus for the user's next skill. If that skill hits them, they're Deafened for 2 turns before it lands.

history.why: Was a Resound-granting Charge; now the boom arrives ahead of the follow-up, so the next skill can't be countered or reflected by them.

before.effect: 15 damage. The user's next damaging skill also Resounds.

history.why: Was the base Charge plus Lightning's Charged Dash plus Resound; now it sets up the next skill to echo.

before.effect: 15 damage; the user gains 1 Charge, and 1 Focus for their next skill. Resound.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Deafened for 2 turns and Sapped.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and each time they gain Charge, a random enemy takes 10 damage.

history.why: Was the base Rage with 3 Charge; now every Charge the user gains calls down a strike.

before.effect: The user gains 3 Charge, then 1 Might and Immune for 3 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The strike arcs back along their Sapped: they lose all of it, and the user gains 1 Charge per stack.

history.why: Was Peal, a third cheap Resound hit; now Sapped on the enemy pays off as Charge for the user, at the cost of the Sapped.

before.effect: 15 damage. Resound; against a Sapped target, the echo is as strong as the hit.

history.why: Was Lightning's Zap with Resound added; now Sapped targets ring twice as loud.

before.effect: 15 damage, and the user gains 1 Charge. Resound. Costs r instead while the user has Charge.

rows.effect: Channeled. The flash: 10 damage to target enemy now, and they're Deafened for 1 turn. The thunder: 40 Piercing damage to them on the following turn.

history.why: Was Lightning's Particle Beam with 10 more damage and Resound; now the flash and the thunder land a turn apart.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 40 Piercing damage to target enemy and to every Sapped enemy. Resound.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time one of target enemy's counters, reflects or Traps would trigger, it fails, and they take 25 damage and are Deafened for 2 turns. If nothing triggers it, they're Sapped when it ends.

history.why: Was Lightning's Tesla Coil with bigger numbers and Deafened; now it's a trap for trappers.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy uses a skill, they take 20 damage, are Sapped, and are Deafened for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and the last skill they used before this comes off cooldown.

history.why: Was Invulnerable plus 2 Charge, an upgrade of Lightning's Blink; now lightning strikes twice: it readies the user's last skill again, cooldown utility no other Maneuver has.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains 2 Charge.

rows.effect: Summons a Thunderbird (30 HP) permanently. Wingclap (Sr): 10 damage to all enemies, Resound. When it dies, every enemy is Deafened for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Lightning's Storm Hawk with Resound for Sap; now its wings hit the whole team, and its death silences their tricks.

before.effect: Summons a Thunderbird (30 HP) permanently. Wingclap (r): 15 damage, Resound. Call the Storm (I): target ally gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: 25 damage and a Mark for 1 turn. The hit that spends the Mark Resounds, whoever it's from.

history.why: Was Lightning's Innervate with Resound added; now it hands the echo to a teammate.

before.effect: 20 damage, and Saps the target. Resound.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. Resound. The user spends all their Charge, and the echo repeats once more for each Charge spent, a turn apart.

history.why: Was Lightning's Static Burst with 5 more damage and Resound; now Charge buys more echoes instead of burst.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. Consumes the user's Charge for 10 more per Charge. Resound.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. All Charge on the enemy side is grounded: it's removed, and the user heals 10 per Charge.

history.why: Was Lightning's Siphon Charge taking all of it; now it drains every enemy's Charge into healing.

before.effect: 10 damage. The user takes all of the target's Charge, and Saps them.

rows.effect: Summons a Thunderhead (25 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of your turns, it strikes the unit with the most Charge on the field, either side, for 20 damage (a random enemy if no one has any).

history.why: Was a Resound minion much like Thunderbird; now a lightning rod that hits whoever holds the most Charge, allies included.

before.effect: Summons a Thunderhead (20 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 10 damage to a random enemy, with Resound.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns. Nothing lands until it ends; then every enemy takes 10 damage per turn it lasted, and it Resounds.

history.why: Was Lightning's Lightningrod plus random damage plus Resound; now it builds to a crescendo the enemy wants to cut short.

before.effect: Channeled. The user has Stormborn while channeling, and at the end of each of their turns deals 10 damage to a random enemy, with Resound.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. The user discharges all their Charge into them: 1 Sapped per Charge spent.

history.why: Was a Resound stab with a Sapped rider; now the user's Charge sets up the target's Sapped.

before.effect: 15 damage. Resound. If the target is Sapped, the user gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, their Sapped can't be removed, and it takes effect at 2 stacks instead of 3.

history.why: Was 25 Piercing plus 15 more if the target had a counter or Trap; now a rule bend that makes Sapped bite sooner and stick.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage. If the target has an active counter, reflect or Trap, it's destroyed and they take 15 more.

history.why: Was Lightning's Malectrocute with 5 more damage and Deafened; now it tears through the target's tricks.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +10 if the user is Charged and +10 if the target is Sapped. Sapped targets are also Deafened for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they and all their allies are Deafened for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Lightning's Hologram widened to every enemy; now one caught attack silences their whole team.

before.effect: For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a Harmful skill is countered and Deafened for 2 turns, and the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun. Resound; the echo also stuns their Strategic skills for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Lightning's System Shock turned into a full Stun; now the echo brings a second, lighter stun.

before.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun, or 2 turns if the target is Sapped. Resound.

rows.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each enemy they damage is Deafened for 1 turn. Each time a Deafened enemy's counter, reflect or Trap fails to trigger, the user gains 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Storm Drummer, which just made everything Resound; now keeps enemies Deafened and profits from their failed tricks.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and all their damaging skills Resound.

history.why: Was Lightning's Three Storm Breaths with Resound added; now it's purely the echo engine on the base Dance.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Stormborn and Conduit, and all their damaging skills Resound.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20. For 2 turns, their Charge can build past 3 to 5; at 5, it's spent and they generate 2 extra energy next turn.

history.why: Was a heal that ended Stuns and gave Charge if it did; now a rule bend on the Charge cap, so a Charge build can bank a bigger turn.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, and their Stuns and Sleep end; if they had any, they also gain 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Lightning's Defibrillate plus 1 Charge; now it restarts a Stunned ally.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, +5 per Charge the user has, and gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: For 2 turns, each time target ally damages an enemy, one of the ally's Sapped stacks moves onto that enemy; if the ally has none, the enemy gains 1 Sapped.

history.why: Was 2 Charge and Stormborn, more of Lightning's own Buffs; now lets an ally discharge their own Sapped into enemies through their attacks.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Charge and Stormborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Deafened for 2 turns, and gains 1 Sapped for each skill they use during it.

history.why: Was Lightning's Power Drain with Deafened added; now acting while deafened drains their energy.

before.effect: Target enemy is Deafened for 2 turns and Sapped.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each time an ally damages them, every enemy takes 5 damage.

history.why: Was Lightning's Apply Polarity with 10 more damage and Resound; now each ally hit tolls across the enemy team.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain 1 Charge. Resound.

rows.effect: All allies heal 15. Until the user's next turn, each skill an enemy uses rolls back as an echo: all allies heal 10 more.

history.why: Was Skyward Chorus, a heal with one echo; now the enemy's own actions drive the team's healing.

before.effect: All allies heal 20, and it echoes: they heal 10 more at the start of the user's next turn.

history.why: Was Lightning's Signal Boost made team-wide; now the healing itself Resounds.

before.effect: All allies heal 15; then each Charged ally heals 10 more per Charge.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. Resound, but the echo forks to a random other enemy instead, at full strength.

history.why: Was Lightning's Arc widened to Sapped targets, plus Resound; now the second hit is the echo, a turn later.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and to every Marked or Sapped enemy. Resound.

rows.effect: All enemies are Deafened for 2 turns, and any of them channeling a skill stops.

history.why: Was Lightning's Crackle with Deafened added; now the roar also breaks concentration.

before.effect: All enemies are Deafened for 1 turn and Sapped.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. Damage it absorbs echoes back: at the start of the user's next turn, each attacker takes half of what they dealt to it.

history.why: Was Lightning's Lightning Cage lasting a turn longer; now what hits the Shield rings back at the attacker.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield plus 10 per Charge for 2 turns, and gains 1 Charge whenever it takes damage.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. The peal deafens the rest of their team: every other enemy is Deafened for as long.

history.why: Was a Resound retaliation Taunt; now the Taunted enemy's allies lose every counter, reflect and Trap that could cover them.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns; each time they damage the user, they take 10 damage that Resounds.

history.why: Was the base Taunt plus Lightning's Aggro Signal reflect; now every forced attack rings back at the attacker, twice.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. The first Harmful skill they use on the user is Reflected.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and draws the storm: enemy skills that would hit more than one of the user's allies hit only the user instead.

history.why: Was Stormborn, Armor and a flat damage reflect, close to Lightning's EXO-Armor; now a lightning rod that pulls every area attack onto the user.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Stormborn, and anyone who damages them takes 10 damage.

kits.name: Cloud
kits.tagline: Wind that gathers instead of rushing: slow, telegraphed, and heavy when it breaks.
kits.taglineHtml: Wind that gathers instead of rushing: slow, telegraphed, and heavy when it breaks.
kits.introHtml:
• Drift: a Drift skill hangs in plain sight and lands at the start of the user's next turn, on the same targets if they're still valid (otherwise on another valid one). It still lands if the user is Stunned, but is lost if they die. Counters and Traps react when it lands. Drift skills cost less and hit harder than an instant version would.
  • Aloft (Buff): the bearer counts as Leaping (+5 direct damage, and Wind's Leaping payoffs) for its whole duration; dealing damage doesn't end it. Unlike a Leap, it gives no Invulnerability.

keywords.html: Drift: a Drift skill hangs in plain sight and lands at the start of the user's next turn, on the same targets if they're still valid (otherwise on another valid one). It still lands if the user is Stunned, but is lost if they die. Counters and Traps react when it lands. Drift skills cost less and hit harder than an instant version would.
Aloft (Buff): the bearer counts as Leaping (+5 direct damage, and Wind's Leaping payoffs) for its whole duration; dealing damage doesn't end it. Unlike a Leap, it gives no Invulnerability.

rows.effect: Drift. 35 damage to target enemy when it lands.

It builds for 2 turns instead of 1: at the start of the user's second turn from now, 50 damage to target enemy and 30 to each of their allies. It still lands if the user is Stunned, but is lost if they die.

history.why: Was Cumulus Crash, a plain Drift Smash; now an expensive, two-turn thunderhead with the kit's biggest hit, telegraphed a full turn longer.

before.effect: Drift. When it lands, 30 damage to target enemy and 20 to their allies.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and the user gains Aloft for 2 turns. If they were already Aloft, they dive instead: the target's non-Strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Wind's Launch with Aloft for Rushing; now it rises, then dives on the second use.

before.effect: The user gains Aloft for 2 turns, and 1 Focus for their next skill.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Isolated for 1 turn, and the user gains Aloft for 2 turns.
For 3 turns, the user is Aloft and gains 1 Might, and any Debuff applied to them drifts off at the start of their next turn.

history.why: Was Wind's Chainbreaker lasting a turn longer, plus Aloft; now Debuffs can't stay on the user past a turn.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes all Debuffs from the user; for 3 turns they're Aloft and Immune.

rows.effect: 15 damage to every other unit on the field that isn't Leaping or Aloft, the user's allies included.

history.why: Was Hailstone, a bare Drift Shot; now cheap hail that falls on both sides and spares only those in the air.

before.effect: Drift. 25 damage when it lands.

rows.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to every enemy who used a Harmful skill in the meantime, and 15 to the rest.

history.why: Was Wind's Elegant Sweep with an Aloft bonus; now the squall hits hardest on whoever attacked while it gathered.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to all enemies, or 40 if the user is Aloft.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each skill target enemy uses gathers a cloud over them. When it ends, 15 damage per cloud Drifts onto them.

history.why: Was Wind's Float Noose with its damage Drifting; now it stores up a storm the target builds themselves.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they're Isolated for 1 turn and 15 damage Drifts onto them.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and begins Rushing. For 3 turns, their Rushing doesn't end after a turn with no skill used.

history.why: Was Invulnerable plus Debuff removal, like Ocean's Sounding and Crystal Cocoon; now a rule bend that lets a Wind character hold Rushing through idle turns.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and all their Debuffs evaporate.

history.why: Was Wind's Bound with Aloft for Leaping; now it's the cleanse Wind keeps in Chainbreaker, on a dodge.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains Aloft for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Summons a Sky Whale (50 HP) permanently. Rain Down (r): Drift; when it lands, all allies heal 10. Breach (A): Drift; when it lands, 20 damage to all enemies.

history.why: Was Wind's Grand Eagle with Aloft for Leap; now a slow sky beast whose rain and dives land a turn later.

before.effect: Summons a Sky Whale (50 HP) permanently. Carry (A): target ally gains Aloft for 2 turns. Rain Down (r): Drift, 20 damage.

rows.effect: Drift. When it lands, 30 damage to the enemy with the least HP, and a Mark on them for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Wind's Compressed Bolt with its damage Drifting; now it picks its target when it lands, hunting the weakest.

before.effect: Drift. 30 damage when it lands; if the target is Immobile, their non-Strategic skills are also stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 30 damage to all enemies. It doesn't end the user's Leaping, and if they weren't Leaping, they Leap once it resolves.

history.why: Was a bare 40-damage Drift; now a Leaping rule bend that keeps or starts a Leap for the next skill.

before.effect: Drift. 40 damage to all enemies when it lands.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, and the user heals as much. Drift: when it lands, it drains them again for 15.

history.why: Was Wind's Sap Speed plus Shield removal; now a drain that returns for more a turn later.

before.effect: 5 damage. Removes the target's mobility buffs and Shield; the user gains 1 Swiftness per buff removed.

rows.effect: Summons 2 Cloudlings (10 HP) for 3 turns. Drizzle (nc): Drift, 10 damage. When a Cloudling dies, it breaks into rain: all allies heal 10.

history.why: Was Wind's Wind Sprites with Drift; now killing them rains healing on your team.

before.effect: Summons 2 Cloudlings (10 HP) for 3 turns. Drizzle (nc): Drift, 10 damage.

rows.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to all enemies. While it lasts, every ally is Aloft.

history.why: Was Wind's Vortex with Aloft on the user; now the whole team rides the clouds while it lasts.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns; the user is Aloft while channeling.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. The user spends all their Swiftness, dealing 10 more per stack.

history.why: Was a Drift stab with an Immobile bonus; now a new outlet that cashes banked Swiftness for damage.

before.effect: Drift. When it lands, 15 damage, or 30 if the target is Immobile by then.

history.why: Was Wind's Airknife with Aloft for Rushing; now it Drifts, giving the team a turn to pin the target down.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 if the user is Aloft or Leaping.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage. If the user is Aloft, they end it to deal 20 more.
Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and for 2 turns they count as Immobile even if they have mobility skills or buffs.

history.why: Was a counter that made the user and an ally Untargetable, unrelated to Wind; now an enabler that switches on Wind's Immobile payoffs against any enemy.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and the user and a random ally become Untargetable for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun to target enemy. The user is Aloft for as long as the target stays Stunned.

history.why: Was a bare Drift Stun; now ties Aloft to the Stun, so extending the Stun keeps the user in the air.

before.effect: Drift. When it lands, 20 damage and a 1-turn Stun.

rows.effect: For 4 turns, the user is Aloft and gains 1 Focus. At the start of each of their turns, a random enemy loses their mobility buffs.

history.why: Was Wind's Top Speed with Aloft for Rushing; now it grounds a random enemy each turn.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user is Aloft and Ghosted; now, 1 Focus and 2 Swiftness.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15. For 1 turn, each hit they take is held in the cloud and lands at the start of the user's next turn instead, 10 lower.

history.why: Was Gentle Rain, a bare Drift heal; now it postpones the ally's incoming hits, buying a turn to heal them before the damage arrives.

before.effect: Drift. Target ally heals 35 when it lands.

rows.effect: Target ally gains Aloft for 2 turns, above the fray: any Taunt on them ends, and they can't be Taunted while Aloft.

history.why: Was Wind's Swiftwind with Aloft; now it frees an ally from Taunts.

before.effect: Target ally gains Aloft for 3 turns and 1 Swiftness.

rows.effect: For 2 turns, target enemy's skills Drift: each lands at the start of their next turn instead of when it's used.

history.why: Was a formula (Confusion if Immobile, else lose mobility buffs); now delays every skill the enemy uses by a turn, so their Invulnerability, heals and counters all arrive late.

before.effect: If target enemy is Immobile, they gain 2 Confusion for 2 turns; otherwise they lose all mobility buffs.

history.why: Was Wind's Headwind plus a lockout; now it grounds a target, then becalms them on the next use.

before.effect: Target enemy loses all mobility buffs, gains 1 Weakness, and can't gain mobility buffs for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them loses a Debuff.

history.why: Was Wind's Feathermark with Aloft for Leap; now the team's hits cleanse them.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain Aloft for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Drift. When it lands, all allies heal 30 and gain 1 Swiftness.
20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, and the user gains Aloft for 1 turn. If they were already Aloft, the second hit goes to the enemy with the least HP instead.

history.why: Was a split instant-and-Drift Cleave; now Aloft gives the user the vantage to aim its second hit.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy now. Drift: 20 damage to a random other enemy when it lands.

history.why: Was Wind's Falling Slam with 5 more damage and Aloft; now the second hit Drifts in a turn later.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Costs 1 less while the user is Aloft.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Each ally with Swiftness trades 1 of it to begin Rushing.

history.why: Was Thunderclouds Gather, Intimidate plus Drift damage; now Swiftness sets up Rushing across the team.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and 15 damage Drifts onto each of them.

rows.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. If it breaks while they're Rushing, they Leap.

history.why: Was Shield that broke into Untargetable, using no Wind status; now Rushing sets up a Leap when the Shield goes.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. If it breaks, they vanish into the cloud: Untargetable for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Wind's Slipstream with Aloft for Rushing; now breaking the Shield hides the user.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns, or 35 if they're Aloft.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each skill they use while Taunted Drifts 10 damage back onto them.

history.why: Was Wind's Piercing Cry plus a mobility lockout; now every attack they make returns to them a turn later.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn, or 3 turns if they're Immobile; they can't gain mobility buffs while Taunted.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and Aloft; at the end of each of their turns, 15 damage Drifts onto the enemy who last damaged them.

history.why: Was Wind's Djinnform with Aloft for the Leap; now the titan answers every attacker a turn later.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 20 Shield, Immune and Aloft.

kits.name: Evolution
kits.tagline: Poison that adapts: every use makes the skill stronger.
kits.taglineHtml: Poison that adapts: every use makes the skill stronger.
kits.introHtml:
• Evolve: each Evolution skill has three stages. It starts at Stage I and goes up one stage each time it's used, then stays at III, unless the skill says otherwise. Each row gives Stage I, then what II and III change; a later stage keeps the earlier stages' changes unless it replaces them. Stages belong to the skill and both players can see them, so the enemy knows which skills to fear by the late game.

This kit has one new keyword on purpose: Evolve already rewrites every skill three times.

keywords.html: Evolve: each Evolution skill has three stages. It starts at Stage I and goes up one stage each time it's used, then stays at III, unless the skill says otherwise. Each row gives Stage I, then what II and III change; a later stage keeps the earlier stages' changes unless it replaces them. Stages belong to the skill and both players can see them, so the enemy knows which skills to fear by the late game.

rows.effect: I: 20 damage and 1 Toxin to target enemy. II: 20 damage, and their Toxin ticks once now. III: 25 damage, and their Toxin ticks twice now; then this returns to Stage I.

history.why: Was Viper Strike with more Toxin and damage per stage; now it evolves from applying Toxin to cashing it in, then resets.

before.effect: I: 20 damage and 1 Toxin. II: 2 Toxin. III: 25 damage, and Prey targets also gain 1 Vulnerable.

rows.effect: I: 25 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 1 Toxin. II: they gain as much as the target has, at least 1. III: the target takes 5 more per Toxin on their allies.

history.why: Was Plague Stomp adding Toxin and splash back per stage; now it grows into a contagion that copies the target's Toxin onto their team.

before.effect: I: 25 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 1 Toxin. II: the target gains 1 Toxin too. III: their allies also take 15 damage.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. The user's next skill that gives Toxin also gives it to every Prey enemy.

history.why: Was Lunge plus Focus per Prey enemy; now turns any single-target Toxin skill into a spread onto every Prey enemy.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. The user gains 1 Focus for their next skill per enemy already Prey (max 2); then every enemy counts as Prey through the user's next turn.

history.why: Was Lunge handing out its Prey one stage at a time; now charging into existing Prey pays Focus before it spreads Prey.

before.effect: I: 10 damage; the target is Prey through the user's next turn. II: every enemy is. III: the user also gains 1 Focus for their next skill.

rows.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. I: if the user takes direct damage, they heal 15. II: they also lose their Debuffs. III: the skill that hit them is countered instead.
I: all Might in the battle turns into Weakness. II: the user's own is spared, and they gain Immune for 2 turns. III: they also gain 1 Might per stack converted, for 3 turns.

history.why: Was a Might buff that only grew in numbers; now it evolves Viper Stance from a blunt conversion into stealing the enemy's Might.

before.effect: I: for 2 turns, the user gains 1 Might and deals 10 more to Prey. II: 2 Might. III: lasts 3 turns.

rows.effect: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin to target enemy. Until the end of the user's next turn, every enemy with any Toxin counts as Prey.

history.why: Was Venom Spit, an evolving random Debuff; now a Texture bridge where any Toxin on an enemy makes them Prey for a turn.

before.effect: I: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin, Weakness or Vulnerable, at random. II: it picks one the target doesn't have. III: if that makes them Prey, they're also Marked.

history.why: Was Sting adding a second and third status per stage; now the venom adapts to what the target lacks and Marks fresh Prey.

before.effect: I: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin, Weakness or Vulnerable, at random. II: two of the three. III: all three.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. I: 25 Affliction damage to target enemy on the following turn. II: against Prey, it lands at once. III: it also hits every other Prey enemy.

history.why: Was Banewood Javelin with 10 more damage per stage; now it learns to strike Prey instantly, then to volley every Prey enemy.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, I: 25 Affliction. II: 35. III: 45, and 2 Toxin.

rows.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. I: whenever target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Toxin. II: when it ends, they take 10 Affliction per trigger. III: if it never triggered, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Snake Pit with wider triggers and more Toxin; now it hatches for delayed damage and at III punishes an enemy who plays around it.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. I: each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Toxin. II: any skill. III: 2 Toxin each time.

rows.effect: Unstunnable. I: the user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains 1 Focus. II: their Toxin moves to the last enemy who damaged them. III: all their Debuffs do.

history.why: Was Slither plus a cleanse and Swiftness; now the shed skin carries the user's Toxin, then all their Debuffs, back to whoever hurt them.

before.effect: Unstunnable. I: the user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains 1 Focus. II: also removes their Debuffs. III: also 1 Swiftness.

rows.effect: Summons a Parasite (20 HP) permanently, lodged in target enemy: only they can target it, and it dies with them. Feed (r): its host loses 10 HP, and the user's ally with the least HP heals 10.

history.why: Was Mutant Spawn, an evolving minion; now a minion that lives inside an enemy, where only its host can dig it out.

before.effect: Summons a Mutant Spawn (25 HP) permanently. Mandibles (r, Evolves): I: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin. II: the Spawn grows to 40 HP, healed to full. III: Mandibles hits every Prey enemy.

history.why: Was Serpent Fang with bigger numbers per stage (and a Bite name other kits use); now the Spawn itself grows, then its Mandibles hunt every Prey enemy.

before.effect: Summons a Mutant Spawn (25 HP) permanently; its skill Evolves too. Bite (r): I: 5 Piercing and 1 Toxin. II: 10 Piercing. III: 2 Toxin.

rows.effect: I: 20 damage to target enemy; 1 of their Armor turns into Vulnerable. II: all of it does. III: their Shield dissolves too, giving 1 Toxin per 10 removed.

history.why: Was Acid Orb's Prey riders returned one per stage; now the acid eats Armor into Vulnerable, then Shield into Toxin.

before.effect: I: 20 damage; Prey targets are Marked. II: they also gain 1 Vulnerable. III: 25 damage, and every target counts as Prey.

rows.effect: 30 Affliction damage to every unit on both sides, minions and the user included, except those at or above 60 HP.

history.why: Was Miasma, an evolving Vulnerable wave; now a cull of every weakened unit on the board, allies too, that spares only the fit.

before.effect: I: 15 damage and 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns to all enemies. II: its damage becomes Affliction. III: 20 Affliction, and Prey enemies keep the Vulnerable permanently.

history.why: Was Acid Wash with Toxin and damage added; now the cloud learns to seep past Armor and Shield, then scars Prey for good.

before.effect: I: 15 damage and 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns to all enemies. II: each also gains 1 Toxin. III: 25 damage.

rows.effect: Removes all Toxin from target enemy. They die if their HP is at most 5 per stack removed; otherwise the user heals 5 per stack.

history.why: Was Devour with a bigger threshold per Debuff; now cashes a Toxin stack in as an execute or as healing.

before.effect: Executes target enemy below 15 HP, +5 per stack of Toxin, Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion they have. The threshold is doubled for minions.

history.why: Was Devour with its threshold raised per stage; now the threshold reads how debilitated the target is.

before.effect: I: executes target enemy below 15 HP (doubled for minions). II: below 20. III: below 25, and the user heals 15 on an execution.

rows.effect: Summons 2 Larvae (15 HP). Nibble (W): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin. I: they last 3 turns. II: whoever kills a Larva gains 2 Toxin. III: they no longer expire.

history.why: Was Spriggan Harasser with one more minion per stage; now killing a Larva poisons its killer, and at III they stay for good.
