before.effect: Summons Larvae (15 HP) for 3 turns: I: 1. II: 2. III: 3. Nibble (W): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 6 turns; Evolves each turn. I: 5 Affliction to all enemies and 1 Toxin to a random one. II: the Toxin goes to a non-Prey enemy. III: Prey enemies gain 1 Weakness.

history.why: Was Nine Plagues whose stages only added Toxin; now the strain seeks out healthy enemies, then weakens the Prey it made.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 6 turns: 5 Affliction to all enemies each turn, and a random enemy gains 1 Toxin. It Evolves each turn it's channeled: II: 2 Toxin. III: every enemy gains 1.

rows.effect: I: 5 Piercing damage; against Prey, the user gains 1 random energy. II: 15 Piercing against targets at or below 40 HP. III: it executes Prey below 15 HP.

history.why: Was Pounce with more damage per stage; now it evolves from an energy thief into a finisher that executes Prey.

before.effect: I: 5 Piercing damage; against Prey, you gain 1 random energy. II: 10 Piercing. III: 15 Piercing, and the target counts as Prey.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable. I: Prey targets gain 2 Toxin. II: a Stunned target's Toxin doubles instead. III: every target's Toxin doubles instead.

history.why: Was Envenom with more Toxin per stage; now it evolves into doubling existing Toxin, which does nothing to a clean target.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable. I: 1 Toxin against Prey. II: 2 Toxin. III: 3 Toxin, against anyone.

rows.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. I: if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain 1 Toxin. II: 1 Toxin per energy it cost. III: it's visible, and any enemy's Harmful skill triggers it.

history.why: Was Numbing Needle's statuses returned one per stage; now it punishes costly skills, and at III becomes a visible warning to the whole team.

before.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. If target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered. I: they gain 1 Toxin. II: and 1 Weakness. III: and 1 Vulnerable and 1 Confusion.

rows.effect: I: target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if Prey. II: they count as Prey while Stunned. III: when it ends, a random Prey ally of theirs is Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Lacerate plus Toxin and a shorter cooldown; now the paralysis makes its victim Prey, then spreads to a Prey ally.

before.effect: I: a 1-turn Stun, or 2 turns against Prey. II: also 1 Toxin. III: cooldown drops to 2.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness at the start of each of their turns. Each enemy skill that damages them meanwhile deals 5 less to them for the rest of the match (max 15 per skill).

history.why: Was a Prey-gated Swiftness and Focus formula; now the user adapts to each skill that hits them, a lasting per-skill resistance no other kit has.

before.effect: For 3 turns, at the start of each of the user's turns, they gain 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus if any enemy is Prey. Prey enemies can't gain Swiftness.

history.why: Was Poison's three stance conversions in one, strictly better; now a mobility buff that runs on Prey and pins Prey down.

before.effect: Every enemy's Might, Armor and Focus turn into as many Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion. (Poison's three stances in one.)

rows.effect: I: target ally heals 20. II: they lose their Toxin and heal 10 more per stack removed. III: the same healing repeats at the start of their next turn.

history.why: Was a heal that grew by 10 per stage; now it evolves into a cure that scales with the Toxin removed, then regrows next turn.

before.effect: I: target ally heals 20. II: 30. III: 30, and removes all their Toxin.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and Toxin on them heals them for its damage instead of harming them.

history.why: Was Viper's Crest plus Antidote's Remission conversion; now lets self-Toxin play (Bad Stomach and the like) feed the ally instead of hurting them.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns, and their Weakness and Vulnerable turn into as many Might and Armor.

history.why: Was Viper's Crest with Armor and a Toxin ward added per stage; now it runs Poison's conversions backwards, turning an ally's Debuffs into Buffs.

before.effect: I: target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns. II: also 1 Armor. III: also can't gain Toxin for 3 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each Debuff stack on them counts as 2 toward Prey.

history.why: Was Swamp Toxins with more Toxin per skill; now bends the Prey count so any Poison Debuff turns the target into Prey sooner.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Toxin and 1 Confusion for 2 turns. Each skill they use while Confused gives them 1 more Toxin.

history.why: Was Swamp Toxins with more stacks per stage; now the fever feeds on every skill they push through the Confusion.

before.effect: I: target enemy gains 1 Confusion and 1 Toxin. II: 2 Toxin. III: 2 Confusion and 2 Toxin.

rows.effect: Evolves each time it triggers, not on use. I: 15 damage to target enemy; for 1 turn, allies who damage them give them 1 Vulnerable. II: 1 Toxin too. III: it lasts 2 turns.

history.why: Was Preymark with longer Prey and more damage per stage; now it only evolves when teammates follow up on the mark.

before.effect: I: 15 damage; the target is Prey for 1 turn. II: 2 turns. III: 20 damage, and allies who damage them gain 1 Might.

rows.effect: I: all allies gain 2 Renew and all enemies 1 Toxin. II: for 2 turns, each enemy Toxin tick heals a random ally 5. III: first, allies' Toxin moves onto random enemies.

history.why: Was Serpentsong with bigger numbers per stage; now allies feed on the enemy's Toxin, then hand their own Toxin over.

before.effect: I: all allies gain 2 Renew and all enemies 1 Toxin. II: 3 Renew and 2 Toxin. III: allies also heal 15.

rows.effect: I: 15 damage to all enemies; if it hits Prey, its cooldown resets. II: if it hits none, the enemy with the most Toxin becomes Prey for 1 turn. III: Prey take 10 more.

history.why: Was Tail Lash with 5 more damage and Toxin; now a use that finds no Prey sets up its own next reset.

before.effect: I: 15 damage to all enemies; its cooldown resets if it hits Prey. II: 20 damage. III: Prey hit also gain 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. While it lasts, their Toxin can't be removed, moved or reduced.

history.why: Was Bad Stomach plus Intimidate on new Prey; now locks every enemy's Toxin in place against cleanses and transfers.

before.effect: The user gains 1 Toxin; then every enemy gains as much Toxin as the user has (max 3). Enemies this makes Prey are Intimidated for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Bad Stomach whose self-Toxin simply went away at II; now the user's own poison sets the dose, and new Prey are Intimidated.

before.effect: I: all enemies gain 1 Toxin, and so does the user. II: the user no longer does. III: enemies also gain 1 Weakness.

rows.effect: The user gains 15 Shield and 1 Armor for 2 turns, during which each Weakness on an enemy lowers their damage to the user by 10 instead of 5.

history.why: Was Coil with Toxin on Shield hits; now doubles the Weakness that Viper Stance and Sting spread, but only against the user.

before.effect: The user gains 15 Shield and 1 Armor for 2 turns. Each time an enemy damages the Shield, they gain 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Coil with Shield and Armor raised per stage; now the shell is spined and poisons whoever hits it.

before.effect: I: 10 Shield and 1 Armor. II: 15 Shield. III: 20 Shield and 2 Armor.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and counts as Prey for 2 turns. If they don't damage the user during it, they fall Asleep when it ends.

history.why: Was Mesmerizing Glare with longer duration and Toxin; now the hood lulls an enemy who won't strike into Sleep.

before.effect: I: target enemy is Taunted and counts as Prey for 2 turns. II: 3 turns. III: they also gain 1 Toxin each turn they're Taunted.

rows.effect: The user is Stunned and Invulnerable for 1 turn, cocooned. Then, for 3 turns, they gain 3 Armor, 2 Might and Immune.

history.why: Was Chimera Form, three stages of Armor, Might and self-Toxin; now a cocoon: the user gives up a turn to emerge as a much stronger Titan.

before.effect: I: for 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and 1 Might, but 1 Toxin each turn. II: a random enemy gains that Toxin instead. III: when it ends, they keep 1 Armor for good.

history.why: Was a Might and Armor form that grew in numbers; now the mutation first poisons the user, then turns outward, then leaves permanent scales.

before.effect: I: for 3 turns, 1 Might and 1 Armor. II: 2 of each. III: also Immune.

kits.name: Life
kits.tagline: Earth that grows: a garden that becomes a grove, and a team that keeps getting bigger.
kits.taglineHtml: Earth that grows: a garden that becomes a grove, and a team that keeps getting bigger.
kits.introHtml:
• Flourish: healing that would take a unit above max HP raises their max HP by the excess instead, up to +30 per unit for the match. The raised max HP lasts for the rest of the match.
  • Bloom: a Seedling (from any source) that is alive at the end of its creator's second turn after appearing becomes a Treant: 40 max HP, healed to full, with Treant Slam (nc): 15 damage. Treants still count as Seedlings.

keywords.html: Flourish: healing that would take a unit above max HP raises their max HP by the excess instead, up to +30 per unit for the match. The raised max HP lasts for the rest of the match.

Bloom: a Seedling (from any source) that is alive at the end of its creator's second turn after appearing becomes a Treant: 40 max HP, healed to full, with Treant Slam (nc): 15 damage. Treants still count as Seedlings.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +5 per 10 max HP the user has gained from Flourish.

history.why: Was Worldfist with a Treant bonus; now it trades minion scaling for the user's own growth.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, +5 per allied minion (+10 per Treant).

rows.effect: 30 damage to target enemy. Every other unit in the battle, on both sides and minions included, heals 15, which can Flourish.

history.why: Was Root Upheaval, splash damage that sped Blooming; now one heavy blow whose tremor heals every other unit on the board, enemies included.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Costs 1 less per allied minion. Each allied Seedling that hasn't Bloomed takes 5 damage and Blooms a turn sooner.

history.why: Was Worldquake with more damage and a Seedling heal; now it tears up the user's own Seedlings, spending their HP to hurry their Bloom.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Costs 1 less per allied minion. Each allied Seedling heals 10.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and the user creates a Seedling that takes the next single-target Harmful skill aimed at the user.

history.why: Was Rolling Crash with a Seedling in place of the Boulder; now the Seedling is cover, so shielding the user and living to Bloom pull against each other.

before.effect: 15 damage, and the user creates a Seedling.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user or one of their minions, dealing 15 Piercing damage to its user.

history.why: Was Shale Guard with 5 more damage and a Seedling; now the counter guards the whole garden, not just the user.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, dealing 15 Piercing damage to its user and creating a Seedling for the user.

rows.effect: The user creates 2 Seedlings and is Immune for 3 turns. Each allied Seedling that Blooms during it gives the user 1 Might for good.

history.why: Was Nature's Wrath with an instant Bloom; now the Seedlings must survive to Bloom, and each that does gives the user permanent Might.

before.effect: The user creates 2 Seedlings, and every allied Seedling Blooms at the end of this turn. The user gains Immune for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Can instead target an allied Treant: it's flung at a random enemy for damage equal to its HP, and lands as a fresh Seedling.

history.why: Was Launch Stone without the Boulder plus Vine Lash's Seedling; now Treants are the ammunition, and a thrown one lands as a Seedling that can Bloom again.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the user has no Seedling, they create one.

rows.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns while it channels, Channel Growth. In 2 turns, 50 damage to target enemy.

history.why: Was Tunnelmaker scaling per minion, Worldfist's trick again; now the wind-up itself tends every allied Seedling.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 50 damage to target enemy, +10 per allied minion still alive when it lands.

history.why: Was Tunnelmaker with Flourish healing in place of the Boulder; now the two-turn wait asks the team to keep its minions alive for the payoff.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 55 damage to target enemy; the user then heals by half the damage dealt, which can Flourish.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each skill target enemy uses tightens the roots: 1 Weakness for 2 turns (max 3). At 3, a Seedling sprouts for the user.

history.why: Was Boulder Trap making Seedlings instead of Boulders; now every skill the target uses tightens the roots, until the garden grows from them.

before.effect: For 2 turns, whenever target enemy creates a minion, it's destroyed and the user creates a Seedling instead. The target is also Immobile.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and creates a Boulder. If the Boulder still stands at the start of their next turn, it cracks open into a Worldsprout.

history.why: Was an expansion where a surviving Boulder gave Armor; now a bridge where a Boulder that survives a turn cracks open into a Worldsprout.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and creates a Boulder. If the Boulder still stands at the start of their next turn, they gain 2 Armor for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Burrow with Flourish healing in place of Ghosted; now it leaves a Boulder the enemy must break to deny the user Armor.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and heals 20, which can Flourish.

rows.effect: Summons an Acorn (5 HP, not a Seedling) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it gains 10 max HP and heals 10, without limit. Crush (r): damage to target enemy equal to half its HP.

history.why: Was Grove Warden, a Seedling that healed once it Bloomed; now an acorn that grows without limit, frail for many turns and a giant if left alone.

before.effect: Summons a Grove Warden (15 HP, a Seedling) permanently. Once it Blooms, at the end of each of your turns it heals your most injured ally 10, which can Flourish.

history.why: Was Forest Stalker with a healing skill swapped in, and Blooming would have shrunk it; now it starts fragile and becomes a healer only if protected until it Blooms.

before.effect: Summons a Grove Warden (50 HP, counts as a Seedling) permanently. At the end of each of your turns it heals your most injured ally 10, which can Flourish.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and the user creates a Boulder. For 3 turns, each time an allied Boulder takes damage, Channel Growth.

history.why: Was Thorn Lash, damage plus a thorned Seedling; now a Texture bridge where every blow on the user's Boulders makes their Seedlings grow.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and the user creates a thorned Seedling: an enemy who damages it before it Blooms takes 15 Piercing damage.

history.why: Was Vine Lash that could also force a Bloom; now its Seedling punishes whoever tries to weed it out.

before.effect: 25 damage. The user creates a Seedling; if they already had 2, one of them Blooms now instead.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. The user creates a Seedling for each enemy left below 50 HP (max 2).

history.why: Was Verdant Burst plus a team heal; now wounded enemies seed the user's garden, so it pays to time it late.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then 25 damage to all enemies; every ally heals 10, which can Flourish.

rows.effect: Sacrifices an allied Seedling or Treant; target ally heals its remaining HP, which can Flourish.
Creates 2 Seedlings (15 HP). Channel Earth (r): its creator gains 1 Might and 1 Armor. If one dies before Blooming, the other Blooms at once.

history.why: Was Sprout Seedling word for word; now the pair is linked, so killing one Seedling grows the other into a Treant.

before.effect: Creates 2 Seedlings (15 HP). Channel Earth (r): its creator gains 1 Might and 1 Armor.

rows.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, every allied minion heals 15, which can Flourish; if the user has no minion, they create a Seedling.

history.why: Was Worldcaller making Seedlings instead of Worldsprouts; now it grows the minions the user already has past their max HP.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they create a Seedling; Seedlings created this way Bloom a turn sooner.

rows.effect: Sacrifices the user's Seedling with the least HP, if they have one, to deal 25 Piercing damage to target enemy; otherwise 10 damage.

history.why: Was a generic anti-healing Stab with nothing Earth in it; now gives spare Seedlings a cheap outlet as ammunition.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they were healed since the user's last turn.

history.why: Was Stonepierce plus an Armor rider; now the brambles catch enemies who have just been healed.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets with Shield or Armor; the user gains 1 Armor if it hits either.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage. Against a Stunned target, 10 of their max HP moves to the user, counting toward the user's Flourish limit.

history.why: Was Stone Drill word for word; now it drinks max HP from a Stunned target to grow the user.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it lands on the user's minion with the most HP instead of its targets. With no minion to take it, it's countered and the user creates a Boulder.

history.why: Was Pitfall with Armor per energy; now turns the user's minions into cover that soaks the enemy's skill.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn; the user gains 1 Armor per energy it cost, for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Pitfall plus a Seedling; now the snare hardens the user in proportion to the skill it caught.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn, and the user creates a Seedling.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 2 turns and gains 25 Shield. When the Stun ends, the user heals whatever Shield is left, which can Flourish.

history.why: Was Earthwrap plus a Seedling heal; now the enemy's vine Shield is stored growth, so breaking it or leaving it is a real choice.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 2 turns and gains 20 Shield; each allied Seedling heals 10.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, at the start of each of the user's turns, they heal 10, which can Flourish, and gain 1 Swiftness if they're above their starting max HP.

history.why: Was Landslide's shape with healing and a Seedling in place of Shield and a Boulder; now a mobility buff that turns growth into Swiftness.

before.effect: The user heals 15, which can Flourish. If they're already above their starting max HP, they also create a Seedling.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20, which can Flourish. If any of it Flourishes, the user creates a Seedling.

history.why: Was Grovetender with 10 more healing; now overhealing a healthy ally plants a Seedling, so topping up the full is a real option.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then target ally heals 25, which can Flourish.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their max HP rises by 20; the extra HP arrives filled and leaves when it ends.

history.why: Was Infuse Earth with a Flourish rider (bland core row); now it grafts 20 max HP onto an ally for 3 turns, which no other Bless does.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random, or both if they're above their starting max HP.

history.why: Was Infuse Earth plus a heal; now it rewards blessing an ally who has already grown.

before.effect: Target ally heals 10, which can Flourish, and gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random.

rows.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns, and meanwhile their skills can't target or damage the user's minions.

history.why: Was Weakness plus more Weakness while the user had a Seedling; now shields a young garden from one enemy until it Blooms.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Weakness, and 1 more at the start of each of their next 2 turns while the user has a Seedling.

history.why: Was Worldmute counting minions instead of Might; now the vines keep tightening for as long as the user's garden survives.

before.effect: For each allied minion, a random enemy gains 1 Weakness for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage. Every ally heals 5, which can Flourish.
All allies heal 20. For 2 turns, damage dealt to any unit on the user's side is split evenly among all of them, minions included.

history.why: Was Verse of Nurturing with Armor per Seedling; now the whole side shares every hit through its roots, so burst on one ally is spread across the team.

before.effect: Channel Growth twice, then all allies heal 20 and gain 1 Armor for 2 turns per allied Seedling (max 3).

history.why: Was Verse of Nurturing with Flourish added; now the user's Seedlings harden the whole team.

before.effect: Channel Growth twice, then all allies heal 25, which can Flourish, and gain 2 Renew.

rows.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, doubled against minions. Each enemy minion it kills becomes a Seedling for the user.

history.why: Was Vine Whirl with Treant scaling in place of the Boulder launch; now it clears enemy minions and replants them as the user's own.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, +5 per allied Treant.

rows.effect: Every allied Seedling Blooms now, and every allied minion heals to full.
The user gains 25 Shield; if they have Flourished HP, they also gain 2 Armor for 2 turns.
Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns by the user's healthiest minion, or by the user if they have none. A Seedling that survives it Blooms when it ends.

history.why: Was Ancient Grudge plus Seedlings; now the garden holds the enemy's attention, and a Seedling that weathers it Blooms.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time). While they're Taunted, each of their Harmful skills gives the user a Seedling.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and 1 Armor per allied minion, and allied minions are Untargetable.

history.why: Was Treant Form counting Treants for Armor instead of Boulders for Shield; now the user shelters the grove so its Seedlings can Bloom.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user counts as a Treant: 1 Might per allied Seedling and 1 Armor per allied Treant; every heal on them can Flourish.

kits.name: Divine
kits.tagline: Holy made absolute: one light that heals whoever it touches on your side and burns whoever it touches on theirs.
kits.taglineHtml: Holy made absolute: one light that heals whoever it touches on your side and burns whoever it touches on theirs.
kits.introHtml:
• Radiant: a Radiant skill can target any unit, and says what it does to an ally and to an enemy. It counts as Helpful on allies and Harmful on enemies, for counters and Traps. Radiant skills that hit a whole side let the player choose the side.
  • Exalted (Buff): counts as Anointed. While Exalted, the bearer's Radiant skills reach both sides: used on an ally, they also hit a random enemy; used on an enemy, they also help the ally with the least HP.

keywords.html: Radiant: a Radiant skill can target any unit, and says what it does to an ally and to an enemy. It counts as Helpful on allies and Harmful on enemies, for counters and Traps. Radiant skills that hit a whole side let the player choose the side.

Exalted (Buff): counts as Anointed. While Exalted, the bearer's Radiant skills reach both sides: used on an ally, they also hit a random enemy; used on an enemy, they also help the ally with the least HP.

rows.effect: Enemy: 20 damage. Ally: heals 20. If its last use was on the other side, 10 more, and the user is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Righteous Blow's Anointed bonus applied to either side; now alternating sides is what empowers it, and alternating Anoints the user.

before.effect: Enemy: 20 damage. Ally: heals 20. If the user is Anointed, 10 more either way.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. If the user is Exalted, it's spent to bring the Hammer down on both sides: every ally also heals 25.

history.why: Was a Radiant hit or team Shield; now an Exalted hit that spends Exalted for a swing across both sides.

before.effect: Enemy: 25 damage, and their allies are Condemned. Ally: heals 25, and their allies gain 10 Shield.

history.why: Was Divine Storm mirrored with 5 more damage; now the splash Condemns the enemy team or Shields the allied one.

before.effect: Enemy: 25 damage to them and 10 to their allies. Ally: heals 25, and their allies 10. The user heals 5 per unit hit.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. If the target is Condemned, it triggers now, and the user is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Holy Advance, a Radiant hit or heal with a discount; now a Texture bridge that sets off an enemy's Condemn and Anoints the user for it.

before.effect: Enemy: 15 damage, and the user's next Helpful skill costs 1 less. Ally: heals 15, and the user's next Harmful skill costs 1 less.

history.why: Was Zealous Rush plus a mirrored heal; now each side's use discounts the user's next move on the other side.

before.effect: Enemy: 15 damage, and the user's next Harmful skill Sanctifies for 1 turn. Ally: heals 15 and gains 1 Focus for their next skill.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and the ally with the least HP heals the damage it would have dealt.

history.why: Was Retribution plus Condemn; now it's a true counter whose stopped damage becomes healing for the neediest ally.

before.effect: For 1 turn, Harmful skills used on the user heal them instead of damaging them, and their users are Condemned.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Exalted. Each time they damage an enemy, the ally with the least HP heals 10; each time they heal an ally, a random enemy takes 10.

history.why: Was Divine Fury with Exalted in place of Anointed; now every skill the user has reaches both sides, so it works without other Radiant skills.

before.effect: The user becomes Exalted for 3 turns.

rows.effect: Enemy: 15 damage; until the user's next turn, allies who damage them heal 5. Ally: heals 15; until then, enemies who damage them are Condemned.

history.why: Was Sunbeam's Anointed heal mirrored to either side; now each side leaves a short-lived mark that pays off for teammates.

before.effect: Enemy: 15 damage. Ally: heals 15. Consumes the user's Anointed for 15 more either way.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 damage to target enemy, and they're Sanctified for 2 turns. Each ally healed by that Sanctify is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was a Radiant 50 damage or 50 heal; now a Texture bridge whose Sanctify Anoints every ally who cashes it in.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn: Enemy: 50 damage. Ally: heals 50 and loses their Debuffs.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first Helpful skill target enemy uses is diverted: its effects land on the user's ally with the least HP instead.

history.why: Was a Helpful-skill counter that Condemned; now it steals the enemy's first Helpful skill for the user's weakest ally.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered and they're Condemned.

history.why: Was Decree plus a Sanctify; now an invisible edict against the enemy's healing and buffs.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned for 2 turns; the first time it triggers, they're also Sanctified for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. If they're Anointed, it's spent, and they're Exalted until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Cloister, since Exalted already counts as Anointed; now it always grants Invulnerable and trades Anointed for Exalted.

before.effect: The user gains Immune for 1 turn, and Invulnerable too if they're Anointed or Exalted.

rows.effect: Summons a Seraph (40 HP) permanently. Burning Light (W): 15 damage to target enemy, and they're Condemned. Whenever an enemy's Condemn triggers, the Seraph Sanctifies them for 1 turn.

history.why: Was a Radiant minion that burned or healed; now a Texture bridge whose Condemns ripen into Sanctify.

before.effect: Summons a Seraph (45 HP) permanently. Burning Light (W, Radiant): Enemy: 15 damage and Sanctify. Ally: heals 15.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Mark for 1 turn. Every Invisible effect in the battle is revealed and ends, on both sides, the user's own included.

history.why: Was Censure, a Radiant hit or heal with Sanctify or Immune; now a light that ends every hidden Trap, counter and Mislead on the board, friend or foe.

before.effect: Enemy: 20 damage and Sanctify for 1 turn. Ally: heals 20 and gains Immune for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. The user is Exalted for 1 turn, plus 1 more turn for each enemy it leaves below half HP (max 3 turns).

history.why: Was a Radiant side choice that echoed if Anointed; now an Exalted blast whose Exalted lasts longer the more enemies it breaks.

before.effect: Choose a side: enemies take 25 Piercing damage, or allies heal 25. If the user is Anointed, it strikes again at the start of their next turn, on the other side.

history.why: Was Holy Nova with a side choice added; now the Anointed repeat flips sides, so one cast both smites and heals.

before.effect: Choose a side. Enemies: 25 Piercing damage each. Allies: each heals 25. If the user is Anointed, it repeats on the same side at the start of their next turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy; the user heals 10. If they're Sanctified, it's spent and the user is Exalted for 2 turns; otherwise they're Sanctified for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Ascension with Exalted in place of permanent Anointed; now it sets up its own Sanctify, so the second use pays off.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. If they're Sanctified, the user becomes Exalted for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Summons a Harbinger (20 HP) for 3 turns. While it lives, the user is Exalted. Trumpet (W): 10 damage to all enemies.

history.why: Was a Radiant minion that Anointed or Condemned once and died; now a herald whose life keeps the user Exalted, so the enemy must kill it.

before.effect: Summons a Harbinger (15 HP) for 3 turns. Proclaim (W, Radiant): Ally: Anointed until the end of their next turn. Enemy: Condemned for 2 turns. Either way, the Harbinger then dies.

history.why: Was Divine Blessing granting Exalted instead of Anointed, with Vengeance's Herald name; now its one proclamation can bless an ally or Condemn an enemy.

before.effect: Summons a Herald (15 HP) for 3 turns. Proclaim (W): target ally is Exalted until the end of their next turn; then the Herald dies.

rows.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns, a random enemy who isn't Sanctified takes 10 damage and is Sanctified; then every ally heals 5 per Sanctified enemy.

history.why: Was Consecration plus a random heal; now the healing grows with how many enemies the light has marked.

before.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns, a random enemy who isn't Sanctified takes 10 damage and is Sanctified, and a random ally heals 10.

rows.effect: Enemy: 10 damage, or 20 if they have more HP than the user. Ally: heals 10, or 20 if they have less HP than the user.

history.why: Was Piercing Light mirrored to either side; now both sides compare against the user's own HP, levelling the scales.

before.effect: Enemy: 10 damage, 20 if they're Condemned or Sanctified. Ally: heals 10, 20 if they have a Debuff. The bonus always applies if the user is Anointed.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Until the end of the user's next turn, their skills don't spend their Anointed.

history.why: Was double damage against Condemned targets; now lets a Holy player cash Anointed skills like Sunbeam repeatedly for a turn.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage. Against a Condemned target, it ends the Condemn without triggering it and deals double.

history.why: Was Crusade plus 15 against Condemned; now cashing a Condemn in for damage means giving up its penalty.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage. Targets above 75 HP are Condemned; targets already Condemned take 15 more.

rows.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. Enemy: if they use a Harmful skill, it's countered. Ally: the first Harmful skill used on them is countered. Either way, the countered skill's user is Condemned.

history.why: Was Martyrdom's Anointing spread to every ally; now Radiant lets it guard an ally instead of watching an enemy.

before.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. If target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and every ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: Enemy: Stunned for 1 turn if Condemned, otherwise Condemned. Ally: loses all Stuns.
For 2 turns, the user is Invulnerable and Immune and their healing is doubled, but they can only use Helpful skills.

history.why: Was Angel's Grace with Exalted in place of Ghosted; now a sanctuary that trades the user's offense for doubled healing.

before.effect: For 2 turns, the user is Exalted, Invulnerable and Immune.

rows.effect: Target ally heals to full HP and loses all their Debuffs.

history.why: Was a Radiant 50 heal or 30 damage; now a free, total restoration held back by a very long cooldown.

before.effect: Ally: heals 50. Enemy: 30 damage and Condemned.

rows.effect: Ally: Exalted until the end of their next turn, and 1 Might for 3 turns. Enemy: they lose Anointed and Exalted, and can't gain either for 2 turns.

history.why: Was a Radiant Anoint or Condemn; now it grants Exalted to an ally or locks an enemy out of Anointed and Exalted.

before.effect: Ally: Anointed until the end of their next turn, and 1 Might for 3 turns. Enemy: they lose Anointed and Exalted, and are Condemned.

history.why: Was Holy Favor granting Exalted instead of Anointed; now Radiant lets it bless an ally or strip an enemy's blessing.

before.effect: Target ally is Exalted until the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: Enemy: Condemned and Sanctified for 2 turns. Ally: loses their Condemn, Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion.

history.why: Was Mark of Heresy plus stripping Anointed; now Radiant turns it around into a cure for Holy's own penalties.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Sanctified for 2 turns, and loses Anointed and Exalted.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and they're Sanctified for 2 turns. Its healing goes to the ally with the least HP instead of the damager.

history.why: Was Karmic Marking mirrored onto allies; now its Sanctify always feeds whoever needs healing most.

before.effect: Enemy: 15 damage, and Sanctified for 2 turns if the user is Anointed. Ally: heals 15, and Anointed until the end of their next turn if the user is.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. Healing past an ally's max HP instead deals that much damage to a random enemy.

history.why: Was Saving Grace with a side choice; now wasted healing crosses over as damage, so it smites harder the healthier the team is.

before.effect: Choose a side. Allies: heal 15 and gain 10 Shield. Enemies: 15 damage and Condemned. If the user is Anointed, it repeats on that side at the start of their next two turns.

rows.effect: Hits the target and one random unit on the other side: enemies take 15 damage, allies heal 15.
Bypass. For 1 turn, no unit on either side can use Harmful skills.

history.why: Was Excoriate retargeted onto recent attackers with a Sanctify rider; now a battle-wide ceasefire that only Helpful play survives.

before.effect: Bypass. Every enemy who used a Harmful skill since the user's last turn is Condemned for 2 turns; Sanctified ones are also Intimidated for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Excoriate with a longer Condemn and damage; now it judges whoever acted against the team last turn.

before.effect: Bypass. Every Sanctified enemy is Condemned for 2 turns, and every Condemned enemy takes 15 damage.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns, and is Anointed while any of it remains.

history.why: Was the stock shield that marks its breaker (Vigilante, Ritual, Assassin); now a new source of Anointed that lasts as long as the Shield holds.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. When it breaks, the enemy who broke it is Sanctified for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Shield of Faith with 10 more Shield; now breaking it Sanctifies the attacker, so the team heals by striking back.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield. If they're Anointed or Exalted, 10 more and Immune for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user, the user is Exalted until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was a Radiant Taunt or ally-centered Taunt; now an Exalted Taunt that turns each blow the user takes into Exalted.

before.effect: Enemy: Taunted and Condemned until they use a new Harmful skill. Ally: every enemy is Taunted by that ally for 1 turn, and the ally gains 20 Shield.

history.why: Was Gleam plus a heal; now Radiant lets the user make any ally the beacon the enemy must attack.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and Condemned until they use a new Harmful skill; when they do, the user heals 15.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Exalted and gains 2 Armor. Whenever they Condemn an enemy, a random ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Grand Crusader plus a heal and an Exalted doubling; now the form turns every Condemn the user lands into an ally's Anointing.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies and 10 healing to all allies. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Armor per Sanctified or Condemned enemy, doubled if Exalted.

kits.name: Evil
kits.tagline: Unholy with nothing held back: it poisons healing itself, and spends souls like coin.
kits.taglineHtml: Unholy with nothing held back: it poisons healing itself, and spends souls like coin.
kits.introHtml:
• Unhallowed (Debuff): any healing the bearer would receive, including Renew and Lifesteal, deals that much Affliction damage to them instead.
  • Tithe N: the skill spends up to N of the user's Soul Fragments for the listed bonus. It still works with none, so Tithe is a choice of which skill to use, not a prompt.

keywords.html: Unhallowed (Debuff): any healing the bearer would receive, including Renew and Lifesteal, deals that much Affliction damage to them instead.
Tithe N: the skill spends up to N of the user's Soul Fragments for the listed bonus. It still works with none, so Tithe is a choice of which skill to use, not a prompt.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. If they were healed since the user's last turn, they take 10 more and are Unhallowed for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Witchblade's Horrify bonus with Unhallowed tacked on; now it punishes an enemy who was just healed by turning their next heals against them.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. Horrified targets take 10 more and are Unhallowed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 40 damage to target enemy; their allies are Horrified for 2 turns. Tithe 2: per Fragment spent, a random one of those allies takes 15 Affliction damage.

history.why: Was Soulcrusher with Tithe buying more damage; now spent souls become Affliction splash on the Horrified allies.

before.effect: 40 damage to target enemy; their allies are Horrified for 2 turns. Tithe 2: 10 more damage per Fragment.

rows.effect: 15 damage, and the user's next Harmful skill drains a Soul Fragment from its target. Tithe 1: that skill also costs 1 less.

history.why: Was Wraithwalk draining 2 Fragments instead of 1; now spending a soul buys Focus that the drain pays back.

before.effect: 15 damage, and the user's next Harmful skill drains 2 Soul Fragments from its target.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user. If the user dies before the end of their next turn, the last enemy it countered dies with them.

history.why: Was Spite, a counter that Horrified and paid Soul Fragments side by side; now a counter that binds its victim's life to the user's.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user and Horrifies its user for 2 turns; each skill countered gives the user a Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Spiteful Retort with Unhallowed added; now every attack it stops feeds the user's souls.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Horrified and Unhallowed for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Tithe all: the user is Immortal for 1 turn per Fragment (max 3). While Immortal, each enemy who damages them loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

history.why: Was Undying Fury plus Might; now the souls spent on Immortality flow back from whoever attacks the user.

before.effect: Tithe all: 10 damage to a random enemy per Fragment. Then the user is Immortal for that many turns (max 3) and gains 1 Might per 2 Fragments spent.

rows.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Soul Fragment the user has. If the target is Unhallowed, the user drains a Soul Fragment from them.

history.why: Was Bone Shard with a Tithe that applied Unhallowed; now it pays Unhallowed off by harvesting souls.

before.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Soul Fragment the user has. Tithe 1: the target is Unhallowed for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. In 3 turns, 70 Affliction damage to target enemy. Each time they're healed meanwhile, it lands a turn sooner.

history.why: Was Soul Lance doubled against healed targets; now a long-fuse doom that the enemy's own healing hurries along.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, doubled if they were healed in the meantime. If they end below 50 HP, the user drains a Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Soul Lance with a Tithe for more damage; now the hidden threat punishes the enemy for healing anyone during the wait.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage; Tithe 2 for 15 more each. If the target ends below 50 HP, the user drains a Soul Fragment.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy would be healed, they take that much Affliction damage instead and are Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Soul Shackle with Unhallowed in place of Weakness; now it springs on healing rather than on any skill.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they're Stunned for 1 turn and Unhallowed for 2.

rows.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn. Tithe 1: they become Invulnerable for 1 turn instead.

history.why: Was Grave Step plus Untargetable; now spending a soul upgrades the escape from surviving hits to avoiding them.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal and Untargetable for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Summons a Fiend (35 HP) permanently. Rend Soul (S): 15 Affliction damage and Unhallowed for 1 turn. Feast (r): drains a Soul Fragment from a Horrified enemy for its summoner.
25 damage to target enemy. If they're Unhallowed, the user also heals them 15, which Unhallowed turns into damage; otherwise they're Horrified for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Fel Bolt with Unhallowed added; now it cashes Unhallowed in with a mocking heal, or Horrifies as Fel Bolt does.

before.effect: 25 damage; the target is Horrified and Unhallowed for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies, +10 per Soul Fragment the user has. For 1 turn, any healing they receive also heals the user.

history.why: Was Soul Blast with a Tithe for Unhallowed; now the enemy's healing feeds the user for a turn afterwards.

before.effect: 25 damage to all enemies, +10 per Soul Fragment the user has. Tithe 1: they're all Unhallowed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Every Horrified enemy takes 5 damage and loses a Soul Fragment to the user; the user heals 10 per enemy reaped.

history.why: Was Drain Soul with healing per Fragment held; now harvests every Horrified enemy at once, an outlet for Horrify spread.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, draining a Soul Fragment; then the user heals 5 per Soul Fragment they have.

history.why: Was Drain Soul with Unhallowed added to its condition; now hoarded souls heal the user, which pulls against spending them on Tithe.

before.effect: 5 damage, and drains a Soul Fragment; 2 if the target is Horrified or Unhallowed.

rows.effect: Summons a Tormentor (25 HP) for 3 turns. Barbed Whip (r): 10 Affliction damage. False Mercy (I): target enemy is Unhallowed for 1 turn; if it takes hold, they then heal 15.

history.why: Was Imp with Unhallowed in place of Horrify (and a Lash other kits use); now its mercy is the attack, a heal that hurts, and it never truly heals an Immune enemy.

before.effect: Summons a Tormentor (25 HP) for 3 turns. Lash (r): 10 Affliction damage. Mockery (I): target enemy is Unhallowed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. Each turn, 10 damage to target enemy, with Lifesteal. While it channels, the user is Immortal, but only this Lifesteal can heal them.

history.why: Was Drain Essence, whose overhealing made Soul Fragments like Black Mass does; now a bridge where Immortal holds the user up while Lifesteal climbs back.

before.effect: Channeled. Each turn, 10 damage to target enemy and the user heals 10; healing past the user's max HP gives them a Soul Fragment per 10 instead.

history.why: Was Drain Life plus Unhallowed and an extra Fragment; now draining while healthy turns surplus life into souls.

before.effect: Channeled. Each turn, 10 damage to target enemy and the user heals 10; the target is Unhallowed while it lasts. If they die, the user gains 2 Soul Fragments.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy; at or above 70 HP, it drains a Soul Fragment. Tithe 1: if it leaves them below 20 HP, they die.

history.why: Was Blighted Dagger plus the base low-HP bonus; now a soul can be spent to make it an execution.

before.effect: 15 damage. At or above 70 HP, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user; below 30 HP, they take 10 more.

rows.effect: 35 Piercing damage to target enemy. The user pays in blood instead of energy: they lose 25 HP, which can't kill them.

history.why: Was Desecrate, 35 Piercing with Horrify or Unhallowed; now the same heavy hit for no energy at all, paid for with the user's own HP.

before.effect: 35 Piercing damage. A target with Buffs is Horrified for 2 turns; one with none is Unhallowed for 2 turns instead.

history.why: Was Lay Waste plus stripping Buffs; now it reads the target and picks whichever curse fits.

before.effect: 35 Piercing damage. A target with Buffs loses them all and is Horrified for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. If target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered, and its targets take the healing it would have given as Affliction damage.

history.why: Was Mirage of Nightmares with Unhallowed in place of the user's buffs; now it turns an enemy's heal into harm on its targets.

before.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. If target enemy uses a Strategic skill, it's countered and they're Unhallowed for 2 turns; the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Target enemy gains 1 permanent Vulnerable, plus 1 permanent Weakness if Horrified. Tithe 1: they're also Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Cripple with Tithe buying more Vulnerable; now a soul buys back the Stun that Unholy's version gave up.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 permanent Vulnerable, plus 1 permanent Weakness if Horrified. Tithe 2: 1 more permanent Vulnerable per Fragment.

rows.effect: 15 Piercing damage to target enemy, and the user gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns (stacking). For those 2 turns, the user's Confusion lowers their skill costs instead of raising them.

history.why: Was Grisly Spectacle plus damage per Confusion; now flips the self-Confusion Unholy dances pile up into a discount.

before.effect: 15 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 per Confusion the user has; then the user gains 1 Confusion for 1 turn (stacking). Every Horrify on enemies lasts 1 turn longer.

history.why: Was Grisly Spectacle extending Unhallowed too; now the user's own Confusion powers it, so each repeat costs more and hits harder.

before.effect: 15 Piercing damage; every Horrify and Unhallowed on enemies lasts 1 turn longer. The user gains 1 Confusion for 1 turn (stacking).

rows.effect: Target ally heals 35. At the end of each of their next 2 turns, they lose 10 HP unless they damaged an enemy that turn.

history.why: Was Consume Lesser pointed at any ally; now a big heal on credit that the ally repays in HP unless they keep attacking.

before.effect: Target ally heals 25; the other ally with the most HP loses 15 to pay for it.

history.why: Was Consume Lesser healing the user for 5 more; now it heals any ally and bills the healthiest one.

before.effect: Deals 15 damage to another ally or an allied minion, and the user heals 25.

rows.effect: Target ally gains Lifesteal for 2 turns. Tithe 2: also 1 Might per Fragment for 2 turns.
Target enemy gains 1 Confusion and is Immortal for 3 turns. Each hit that would have taken them below 5 HP gives its dealer a Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Profanation, Unhallowed that drained Fragments; now a curse that won't let its victim die, so the team can farm them for Soul Fragments.

before.effect: Target enemy is Unhallowed for 2 turns. Each time it hurts them, the user drains a Soul Fragment from them.

history.why: Was Cause Fear with Unhallowed in place of Horrify; now each heal it spoils also hands the user a soul.

before.effect: Target enemy is Unhallowed for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Tithe 1: for 2 turns, each ally who damages them gains a Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Soul Sickness with drain in place of gain; now the user invests one soul so the whole team can farm the target.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target drain a Soul Fragment from them.

rows.effect: All allies heal 25. Then each ally at full HP gives 10 of it back to gain 1 Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Profane Chant with team lifesteal; now a team heal whose overflow becomes Soul Fragments for allies who didn't need it all.

before.effect: 20 damage and 2 Weakness for 1 turn to all enemies; the user's allies split the damage dealt as healing.

history.why: Was Profane Chant with Unhallowed added; now the team drinks what the chant takes, a shared Lifesteal.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, and 2 Weakness and Unhallowed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, then 10 to them and to each of the user's allies. Tithe 1: the allies are spared.
All enemies are Unhallowed until the end of their next turn; any of them healed during it are also Horrified for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Soulshriek with a bigger Tithe buying damage and statuses; now a team-wide window in which the enemy can't safely heal.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Tithe 2: 10 more per Fragment, and if any was spent, they're Horrified and Unhallowed for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user gains 20 Shield, plus 10 drained as Affliction damage from each Unhallowed or Horrified enemy.

history.why: Was Misery draining minions too and doubling the Shield; now it drains cursed enemies instead of the user's allies.

before.effect: Drains 10 HP from each other ally and allied minion; the user gains 20 Shield plus twice the amount drained.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. While they're Taunted, the user is Immortal.

history.why: Was Unrelenting Horror with Unhallowed added; now the tyrant can't fall while the enemy is forced to face them.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns; they're Unhallowed while Taunted. If they're Horrified, the user also gains Lifesteal for that time.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Lifesteal and 1 Armor per Soul Fragment they have (max 4), but can't spend Soul Fragments.

history.why: Was Soul Colossus with double healing; now it keeps the souls instead of spending them, turning a hoard into Armor.

before.effect: Tithe all: the user heals 10 per Fragment, then gains 2 Armor and Immortal for that many turns (max 4).

kits.name: Dimension
kits.tagline: Shadow folded into space: pull a unit out of the fight, or tie two together so one effect lands twice.
kits.taglineHtml: Shadow folded into space: pull a unit out of the fight, or tie two together so one effect lands twice.
kits.introHtml:
• Banished: the bearer leaves the fight until the end of their next turn. They can't act or be targeted by anyone, take no damage, and their effects neither tick nor expire; any channel they hold ends. On an enemy it's a Debuff (Immune stops it); on an ally, a Buff.
  • Entangled: links two or more units on the same side. Any effect applied to one is applied to the others too (effects, not damage or healing). It lasts its duration, or until one of them dies.

keywords.html: Banished: the bearer leaves the fight until the end of their next turn. They can't act or be targeted by anyone, take no damage, and their effects neither tick nor expire; any channel they hold ends. On an enemy it's a Debuff (Immune stops it); on an ally, a Buff.
Entangled: links two or more units on the same side. Any effect applied to one is applied to the others too (effects, not damage or healing). It lasts its duration, or until one of them dies.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. Time folds: this doesn't use up the user's turn, so they can use another skill this turn.

history.why: Was Fold Strike, a Bypassing hit that deepened Sleep; now a light hit that folds time and leaves the user free to act again this turn.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, Bypassing. It doesn't wake a Sleeping target, whose Sleep lasts 1 turn longer instead.

history.why: Was bonus damage and Stealth against Isolated targets; now lets a Sleep player hit Sleepers and deepen their sleep.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, Bypassing. If they're Isolated, 10 more, and the user gains Stealth.

history.why: Was Black Axe with an Entangle rider in place of its kill-Stealth; now Isolated targets pay out damage and Stealth, rewarding Shadow's setup.

before.effect: 25 damage; the target and a random ally of theirs are Entangled for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 30 damage to target enemy and 20 to their allies; then the user is Banished.

history.why: Was a payoff that needed another skill's Entangle; now it hits harder and pays for it with the user vanishing for a turn.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. If the target is Entangled, their partners take 25 instead of 15.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, Bypassing. The user gains Stealth at the start of their next turn unless an enemy targets them first.

history.why: Was passing Stealth on if Stealthed; now a new, board-read way into Stealth after an attack.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, Bypassing. If the user is Stealthed, they pass their Stealth to a random ally and gain 1 Focus for their next skill.

history.why: Was Long Shadow plus Bypass; now the user steps out of Stealth to hide an ally and speed their next move.

before.effect: 10 damage. Stealthy, and the user's next skill is Stealthy and Bypasses.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and its user is Banished.
Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune. Each time a skill of theirs ends their Stealth, its targets are Blinded for 1 turn.

history.why: Was an expansion where broken Stealth empowered the next skill; now a bridge where every exit from Stealth leaves its targets Blinded.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness, and whenever their Stealth ends, their next skill deals 15 more.

history.why: Was Night of Knives with more Might while Stealthed; now rewards breaking Stealth, so each ambush out of it hits harder.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness, +1 Might each time they use a skill while Stealthed (max 3).

history.why: Was Night of Knives plus Ghosted; now it grows with each skill used from Stealth.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and Ghosted.

rows.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Entangled, their partners take it too; if not, they're Entangled with a random ally for 2 turns.

history.why: Was a payoff that needed another skill's Entangle; now it makes its own link, so the next shard echoes.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage; if the target is Entangled, their partners take it too.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy. Channeling and landing it don't end the user's Stealth.

history.why: Was doubled against evasive targets; now lets a Stealthed user snipe without leaving Stealth.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable, doubled if they're Stealthed, Untargetable or Invulnerable when it lands.

history.why: Was Dream Seeker with 5 more damage; now it punishes the target for escaping, which Shadow's own Snipe merely ignores.

before.effect: On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable and reaching them even if Stealthed. It doesn't end Sleep.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Helpful skill, its target is Banished instead of helped.

history.why: Was Dream Chains with Banish in place of Sleep; now it snatches away whoever the enemy tries to heal or buff.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy doesn't use a skill, they're Banished.

rows.effect: The user is Banished, and so is the last enemy who damaged them.

history.why: Was Shadowstep with Banish in place of Ghosted; now the user drags an attacker out of the fight with them.

before.effect: The user is Banished: out of reach, with their effects frozen as they are.

rows.effect: Summons a Void Stalker (30 HP) permanently. Tether (r): target enemy and a random ally of theirs are Entangled for 2 turns. Rend (r): 10 Piercing damage, and Entangled partners take it too.

history.why: Was Spirit Raven with a Tether that nothing paid off; now its own Rend cashes in the links it makes.

before.effect: Summons a Void Stalker (30 HP) permanently. Rend (r): 10 Piercing damage. Tether (r): target enemy and a random ally of theirs are Entangled for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Entangled with a random ally for 2 turns, then takes 20 damage and is Blinded for 2 turns (so both are).
25 damage to all enemies; then the one with the most HP is Banished.
5 Affliction damage to all enemies. Blinded ones take 10 more, and each Blind moves to a random enemy who isn't Blinded.

history.why: Was Drink Darkness paying off Entangled instead of Blinded; now it cashes Blind in for damage and passes it on instead of clearing it.

before.effect: 5 Affliction damage to all enemies. Entangled ones take 15 more, and their Entangle ends.

rows.effect: Summons a Rift (20 HP) for 3 turns. Shunt (I): target enemy is Isolated for 1 turn, or Banished if they already were.
Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to all enemies, and a random ally's Debuff trades places with a random enemy's Buff.

history.why: Was Nightsong with Isolation each turn; now folds the two sides together, swapping one Debuff for one Buff every turn.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns, and each turn a random enemy is Isolated for 1 turn. If it completes, every Isolated enemy falls Asleep.

history.why: Was Nightsong with Banish in place of Sleep; now it Isolates as it goes and puts only the Isolated to Sleep.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns; if it completes, the enemy with the least HP is Banished.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Knifing an Isolated target, alone and unwatched, gives the user Stealth.

history.why: Was Knife from Nowhere, bonus damage if the user went untargeted; now a bridge where knifing an Isolated enemy slips the user into Stealth.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if no enemy has targeted the user since the user's last turn.

history.why: Was Backstab plus Bypass; now it rewards going unnoticed, whether or not the user is Stealthed.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or the target is Blinded. Bypasses.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy; any Blind or Isolation on them lasts 2 turns longer.

history.why: Was doubled against Isolated targets then Isolating an ally; now stretches the Shadow Debuffs already on the target.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the target is Isolated; then a random ally of theirs is Isolated for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Ambush plus Isolated; now it pays off Isolated and spreads it, so the tear keeps widening.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the user is Stealthed; the target is Isolated for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. If target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they're Entangled with a random ally for 2 turns; then they're Isolated for 1 turn, so both are.

history.why: Was Hidden Door, a Texture counter that Stealthed its targets; now an Entangled counter that ties the culprit to an ally and cuts both off from help.

before.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. If target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and each of its targets gains Stealth.

history.why: Was redirecting the countered skill onto the enemy's own ally, Faerie's friendly-fire trick; now the ambushed allies slip into Stealth.

before.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. If target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and used instead on a random ally of theirs.

history.why: Was Illusory Lure's Isolate doubled through Entangle; now the door opens onto the enemy's own team.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Entangled with a random ally for 3 turns and Isolated for 2.

rows.effect: 10 damage, and the target falls Asleep. If damage wakes them, they're Banished instead.

history.why: Was Sap with Banish in place of Sleep; now it keeps the Sleep, and hitting the sleeper extends the lockout at the cost of making them untouchable.

before.effect: 10 damage, then the target is Banished.

rows.effect: The user is Banished. When they return, they gain Stealth, and Ghosted and 1 Focus for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Hall of Phantoms shared with an ally through Entangle; now the user folds out of the fight and returns hidden and Ghosted.

before.effect: The user gains Stealth. If they were already Stealthed, they're Entangled with a random ally for 2 turns, then gain Ghosted, Immune and 1 Focus for 2 turns (so the ally does too).

rows.effect: Target ally is Banished. When they return, they heal 30 and lose their Debuffs.

history.why: Was Touch of Slumber with Banish in place of Sleep; now the ally steps out with their Debuffs frozen and comes back healed and cleansed.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20 and is Banished.

rows.effect: Target ally and a random other ally are Entangled for 2 turns; then target ally gains Stealth.
Target enemy and a random ally of theirs are Entangled for 3 turns. Each time either uses a skill, the other gains 1 Confusion, so both do.

history.why: Was Dark Matter's Entangle-then-Blind with Blinding Powder's Blind; now the link itself punishes acting, so every skill either uses taxes both.

before.effect: Target enemy and a random ally of theirs are Entangled for 3 turns; then target enemy is Blinded for 3 turns.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, allies' skills can target them even if they're Stealthed, Untargetable or Invulnerable.

history.why: Was Shadowbrand plus Bypass; now the brand pins the target within reach of the whole team.

before.effect: 10 damage and Sanctify for 2 turns. Bypasses. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and are Entangled together for 2 turns, but only Buffs pass through this link.

history.why: Was Exodus, which Banished badly hurt allies much as Safe Harbor does; now a team heal that links the team so any Buff one gains, all gain.

before.effect: All allies heal 20; each ally left below 40 HP is Banished, and heals 20 more when they return.

history.why: Was Nightfall with Banish in place of Stealth; now it pulls only endangered allies out of the fight, and they return healthier.

before.effect: All allies heal 20; then the one with the least HP is Banished.

rows.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies, repeated at the start of the user's next turn if they're still Stealthed.

history.why: Was bonus damage per Blind, Isolation or Sleep; now an echo that pays for staying in Stealth.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies, +10 to each who is Blinded, Isolated or Asleep.

history.why: Was Shadow Pulse paying off another skill's Entangle; now it pays off Shadow's own Blind, Isolate and Sleep.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies; Entangled ones take 10 more.

rows.effect: All enemies are Entangled together for 2 turns, then Blinded for 1 turn.
The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. Damage it absorbs is folded across: the ally with the least HP gains that much Shield for 1 turn.

history.why: Was a Shield that gave Stealth when broken; now what the Shield absorbs reappears as Shield on the weakest ally.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. When it breaks, the user gains Stealth.

history.why: Was a pile of Shield, Ghosted and Stealth at once; now the Stealth waits for the Shield to break, so the user vanishes as the hit lands.

before.effect: The user gains 15 Shield and Ghosted for 1 turn, and Stealth.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 1 turn, and every other unit on both sides, minions included, is Banished: the two fight alone.

history.why: Was Hollow Decoy, a decoy that Banished whoever broke it; now it pulls the user and one enemy into a pocket and leaves everyone else outside.

before.effect: Creates a Hollow (5 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn. If they destroy it, they're Banished.

history.why: Was Shadow Mockery plus Isolated; now killing the decoy drags its killer out of the fight.

before.effect: Creates a Hollow (5 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn. If they damage it, they're Isolated for 1 turn.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Entangled with the ally with the least HP, then gains 2 Armor and Immune, so that ally does too.

history.why: Was Faceless One plus Ghosted; now the void wraps the weakest ally in the user's form, sharing its Armor and Immune through the link.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor and Ghosted, and all enemies are Taunted by the user and Isolated.

kits.name: Apocalypse
kits.tagline: The world ending both ways at once, and the shock where fire meets ice.
kits.taglineHtml: The world ending both ways at once, and the shock where fire meets ice.
kits.introHtml:
• Frostfire (Debuff): counts as both an Ignite and Chilled (5 Affliction at the end of its applier's turn, and costs can't be reduced).
  • Thermal Shock: when a unit with a Fire debuff (Ignite, Scorched, Frostfire) gains a Frost debuff (Frostbitten, Chilled, Numb, Frostfire), or the reverse, it takes 15 Piercing damage and is Shattered for 1 turn. Once per unit per turn. Frostfire alone doesn't Shock, but anything of either kind applied after it does.

keywords.html: Frostfire (Debuff): counts as both an Ignite and Chilled (5 Affliction at the end of its applier's turn, and costs can't be reduced).

Thermal Shock: when a unit with a Fire debuff (Ignite, Scorched, Frostfire) gains a Frost debuff (Frostbitten, Chilled, Numb, Frostfire), or the reverse, it takes 15 Piercing damage and is Shattered for 1 turn. Once per unit per turn. Frostfire alone doesn't Shock, but anything of either kind applied after it does.

rows.effect: 20 damage. The target is Ignited if they have a Frost debuff, otherwise Frostbitten for 1 turn.
25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, then the target gains Frostfire. If that Thermal Shocks them, each of their allies with a Fire or Frost debuff is Shocked too.

history.why: Was Chain Detonation's splash plus Frostfire and Foot of the Mountain's Chill; now one Shock on the target cracks through every primed ally.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. The target gains Frostfire; their allies are Chilled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. If that skill hits a Chilled enemy, the cold cracks their Ignite: it ticks twice at once.

history.why: Was a Chill-then-Ignite Thermal Shock setup; now Ice's Chilled sets up an Ignite payoff for players running both.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, who is Chilled through the user's next turn. The user gets 1 Focus for their next skill, which also Ignites its targets.

history.why: Was the kit's apply-the-opposite trick again (as on Tempering Blow); now a cold opener whose follow-up Ignites, a two-turn Shock the user sets up alone.

before.effect: 15 damage, and 1 Focus for the user's next skill. The target is Chilled for 1 turn, or Ignited if already Chilled.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user. Its user gains Frostfire and is Thermal Shocked the next time they use a skill.

history.why: Was Blisterblade's burn plus Frost Spines' Frostborn; now the countered enemy carries a Shock that goes off when they next act, so they must choose to act or wait.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains Frostfire, and the user gains Flameborn and Frostborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: For 4 turns, the user swings between extremes: 3 Might on their first and third turns, and 3 Armor and Immune on their second and fourth.

history.why: Was a Thermal Shock rider on the user's hits; now a Rage that alternates between all-out fire and frozen defense, so the user times their turns around it.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and their damaging skills Ignite targets with a Frost debuff and Chill the rest for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Blazing Fury plus Frostborn; now every hit the user lands flips its target to the other extreme, so any skill they own feeds Thermal Shock.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, Flameborn and Frostborn.

rows.effect: 15 damage and Frostfire. If the target has no Buffs, they're also Numbed for 1 turn, Thermal Shocking them.

history.why: Was Flickerflare with Frostfire in place of Ignite; now it Shocks on its own, but only against targets with no Buffs, borrowing Ice's read from Icelance.

before.effect: 15 damage and Frostfire.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 damage to target enemy. If they gain a Fire or Frost debuff first, it lands at once and Thermal Shocks them.

history.why: Was Comet Shard with an Ignite added; now the comet falls the moment anyone burns or chills the target, rewarding teammates who follow it up.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 Piercing damage, then Ignites them. Lands instantly if the target is Chilled.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time target enemy falls to 50 HP or less, the ice cracks under them: they take 20 Piercing damage and are Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Hidden Explosives with a Chill rider; now a Trap that springs on an HP threshold rather than on any action the target takes.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, an Explosion is triggered, and it Chills every enemy it hits for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Hidden Explosives lasting longer plus Frostfire; now Fire's Explosion carries Ice's Chill, so it Shocks every burning enemy at once.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they gain Frostfire and Explode.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and for 1 more turn after that, Invulnerable to enemies with a Fire debuff.

history.why: Was Flame Dash plus Frostborn; now the enemies' own burns become steam that hides the user from them for an extra turn.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains Flameborn and Frostborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Summons a Salamander (35 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it gives a random enemy Frostfire. When it dies, every enemy with Frostfire is Thermal Shocked.

history.why: Was Dragon Hatchling's passive with Frostfire plus Ice Bear's bite; now killing the Salamander Shocks every Frostfired enemy, so the enemy must decide whether to.

before.effect: Summons a Salamander (35 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it gives a random enemy Frostfire. Cold Bite (S): 20 damage and Chilled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage and Frostfire. If the target was already Thermal Shocked this turn, the Frostfire Shocks them again.

history.why: Was the kit's apply-the-opposite trick again; now it breaks Thermal Shock's once-per-turn limit, a finisher for a teammate's Shock.

before.effect: 20 damage. Ignited targets are Frostbitten for 2 turns; targets with a Frost debuff are Ignited.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. Each Ignite on them turns into Frostfire, Thermal Shocking its bearer.

history.why: Was Inferno with Frostfire in place of Ignite; now it freezes the Ignites already burning, Shocking every burning enemy at once.

before.effect: 15 damage and Frostfire to all enemies.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user as much. If they have both a Fire and a Frost debuff (Frostfire counts), they're Thermal Shocked and the user heals 20 more.

history.why: Was Feed the Fire and Siphon Frost's rewards handed out together; now it drains and detonates a target who carries both extremes.

before.effect: 10 damage. If the target has both a Fire and a Frost debuff, they're all removed; the user heals 10 per debuff and gains Flameborn and Frostborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Summons a Twilight Jotunn (60 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 25 damage to a random enemy. While it stands, the user is Stunned; Swiftness can't stop it.

history.why: Was two motes laying Ignite and Chill side by side; now a huge summon that locks its summoner, so the enemy must choose between killing it and freeing the user.

before.effect: Summons a Cinder Mote and a Frost Mote (10 HP each) for 2 turns. Each turn, the Cinder Mote Ignites a random enemy and the Frost Mote Chills that enemy for 1 turn.

history.why: Was an Ignite mote beside a Chill mote on random targets; now the pair works one target together, so killing either mote stops the Shocks.

before.effect: Summons a Cinder Mote and a Frost Mote (10 HP each) for 2 turns. At the end of each of your turns, one Ignites a random enemy and the other Chills a random enemy for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. Turn 1 Ignites them all; turn 2 Chills them all for 1 turn; turn 3 makes every Ignited enemy Explode.
10 damage and Frostfire to target enemy. Against targets at or below 60 HP, it's 20 damage, and their Frostfire ticks at once.

history.why: Was a Chill-then-Ignite Shock on low targets; now a Frostfire row that finishes low targets with an early tick.

before.effect: 10 damage and Chilled for 1 turn. Against targets at or below 60 HP, they're also Ignited, Thermal Shocking them.

history.why: Was Searing Needle's Fire bonus plus a Frost twin; now Stab's low-HP bonus becomes a whole Shock from one needle.

before.effect: 10 damage, +10 Affliction if the target has a Fire debuff and +10 Piercing if they have a Frost debuff.

rows.effect: 20 Affliction damage to target enemy, +10 for each Fire or Frost debuff they have. Then those debuffs are removed.

history.why: Was Pyrokinesis doubled against Shattered instead of Ignited; now a spender that cashes in every Fire and Frost debuff, trading the setup for burst.

before.effect: 20 Affliction damage, doubled if the target is Shattered.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain Frostfire. A Helpful skill Scorches and Numbs them for 1 turn instead.

history.why: Was Heat Haze with Frostfire in place of Ignite; now it counters attackers and Shocks an enemy who tries to support, a split neither parent reads.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they gain Frostfire and are Scorched.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, who gains Frostfire and is Stunned for 1 turn. If the Frostfire is still on them when the Stun ends, it's consumed to Stun them 1 more turn.

history.why: Was a Chill that Stunned only Shattered targets; now Frostfire holds the Stun, so cleansing it is the enemy's way out.

before.effect: 15 damage and Chilled for 1 turn. Shattered targets are also Stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and Explodes at the end of each of their turns in which they dealt damage.

history.why: Was Ivory Step with a double Explosion on Frost-debuffed enemies; now a Fire player's sustained dance that turns every attacking turn into an Explosion.

before.effect: The user gains Immune for 1 turn and Explodes. Enemies with a Frost debuff take the Explosion twice.

history.why: Was Ivory Step plus Frostborn; now Ice's debuffs set up Fire's Explosion, doubling it on the frozen.

before.effect: The user gains Immune and Frostborn for 1 turn, and Explodes.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 35 at the end of the enemy's next turn. If a hit would kill them before then, the heal lands first, at once.

history.why: Was a heal plus Shield from enemy Ignite ticks; now a heal frozen in waiting that thaws early to cushion a killing blow.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20. For 2 turns, whenever an Ignite on an enemy ticks, that ally gains 5 Shield.

history.why: Was Flamethirst plus Freeze Wound side by side; now the team's burning enemies feed an icy Shield on the healed ally.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15, gains Flameborn for 2 turns and 2 Armor for 1 turn.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their direct damage deals 10 more to Shattered enemies.

history.why: Was Burning Blood plus Boreal Aegis; now it turns an ally into the one who cashes in the kit's Shatters.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Might for 1 turn and Frostborn until the end of their next turn.
