rows.effect: Target enemy gains Frostfire, then 1 Confusion for 2 turns per Fire or Frost debuff they have, Frostfire included (max 3).

history.why: Was Overheat Metal plus Hypothermia's Numb and Frostfire; now Frostfire's Chill stops them offsetting Confusion that grows with each extreme, an energy stall.

before.effect: Target enemy gains Frostfire, and 1 Weakness, 1 Vulnerable and Numb for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. For 2 turns, each Explosion that hits them also Frostbites them for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Numb plus allies Igniting for a Shock; now Fire's Explosions deliver Ice's Frostbitten.

before.effect: 15 damage and Numb for 1 turn. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target Ignite them.

history.why: Was Searing Brand plus Chilling Grasp's Numb; now the frost brand turns allies' hits into the Ignite that completes the Shock.

before.effect: 15 damage and Numb for 1 turn. If the target was Ignited, they also gain 2 Weakness for 1 turn.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. For 2 turns, Chilled enemies' skills also cost 1 more random energy.

history.why: Was Northern Solace with leftover Shield turned to healing; now bends Ice's Chill from a cap on discounts into a real cost tax.

before.effect: All allies heal 10 and gain 25 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, each heals for the Shield they have left.

history.why: Was Northern Solace plus Searing Aegis and Frostborn; now a frost Shield that melts into healing if the enemy doesn't break it.

before.effect: All allies heal 10, and gain 20 Shield, Flameborn and Frostborn for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, who also gains copies of the target's Fire and Frost debuffs.

history.why: Was Blastwave's and Glacial Sweep's riders side by side; now the second target inherits the first's fire and frost, Shocking it if it held the other.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a random other enemy. Ignited ones Explode; Chilled ones are Frostbitten for 1 turn.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and a random one gains Frostfire. For as long, each enemy with Frostfire is Intimidated twice over.

history.why: Was a team Scorch that Shocked Frost bearers; now Frostfire's Chill freezes cooldowns, doubling the Shout on its bearers.

before.effect: All enemies are Scorched for 2 turns, Thermal Shocking each one with a Frost debuff.

history.why: Was Tempering Blow's apply-the-opposite trick on the whole team; now a team-wide Scorch that cuts healing and Shocks the frozen.

before.effect: Every Ignited enemy is Frostbitten for 1 turn, and every enemy with a Frost debuff is Ignited.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns, and is Frostborn while any of it remains.

history.why: Was a Shield that Exploded when broken (a third Fire expansion); now gives Ice players a new route to Frostborn, balancing the kit.

before.effect: The user gains 30 Shield for 1 turn. If an enemy breaks it, an Explosion is triggered.

history.why: Was Ashen Barrier also counting Frost debuffs; now an ice wall with fire inside that punishes whoever breaks it.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield per Fire or Frost debuff on enemies (max 50), for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, and moves every Fire and Frost debuff on their allies onto them.

history.why: Was Ring of Fire with Frostbitten in place of Scorched; now it drags the whole team's fire and frost onto the Taunted enemy, Shocking them if both arrive.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn. If they use a Harmful skill, they're Ignited; if not, they're Frostbitten for 2 turns.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune, and enemies who damage them gain Frostfire.

history.why: Was Wraith in White plus a Frost mirror of it; now attackers are primed with Frostfire, so hitting the Colossus twice Shocks them.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might per Fire debuff and 1 Armor per Frost debuff on enemies, and Immune while they have Flameborn or Frostborn.

kits.name: Alchemy
kits.tagline: Fire and water in the crucible: nothing is destroyed, only changed.
kits.taglineHtml: Fire and water in the crucible: nothing is destroyed, only changed.
kits.introHtml:
• Transmute: turns effects on a unit into others, stack for stack, as the skill lists. The standard recipes: on enemies, Might becomes Weakness, Armor becomes Vulnerable, Focus becomes Confusion, and Renew becomes Weakness; on allies, the reverse, and other Debuffs become Renew.
  • Catalyst: the next skill that affects the bearer is doubled for them: twice the stacks, amounts and durations. A Buff on allies, a Debuff on enemies.

keywords.html: Transmute: turns effects on a unit into others, stack for stack, as the skill lists. The standard recipes: on enemies, Might becomes Weakness, Armor becomes Vulnerable, Focus becomes Confusion, and Renew becomes Weakness; on allies, the reverse, and other Debuffs become Renew.
Catalyst: the next skill that affects the bearer is doubled for them: twice the stacks, amounts and durations. A Buff on allies, a Debuff on enemies.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Their Ignite ticks at once, plus once more for each Buff they have (max 3 more).

history.why: Was a Renew-to-Weakness Transmute; now a Fire expansion where a buffed enemy's Ignite burns hotter.

before.effect: 25 damage. The target's Renew is Transmuted into as much Weakness.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. For 2 turns, Scorched on any of them also halves the Shield they gain.

history.why: Was a Shield-to-Vulnerable Transmute; now a Fire expansion that stretches Scorched from healing to Shield.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Each target's Shield is Transmuted into Vulnerable, 1 per 10 Shield.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. The user gains 1 Renew for each Ignited enemy (max 3).

history.why: Was a bland Catalyst rider; now every Fire Ignite on the board turns into Water Renew for the user.

before.effect: 15 damage; the target gains Catalyst, and the user 1 Focus for their next skill.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user: its user is Ignited, and the user's Debuffs are Transmuted into Renew.
For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might, and gains Catalyst at the start of each of their turns.

history.why: Was Blazing Fury plus Quiet Fury's Flow plus Catalyst; now the user is re-Catalyzed every turn, so their allies race the enemy to act on them first.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might, Flow and Flameborn; then Catalyst for their next skill.

rows.effect: 15 damage and Ignite to target enemy. For 2 turns, if that Ignite is removed from them, they Explode.

history.why: Was an Ignite that Exploded enemies with Renew; now a volatile Ignite that punishes being cleansed, which any Fire player wants.

before.effect: 15 damage and Ignite. If the target has Renew, it boils over: they Explode.

history.why: Was Flickerflare with Catalyst in place of Ignite; now Water's Renew on the enemy turns Fire's Ignite into an Explosion.

before.effect: 15 damage and Catalyst.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, plus the total healing they received in the meantime.

history.why: Was Tidal Arrow with a Transmute rider in place of its Flow requirement; now any healing spent saving the target during the wait is added to the hit.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage, and each Buff on the target is Transmuted into 1 Weakness.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they gain Catalyst. If they already had it, it reacts instead: they Explode.

history.why: Was Whirlpool Trap with Catalyst tacked on; now acting twice makes the Catalyst react into an Explosion, unless a teammate spends it first.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Confusion and then Catalyst.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Their Debuffs are removed, and for each one, a random enemy gains Catalyst.

history.why: Was Dive with its Renew coming from Transmuted Debuffs; now the user's ailments boil off into Catalyst on the enemy team.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn; their Debuffs are Transmuted into Renew.

rows.effect: Summons a Homunculus (30 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, one stack of Might, Armor, Focus or Renew on a random enemy is Transmuted, and a random ally gains that stack.

history.why: Was a Renew-making skill beside a Dragon Hatchling-style Ignite; now it steadily turns an enemy's Buff into a Debuff and hands the Buff to an ally.

before.effect: Summons a Homunculus (30 HP) permanently. Distill (r): one Debuff on target ally is Transmuted into 2 Renew. Firebrew (r): 10 damage and Ignite.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they have Catalyst, the doubled hit also Transmutes one of their Buffs; if not, they gain Catalyst.

history.why: Was Splash's random-ally Renew plus Catalyst; now it primes the target on one cast and cashes the Catalyst in on the next, stripping a Buff as it does.

before.effect: 20 damage and Catalyst; a random ally gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. Each enemy with Catalyst Explodes.
5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. Then 10 of their max HP is distilled into the user: theirs drops by 10 and the user's rises by 10 for the rest of the match (up to 30 per enemy).

history.why: Was Buffs Transmuted into Affliction damage; now a small drain that permanently moves max HP from the enemy to the user.

before.effect: 5 damage. Each Buff on the target is Transmuted into 5 Affliction damage, dealt now; the user heals as much.

rows.effect: Summons an Alembic (15 HP) for 3 turns. Brew (nc): target unit, ally or enemy, gains Catalyst.
Channeled, up to 4 turns. Each turn, 5 damage to all enemies and 1 Renew to all allies. When it ends, allies' Renew boils off as 5 Affliction per stack to random enemies.

history.why: Was Call Rain with a Buff Transmute in place of its Renew; now the Renew it brews boils into damage when the channel ends, so when to stop is the choice.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. Each turn, 5 damage to all enemies, and one Buff on each is Transmuted (Buffs with no recipe become Scorched instead).

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. It ignores counters and reflects; if it slips past one, the user gains Flow for 2 turns.

history.why: Was the stock Stab plus healing against Scorched targets; now a probe that gives Water players a new way to earn Flow by testing for tricks.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets at or below 60 HP. If the target is Scorched, the user heals as much as this deals.

history.why: Was Shell Knife with Catalyst in place of Renew; now Fire's Scorched turns the needle into a bloodletting that heals the user.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the target has Catalyst, which it consumes.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. The user boils off all their Renew, and the target's Ignite ticks once per stack (max 4).

history.why: Was the stock Armor-to-Vulnerable recipe; now the user's Water Renew is spent as fuel for a Fire Ignite.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage. The target's Armor is Transmuted into Vulnerable.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's Transmuted: its healing lands on its targets as damage, and its Buffs as the matching Debuffs.

history.why: Effect unchanged; it was already a standout (a Helpful skill turned wholly against its own side), so it moves from Transmute to Unique.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's Transmuted: its healing lands on its targets as damage, and its Buffs as the matching Debuffs.

history.why: Was Dunk with a Transmute in place of its Confusion; now the enemy's own heal or Buff lands inverted instead of just being stopped.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered and the Buffs on its targets are Transmuted.

rows.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun that Swiftness can't stop: each Swiftness on the target is Transmuted into 1 Confusion instead.

history.why: Was a plain Stun whose Catalyst bonus only restated Catalyst; now it Transmutes the Swiftness that would have dodged it.

before.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun, doubled to 2 turns if the target has Catalyst.

rows.effect: The user gains Catalyst. At the start of their next turn, they gain 1 Might, 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus for 3 turns, doubled if the Catalyst is still unspent.

history.why: Was the base Dance restating Catalyst's doubling; now it's a gamble, since an enemy hit or an ally's heal in between spends the Catalyst first.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus, all doubled if they have Catalyst.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15; their Debuffs are Transmuted into 2 Renew each.
For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their Normal damage is Piercing.

history.why: Was Might and Renew with more Renew for hitting Ignited enemies; now a Bless that changes the ally's damage type, dissolving Armor for any class.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Renew, and 1 more Renew each time they damage an Ignited enemy.

history.why: Was Touch of Grace's Flow plus Flamethirst's Flameborn; now Fire's Ignites on enemies feed the ally's Water-style healing.

before.effect: Target ally gains Flow and Flameborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: All of target enemy's Buffs are Transmuted; any without a recipe are removed.
15 damage and Catalyst. For 1 turn, each ally skill that damages the target gives them Catalyst again.

history.why: Was Aqua Ring plus an Ignite; now a brand that re-arms Catalyst after every ally hit, so the team's whole turn chains doubled damage.

before.effect: 15 damage and Ignite. For 2 turns, allies who damage the target gain Flow.

rows.effect: All allies heal 15. Every Renew on enemies is Transmuted into Weakness, and each ally gains 1 Renew per 2 stacks converted.

history.why: Was Rainsong with a Debuff-to-Renew Transmute; now it takes the enemy team's Renew for the user's team, leaving them Weakness.

before.effect: All allies heal 15, and each Transmutes one Debuff into 2 Renew.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If the target has Catalyst, it splashes: both hits are doubled.

history.why: Was Water Lash gated on Catalyst instead of Flow, with Fire's statuses added; now one Catalyst doubles the splash as well.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies; those with Catalyst are also Ignited and Scorched (doubled).

rows.effect: For 1 turn, every Buff an enemy gains is Transmuted on arrival.

history.why: Was Whale Call plus Catalyst; now a team-wide window in which the enemy's own Buffs arrive as Debuffs.

before.effect: All enemies gain 1 Vulnerable, then Catalyst.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, what's left of it is Transmuted into Renew, 1 per 5 Shield.

history.why: Was Aqua Veil plus a rider for when the user is Ignited; now an unbroken Shield condenses into Renew, so the enemy must break it or feed it.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield for 1 turn and 2 Renew; an Ignite on them is quenched into 20 more Shield.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Half the damage they deal the user is Transmuted into healing for the user instead.

history.why: Was Ring of Fire plus Catalyst; now the Taunted enemy's attacks are half turned into the user's healing.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn and gives them Catalyst. If they use a Harmful skill while Taunted, they're Ignited.

rows.effect: For the rest of the match, the user has 2 Armor and Immune, but can't gain any other Buff.

history.why: Was a 4-turn Titan that Transmuted Debuffs on arrival; now a permanent transformation paid for by shutting out every other Buff.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and 2 Renew each turn, and every Debuff applied to them is Transmuted on arrival.

kits.name: Plasma
kits.tagline: Fire and lightning past their limits: power you ride until it melts down.
kits.taglineHtml: Fire and lightning past their limits: power you ride until it melts down.
kits.introHtml:
• Heat (the user's, max 5): Plasma skills add the Heat they list (+1 or +2) after resolving, and the user also gains 1 Heat whenever they gain Charge. Plasma skills deal 5 more damage per Heat. At the end of a turn in which the user has 5 Heat, they Melt Down: they take 20 Affliction, every enemy takes 20 Affliction and is Sapped, and Heat returns to 0.
  • Vent: a Vent skill removes all the user's Heat for the benefit it lists per Heat removed.

keywords.html: Heat (the user's, max 5): Plasma skills add the Heat they list (+1 or +2) after resolving, and the user also gains 1 Heat whenever they gain Charge. Plasma skills deal 5 more damage per Heat. At the end of a turn in which the user has 5 Heat, they Melt Down: they take 20 Affliction, every enemy takes 20 Affliction and is Sapped, and Heat returns to 0.
Vent: a Vent skill removes all the user's Heat for the benefit it lists per Heat removed.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. +1 Heat, or if the user already has 4, Vent instead: 5 more damage per Heat removed.

history.why: Was Jolt with Heat in place of Charge; now a builder that becomes a safety-valve finisher at 4 Heat, so when to Strike matters.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. +1 Heat.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Until they end, the Ignites on every enemy it hits deal double.

history.why: Exploded Sapped enemies; now bends Fire's Ignite so a team's existing burns hit twice as hard.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Sapped enemies it hits Explode. +1 Heat.

history.why: Was Chain Detonation's Explosions plus Static Slam's splash; now Lightning's Sapped is what sets off Fire's Explosions.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies; Ignited targets Explode. +2 Heat.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Vent: the user's next skill costs 1 less per 2 Heat removed.

history.why: Was Charged Dash plus the base Focus; now it Vents Heat into a cheaper next skill, trading damage for tempo.

before.effect: 15 damage; the user gains 1 Charge (and so 1 Heat), and 1 Focus for their next skill.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user. Vent: its user takes 10 Affliction per Heat and is Ignited.
For 3 turns, the user gains Stormborn and Flameborn and can't Melt Down; if they end it at 5 Heat, they Melt Down then. +2 Heat.
15 damage and Ignite. Each time this Ignite ticks, the user gains 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Zap with Heat in place of Charge, plus an Ignite; now Fire's burn charges the user, feeding both Heat and energy.

before.effect: 15 damage and Ignite. Costs r instead while the user has Heat. +1 Heat.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target, up to 3 turns. When the channel ends, 30 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 for each turn it was held.

history.why: Was a Snipe doubled by a Meltdown; now the user decides how long to charge it, trading turns and exposure for a bigger shot.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to target enemy, doubled if the user Melted Down in between. +2 Heat.

history.why: Was Particle Beam with an Ignite added; now it lands double if the user times a Meltdown between the cast and the impact.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to target enemy and to every Sapped enemy, Igniting them. +2 Heat.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time target enemy is healed, they're Scorched for 2 turns before the heal lands, and they Explode.

history.why: Was a Tesla Coil-style Sap trap that drained Heat; now a Fire expansion that turns the enemy's own healing into a Scorch and an Explosion.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 damage and are Sapped, and the user loses 1 Heat.

history.why: Was Tesla Coil plus an Ignite; now it bleeds off one Heat each time it bites, a slow Vent that the enemy triggers.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they take 15 damage and are Sapped and Ignited. +1 Heat when it triggers.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Vent: 10 Shield per Heat.
Summons a Ball Lightning (25 HP) permanently. Each turn, it deals 10 damage to a random enemy and gives you 1 Heat. Detonate (r): it dies, dealing 20 to all enemies and Sapping them.

history.why: Was Dragon Hatchling's burning passive plus a Detonate, and never touched Heat; now it stokes the user's Heat every turn, a clock they must manage.

before.effect: Summons a Ball Lightning (25 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 10 damage to a random enemy and Ignites them. Detonate (r): it dies, dealing 20 damage to all enemies and Sapping them.

rows.effect: 20 damage and Ignite. This Ignite deals 5 more per Heat the user has when it's applied. +1 Heat.

history.why: Was Innervate's Sap plus Fireball's Explosion; now it banks the user's Heat into an Ignite that keeps burning after a Vent or Meltdown.

before.effect: 20 damage, and Saps; an Ignited target Explodes. +1 Heat.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. The user Melts Down at the end of this turn, whatever their Heat.

history.why: Was Static Burst with a Heat Vent in place of spending Charge; now it forces a Meltdown on demand, trading the stored Heat for timing.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. Vent: 10 more to each per Heat.

rows.effect: 10 damage, and Saps. Vent: the user heals 10 per Heat.
Summons 2 Jumper Sparks (10 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of your turns, each deals 10 damage to a random enemy and gives 1 Charge to the ally closest to 3 Charge.

history.why: Was Sparks drawing the user's Heat; now a Lightning expansion that pushes whichever ally is nearest a full Charge over the top.

before.effect: Summons 2 Sparks (10 HP) for 2 turns. Each turn, each draws 1 Heat from you to deal 15 damage to a random enemy, or 5 if you have none.

history.why: Was Cinderlings with a Heat-threshold Ignite; now the Sparks draw Heat off the user to hit harder, cooling them as they work.

before.effect: Summons 2 Sparks (10 HP) for 2 turns. Each deals 5 Affliction to every enemy each turn; while their summoner has 3 or more Heat, each also Ignites a random enemy.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns. At the end of each, 10 damage to all enemies, and the user spends 1 Charge, if they have any, to make every enemy's Ignite tick at once.

history.why: Was a near-copy of Lightningrod (Stormborn while channeling); now Lightning's Charge is spent to fire Fire's Ignites.

before.effect: Channeled. The user has Stormborn while channeling (so each Charge also adds Heat), and their Meltdowns deal no damage to them.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 against targets at or below 60 HP. Vent: that threshold rises by 10 HP per Heat removed.

history.why: Was a Heat builder with a fixed 80 HP threshold at 3 Heat; now the user dumps Heat to stretch the finishing range as far as they need.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets at or below 60 HP (80 HP while the user has 3 or more Heat). +1 Heat.

history.why: Was Stun Baton with Ignite in place of Sapped; now running hot widens Stab's low-HP window.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the target was at or above 80 HP, the user gains 1 Charge; if they end at or below 40 HP, they're Ignited.

rows.effect: 20 Piercing damage, +10 for each Charge the user spends on it. Each Charge spent becomes 1 Heat.

history.why: Was Malectrocute with Ignited added to its condition; now it burns Lightning's Charge into damage and Heat, giving up the energy it would have made.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, +10 if the user is Charged and +10 if the target is Sapped or Ignited. +1 Heat.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Ignited. For 2 turns, that Ignite also ticks at the end of their own turns.

history.why: Was Hologram with Ignited in place of Sapped; now a counter that plants a Fire Ignite burning on both sides' turns.

before.effect: For 1 turn, any Ignited enemy who uses a Harmful skill is countered and Sapped twice, and the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Hologram plus an Ignite; now Fire's Ignite is what opens Lightning's counter, and it drains energy twice as hard.

before.effect: For 1 turn, any Sapped enemy who uses a Harmful skill is countered and Ignited, and the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn. +1 Heat.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. Vent: for every 2 Heat removed, a random other enemy is stunned the same way.

history.why: Was a Heat builder that hit everyone at 4 Heat; now spreading the Stun costs the user their Heat.

before.effect: 15 damage and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. At 4 or more Heat, it hits every enemy. +1 Heat.

history.why: Was System Shock plus an Ignited rule; now at high Heat the stun spreads to the whole team, usually right before a Meltdown.

before.effect: 15 damage, and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn (2 if Sapped). Ignited targets are fully Stunned instead. +1 Heat.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Stormborn, and can't be Stunned while they have 3 or more Heat.

history.why: Was Three Storm Breaths plus Flameborn and Might per Heat; now running hot makes the user unstoppable, so they want to stay near the edge.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Stormborn, Conduit and Flameborn, and 1 Might per Heat they have, checked each turn.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20. Vent: they gain 1 Charge per 2 Heat removed.

history.why: Was Defibrillate with a Heat Vent in place of its Charge scaling; now the user dumps Heat into an ally's Charge, and so their energy.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20. Vent: 10 more healing per Heat.

rows.effect: Target ally's Charge fills to 3 at once, and they gain 1 Might for 3 turns. For those 3 turns, they can't gain Charge.

history.why: Gave Charge for Igniting; now a Lightning trade-off: an instant full Charge paid for with 3 turns of none.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and 1 Charge each time they Ignite an enemy.

history.why: Was Overclock's Conduit plus Flameborn; now the ally's Fire Ignites charge them with Lightning's energy.

before.effect: Target ally gains Conduit and Flameborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Sapped and Confused for 2 turns. While they're Confused, full Sapped isn't spent: they generate 1 less energy every turn it stays at 3.

history.why: Was Sapped and Scorched with an Ignite if already Sapped; now bends Lightning's Sapped so a full stack keeps draining instead of resetting.

before.effect: Target enemy is Sapped and Scorched for 2 turns; if they were already Sapped, they're also Ignited.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. Vent: the Sanctify heals 5 more per Heat removed.

history.why: Was allies drawing the user's Heat for damage; now the user's Heat is poured into team healing off the target.

before.effect: 15 damage. For 1 turn, each ally who damages the target draws 1 Heat from the user, dealing 10 more with it.

history.why: Was Apply Polarity plus an Ignite; now allies who hit the target spend the user's Heat, cooling them while sharing the power.

before.effect: 15 damage and Ignite. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain 1 Charge.

rows.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield. If the user Melts Down before their next turn, the Meltdown heals every ally 20 and doesn't hurt the user.

history.why: Was a third Vent-for-healing skill beside Coolant Draw and the Heal; now it turns a Meltdown timed after it into team healing.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield. Vent: 5 more healing each per Heat.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Any channel either of them holds is broken, and neither can start one until the user's next turn.

history.why: Was an arc that spread Ignite and Sapped from an Ignited target; now a Cleave that shorts out channels, answering Snipes and Channels from any kit.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If the target is Ignited, the arc carries it: the other enemy is Ignited and Sapped.

history.why: Was Arc plus Blastwave's Explosions; now a burning target's Ignite rides the arc to the second enemy and drains them.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and to every Marked or Ignited enemy; Ignited ones Explode. +1 Heat.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and every minion in the battle, on both sides, is Stunned for 2 turns.

history.why: Was a Sap that pushed Heat to 4; now an electromagnetic pulse that shuts down every minion, the user's own included.

before.effect: All enemies are Sapped, and the user's Heat rises to 4.

history.why: Was Crackle plus a Scorch on Ignited enemies; now it drains the enemy while pushing the user to the brink, where the next builder melts them down.

before.effect: Saps all targetable enemies; Ignited ones are also Scorched for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user gains 50 Shield for 1 turn. The surge costs them: their next skill costs 2 more energy.

history.why: Returning absorbed damage duplicated Ocean's Returning Wave and Thunder's Thunder Cage; now a double-size Shield paid for with the next skill's cost.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield plus 10 per Heat for 2 turns; their Heat can't rise while it holds.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn. Vent: 1 more turn and 1 Sapped per 2 Heat removed.

history.why: Was a 2-turn Taunt that built Heat; now the Taunt's length and its Sap scale with the Heat the user dumps.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each Harmful skill they use on the user gives the user 1 Heat and Saps them.

history.why: Was Aggro Signal plus an Ignite; now the Taunted enemy's attacks feed the user's reactor and drain their own energy.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's Reflected back to them, and they're Ignited and Intimidated for 1 turn.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and 1 Armor per Heat they have, checked each turn.

history.why: Was EXO-Armor with a Heat Vent in place of spending Charge; now Armor tracks Heat each turn, so every Meltdown costs the user their defense.

before.effect: Vent: 1 Armor and 1 Might per Heat. Then the user gains Stormborn and Flameborn for 3 turns.

kits.name: Mechanic
kits.tagline: Fire in the boiler, wind in the bellows: machines you build, tune and send into the fight.
kits.taglineHtml: Fire in the boiler, wind in the bellows: machines you build, tune and send into the fight.
kits.introHtml:
• Contraptions: machine minions. They can't be healed or gain Renew (only Repair skills restore them), and they ignore Stun, Sleep and Confusion. Several skills build a Turret (20 HP), which deals 10 damage to a random enemy at the end of each of your turns.
  • Upgrade: raises an allied minion one level (max 3). Each level gives +10 max HP (and 10 HP) and +5 damage on its skills.

keywords.html: Contraptions: machine minions. They can't be healed or gain Renew (only Repair skills restore them), and they ignore Stun, Sleep and Confusion. Several skills build a Turret (20 HP), which deals 10 damage to a random enemy at the end of each of your turns.
Upgrade: raises an allied minion one level (max 3). Each level gives +10 max HP (and 10 HP) and +5 damage on its skills.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and a random allied minion is Upgraded.
25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. If the user is Rushing, it vents: their Rushing ends, and the splash is 30 and Ignites.

history.why: Was the base Smash scaling with the kit's own Contraptions, so it did nothing new alone; now it spends Wind's Rushing for a heavier, burning splash.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies, +5 to each per allied Contraption.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user begins Rushing and leaves a Turret behind for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Launch's Rushing plus Bound's Leap plus an Ignite; now the dash leaves a machine behind, building the workshop on the move.

before.effect: The user Leaps and begins Rushing; their next skill also Ignites its target.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Isolated for 1 turn, and the user builds a Turret.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and 1 more Might each time their side causes an Explosion (max 3 more).

history.why: Was Chainbreaker with Might in place of Immune; now gives Fire teams a new route to Might through Explosions.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs, and for 3 turns they gain 1 Might per Debuff removed (at least 1, max 3).

history.why: Was Chainbreaker with a Contraption Upgrade tacked on; now the Debuffs that Wind's cleanse burns off become Fire's Might.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs; they're Immune for 2 turns, and every allied Contraption is Upgraded.

rows.effect: 15 damage. If an allied minion damaged the target this turn, that minion is Upgraded.

history.why: Was Air Bullet's mobility check gating Flickerflare's Ignite; now it rewards focusing one target with any allied minion by Upgrading it.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the user is Leaping or Rushing, it also Ignites.

rows.effect: Channeled. The user builds a Mortar (Contraption, 20 HP); on the following turn, if it still stands, it fires: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies.

history.why: Was Elegant Sweep plus 5 per Contraption; now the shot comes from a Mortar the enemy can destroy before it fires.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 25 Piercing damage to all enemies, +5 per allied Contraption.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first skill target enemy uses Ignites them; after that, their Ignite also ticks each time they use a skill.

history.why: Was Float Noose with Ignite swapped in and a Rushing bonus; now bends Ignite so every skill the target uses fans the flame.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage and are Ignited, or 20 if they're Leaping or Rushing.

history.why: Was Float Noose with an Ignite in place of Isolated plus a Contraption bonus; now it punishes a target who keeps moving.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage and are Ignited, and each allied Contraption deals them 5 more.

rows.effect: The user Leaps. When a damaging skill ends the Leap, it also causes an Explosion.

history.why: Was Bound plus Flame Dash's Flameborn; now the Leap's landing detonates, so Wind's jump sets up Fire's Explosion.

before.effect: The user Leaps and gains Flameborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Builds a Clockwork Hound (Contraption, 30 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 10 damage to a random enemy, and every other turn it Upgrades itself.

history.why: Was Grand Eagle rebuilt as a machine; now the Hound tunes itself, growing to level 3 if the enemy leaves it alone.

before.effect: Builds a Clockwork Hound (Contraption, 40 HP) permanently. Buzzsaw (r): 15 damage. Wind-Up (A): target ally Leaps.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Mark for 1 turn. Until the end of their next turn, they're hooked: they lose Invulnerable, Untargetable and Stealth, and can't gain them.

history.why: Was Fireball with Immobile in place of Ignited; now a grappling hook that pins the target down, denying every escape status at once.

before.effect: 20 damage. Immobile targets Explode.

history.why: Was Compressed Bolt plus an Ignite; now Wind's Immobile read is what sets off Fire's Explosion.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the target is Immobile, their non-Strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn and they're Ignited.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, +10 for each ally of the user who used a damaging skill earlier this turn.

history.why: Ticked Ignites, twice if the user was mobile; now a Blast that builds pressure from the team's own sequencing, rewarding it for going last.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Every Ignite on them ticks at once, or twice if the user is Leaping or Rushing.

history.why: Was Spiral Burst plus Inferno; now the bellows fan the fires already burning, and the user's speed fans them harder.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, +10 if the user is Leaping and +10 if Rushing; all of them are Ignited.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user as much. The user burns all their Swiftness as fuel: 10 more healing per stack.

history.why: Turned a consumed Ignite into Rushing; now a new outlet for Wind's banked Swiftness.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user as much. If they're Ignited, the Ignite is consumed and the user begins Rushing.

history.why: Was a Contraption sacrifice that needed two of the kit's own machines; now it burns an enemy's Ignite as fuel for Wind's Rushing.

before.effect: Destroys an allied Contraption: the user gains 10 Shield plus 10 per its level, and another allied Contraption is Upgraded.

rows.effect: Builds 2 Turrets for 3 turns. When one is destroyed, the other is Upgraded.

history.why: Was two Turrets and nothing else, the base Summon in machine form; now killing one makes the other stronger, so the enemy must split or commit.

before.effect: Builds 2 Turrets for 3 turns.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns. At the end of each, a random allied minion is Upgraded; if the user has none, they build a Turret instead.

history.why: Was Turret-first with Upgrade as the fallback; now Upgrade-first for any minion, with a Turret only to get started.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns. At the end of each, the user builds a Turret, or Upgrades one if they already have any.

history.why: Was Vortex plus 5 per Contraption; now the channel is the workshop itself, building then tuning a Turret each turn it runs.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, +5 per allied Contraption; one more turn if the user is Leaping or Rushing when it ticks.

rows.effect: Usable while Stunned. 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP.

history.why: Was a Leap rule bend that nearly duplicated Tune-Up; now a free finisher that keeps working when the user is Stunned, like the kit's machines.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Used while Leaping, it gets the Leap's 5 bonus damage without ending the Leap.

history.why: Ignited targets from a Leap; now a pure Wind rule bend that lets a Leaper chip away while saving the landing blow.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets at or below 60 HP. Used while Leaping, it doesn't end the Leap and Ignites the target.

history.why: Was Airknife plus Searing Needle; now a poke that keeps the user airborne and Invulnerable, borrowing Air Bullet's trick and adding Fire.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 if the user is Rushing; Ignited targets take 10 more.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage, doubled against minions. If it destroys one, the user builds a Turret from the wreck.

history.why: Was Sonic Thrust with its drawback swapped for Rushing; now a minion-shredder that turns the wreck into a Turret.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, and the user begins Rushing.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and a Dummy (Contraption, 15 HP) is built. When the Dummy is destroyed, it Explodes.

history.why: Was Spring Trap's counter-and-build-a-Turret again; now it builds a Dummy that punishes whoever destroys it.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and the user builds a Turret.

rows.effect: Lands at the start of the user's next turn: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun to target enemy, unless they used a mobility skill in between.

history.why: Was Flashbang plus Buffet's Strategic stun on Ignited targets; now a lobbed grenade with a full Stun that Wind's mobility can dodge.

before.effect: 15 damage, and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn; Ignited targets lose their Strategic skills for 1 turn too.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Ghosted and begins Rushing. At the end of each turn they're still Rushing, every allied minion is Upgraded.

history.why: Was Top Speed plus a Turret; now keeping Wind's Rushing going tunes every allied minion each turn.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Ghosted and begins Rushing; they also build a Turret.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20. An allied minion is instead Upgraded twice; a Contraption is Repaired for 20 first.

history.why: Was a heal-or-Repair with a single Upgrade; now a double Upgrade on minions, so it's a real tuning tool.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, or target Contraption is Repaired for 20 and Upgraded.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their damaging skills don't end their Leap; it ends only when they take damage.

history.why: Made Rushing allies Ignite; now bends Leaping so an ally keeps striking from the air until something hits them.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and begins Rushing; while they're Rushing, their damaging skills Ignite.

history.why: Was Swiftwind or a double Upgrade; now Wind's Rushing keeps an ally's hits Igniting for as long as they keep acting.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Swiftness, or target Contraption is Upgraded twice.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each mobility skill they use backfires: it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Ignite locked on by Confusion; now a rigged Curse that turns the enemy's Charges, Maneuvers, Misleads and Dances against them.

before.effect: Target enemy is Ignited and Confused for 2 turns. While they're Confused, their Ignite can't be removed.

history.why: Doubled the Ignite on mobile enemies; now protects a Fire player's Ignite from cleansing.

before.effect: Target enemy is Ignited and Confused for 2 turns. While they have a mobility buff, the Ignite deals double.

history.why: Was Headwind plus a Scorch; now the target's own speed fans the fire, so they must choose between moving and burning.

before.effect: Target enemy loses their mobility buffs, gains 1 Weakness, and is Scorched for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, allied minions attack them instead of random enemies, and each one that damages them is Upgraded.

history.why: Was focus fire for 10 more damage; now focus fire that levels up every minion joining in.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allied minions attack the target instead of random enemies and deal 10 more to them.

history.why: Was Feathermark with a bonus only for the kit's own Contraptions; now it points every allied minion, from any source, at one target.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allied Contraptions deal 10 more to the target.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20. Each ally at or below half HP afterwards gets a Turret for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Uplifting Verse's heal plus a Contraption repair; now it posts Turrets beside whichever allies are still hurt.

before.effect: All allies heal 15, and every allied Contraption is Repaired to full and Upgraded.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. The user overheats: they're Ignited, and deal 5 more direct damage while they stay Ignited.

history.why: Spread an existing Ignite between its two targets; now a Fire trade-off that burns the user for extra damage, which Flameborn turns into healing.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If either is Ignited, the blades spread it to the other.

history.why: Was Falling Slam plus 5 per Contraption; now the blades carry Fire's Ignite from one enemy to the other.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, +5 per allied Contraption. Costs 1 less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Every allied minion is Upgraded, and loses that level again after 2 turns.

history.why: Was minions attacking twice; now a temporary overclock of every minion's level.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and allied minions attack twice at the end of this turn.

history.why: Was Echoing Voice reworked plus a Scorch; now a rallying whistle that doubles every allied minion's next attack.

before.effect: Every ally gains 1 Swiftness; every enemy loses 1 Swiftness and is Scorched for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, if 10 or more is left, the user builds a Turret for 2 turns from it.

history.why: Was Slipstream with a Contraption bonus in place of its Rushing bonus; now an unbroken Shield is salvaged into a Turret.

before.effect: The user gains 15 Shield, +10 per allied Contraption.

rows.effect: Builds a Decoy (Contraption, 20 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns, or 3 if they're Immobile.
For 3 turns, the user counts as a Contraption: 20 Shield, Immune, ignores Stuns, and can be Upgraded. Then they Leap.

kits.name: Brimstone
kits.tagline: Sulfur and hellfire: pack the enemy with fuel, then light it.
kits.taglineHtml: Sulfur and hellfire: pack the enemy with fuel, then light it.
kits.introHtml:
• Sulfur (Debuff, max 4): does nothing on its own. When the bearer takes Ignite damage or Explodes, their Sulfur Erupts: they take 10 Affliction per stack, each of their allies takes 5 per stack, and every stack turns into 1 Toxin. Fire lights it; Poison is what's left.

One keyword: Fire's Ignite and Explode are the fuse.

keywords.html: Sulfur (Debuff, max 4): does nothing on its own. When the bearer takes Ignite damage or Explodes, their Sulfur Erupts: they take 10 Affliction per stack, each of their allies takes 5 per stack, and every stack turns into 1 Toxin. Fire lights it; Poison is what's left.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 1 Sulfur. If that brings them to 4, their Sulfur Erupts at once.

history.why: Was Torch Strike's Ignite plus Viper Strike with Sulfur for Toxin; now it loads without fire, and the fourth stack bursts on its own.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, 1 Sulfur, and Ignite.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. For 2 turns, Explosions deal 10 more to each enemy it hit.

history.why: Ignited Prey among those hit; now primes the enemy team for a Fire player's Explosions.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Prey among them are Ignited.

history.why: Was Plague Stomp with Sulfur in place of Toxin; now Poison's Prey decides who catches Fire's Ignite.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 2 Sulfur.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. Until the user's next turn, Toxin on the target also ticks at the start of the target's turn.

history.why: Was Lunge plus double Ignites on Prey; now bends Poison's Toxin to tick an extra time.

before.effect: 10 damage. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey, and Ignites deal double to Prey.

history.why: Was Lunge plus a Scorch on Ignited enemies; now Poison's Prey window doubles every burn on the enemy team.

before.effect: 10 damage. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey, and Ignited ones are also Scorched.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user. Its user gains 2 Sulfur; if they're Ignited, it Erupts at once and the user heals as much as it deals.

history.why: Was Blisterblade with Sulfur added; now a burning attacker Erupts on the spot and the blast heals the user, Shed Skin's healing in a new form.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 2 Sulfur and is Ignited.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and every Ignited or Scorched enemy counts as Prey.

history.why: Was Sulfur for enemies' Harmful skills; now Fire's burns mark enemies as Prey for Poison's payoffs.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and every enemy who uses a Harmful skill gains 1 Sulfur.

history.why: Was Viper Stance with an Ignite added; now a sermon of damnation in which every enemy attack loads the attacker with Sulfur.

before.effect: All Might in the battle turns into Weakness; then every enemy with Weakness is Ignited.

rows.effect: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Sulfur. If the target is Prey, their Sulfur Erupts.

history.why: Was Sting with Sulfur in place of its random debuff; now Poison's Prey is itself the fuse, no fire needed.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Sulfur, or 2 if the target is Ignited.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 25 Affliction damage and 2 Sulfur, and the target's next Eruption is doubled.

history.why: Was Banewood Javelin plus an Ignite, with no Sulfur despite its hook; now sticky pitch that doubles the target's next Eruption.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 25 Affliction damage and Ignite.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Sulfur. The first damaging skill they use makes it all Erupt.

history.why: Was Snake Pit with Sulfur for Toxin; now Strategic skills feed the pit and damaging ones light it, so the enemy can't play around both.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. Each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Sulfur; the third time, they also Explode.

rows.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and every other unit, ally or enemy, is Blinded for 1 turn.

history.why: Was an escape that handed out Sulfur; now smoke that blinds both sides, a gamble that scatters an enemy focus-fire at the cost of the user's own team's aim.

before.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and every enemy gains 1 Sulfur.

history.why: Was Slither plus Flameborn; now the escape leaves a cloud that loads the whole enemy team.

before.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains Flameborn and 1 Focus.

rows.effect: Summons a Belching Toad (30 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it swallows the newest Debuff on a random ally and belches it onto a random enemy.

history.why: Was a Toad feeding enemies Sulfur; now a permanent minion that cleans one Debuff off the team each turn and hands it to the enemy.

before.effect: Summons a Brimstone Toad (30 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it gives a random enemy 1 Sulfur, or Ignites them if they have 3 or more.

history.why: Was Emerald Asp's bite with Sulfur for Toxin beside a separate Ignite skill; now the Toad runs the whole load-then-light loop by itself.

before.effect: Summons a Brimstone Toad (30 HP) permanently. Spit Sulfur (r): 5 Piercing damage and 2 Sulfur. Belch Flame (S): Ignites target enemy.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Mark for 1 turn. Until the Mark is spent, they count as Prey.

history.why: Was a Sulfur spreader; now a Poison expansion giving new access to Prey through the Mark.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Sulfur. When the target's Sulfur next Erupts, each of their allies gains 1 Sulfur from it.

history.why: Was Fireball with a Sulfur rider; now it seeds a chain reaction, one Eruption loading the next.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Sulfur. An Ignited target Explodes.

rows.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Then each one's Ignite ticks once for every 2 Toxin they have (max 3).

history.why: Was Sulfur or Ignite by turns; now Poison's Toxin stacks decide how hard Fire's Ignites burn.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Those without Sulfur gain 1; those who already have it are Ignited.

history.why: Was Acid Wash with Sulfur for Vulnerable; now the first rain loads the enemy team and the next one lights it.

before.effect: 15 damage and 1 Sulfur to all enemies.

rows.effect: Target enemy's Sulfur Erupts. Then, if they're below 15 HP (doubled for minions), they're executed.

history.why: Was Devour with a higher threshold on Ignited targets; now the Eruption softens the target first, so the execute follows the blast.

before.effect: Executes target enemy below 15 HP, or below 25 if they're Ignited (doubled for minions).

rows.effect: Summons 2 Stokers (10 HP) for 2 turns. At the end of each of your turns, each Ignites the enemy with the most Sulfur.

history.why: Was Cinderlings adding Sulfur; now the Stokers seek out the most loaded enemy and light them.

before.effect: Summons 2 Stokers (10 HP) for 2 turns. At the end of each of your turns, each gives a random enemy 1 Sulfur and deals them 5 Affliction.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 8 turns. Each turn, 5 Affliction to all enemies, and a random enemy gains 1 Sulfur. When it ends or is broken, every enemy's Sulfur Erupts.

history.why: Was Nine Plagues with Sulfur for Toxin; now the channel's end detonates everything it loaded, so breaking it early still costs the enemy.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 8 turns. 5 Affliction to all enemies each turn, and a random enemy gains 1 Sulfur; every third turn, all Ignited enemies Explode.

rows.effect: 5 Piercing damage and Ignite. If this Ignite makes their Sulfur Erupt this turn, the user gains 1 random energy.

history.why: Was Pounce plus an Ignite; now the energy comes from lighting a loaded target, not from Prey.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage and Ignite. Against Prey, you gain 1 random energy.

rows.effect: 20 Affliction damage, +10 per Toxin on the target. Then their Toxin is burned away.

history.why: Was Pyrokinesis plus Envenom's Bypass and Prey read; now Fire burns off Poison's Toxin for burst, trading damage over time for damage now.

before.effect: 20 Affliction damage, Bypassing Invulnerable; doubled against Ignited or Prey targets.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain 1 Sulfur per energy it cost.

history.why: Was Numbing Needle with Sulfur for Toxin plus a Scorch; now the bigger the skill they tried, the more fuel they choke on.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they gain 2 Sulfur and 1 Weakness, and are Scorched.

rows.effect: Bypass. 10 damage to target enemy, who is Stunned for 1 turn. Swiftness, Immune and Unstunnable don't stop it.

history.why: Was a Stun extended by an Eruption; now a short Stun that nothing can stop, for teams that lean on Swiftness or Immune.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn. If their Sulfur Erupts while they're Stunned, the Stun lasts 1 more turn.

history.why: Was Lacerate with Ignited added to its Prey check; now lighting the target mid-Stun extends it, a sequencing reward.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey or Ignited.

rows.effect: The user gains Immune for 1 turn and Explodes; every enemy with Sulfur Erupts.
Target ally heals 20, and their Toxin is drawn off: a random enemy gains that much Sulfur.

history.why: Was Moonglove Mixture with Sulfur for Toxin; now it cleanses an ally's Toxin by turning it into an enemy's fuel.

before.effect: Target unit, ally or enemy, heals 30 and gains 2 Sulfur.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and Flameborn, and their Flameborn heals them for all the Affliction damage they deal, not just their Ignites'.

history.why: Added Toxin to each Ignite the ally applied; now bends Fire's Flameborn to feed on any Affliction the ally deals.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and each Ignite they apply also gives 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Viper's Crest plus Flameborn; now the ally's Fire Ignites stack Poison's Toxin, pushing targets toward Prey.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and Flameborn for 3 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy's Toxin turns into Sulfur, stack for stack (max 4), and they're Confused for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Swamp Toxins with Sulfur added; now it reloads the Toxin that Eruptions leave behind, so one target can Erupt again.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 2 Sulfur, 1 Confusion and 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: 15 damage and 2 Sulfur. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target heal 5 per Sulfur on it.

history.why: Was Searing Brand plus Sulfur; now a Sanctify-style brand whose healing grows with the fuel on the target.

before.effect: 15 damage and 1 Sulfur. If the target was Ignited, they also gain 2 Weakness for 1 turn.

rows.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain Flameborn for 2 turns, which also heals them 10 for each Eruption their side causes.

history.why: Was Serpentsong with Flameborn for Renew plus Sulfur; now Fire's Flameborn treats every Eruption as an Explosion, healing the team.

before.effect: All allies gain Flameborn for 2 turns; all enemies gain 1 Sulfur and 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, who gains as much Sulfur as the target has.

history.why: Was Tail Lash plus Blastwave's Explosions; now the tail flicks the target's fuel onto a second enemy.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Each Ignited one Explodes; the cooldown resets if it hits Prey.

rows.effect: All enemies gain 1 Sulfur, and for 2 turns, any Sulfur removed from them Erupts instead.

history.why: Was Bad Stomach with Sulfur for Toxin; now cleansing the fuel sets it off, so their healers can't simply wash it away.

before.effect: All enemies gain 1 Sulfur; if the user has Flameborn, 1 Toxin too.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. If an enemy breaks it, the user becomes Flameborn for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Shield that handed out Sulfur; now a Fire expansion giving new access to Flameborn when the Shield breaks.

before.effect: The user gains 1 Armor and 20 Shield for 1 turn. Enemies who damage the Shield gain 1 Sulfur each time.

history.why: Was Coil plus Ashen Barrier's Shield per burning enemy; now attackers who strike the coil pick up fuel.

before.effect: The user gains 1 Armor, and 10 Shield plus 10 per enemy who is Ignited or has Toxin.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Whenever another enemy uses a Helpful skill meanwhile, the Taunt jumps to them.

history.why: Was a Taunt that stacked Sulfur each turn; now a Taunt that hunts whoever supports the enemy team, pulling healers into the fight.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. They gain 1 Sulfur at the end of each turn they're Taunted.

history.why: Was Mesmerizing Glare with Sulfur on each attack; now the Taunt loads them steadily whether they attack or not.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and Prey for 2 turns; each Harmful skill they use gives them 1 Sulfur.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune, and each Debuff aimed at them gives its user 1 Sulfur instead.

history.why: Was Wraith in White with Sulfur and Ignite counts swapped in; now debuffs thrown at the Pit Lord become fuel on the thrower.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might per enemy with Sulfur and 1 Armor per Ignited enemy, and is Immune while Flameborn.

kits.name: Sun
kits.tagline: Fire over earth: a star that scorches the enemy and ripens everything on your side.
kits.taglineHtml: Fire over earth: a star that scorches the enemy and ripens everything on your side.
kits.introHtml:
• Corona (Buff, max 3, lasts 3 turns; gaining more refreshes it): at the end of the bearer's turn, every enemy takes 5 Affliction per stack and every ally heals 5 per stack. Minions can carry it too.
  • Solar Flare: a Flare skill spends all the user's Corona for the bonus it lists per stack, trading the slow burn for a burst.

keywords.html: Corona (Buff, max 3, lasts 3 turns; gaining more refreshes it): at the end of the bearer's turn, every enemy takes 5 Affliction per stack and every ally heals 5 per stack. Minions can carry it too.
Solar Flare: a Flare skill spends all the user's Corona for the bonus it lists per stack, trading the slow burn for a burst.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy; the user gains 1 Corona.
20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. For 2 turns, Scorch on any of them also halves the Shield they gain.

history.why: Was Earth's Worldquake with Ignite counted instead of minions, plus a Scorch rider; now it bends Fire's Scorch so it also starves Shield.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Costs 1 less per Ignited enemy, and Ignited enemies hit are Scorched for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Worldquake with Fire's Ignite added; now Fire's Ignites pay for Earth's discount and turn into Scorch.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, all Ignited. Costs 1 less per allied minion.

rows.effect: 10 damage, and creates a Sunstone: a Boulder (45 HP) that Explodes when it's destroyed or launched.
Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user takes 15 Affliction per Corona the user has, and the user's Corona is refreshed.

history.why: Was Blisterblade's Igniting counter with 1 Corona tacked on; now the counter cashes in the user's Corona as burst without spending it.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user and Ignites its user; the user gains 1 Corona.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune, can hold up to 5 Corona and gains 1 each turn. When it ends, their Corona drops to 3.

history.why: Was Nature's Wrath plus 2 Corona; now it lifts the Corona cap for a window the user has to fill.

before.effect: The user creates 2 Seedlings and gains 2 Corona, then Immune for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If the user has no Corona, they gain 1; otherwise it Flares: 10 more per Corona.

history.why: Its Flare needed Corona from other Sun skills; now it alternates building and spending on its own.

before.effect: 15 damage. Flare: 10 more per Corona.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 damage to target enemy. Flare: when it lands, every ally heals 10 per Corona spent.

history.why: Was Heat Seeker's Scorch plus Tunnelmaker's early landing with Corona for the Boulder; now its Flare turns the snipe into a team heal.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 55 damage to target enemy, who is permanently Scorched. Flare: with 2 or more Corona spent, it lands a turn sooner.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, each time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they take 10 damage and the user creates a Seedling (max 3).

history.why: Was Heatstroke, a Corona Trap with an Ignite rider; now new Seedling access for Earth players, sown by the enemy's own attacks.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they're Ignited and a random ally of yours gains 1 Corona.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. At the start of their next turn they rise: they gain 1 Corona, and each enemy who used a Harmful skill meanwhile is Ignited.

history.why: Was Burrow plus 1 Corona; now a sunset and sunrise that burns the enemies who acted while the user was gone.

before.effect: The user sinks below the horizon: Invulnerable and Ghosted for 1 turn, and 1 Corona.

rows.effect: Summons a Sunflower (40 HP, counts as a Seedling) permanently; it always has 1 Corona. Scatter Seeds (r): the Sunflower loses 10 HP, and its creator creates a Seedling.

history.why: Was Forest Stalker with Corona and a renamed Channel Earth; now its skill trades its own HP for new Seedlings.

before.effect: Summons a Sunflower (40 HP, counts as a Seedling) permanently; it always has 1 Corona. Photosynthesis (r): its creator gains 1 Might and 1 Armor.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Each allied Seedling ripens: it uses Channel Earth at no cost, then loses 5 HP.

history.why: Sacrificed a Seedling to Ignite and Scorch; now a new outlet for Earth's Seedlings, cashing in their Channel Earth for free.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Seedling, one is sacrificed and the target is Ignited and Scorched for 2 turns; otherwise, the user creates one.

history.why: Was Vine Lash plus Ignite; now Earth's Seedling is planted on one cast and burned as fuel on the next.

before.effect: 25 damage and Ignite. If the user has no Seedling, they create one.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Flare: 10 more to each per Corona, but the user is Scorched for 1 turn per Corona spent.

history.why: Was Verdant Burst with a Flare bonus; now the burst costs the user their own healing for a while.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then 25 damage to all enemies. Flare: 10 more to each per Corona.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it, 10 more if the target is Ignited. The user gains 1 Corona, and all their Corona lasts 2 turns longer.

history.why: Was Worldmarch plus Corona per Seedling; now it drains burning enemies and stretches the Corona's lifespan.

before.effect: Every allied Seedling becomes a Worldsprout, and the user gains 1 Corona per Seedling.

rows.effect: Summons a Sunseed (20 HP) for 3 turns with 1 Corona. When it dies or expires, its creator gains its Corona. Brighten (r): the Sunseed gains 1 Corona.

history.why: Was Sprout Seedling with Corona on each; now one Corona carrier that grows it and hands it over when it dies.

before.effect: Creates 2 Seedlings (15 HP), each with 1 Corona. Channel Earth (r): its creator gains 1 Might and 1 Armor.

rows.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they gain 1 Corona. While it channels, their Corona doesn't expire and deals double to Ignited enemies.

history.why: Was Worldcaller with Corona each turn; now it builds Corona and doubles its bite on Fire's burning targets.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they create a Seedling and gain 1 Corona.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. The next Ignite put on them before the user's next turn burns once the moment it lands.

history.why: Was Earth's Stonepierce check with an Ignite tacked on; now primes the target so Fire's next Ignite ticks on arrival.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. If they have Shield or Armor, it first melts 10 Shield or 1 Armor, and they're Ignited.

history.why: Was Stonepierce plus Ignite; now Earth's defense check becomes Fire melting that defense away.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets with Shield or Armor, and Ignite.

rows.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each of the user's turns since they last dealt direct damage (max +30).

history.why: Was Earth's Stone Drill trading Armor for an Ignite; now magma that builds while the user holds back, a big hit for supports and patient builds.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user has Armor, they lose 1, and this deals 15 more and Ignites the target.

history.why: Was Stone Drill with Scorch tacked on; now it spends the user's own Armor to melt through.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might. The target is Scorched for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Blinded for 1 turn per Corona the user has (at least 1).

history.why: Was Pitfall with Scorch in place of Isolated; now a glare that blinds longer the brighter the user burns.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Stunned for 1 turn and Scorched for 2.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn and Ignited. Flare: 1 more turn of Stun per 2 Corona.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness, and each time their Corona ticks they gain 1 Might until it ends. They gain 1 Corona now.

history.why: Was Landslide with Corona in place of the Boulder; now a mobility buff that ramps Might off Corona ticks.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from Basking, they also gain 1 Corona.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20. Each Ignite or Scorch on them is removed and becomes 1 Corona.

history.why: Was Grovetender plus 1 Corona; now it turns an ally's burns into sunlight.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then target ally heals 15 and gains 1 Corona.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Renew. At the start of each of the user's turns, both move to the ally with the least HP.

history.why: Was a bland 1 Corona; now a blessing that turns toward whoever needs it, a roaming Buff no other Bless has.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Corona.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Scorched for 2 turns; the healing the Scorch denies them goes to a random ally of the user instead.

history.why: Was Worldmute plus Scorch; now Fire's Scorch steals the enemy's healing for the Sun's side.

before.effect: For each Might target ally has, a random enemy gains 1 Weakness and is Scorched for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Flare: for 1 turn per Corona spent, allies who damage them gain 1 Corona.

history.why: Was a second '10 more per Corona' Flare beside Noon Ray; now spending the user's Corona seeds it into the team.

before.effect: 20 damage. Flare: 10 more per Corona, and a 1-turn Stun if 3 were spent.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20. Flare: every ally gains 1 Corona per 2 Corona spent, rounded up.

history.why: Was Verse of Nurturing with Corona in place of Renew; now it spreads one ally's sun across the team.

before.effect: Channel Growth twice; then all allies heal 20 and gain 1 Corona.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Every allied Seedling is burned off: it dies, and both enemies are Ignited and burn once now per Seedling lost.

history.why: Was Sunwheel, a Corona Cleave that Ignited the unlit target; now Earth's Seedlings are spent as fuel for Fire's Ignite.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a random other enemy. If both were already Ignited, the user gains 1 Corona; otherwise, the unlit one is Ignited.

history.why: Was Vine Whirl plus Ignite and an exploding Boulder; now it lights the pair, then turns a lit pair into Corona.

before.effect: 5 damage to all enemies, Igniting them. If there's an allied Boulder, a random one is launched and Explodes on impact.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Every allied minion gains 1 Corona, and it ticks once now.

history.why: Was Awakener's Roar plus Corona; now it keeps Shout's Intimidate and makes the minions' Corona pulse at once.

before.effect: Every allied minion heals to full and gains 1 Corona.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. Damage it absorbs is baked into a random allied Boulder, which gains that much HP.

history.why: Was Rampart that Ignites attackers; now feeds Earth's Boulders, and so Launch Stone, from the hits the user soaks.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. Enemies who damage it are Ignited.

history.why: Was Rampart plus 1 Corona; now Earth's wall sets fire to whoever hits it.

before.effect: The user gains 30 Shield, or doubles their Shield if they have some, and gains 1 Corona.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. For as long, no other enemy can target the user.

history.why: Was Earth's Ancient Grudge with a Corona tick added; now a duel at high noon, where only the Taunted enemy may aim at the user.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts target enemy (only one at a time). Each time they damage the user, the user's Corona ticks once.

history.why: Was Ancient Grudge plus Scorch; now each blow the grudge-holder lands makes the user's sun flare against their whole team.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time), who is Scorched while Taunted.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune and swells: at the start of each of their turns, they gain 15 max HP and heal 15. When it ends, they lose that max HP, and every enemy takes as much damage.

history.why: Was Radiant Colossus, a locked-Corona Titan much like Solar Maximum; now a star that swells on max HP instead of Armor and collapses onto the enemy team.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune, their Corona stays at 3 and can't be spent, and each tick gives them 1 Armor. When it ends, they lose all Corona.

history.why: Was Treant Form plus 3 Corona; now the user becomes a fixed sun that hardens with every tick.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 1 Might per allied Seedling and 5 Shield per allied Boulder; they gain 3 Corona now.

kits.name: Judgment
kits.tagline: Holy fire that waits for a verdict: the enemy's own actions convict them.
kits.taglineHtml: Holy fire that waits for a verdict: the enemy's own actions convict them.
kits.introHtml:
• Sin (Debuff, max 5): an Accused enemy (a Debuff with a duration) gains 1 Sin each time they use a Harmful skill. Sin stays after Accused ends, until it's Sentenced or cleansed.
  • Sentence: a Sentence skill removes all Sin from its target for the effect it lists per Sin.

keywords.html: Sin (Debuff, max 5): an Accused enemy (a Debuff with a duration) gains 1 Sin each time they use a Harmful skill. Sin stays after Accused ends, until it's Sentenced or cleansed.
Sentence: a Sentence skill removes all Sin from its target for the effect it lists per Sin.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and they're Accused for 2 turns. If the user is Anointed, the target also gains 1 Sin at once.

history.why: Was Righteous Blow's Anointed bonus with Accused added; now Anointed speeds the conviction instead of the hit.

before.effect: 20 damage, and the target is Accused for 2 turns. If the user is Anointed, 10 more damage and they heal 10.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Their allies are Accused for 1 turn per Sin the target has (max 3).

history.why: Was a second Sentence-everyone hit beside Day of Judgment; now the target's guilt spreads Accusation to their team.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Sentences each: 10 Affliction per Sin, and anyone who had Sin is Ignited.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, who's Accused for 2 turns and gains 1 Sin at once if they used a Harmful skill last turn. The user gains 1 Focus.

history.why: Was Zealous Rush with Accused added; now it convicts retroactively for what the target just did.

before.effect: 15 damage; the target is Accused for 2 turns, and the user's next Harmful skill Sanctifies for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user and Sentences its user: 10 Affliction per Sin. With no Sin, they gain 2 instead.

history.why: Was Blisterblade's Igniting counter plus 2 Sin; now it convicts a first offender or punishes a repeat one.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 2 Sin and is Ignited.

rows.effect: All enemies are Accused for 1 turn. For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains 1 Might per Sin among enemies (max 3), rechecked each turn.

history.why: Was Divine Fury plus Blazing Fury; now the user's fury grows with the enemy team's guilt.

before.effect: The user is Anointed and Flameborn for 3 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, who's Accused for 2 turns; this time, their Helpful skills earn Sin too.

history.why: Was Sunbeam with Accused added; now a harsher charge that also convicts healing and buffing.

before.effect: 15 damage, and the target is Accused for 2 turns. Consumes the user's Anointed to heal them 15.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to the enemy with the most Sin, or to target enemy if none has more, and Sentence: 15 Affliction per Sin.

history.why: Was Spear of Light with a Sentence added; now the verdict lands on whoever is guiltiest when it falls.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage; Sentence: 15 Affliction per Sin.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, target enemy is secretly Accused; the Sin they gain stays hidden from them until it's Sentenced.

history.why: Was Decree with Accused added; now a hidden Accusation, so the enemy can't play around their Sin.

before.effect: Target enemy is Accused and Condemned for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Until their next turn, an enemy's Condemned triggers each time they use a skill instead of ending.

history.why: Turned the user's own Ignites into Anointed; now a rule bend for Holy players, making Condemned fire on every skill for a turn.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Each Ignite on them burns out: it's removed and heals them 10, and they're Anointed if any were.

history.why: Was Cloister plus Flameborn; now enemy Fire on the user is turned into Holy's Anointed.

before.effect: The user gains Immune and Flameborn for 1 turn, and Invulnerable too if they're Anointed.

rows.effect: Summons a Censer Bearer (30 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it relights one enemy whose Ignite ended or was removed since your last turn. Swing Censer (r): 10 damage to target enemy.

history.why: Was Inquisition Hound, a costly Sin minion; now an enabler that keeps Fire's Ignites burning through cleanses and expiry.

before.effect: Summons an Inquisition Hound (45 HP) permanently. Sniff Out (r): target enemy is Accused for 2 turns. Maul (S): 15 damage, +5 per Sin.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and they're Accused for 2 turns. Ignites on them burn 5 more per Sin they have.

history.why: Was Rebuke with Accused for Sanctify; now their guilt feeds any Fire burning them.

before.effect: 20 damage, and Accused for 2 turns; a target that already has Sin is also Ignited.

rows.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, and each takes as much again as the damage they dealt since the user's last turn (max 40 more).

history.why: Was Day of Judgment, a plain team-wide Sentence; now each enemy is weighed by their own last turn, so the aggressors take the blast and the idle barely feel it.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, and Sentences each: 10 Affliction per Sin.

rows.effect: 5 damage. Sentence: the user heals 10 per Sin, and is Anointed if any was removed.
Summons a Tribunal (20 HP) for 3 turns. Summons (r): target enemy is Accused for 2 turns. Condemn (W): target enemy with Sin is Condemned, then the Tribunal dies.
Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns, a random enemy without Sin is Accused and Ignited, and each enemy with Sin takes 10 damage per Sin.
10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. For 2 turns, their Ignite can't be removed, and it burns once more whenever they're healed.

history.why: Paid off Condemned plus Ignite; now bends Fire's Ignite so it can't be cleansed and punishes healing.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're Condemned. If they're Condemned and Ignited, their Ignite also burns once now.
