history.why: Was Piercing Light with Sin added to its bonus; now Holy's Condemned sets off Fire's Ignite early.

before.effect: 10 damage, +10 if the target has Sin or is Condemned or Sanctified. The bonus always applies if the user is Anointed.

rows.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy. Sentence: they're Ignited and Scorched for 1 turn per Sin removed.

history.why: Was Crusade with Accused for Condemned; now Sin is turned into lasting Fire statuses.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage. Targets above 75 HP are Accused for 2 turns; Ignited ones take 10 more.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain 3 Sin.
Target enemy with Sin is Stunned for 1 turn. Sentence: they're Intimidated for 2 turns, 1 stack per Sin removed.

history.why: Was Repentance with Sin as the trigger and a longer Stun; now the Sentence stretches their cooldowns instead.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn if they have Sin or are Condemned. Sentence: 2 turns instead if 4 or more Sin were removed.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each Explosion their side causes gives them 1 Might until it ends.

history.why: Anointed the user while any enemy was Ignited; now turns Fire's Explosions into Might, a new payoff for Explode teams.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and is Anointed while any enemy is Ignited.

history.why: Was Angel's Grace with Flameborn for Ghosted; now a mobility buff whose Anointed is lit by Fire on the enemy.

before.effect: For 2 turns, the user is Invulnerable, Immune and Flameborn.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 40. If any of it is wasted past their max HP, they're Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was a big cleanse with an Ignite-to-Flameborn rider; now overhealing becomes a new way for Holy players to Anoint.

before.effect: Target ally heals 40 and loses their Debuffs; an Ignite removed this way gives them Flameborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn, and their Harmful skills Sentence enemies with Sin: 5 Affliction per Sin.

history.why: Was Holy Favor plus Flameborn; now it hands an ally the power to Sentence.

before.effect: Target ally is Anointed and Flameborn until the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: Every unit on both sides, the user included, is Blinded until the end of the user's next turn.

history.why: Was Arraignment, Accused plus Confusion per Sin; now a cheap, symmetrical Blind that favours whichever team leans on area skills.

before.effect: Target enemy is Accused for 2 turns, and each Sin they gain meanwhile also gives them 1 Confusion.

history.why: Was Mark of Heresy with Accused added; now every sin slows them, doing Curse's job through Sin.

before.effect: Target enemy is Accused, Condemned and Sanctified until the end of the user's next turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 2 turns. Meanwhile, their Ignite's burns also trigger the Sanctify, healing whoever applied the Ignite.

history.why: Was Brand of Guilt, a bland Sentence into Sanctify; now Fire's Ignite ticks cash in Holy's Sanctify for the burner.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Sentence: they're Sanctified for 1 turn per Sin removed.

history.why: Was Karmic Marking with a Sentence added; now their Sin becomes turns of healing for whoever hits them.

before.effect: 15 damage. Sentence: 10 Affliction per Sin. If the user is Anointed, the target is also Sanctified for 2 turns.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. For 1 turn, every enemy is Taunted by the ally with the most HP.

history.why: Was Holy's Saving Grace with Ignite in place of Anointed; now the law protects the weak, forcing every enemy onto the sturdiest ally.

before.effect: All allies heal 10 and gain 10 Shield. It repeats at the start of each of the user's next 2 turns while an enemy is Ignited.

history.why: Was Saving Grace plus Flameborn; now Fire's Ignites on enemies, not Anointed, keep the litany going.

before.effect: All allies heal 10 and gain 10 Shield and Flameborn for 2 turns. If the user is Anointed, it repeats next turn.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a random other enemy. The second one gains as much Sin as the target has.

history.why: Was Blastwave with Accused added; now one enemy's guilt is copied onto a second.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and a random other enemy; both are Accused for 1 turn, and Ignited ones Explode.

rows.effect: Bypass. Sentences every enemy: 5 damage per Sin, and Condemned for 1 turn per Sin removed (max 3).
The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. The first hit meanwhile that would kill them is stayed: its damage lands at the end of their next turn instead.

history.why: Was a Shield whose breaker was Ignited and Condemned; now it postpones a killing blow, buying a turn for healers to answer it.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. The enemy who breaks it is Ignited and Condemned.

history.why: Was Shield of Faith plus Flameborn; now the Shield brands whoever breaks it.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield. If Anointed, they're also Immune and Flameborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns and Condemns them. Each time a Condemned triggers on them meanwhile, they're Ignited and it burns once at once.

history.why: Was Challenge the Guilty, a Taunt that scaled with Sin; now Holy's Condemned lights Fire's Ignite each time it triggers.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn per Sin they have (at least 1), and they're Accused while Taunted.

history.why: Was Gleam with Accused for Condemned; now the Taunt lasts longer the guiltier the target is.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and Accused until they use a new Harmful skill (which earns them Sin as usual).

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and every enemy who damages them is Sanctified for 1 turn.

history.why: Was High Inquisitor, which Accused all enemies much as Righteous Fury does; now new Sanctify access for Holy teams, marking whoever strikes the user.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune and all enemies are Accused; each Sin an enemy gains gives the user 1 Armor (max 3).

history.why: Was Grand Crusader counting Sin instead of Sanctified; now a transformation that armors up as the enemy sins.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, and Sentences each: for 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Armor per 2 Sin removed.

kits.name: Devil
kits.tagline: Fire and damnation: everything is for sale, and the bill always comes.
kits.taglineHtml: Fire and damnation: everything is for sale, and the bill always comes.
kits.introHtml:
• Contract (Buff with a due date): the bearer gets the listed benefit now; when it expires, the Devil collects the listed price. If the bearer dies before then, the Devil's user gains 2 Soul Fragments. Allies sign deals; enemies are offered temptations, whose benefit is real and whose price is steep.
  • Hellfire (Debuff): counts as Ignite, and the bearer is Horrified (can't gain Buffs, Contracts included) while it lasts.

keywords.html: Contract (Buff with a due date): the bearer gets the listed benefit now; when it expires, the Devil collects the listed price. If the bearer dies before then, the Devil's user gains 2 Soul Fragments. Allies sign deals; enemies are offered temptations, whose benefit is real and whose price is steep.
Hellfire (Debuff): counts as Ignite, and the bearer is Horrified (can't gain Buffs, Contracts included) while it lasts.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. If they have Hellfire, it spreads to a random ally of theirs for 1 turn; if not, they gain it for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Torch Strike with Hellfire for Ignite; now repeat hits spread the Hellfire across their team.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and Hellfire for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 40 damage to target enemy. For each Buff they have, a random ally of theirs gains Hellfire for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Soulcrusher with Hellfire for Horrify; now the target's own Buffs damn their allies.

before.effect: 40 damage to target enemy; their allies gain Hellfire for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user loses 15 HP. 25 damage to target enemy, and the user gains 2 Focus for their next skill.

history.why: Was Hasty Bargain, a bland Might-now, pay-later Contract; now a free charge bought with the user's own blood, the only Charge paid in HP.

before.effect: 15 damage. The user signs a Contract (2 turns): 2 Might now; price: 15 Affliction.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; each countered user gains Hellfire for 1 turn, and the user gains 1 Soul Fragment per counter.

history.why: Was Spiteful Retort and Blisterblade merged into Hellfire; now each counter also banks a Soul Fragment.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains Hellfire for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user signs a Contract (3 turns): 2 Might, Flameborn and Immortal now; price: 30 Affliction and Horrified for 2 turns.
15 damage to target enemy. An Ignite on them becomes Hellfire for 2 turns; if they already had Hellfire, the user gains 1 Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Bone Shard plus Hellfire; now it climbs a ladder from Ignite to Hellfire to a Soul Fragment.

before.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Soul Fragment the user has, and Hellfire for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage; if the target has a Contract, its price is collected now, doubled.
Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they're bound by a Contract (2 turns): 1 Swiftness now; price: Stunned for 1 turn and 2 Weakness.
Invisible. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and each ally at or below 30 HP becomes Immortal for as long.

history.why: Was Unholy's Grave Step plus an Ignite on whoever it saved them from; now spreads Unholy's Immortal to the allies closest to dying.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn; each hit that Immortal stops from killing them Ignites its dealer.

history.why: Was Grave Step plus Flameborn; now the death-save burns whoever tried to land the kill.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn and gains Flameborn.

rows.effect: Summons an Imp Notary (25 HP) permanently. Offer (I): target unit gets a Contract (2 turns): 1 Might now; price: 10 Affliction. Sealing Wax (r): 10 Affliction damage, and Hellfire on a Contract holder.

history.why: Its Firebolt reused the Unholy Imp's skill name; Sealing Wax now brands the Imp's own clients.

before.effect: Summons an Imp Notary (25 HP) permanently. Offer (I): target unit gets a Contract (2 turns): 1 Might now; price: 10 Affliction. Firebolt (r): 10 Affliction damage and Ignite.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Hellfire for 2 turns. While it lasts, each Buff it blocks on them gives the user 1 Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Fel Bolt with Hellfire for Horrify; now every Buff the Hellfire denies pays the user a soul.

before.effect: 25 damage and Hellfire for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. The user spends all their Soul Fragments (max 3), and every enemy gains Hellfire for 1 turn per fragment spent.

history.why: Was Soul Blast plus Hellfire; now it spends souls instead of scaling off them, buying longer Hellfire.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, +5 per Soul Fragment the user has, and Hellfire for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage. If the target has a Contract, it ends now and its price is collected, and the user gains 2 Soul Fragments.

Summons an Imp Captain (25 HP) for 3 turns. Ember Whip (r): 10 damage to target enemy. While it lives, the user's Soul Fragments also add their damage to every allied minion's hits, without being spent.

history.why: Was Lesser Devil, a minion bought on a Contract; now a rule bend that lets Unholy's Soul Fragments power the whole minion line.

before.effect: The user signs a Contract (3 turns): a Lesser Devil (25 HP) now; price: 15 Affliction. Prod (r): 10 Affliction damage and Hellfire for 1 turn.

history.why: Was the Unholy Imp with Hellfire and a Contract swapped in; now the summon itself is a loan the user pays off.

before.effect: Summons a Lesser Devil (25 HP) for 3 turns. Prod (r): 10 Affliction damage and Hellfire for 1 turn. Sweet Talk (I): target enemy gets a Contract (1 turn): 1 Might; price: Horrified for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Channeled. Each turn, target enemy takes 10 damage and gains Hellfire for 1 turn; the user heals for all the damage they take that turn, burns included.

history.why: Was Drain Life with Hellfire and 2 Soul Fragments; now the drain also feeds on the target's burns.

before.effect: Channeled. Each turn, 10 damage to target enemy and the user heals 10; the target has Hellfire while it lasts. If they die, the user gains 2 Soul Fragments.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. For 2 turns, the user heals for every Ignite burn on them, whoever lit it, as if Flameborn.

history.why: Was Pitchfork, a Contract-reading Stab; now new Flameborn-style healing for Fire teams, fed by any ally's Ignite.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they have a Contract or 60 HP or less. A Contract on them has 1 turn cut from it.

history.why: Was Blighted Dagger gated on Ignite; now it prods a Contract toward its due date.

before.effect: 15 damage. An Ignited target at or above 70 HP loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

rows.effect: 35 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they have Buffs, those become a Contract: they keep them for 1 turn, then pay 10 Affliction per Buff.

history.why: Was Lay Waste with a full Buff strip; now their Buffs turn into a debt that comes due.

before.effect: 35 Piercing damage. A target with Buffs loses them all and gains Hellfire for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and the user drains a Soul Fragment from them for each Ignite and Scorch they carry.

history.why: Was Devil's Offer, a Strategic counter that forced a Contract; now Fire's burns on the target are harvested as Unholy Soul Fragments.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Strategic skill, it's countered and they receive a Contract (2 turns): 2 Might now; price: 30 Affliction.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and they're Stunned for 1 turn, or until their Contract expires if they have one (max 3 turns).

history.why: Was Cripple with a Contract gate; now a Contract holds the target down until it comes due.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 permanent Vulnerable; if they have a Contract, they're also Stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and Ignites they apply burn at the end of every turn, not only theirs.

history.why: Horrified the Ignited enemies it hit; now bends Fire's Ignite to tick on both sides' turns while the dance lasts.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each Ignited enemy they damage is Horrified for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Grisly Spectacle plus Ivory Step's Explosion; now a real mobility buff where Fire's Ignite sets up Unholy's Horrify.

before.effect: 15 Piercing damage; every Horrified and Hellfire on enemies lasts 1 turn longer, and Ignited enemies Explode. The user gains 1 Confusion for 1 turn (stacking).

rows.effect: Target ally and the enemy with the most HP both have their HP set to the average of the two: the ally heals exactly what that enemy loses.

history.why: Was Infernal Bargain, a heal with a Contract price; now a devil's even split across the battle line, a heal that is also a hit on the healthiest enemy.

before.effect: Target ally heals 30 and receives a Contract (2 turns); price: 15 Affliction and Horrified for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Target ally receives a Contract (2 turns): Lifesteal now; price: 20 Affliction, minus the HP they stole meanwhile.

history.why: Was Vampirism plus Flameborn in a Contract; now the ally pays off the price by using the Lifesteal.

before.effect: Target ally receives a Contract (2 turns): Lifesteal and Flameborn now; price: 20 Affliction.

rows.effect: A coin is flipped for target enemy: heads, each of their Debuffs doubles its stacks and turns left; tails, all their Debuffs are removed.

history.why: Was Temptation, a Focus-now, Confusion-later Contract; now a true gamble on everything already stacked on the target.

before.effect: Target enemy receives a Contract (2 turns): 2 Focus now; price: 2 Confusion for 2 turns and 20 Affliction.

history.why: Was the same 2 Might for 30 Affliction deal as Devil's Offer; now a tempo loan repaid in Curse's Confusion.

before.effect: Target enemy receives a Contract (2 turns): 2 Might now; price: 30 Affliction and Horrified for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they die within 2 turns, whoever killed them has their cooldowns reset, and the user's player gains 1 random energy.

history.why: Ignited or drained a Soul Fragment depending on Ignite; now a bounty that pays the killer and the user, whoever lands the blow.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, allies who damage them Ignite them, or drain a Soul Fragment from them if they're already Ignited.

history.why: Was Soul Sickness plus Hellfire; now the team's hits light the target first, then harvest souls from the fire.

before.effect: 20 damage and Hellfire for 1 turn. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain a Soul Fragment.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20. For 2 turns, each Buff a Horrified enemy would gain goes to a random ally of the user instead.

history.why: Doubled Lifesteal against Ignited enemies; now gives Unholy's Horrified a new outlet, stealing the Buffs it blocks.

before.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain Lifesteal for 1 turn; their Lifesteal heals double against Ignited enemies.

history.why: Was Profane Chant plus Hellfire, off Prayer's job; now a team heal whose Lifesteal feeds on Fire's burning targets.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, and 2 Weakness and Hellfire for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Any enemy it kills Explodes.

history.why: Was Oathbreaker Strike with Ignite on both teams; now a new way for Fire players to cause Explosions, from kills.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy; then they and each of the user's allies take 10 and are Ignited (allies with Flameborn heal it instead).

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; those with Hellfire are Intimidated twice, and the user gains 1 Soul Fragment for each.

history.why: Was Soulshriek with Hellfire for Horrify; now Shout's Intimidate bites harder on the damned and pays souls.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Soul Fragment, they spend one for 10 more damage and Hellfire for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user signs a Contract (2 turns): 40 Shield now; price: any Shield left is lost and dealt to them as Affliction.
Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, and the user is Immortal until their next turn. Each hit that Immortal stops from killing them causes an Explosion.

history.why: Was Sinner's Lure, a Taunt sold as a Contract; now Unholy's Immortal, by holding a killing blow, sets off Fire's Explosions.

before.effect: Target enemy receives a Contract (2 turns): 2 Might now, but they're Taunted by the user; price: 20 Affliction and Hellfire for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Unrelenting Horror plus Hellfire; now the Taunt is a temptation that pays out, then burns.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns and gives them Hellfire; if they were Horrified, the user gains Lifesteal for that time.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and enemies who damage them gain Hellfire for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Soul Colossus plus Flameborn; now a transformation whose body damns anyone who strikes it.

before.effect: Consumes all the user's Soul Fragments to heal 10 each; then for that many turns (max 3), 2 Armor, Flameborn and Immortal.

kits.name: Ritual
kits.tagline: Fire in the dark: candles, circles and rites that pay off only if nobody breaks them.
kits.taglineHtml: Fire in the dark: candles, circles and rites that pay off only if nobody breaks them.
kits.introHtml:
• Rite (N): a Ritual skill with a Rite starts it on the user, visible to both players. It completes once the user (or their Acolytes) have used N more skills, with the effect that skill named; some skills advance or complete it early. The user holds one Rite at a time: starting another replaces it. If the user is Stunned, falls Asleep or is Banished, the Rite breaks. Its effect applies to the target of the skill that started it, unless it says otherwise.

One keyword: the other half of Ritual is Fire's burns and Shadow's stealth, sleep and blindness.

keywords.html: Rite (N): a Ritual skill with a Rite starts it on the user, visible to both players. It completes once the user (or their Acolytes) have used N more skills, with the effect that skill named; some skills advance or complete it early. The user holds one Rite at a time: starting another replaces it. If the user is Stunned, falls Asleep or is Banished, the Rite breaks. Its effect applies to the target of the skill that started it, unless it says otherwise.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. Rite (2): the target Explodes.
20 damage to target enemy and 10 to the others. Rite (3): every enemy is Ignited and Blinded for 2 turns.
15 damage to target enemy, and the user gains 1 Focus. Any Ignite on them is carried off: it ends, and the user's next damaging skill Ignites its targets.

history.why: Was Long Shadow with a Focus bonus against Ignited targets; now carries Fire's Ignite from one enemy to the user's next targets.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. Stealthy. If they're Ignited, the user also gains 1 Focus and their next skill is Stealthy too.

history.why: Was Long Shadow plus an Ignite rider; now Fire's Ignite on the target is what extends the Stealth.

before.effect: 10 damage. Stealthy, and the user's next skill is Stealthy and Ignites its target.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and their Rite can't be broken until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Mirage Blade and Blisterblade plus a Rite step; now it guards the Rite against the Stun meant to break it.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Ignited, and the user's Rite advances by 1.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune, and every unit on both sides gains 2 Might.

history.why: Was Rite of Fury, whose Rite only stretched its own Buffs; now a revel around the fire where everyone hits harder, which favours the side with more hits and minions.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune. Rite (3): the Might and Immune last 3 turns longer.

history.why: Was Night of Knives with a bigger Rite bonus; now Immune shields the Rite from Stuns, and finishing it prolongs the rage.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness. Rite (3): 2 more Might and Flameborn for 3 turns.

rows.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If no ally of theirs used a Helpful skill on them since the user's last turn, they're Isolated for 1 turn.

history.why: Ignited Blinded targets and burned Sleepers; now a new source of Shadow's Isolated that reads whether the target's team is tending them.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. A Blinded target is Ignited; an Asleep one takes their Ignite's damage now without waking.

history.why: Was Shadow Spine with Ignited in place of Isolated; now Shadow's statuses decide how Fire hits them.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, striking once more for each of Blinded, Ignited and Asleep that the target is.

rows.effect: Hidden target. Rite (2): 50 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable, and they're Ignited.

history.why: Was Dream Seeker with a second strike; now the delay is a Rite the enemy can break, not a fixed turn.

before.effect: On the following turn, 35 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable; it doesn't end Sleep. Rite (2): it strikes again.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each Harmful skill target enemy uses deals them 10 Affliction and advances the user's Rite by 1.

history.why: Was Dream Chains plus Ignite; now the enemy's own attacks speed the user's Rite.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy doesn't use a skill, they take 15 Affliction, fall Asleep and are Ignited.

rows.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and no enemy's Sleep can end before the user's next turn.

history.why: Blinded every Ignited enemy; now bends Shadow's Sleep so damage can't wake anyone for a turn.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and every Ignited enemy is Blinded for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Shadowstep with a Rite heal; now the escape turns Fire's Ignites into Shadow's Blind.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user is Ghosted for 1 turn. Rite (2): they gain Stealth and heal 20.

rows.effect: Summons an Acolyte (30 HP) permanently; each skill it uses advances its summoner's Rite. Chant (r): target ally heals 10. Flame Lash (r): 10 damage and Ignite.
20 damage to target enemy and Blinded for 2 turns; each time the Blind sends their skill to a random target, they're Ignited.

history.why: Was Blackbolt plus Ignite; now every misfire the Blind causes sets them alight.

before.effect: 20 damage; the target is Blinded for 2 turns and Ignited.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. Rite (3): every enemy takes 10 Affliction for each skill they used while it counted.

history.why: Was Wave of Darkness plus a flat Rite payoff; now enemies who act to stop the Rite feed its damage.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Confusion for 1 turn to all enemies. Rite (3): every enemy takes 30 Affliction.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. If the user has a Rite, it ends without completing, and they heal 10 per skill it had counted.

history.why: Was Drink Darkness plus Rite steps; now it lets the user cash in a Rite that's about to be broken.

before.effect: 5 Affliction to all enemies; Blinded ones lose Blind and take 10 more. The user's Rite advances by 1 per Blind removed.

rows.effect: Summons a Wick (15 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 10 damage to a random enemy, doubling each time; any damage to it resets it to 10.

history.why: Was Call Shade that Ignited the already Blinded; now a candle that grows 10, 20, 40 if the team keeps it safe.

before.effect: Summons a Candle Shade (15 HP) for 3 turns. Smother (r): 5 Affliction damage and Blinded for 1 turn; a target already Blinded is Ignited instead.

history.why: Was Call Shade renamed, advancing the Rite like the Acolyte; now its Smother turns a Blind into an Ignite.

before.effect: Summons a Candle Shade (15 HP) for 3 turns; each skill it uses advances its summoner's Rite. Smother (r): 5 Affliction damage and Blinded for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. While it lasts, the user can't be Stunned or put to Sleep, and each turn advances their Rite by 1.

history.why: Was Nightsong plus Ignite; now the liturgy shields the user's Rite and carries it forward.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns, and each turn advances the user's Rite. If it completes, every enemy falls Asleep and is Ignited.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if it's the skill that completes the user's Rite.

history.why: Was Backstab plus a Rite step; now it rewards saving the knife for the Rite's last beat.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or the target Blinded. The user's Rite advances by 1 more.

rows.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy. Then every Ignite on the enemy team burns once now.

history.why: Blinded Ignited targets and doubled against Blinded ones; now cashes in every Fire Ignite on the enemy team at once.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, doubled if they're Blinded; an Ignited target is Blinded for 1 turn first.

history.why: Was Ambush plus Ignite; now Fire's Ignite sets up Shadow's Blind for the double hit.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the user is Stealthed, and Ignite.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and the user's Rite completes at once.

history.why: Was Illusory Lure plus a Rite step; now a successful read completes the Rite outright.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Isolated for 2 turns; the user's Rite advances by 1.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. After this, the next time they take damage within 2 turns, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Sap plus an Ignite that didn't wake them; now a primed hex that Stuns on the next hit, the reverse of Sleep.

before.effect: 10 damage; the target falls Asleep and is Ignited, and the Ignite's damage doesn't wake them.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each skill they use advances their Rite by 1 more.

history.why: Was Hall of Phantoms plus a Rite bonus; now a mobility buff that speeds the Rite and guards it with Swiftness.

before.effect: The user gains Stealth; if already Stealthed, Ghosted, Immune and 1 Focus for 2 turns. Rite (2): all allies gain Stealth.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15. Rite (2): all allies heal 25.
For 2 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and Ignites they apply can stack, up to 2.

history.why: Was Nightwrap with an Ignite on the skill that ended it; now bends Fire's rule that Ignite doesn't stack.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth; the skill that ends it Ignites its targets.

history.why: Was Nightwrap plus Flameborn; now the ally strikes out of the smoke with fire.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth, and Flameborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 2 turns. Rite (2): every enemy is Blinded for 2 turns and Scorched.
15 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 2 turns. For as long, skills that damage them while they're Ignited are Stealthy.

history.why: Was a Shadow expansion giving Stealth to the first follow-up attacker; now Fire's Ignite on the target is what keeps Shadow attackers hidden.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. The first ally who damages them before the user's next turn gains Stealth.

history.why: Was Shadowbrand plus Ignite from Stealthed allies; now a new way into Shadow's Stealth for whoever follows up.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 2 turns. Allies who damage them from Stealth also Ignite them.

history.why: Was Shadowbrand plus Ignite; now Stealthed allies are the ones who light the branded target.

before.effect: 10 damage, and Sanctify and Ignite for 2 turns. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20. Rite (3): every ally who hasn't taken damage since it started heals 30 and gains Stealth.

history.why: Was Nightfall with a bigger Rite heal; now the vigil rewards keeping the team untouched while it burns.

before.effect: All allies gain Stealth and heal 15. Rite (3): all allies heal 30 and gain Flameborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Until the user's next turn, healing either of them receives is dealt to the other as damage instead.

history.why: Was counted as a Fire expansion, but its tether that turns one enemy's healing into the other's damage is a standalone trick no other Cleave has, so it is now Unique, text unchanged.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Until the user's next turn, healing either of them receives is dealt to the other as damage instead.

history.why: Ignited the Blinded enemies it hit; now pushes Fire's anti-healing further, turning the enemy's heals into damage.

before.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy and a random other enemy; Blinded ones are also Ignited.

history.why: Was Shadow Pulse with 5 more against Ignited; now a Stealthy two-target cut that ignites the Blinded.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies; Ignited ones take 5 more.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. The user's Rite advances by 1 per enemy that's Blinded or Ignited.

history.why: Was Hunter's Howl plus a Rite payoff; now Shout's Intimidate draws power for the Rite from the board.

before.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 2 turns, or Intimidated if already Blinded. Rite (3): every Blinded enemy Explodes.

rows.effect: The user gains 20 Shield, which lasts for as long as they stay Stealthed (at least 1 turn).

history.why: Gave Stealth if it held and Ignited its breaker; now rewards Shadow players for staying Stealthed by keeping the Shield up.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. If it survives the turn, they gain Stealth; if it breaks, whoever broke it is Ignited.

history.why: Was Veiled Guard plus Flameborn; now the ward either hides the user or burns the attacker.

before.effect: The user gains 1 permanent Armor; with 3 or more, they also gain Stealth and Flameborn.

rows.effect: Creates an Effigy (10 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn. If the Effigy is destroyed, the user's Rite completes at once.
For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune, and any Rite of theirs that completes meanwhile takes effect twice.

history.why: Was Faceless One plus a Rite bonus; now the transformation doubles the user's Rites.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor, and all enemies are Taunted by them and Isolated. Rite (3): Immune and Flameborn for 3 turns.

kits.name: Glacier
kits.tagline: Ice that moves at its own pace: freeze the enemy's clock and let yours run.
kits.taglineHtml: Ice that moves at its own pace: freeze the enemy's clock and let yours run.
kits.introHtml:
• Icebound (Debuff): the bearer's cooldowns don't tick down while it lasts.
  • Meltwater (Buff): the bearer's cooldowns tick down 1 extra at the end of each of their turns.

Glacier is a tempo kit: Ice's lockdown aimed at cooldowns, and Water's cooldown relief pushed further.

keywords.html: Icebound (Debuff): the bearer's cooldowns don't tick down while it lasts.
Meltwater (Buff): the bearer's cooldowns tick down 1 extra at the end of each of their turns.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and they're Icebound for 1 turn. If they already were, the user gains Meltwater for 1 turn instead.

history.why: Was Glacial Hammer with Icebound for Frostbitten; now a second hit on a frozen target speeds the user's own clock.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and Icebound for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. The user spends all their Renew: each stack adds 5 to every hit.

history.why: Was Icefall, an Icebound Smash much like Calving; now a new outlet for Water's Renew, cashed in as damage instead of healing.

before.effect: 30 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. The target is Icebound for 1 turn; if they already were, their allies are too.

history.why: Was Waterfall plus Meltwater; now the freeze spreads from a target already frozen to their whole team.

before.effect: 30 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. The user's other cooldowns drop by 1, and they gain Meltwater for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they're Chilled, the Chill melts off them and the user gains Meltwater for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Avalanche's Numb plus Meltwater; now it trades Ice's Chill on the target for the user's tempo.

before.effect: 15 damage and Numb for 1 turn; the user gains Meltwater for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; they gain Meltwater for 1 turn per turn of that skill's cooldown (max 3).

history.why: Was Riverbend with Icebound added; now countering a big skill buys the user the most tempo.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Strategic skill used on the user; its user is Icebound for 2 turns, and the user gains Flow.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and Meltwater; each time Meltwater brings one of their skills off cooldown, they gain 1 Might until it ends.

history.why: Was Quiet Fury with Meltwater for Focus; now the rage grows with every skill the thaw frees up.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Meltwater, Flow and 1 Might.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Their skill with the longest cooldown left and the user's other skill with the longest cooldown left swap cooldowns.

history.why: Moved Renew off twice-Chilled targets; now takes the enemy's freshest clock and gives them the user's, a cooldown swap no other kit has.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Chilled for 1 turn. If they were already Chilled, their Renew moves to a random ally of the user.

history.why: Was Icicle plus a Renew for an ally; now Ice's Chill lets the user steal the enemy's Water healing.

before.effect: 15 damage and Chilled for 1 turn; a random ally gains 1 Renew.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 50 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Icebound, it lands at once instead, and their Icebound ends.

history.why: Was Comet Shard with Icebound added; now it spends the enemy's Icebound to strike instantly.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 Piercing damage and Icebound for 2 turns. Lands instantly if the target is Chilled.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they're Icebound for 2 turns and that skill's cooldown is doubled.

history.why: Was Frost Snare with Icebound for the second Stun turn; now it buries the skill they used under a doubled cooldown.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they're Stunned for 1 turn and Icebound for 3.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and every enemy with a skill on cooldown is Icebound for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Glissade plus Meltwater; now the user dives out of reach while the enemy's clock stops.

before.effect: The user is Stunned, Invulnerable and Immune until the end of their next turn, with Meltwater for that time.

rows.effect: Summons a Walrus (45 HP) permanently. Tusk (S): 20 damage to target enemy. Haul Out (r): target ally gains Meltwater for 2 turns, and the Walrus is Icebound for as long.

history.why: Was Ice Bear with Icebound for Chill; now the Walrus freezes its own clock to speed an ally's.

before.effect: Summons a Walrus (45 HP) permanently. Tusk (S): 20 damage and Icebound for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Mark for 2 turns. If nothing has spent the Mark when it expires, it breaks on them anyway for 30 damage.

history.why: Was Glacial Bolt, Icebound with a bonus per skill on cooldown; now a Mark that is paid either by the team's follow-up or, slowly, by the ice itself.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Icebound for 1 turn. If they were already Icebound, 10 more per skill of theirs on cooldown instead.

history.why: Was Icelance with Icebound for Numb; now it punishes a frozen target for everything they've spent.

before.effect: 20 damage and Icebound for 1 turn; 10 more against targets with no Buffs.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Every Frost debuff on them thaws: it's removed, and a random ally of the user gains 2 Renew for each.

history.why: Was Glacial Outburst, Icebound per Frost debuff; now Ice's Frost debuffs melt into Water's Renew for the user's team.

before.effect: 25 damage to all enemies, and each is Icebound for 1 turn per Frost debuff they have (max 2).

history.why: Was Glacial Burst with Icebound for its no-Buffs bonus; now Ice's Frost debuffs set how long each lock lasts.

before.effect: 25 damage to all enemies; those without Buffs are also Icebound for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. If they're Icebound, it ends, and the user gains Meltwater for as long as it had left.

history.why: Was Drink Deeply plus Meltwater; now it drains the enemy's frozen time into the user's clock.

before.effect: Removes all Renew from allies; target ally heals 5 per stack removed and gains Meltwater for 1 turn per 2 stacks.

rows.effect: Summons an Ice Tongue (50 HP) for 4 turns. It does nothing for its first 2 turns; then, at the end of each of your turns, it deals 30 Piercing damage to a random enemy.

history.why: Was Glacier Sprite, a minion of spare cooldown tricks; now a slow, visible threat the enemy must spend two turns chopping down or face.

before.effect: Summons a Glacier Sprite (20 HP) for 3 turns. Meltdrip (r): target ally's longest cooldown drops by 1. Freezing Touch (I): 15 damage and Icebound for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Icy Familiar with Icebound for Chill; now it also tends an ally's slowest cooldown.

before.effect: Summons a Glacier Sprite (30 HP) for 3 turns. Freezing Touch (I): 15 damage and Icebound for 1 turn. Frost Mist (r): target enemy is Chilled for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to target enemy and Icebound for 1 turn; while it channels, the user's cooldowns don't tick either.

history.why: Was Blizzard with Icebound for Frostbitten; now a slow advance that freezes both clocks at once.

before.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to target enemy and Icebound for 1 turn; all enemies if the user is Frostborn.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. For 2 turns, Frost debuffs land on them through Immune and can't be removed.

history.why: Gave Renew per Frost debuff on the target; now an enabler that makes Ice's Frost debuffs stick through Immune and cleanses.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they have a Frost debuff; the user gains 1 Renew per Frost debuff on them.

history.why: Was Piercing Cold plus Shell Knife; now Ice's debuffs on the target feed Water's Renew.

before.effect: 10 damage and Frostbitten until the end of the user's next turn; 25 damage if the user has 3 or more Renew.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 per Confusion they have (max 3). Then their Confusion is washed away.

history.why: Was Crushing Ice, which lengthened an Icebound target's cooldowns; now a payoff for Water's Confusion skills, trading the stacks for a hit.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Icebound, each of their skills on cooldown gains 1 more turn.

history.why: Was Drown with Icebound added; now it deepens a lock that's already in place.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage. Against Stunned targets, their Stuns last 1 turn longer and they're Icebound.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Icebound for 1 turn per turn of its cooldown (max 3).

history.why: Was Dunk with Icebound for Confusion; now the bigger the skill they tried, the longer they freeze.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered and they're Icebound for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun; they're Icebound for as long as they stay Stunned.

history.why: Was Undertow plus Icebound; now a Stun that also stops them recovering while they're down.

before.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun. If they were already Stunned, their Stuns last 1 turn longer and they're Icebound too.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and Meltwater, and each ally they use a Helpful skill on gains Meltwater for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Pull of the River with Meltwater added; now the user carries the current to allies they help.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains Flow and Meltwater; now, 3 Renew and 1 Swiftness.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15 and gains Meltwater for 1 turn.
Target ally loses Icebound and Chilled, then gains Meltwater for 2 turns, +1 turn for each of those removed.

history.why: Was Touch of Grace plus Meltwater; now it thaws a frozen ally into extra tempo.

before.effect: Target ally gains Meltwater and Flow for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Icebound for 2 turns, and their skill with the longest cooldown can't be used until it ends.

history.why: Was Hypothermia with Icebound for Frostbitten; now it seals their biggest skill outright.

before.effect: Target enemy is Icebound, Chilled and Numb for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them has their Renew heal once at once, without losing a stack.

history.why: Gave Renew to allies hitting a Chilled target; now a timing bonus for Water teams, firing Renew early for free.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Chilled for 1 turn. For 2 turns, allies who damage them while they're Chilled gain 1 Renew.

history.why: Was Aqua Ring with Meltwater for Flow; now Ice's Chill decides when allies are paid in Water's Renew.

before.effect: 15 damage. For 2 turns, allies who damage the target gain Meltwater for 1 turn.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. For 2 turns, Frostbitten enemies can't use Helpful skills either.

history.why: Turned allies' Frost debuffs into Renew, close to Alchemy's Panacea; now bends Ice's Frostbitten to lock out the enemy's healing too.

before.effect: All allies heal 20. Every Frost debuff on them melts: each is removed and becomes 2 Renew.

history.why: Was Northern Solace and Rainsong plus Meltwater; now it melts Ice's debuffs into Water's healing.

before.effect: All allies heal 15, and gain 20 Shield and Meltwater for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. For 2 turns, the two share their Frost debuffs: each has any the other has.

history.why: Was an Icebound Cleave that passed Icebound to the second target; now an enabler that splits Ice's Frost debuffs across both halves of the break.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If the first is Icebound, the second is Icebound for as long.

history.why: Was Water Lash with Icebound for Weakness; now a lock breaks off one enemy onto another.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies; if the user has Flow, those hit are Icebound for 1 turn.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and every ally of the user with Flow becomes Frostborn for as long.

history.why: Was Groaning Ice, Icebound on enemies who acted; now Water's Flow on the user's allies unlocks Ice's Frostborn.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; any who use a skill before the user's next turn are Icebound for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Arctic Roar with Icebound for Frostbitten; now a warning that freezes whoever moves anyway.

before.effect: The enemy team is Icebound until the end of the user's next turn.

rows.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns, and Meltwater for as long as any of it remains.

history.why: Was Permafrost plus Aqua Veil's Renew; now the shelf speeds the user's clock for as long as it holds.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns (35 if Frostborn) and 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy until they next take direct damage, for up to 4 turns.

history.why: Was Glacial Pull, a Taunt that Icebound Chilled targets; now a long, cold stare that holds only while the user's team leaves that enemy untouched.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns; if they're Chilled, they're also Icebound for as long.

history.why: Was Tidal Pull plus Icebound with its Flow reset intact; now Ice's Chill decides whether the Taunt freezes them too.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns and Icebinds them for 1. The cooldown resets if the user gains Flow.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Icebound, then Immune, and gains 1 Armor per skill of theirs on cooldown (max 3), rechecked each turn.

history.why: Was Naiad Form with Meltwater for Might; now the user freezes their own clock to stay armored while their skills are spent.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 2 Armor, 2 Renew and Meltwater.

kits.name: Aurora
kits.tagline: Ice and lightning lit up across the sky: the kit that bends energy colors.
kits.taglineHtml: Ice and lightning lit up across the sky: the kit that bends energy colors.
kits.introHtml:
• Shimmer (Buff): the bearer may pay colored costs with any color, as if they were random.
  • Dazzled (Debuff): at the start of each of the bearer's turns, one of their player's energies changes to a random other color.

Lightning changes how much energy a player has; Aurora changes which colors they have.

keywords.html: Shimmer (Buff): the bearer may pay colored costs with any color, as if they were random.
Dazzled (Debuff): at the start of each of the bearer's turns, one of their player's energies changes to a random other color.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, +5 per Charge the user has. Then 1 of that Charge is spent to give the user Shimmer until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Jolt with 5 more damage and Shimmer tacked on; now it turns 1 Charge into Shimmer, trading energy quantity for color freedom.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +5 per Charge the user has; the user gains Shimmer for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Until the end of the user's next turn, Frost debuffs on everyone it hits can't wear off or be removed.

history.why: Gave Charge per Chilled enemy hit; now freezes the Frost debuffs already on the enemy team in place, which any Ice player can build around.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. The user gains 1 Charge for each Chilled enemy it hits.

history.why: Was Static Slam with Dazzled tacked on; now the splash always lands, and Ice's Chilled on the enemy team turns into Lightning's Charge.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. If the user is Charged, their allies take 15, are Sapped, and are Dazzled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user has Shimmer for their next skill, which deals 10 more if it hits this enemy too.

history.why: Was Charged Dash with more damage and Shimmer tacked on; now it's a two-step combo that rewards following up on the same target.

before.effect: 15 damage; the user gains 1 Charge, and Shimmer for their next skill.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. Its user is Sapped twice, and their Sapped can't be removed for 3 turns.

history.why: Chilled the attacker and gave 3 Charge side by side; now locks Sapped onto the attacker so a Lightning team can push them to 3.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. Its user is Chilled for 2 turns, and the user gains 3 Charge.

history.why: Was Frost Spines with Dazzled attached; now the counter locks the attacker's costs with Chilled and fills the user's Charge, an energy swing both ways.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Dazzled for 2 turns, and the user gains Frostborn.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Stormborn and 1 Might. Whenever their Charge reaches 3, every enemy is Dazzled for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Overcharge with Shimmer and Might added; now each Charge peak that Stormborn builds scrambles the enemy's colors.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Stormborn, Shimmer and 1 Might.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and Dazzled for 2 turns. It deals 10 more if they were already Dazzled.

history.why: Was Zap with a Shimmer clause that Shimmer already covers; now it's a free flicker that Dazzles and hits harder when kept on one target.

before.effect: 15 damage, and the user gains 1 Charge. Costs r instead while the user has Charge or Shimmer.

rows.effect: Channeled. Target enemy is Chilled until it lands on the following turn, and Sapped once for each energy their player spends meanwhile. Then 35 Piercing damage.

history.why: Was bonus damage per energy the target spent; now Ice's Chilled keeps their costs full while every energy spent Saps them, so the Chill feeds Lightning's Sapped.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each energy their player spends before it lands.

history.why: Was Comet Shard plus Particle Beam's Sapped splash; now the enemy must choose between spending energy and softening a hit they can't see coming.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 Piercing damage, and 20 to every Sapped enemy. Lands instantly if the target is Chilled.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time a Frost debuff on target enemy would end or be removed, it lasts 2 more turns instead, and they take 15 Piercing damage.

history.why: Sapped on each skill, then Chilled at 3 Sapped; now a hidden guard on the target's Frost debuffs that punishes cleansing or waiting them out.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they're Sapped. When that brings them to 3 Sapped, they're also Chilled for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Tesla Coil with Dazzled tacked on; now repeated use drains them to an energy loss, and Ice's Chilled stops them discounting around it.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they take 15 damage, are Sapped, and are Dazzled for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Their Sapped turns into as much Charge; if they're Chilled, it ends and they gain Shimmer for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Blink with Shimmer in place of its damage; now it flips the parents' energy debuffs on the user into their opposites.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains Shimmer for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Summons an Aurora Fox (30 HP, Stormborn) permanently. Foxfire (r): 10 damage to target enemy, +5 per Charge the Fox has, and Dazzled for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Storm Hawk with Dazzled and Shimmer swapped in; now the Fox builds its own Charge from every hit, feeding its bite and its player's energy.

before.effect: Summons an Aurora Fox (30 HP) permanently. Foxfire (r): 10 damage and Dazzled for 1 turn. Glow (I): target ally gains Shimmer for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If the user has Shimmer, it ends and this deals 15 more; if not, the user gains Shimmer for their next skill.

history.why: Was Polar Bolt, Dazzled scaled by Frost debuffs; now a Shimmer skill that alternates between granting Shimmer and cashing it in for damage, evening the core split.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Dazzled for 1 turn, +1 turn per Frost debuff they have.

history.why: Was Icelance plus Numb and Dazzled riders; now Ice's Frost debuffs lengthen the color scramble instead of adding damage.

before.effect: 20 damage, and Numb and Dazzled for 1 turn; 10 more against targets with no Buffs.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Chilled ones are Dazzled for 2 turns; the rest are Chilled for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Glacial Burst with its no-Buffs bonus swapped for Dazzled; now Chilled sets up Dazzled, so Ice teammates or a second cast escalate it.

before.effect: 25 damage to all enemies, and each is Dazzled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. Their player loses 1 energy of the color they hold most, and the user's player gains it.

history.why: Stole energy only from Sapped or Chilled targets; now an unconditional energy theft, the only Consume in the game that drains a player's energy instead of HP.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. If they're Sapped or Chilled, their player loses 1 random energy and the user's player gains it.

history.why: Was Siphon Charge paying out energy and Shimmer every time; now it steals an energy, but only from targets the parents' debuffs already weakened.

before.effect: 5 damage, and Saps. The user's player gains 1 energy of a random color, and the user gains Shimmer for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Summons a Stray Aurora (30 HP) for 3 turns that sides with no one; either team can target it. Each turn it deals 15 damage to a random unit on whichever side has more total HP.

history.why: Was Sky Wisps, a Summon whose only trick was Dazzling; now a neutral light that always punishes the side that's ahead, a comeback tool that can turn on the user.

before.effect: Summons 2 Sky Wisps (10 HP) for 3 turns. Flicker (r): target enemy is Dazzled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns. Each turn, 5 damage to all enemies, and every ally has Shimmer. It ends early if the user takes direct damage.

history.why: Was Lightningrod with Shimmer added; now it frees the whole team's colors for as long as the enemy leaves the channeler alone.

before.effect: Channeled. The user has Stormborn and Shimmer while channeling.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if their player's energy can't pay for any of their skills. Either way, they're Dazzled for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Stun Baton with Chilled added; now it finishes energy-starved targets, and its Dazzle helps create the starvation.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the target was at or above 80 HP, the user gains Charge; if they end at or below 40, they're Sapped and Chilled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. All the user's Charge pours into them: they're Sapped once for each Charge spent.

history.why: Spent Charge for damage only on Chilled targets; now turns the user's own Charge into Sapped on the enemy, a new outlet for Charge.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Chilled, it spends all the user's Charge for 10 more each; if not, the user gains 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Malectrocute with a third +10 for Chilled; now Chilled decides whether it builds Charge or cashes it all in.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, +10 if the user is Charged, +10 if the target is Sapped and +10 if they're Chilled.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they're Dazzled for 1 turn, +1 per energy it cost.

history.why: Was Hologram with Dazzled added to its trigger; now the counter punishes big spends with a longer scramble.

before.effect: For 1 turn, any Sapped or Dazzled enemy who uses a Harmful skill is countered, and the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, their skills that share a color with the last skill they used are stunned.

history.why: Was a Texture row that used neither parent's statuses; its color-keyed Stun is already a standout no other Stun has, so it's now tagged Unique unchanged.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, their skills that share a color with the last skill they used are stunned.

history.why: Was System Shock with Dazzled added to its condition; now it stuns by energy color, reading what the target last cast.

before.effect: 15 damage, and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Sapped or Dazzled.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Shimmer. Each turn they use a skill that shares no color with their previous one, they gain 1 Swiftness and 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Three Storm Breaths with Shimmer added; now it rewards rotating through colors, which Shimmer makes easy to pay for.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Stormborn, Conduit and Shimmer.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15. At the start of the user's next turn, they heal 5 more for each Frost debuff on the enemy team (max 30).

history.why: Cleansed Sapped and Frost debuffs side by side; now a delayed heal that grows with how frozen the enemy team is, for Ice teams.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15 and loses their Sapped and Frost debuffs, healing 10 more for each one removed.

history.why: Was Defibrillate with Shimmer tacked on; now it cleanses both parents' energy debuffs and heals more the more it removes.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, +5 per Charge the user has, and gains Shimmer for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Target ally gains Shimmer for 2 turns, and all of the user's Charge moves to them.

history.why: Was Boreal Aegis with Shimmer added; now it hands an ally both color freedom and the user's stored Charge.

before.effect: Target ally gains Shimmer and Frostborn until the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Dazzled for 2 turns. Each time it changes one of their player's energies, they're also Sapped.

history.why: Was Power Drain with Dazzled tacked on; now each scramble also drains, so the curse ramps toward an energy loss.

before.effect: Target enemy is Sapped, and Dazzled for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Dazzled for 1 turn. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them extends it by 1 turn.

history.why: Was Apply Polarity with Shimmer swapped in and Numb added; now the team's focus fire keeps the target's colors scrambled.

before.effect: 15 damage and Numb for 1 turn. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain Shimmer for 1 turn.

rows.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield. Every skill on cooldown on the user's side comes 1 turn closer to ready.

history.why: Spent allies' Charge for Shield (the stock formula); now the only Prayer that speeds up the whole team's cooldowns.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield. Allies with Charge spend it for 10 more Shield each.

history.why: Was Signal Boost with Shimmer added; now allies trade Lightning's Charge for an Ice wall, giving up the energy for protection.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain Shimmer for 1 turn; Charged allies heal 10 more per Charge.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. It arcs for 10 to the other enemy whose last skill cost the most, Dazzling them for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Arc with Dazzled added as a second conductor; now the arc seeks out whoever spent the most energy.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and to every Marked or Dazzled enemy; then the target is Marked.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. The user gains 1 Charge for each Frost debuff among them (max 3).

history.why: Was Sky of One Color, Chilled beside a color scramble; now the Frost debuffs on the enemy team charge the user, turning Ice's setup into Lightning's resource.

before.effect: All enemies are Chilled for 1 turn, and every energy their player holds turns into one random color.

history.why: Was Crackle with Dazzled for Chilled enemies; now it turns the enemy's whole pool one color, and Chilled stops them discounting around it.

before.effect: Saps all targetable enemies; Chilled ones are also Dazzled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns, and has Shimmer while any of it remains.

history.why: Was Permafrost plus Lightning Cage stitched together; now breaking the Shield also strips the user's color freedom.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield (35 if Frostborn), +10 per Charge, and gains Charge whenever it's hit.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. While Taunted, each Sapped they gain counts as 2.

history.why: Chilled the target and gave Charge side by side; now bends Sapped so a Lightning team drains the Taunted enemy twice as fast.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns; they're Chilled while Taunted. Each skill they use on the user gives the user 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Cold Shoulder with Dazzled added; now their forced attacks feed the user's Charge while Chilled keeps their costs full.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn; while Taunted, they're Dazzled and Frostbitten.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Shimmer and Immune, and 1 Armor for each color among their player's energies.

history.why: Was EXO-Armor with Shimmer tacked on; now its Armor comes from a full-spectrum energy pool rather than spent Charge.

before.effect: Consumes the user's Charge for 1 Armor and 1 Swiftness each; then Stormborn and Shimmer for 3 turns.

kits.name: Winter
kits.tagline: Ice on the wind: the season that pins everything in place.
kits.taglineHtml: Ice on the wind: the season that pins everything in place.
kits.introHtml:
• Snowbound (Debuff; counts as a Frost debuff): the bearer counts as Immobile. They lose their mobility buffs (Swiftness, Rushing, Leaping), can't gain new ones, and their mobility skills (Charge, Maneuver, Mislead, Dance) cost 1 more.

One keyword: Wind already has tools that punish the Immobile, and Winter's own side stays fast (Rushing, Leaping) while the enemy's freezes.

keywords.html: Snowbound (Debuff; counts as a Frost debuff): the bearer counts as Immobile. They lose their mobility buffs (Swiftness, Rushing, Leaping), can't gain new ones, and their mobility skills (Charge, Maneuver, Mislead, Dance) cost 1 more.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they used a mobility skill since the user's last turn, they're Snowbound for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Glacial Hammer with Snowbound in place of Frostbitten; now it punishes an enemy who just moved by pinning them for longer.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and Snowbound for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user Leaps. At the start of their next turn, if they're still Leaping, they land: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies.

history.why: Was Spiral Crash with Snowbound on its Leaping branch; now it's a delayed crash that keeps the user safe in the air, and enemies can cancel it by stripping the Leap.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If the user isn't Leaping, they Leap; if they are, every enemy takes 10 and is Snowbound for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user begins Rushing, and their next damaging skill also Snowbinds its targets for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Launch with Frostborn tacked on; now the skate sets up a pin, turning the user's speed into the enemy's stillness.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing and gains Frostborn for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. Every Frost debuff on its user shatters: it ends, and they take 15 Piercing damage for each.

history.why: Was 15 Piercing, or 30 if Immobile; now cashes in the attacker's Frost debuffs as damage, a new outlet for Ice teams.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, dealing 15 Piercing damage to its user, or 30 if they're Immobile.

history.why: Was Frost Spines with Snowbound and Chilled as the payoff; now Zephyr Blade's Piercing punishment lands hardest on attackers who can't move.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Snowbound and Chilled for 2 turns.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and any enemy who uses a mobility skill is Snowbound for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Chainbreaker with Frostborn added; now it's a 3-turn freeze on the enemy's movement that punishes every dodge.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs; Immune and Frostborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, +5 for each turn in a row the user has used Snowball. From the third in a row, they're also Snowbound for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Icicle with Snowbound in place of Chilled; now it grows every turn it keeps rolling and pins only once it's big.

before.effect: 15 damage and Snowbound for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled. Every enemy is Snowbound until it lands. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to the enemy team.

history.why: Was Elegant Sweep with a Snowbound bonus; now the channel itself pins the whole team, so no one can Leap clear of the blow.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 25 Piercing damage to the enemy team; Snowbound ones take 15 more.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, if target enemy uses a mobility skill, it's countered, and they take 15 Piercing damage and are Snowbound for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Float Noose with Snowbound added; now it's an invisible snare that springs only when the target tries to move.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage and are Isolated and Snowbound for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user Leaps. Enemies who damaged them since their last turn are Snowbound for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Bound with Frostborn tacked on; now the escape also pins whoever was chasing the user.

before.effect: The user Leaps and gains Frostborn for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Summons a Great Yeti (80 HP) permanently. Yeti Maul (nc): 30 damage to target enemy. At the start of each of the user's turns, their player pays 1 random energy to feed it, or it leaves.

history.why: Was Winter Wolf, a Leap/Rush support pet; now a huge, free-swinging Companion with an energy upkeep every turn, the only minion that costs rent.

before.effect: Summons a Winter Wolf (40 HP) permanently. Cold Jaws (S): 20 damage to target enemy. Hunting Howl (r): each ally who is Leaping or Rushing gains 1 Might for 2 turns.

history.why: Cold Jaws Isolated Immobile targets; the Wolf now gives Wind teams a payoff for staying airborne or Rushing.

before.effect: Summons a Winter Wolf (40 HP) permanently. Cold Jaws (S): 20 damage to target enemy; if they're Immobile, they're also Isolated for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Ice Bear's bite with Snowbound plus Grand Eagle's Soar; now the Wolf cuts pinned prey off from their healers with Wind's Isolated.

before.effect: Summons a Winter Wolf (40 HP) permanently. Cold Jaws (S): 20 damage and Snowbound for 1 turn. Howl (A): target ally Leaps.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they're Immobile, their non-Strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn; if not, they're Snowbound for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Compressed Bolt with 5 more damage; now a mobile target gets pinned instead, setting up the stun for the next cast.

before.effect: 20 damage. If the target is Snowbound or otherwise Immobile, their non-Strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. If the user is Rushing or Leaping, they stop, and every enemy is Snowbound for 1 turn, or 2 if they were both.

history.why: Was Spiral Burst with more damage and Chilled added; now the user spends their own speed to freeze the enemy team.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies, +10 if the user is Leaping and +10 if Rushing. All are Chilled for 1 turn, and Snowbound too if the user is Rushing.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, and Snowbound for 1 turn. The user heals 10 and gains each mobility buff this strips from them.

history.why: Was Sap Speed with Snowbound added; now it steals the exact buffs it strips, Rushing and Leaping included, and heals like a Consume.

before.effect: 5 damage; removes the target's mobility buffs and Snowbinds them for 1 turn. The user gains 1 Swiftness per buff removed.

rows.effect: Summons 2 Snow Sprites (10 HP) for 3 turns. Flurry (nc): 5 Piercing damage; a target hit twice in one turn is Snowbound for 1 turn.
Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, and a random one is Snowbound for 1 turn each turn. While it lasts, enemies' Frost debuffs don't wear off.

history.why: Was Vortex stretched to 3 turns with a random Snowbound; now it stops every Frost debuff from wearing off, so the pins pile up instead of melting.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns; each turn, a random enemy is Snowbound for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're Immobile. If the user is Rushing, the target is also Snowbound for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Airknife with Snowbound added to its condition; now Rushing sets up the pin and the pin pays out the damage, a two-stab combo.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 if the user is Rushing or the target is Snowbound.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. The user is Frostbitten for 1 turn and gains Frostborn for 2.

history.why: Stitched Shardstorm's Frostbitten bonus onto Sonic Thrust's self-Stun; now the user freezes themselves to gain Frostborn, a trade-off only Ice offers.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 if they're Frostbitten. Unless the user is Rushing or Frostborn, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Sonic Thrust with its risk removed and Frostbitten added; now it keeps the risk, and Ice's Frostborn gives a second way to avoid it.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage. If the user is Rushing, the target is also Frostbitten for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and the user Leaps. That Leap isn't spent by the user's next damaging skill.

history.why: Countered more against Immobile targets and copied Wind Step's Rushing; now bends Leaping so it survives one hit.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters target enemy's Harmful skills, or all their skills if they're Immobile. When it triggers, the user begins Rushing.

history.why: Was Wind Step with Snowbound added; now it counters, and against a pinned target it shuts down every skill, not just Harmful ones.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they're Marked and Snowbound for 2 turns, and the user begins Rushing.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun that Swiftness can't stop: they lose all their Swiftness instead, and it lasts 1 turn longer per stack lost.

history.why: Was Buffet with a Snowbound condition; now Ice's Absolute Zero idea turns Wind's Swiftness against its owner.

before.effect: 10 damage, and stuns their Strategic skills for 1 turn; Snowbound targets are fully Stunned.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 2 Swiftness, and begins Rushing. Whenever their Swiftness stops a Stun, the Stun's user is Snowbound for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Top Speed with Frostborn tacked on; now every Stun the dancer slips pins the one who threw it.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, Ghosted and Frostborn, and begins Rushing.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20. For 2 turns, whenever they damage an enemy with a Frost debuff, they begin Rushing.

history.why: Was Second Wind, a Wind-only bonus heal on Leaping; now Ice's Frost debuffs on the enemy set the healed ally Rushing, so the freeze feeds Wind's speed.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15. The next time they Leap or begin Rushing within 3 turns, they heal 20 more.

history.why: Was Invigorating Breeze plus Freeze Wound; now a delayed heal that rewards the ally's own mobility.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20. If they're Immobile, they begin Rushing; if not, they gain 2 Armor for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Invigorating Breeze plus Freeze Wound's Armor; now it frees pinned allies and braces mobile ones instead of giving both.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains 1 Armor for 1 turn; above 60 HP afterwards, they begin Rushing.

rows.effect: Target ally gains Frostborn for 2 turns. While they're Frostborn, Frost debuffs they apply last 1 turn longer.

history.why: Was Boreal Aegis plus Swiftwind with an Immobile rider; now makes an Ice ally's Frost debuffs stick longer.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Swiftness and Frostborn until the end of their next turn. Until then, Immobile enemies can't target them.

history.why: Was Swiftwind plus Boreal Aegis; now Frostborn's untouchability extends to anyone pinned to the ground.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Swiftness, and Frostborn until the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Snowbound for 2 turns, and gains 1 Weakness for each mobility buff this strips from them.

history.why: Was Headwind with Snowbound in place of its strip; now the Weakness scales with how much speed the target loses.

before.effect: Target enemy is Snowbound for 2 turns and gains 1 Weakness.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, allies who damage them gain 1 Swiftness; once two have, the target is Snowbound for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Feathermark with Snowbound added; now the team's follow-up hits speed them up and, together, pin the target.

before.effect: 20 damage and Snowbound for 1 turn. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target Leap.

rows.effect: All allies heal 30 and gain 15 Shield. Then every unit on both sides, the user included, is Snowbound for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Winter's Verse, close to Wind's own all-Leap Prayer; now a strong, cheap Prayer that snows in the whole battlefield, stripping mobility from both teams alike.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and Leap. At the start of the user's next turn, each ally still Leaping heals 15 more.

history.why: Was Uplifting Verse with the enemies' Leap swapped for Snowbound; now each ally chooses between attacking out of the Leap and holding it for a second heal.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and Leap; every enemy is Snowbound for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If the user is Leaping, they come down on both: each is Frostbitten for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Snowfall Slam, splash on Immobile enemies; now Wind's Leaping sets up Ice's Frostbitten on both targets as the user lands.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and 10 to every Immobile enemy.

history.why: Was Falling Slam with a Snowbound bonus; now it's one strong hit whose spread depends on how many enemies can't move.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies; Snowbound ones take 10 more. Costs 1 less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

rows.effect: Enemies with a mobility skill or buff are Snowbound for 2 turns; Immobile enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns instead.

history.why: Was Echoing Voice with the enemies Snowbound instead of sped up; now each enemy gets the debuff that hurts them, pinning the mobile and slowing the rest.

before.effect: Every ally gains 1 Swiftness; every enemy is Snowbound for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user gains 10 Shield for 3 turns, and 10 more at the start of each of their turns meanwhile. It all melts the moment they use a damaging skill.

history.why: Was Snowpack, a Shield that Snowbound its attackers, the same trick as the kit's Taunt; now a Shield that piles up while the user holds their fire and vanishes when they strike.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. Enemies who damage it are Snowbound for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Permafrost with Slipstream's Rushing condition; now hitting the Shield gets attackers stuck in it.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns, or 35 if they're Rushing.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each Harmful skill they use on the user leaves them Snowbound for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Piercing Cry plus Cold Shoulder's Frostbitten; now every forced attack on the user digs the target deeper into the snow.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn, or 3 if they're Snowbound or otherwise Immobile; they're Frostbitten while Taunted.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and no unit in the battle can be healed, the user included.

history.why: Gave Shield per Immobile enemy; now the only Titan that shuts off healing for both teams.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune, and at the start of each of their turns, 10 Shield for each Immobile enemy.

history.why: Was Djinnform with more Shield and Frostborn; now its Shield grows each turn with how many enemies are pinned.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 20 Shield, Immune and Frostborn; then they Leap.

kits.name: Stasis
