kits.tagline: Cold that stops the clock on poison: freeze the afflictions in place, then let them all go at once.
kits.taglineHtml: Cold that stops the clock on poison: freeze the afflictions in place, then let them all go at once.
kits.introHtml:
• Suspended: the bearer's effects don't tick, lose duration or deal damage while it lasts (Toxin, Ignite and Renew included). A Debuff on enemies; on allies, a Buff that makes their Buffs last longer. The bearer still acts normally.
  • Thaw: when Suspended ends, all the bearer's Toxin deals its damage at once, doubled (10 Affliction per stack), and then keeps ticking as normal.

keywords.html: Suspended: the bearer's effects don't tick, lose duration or deal damage while it lasts (Toxin, Ignite and Renew included). A Debuff on enemies; on allies, a Buff that makes their Buffs last longer. The bearer still acts normally.
Thaw: when Suspended ends, all the bearer's Toxin deals its damage at once, doubled (10 Affliction per stack), and then keeps ticking as normal.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Until the user's next turn, their Toxin also deals its damage each time they use a skill.

history.why: Was Viper Strike with a Frostbitten-per-Toxin bonus; now bends Toxin to tick on every skill the target uses, for Poison teams.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 1 Toxin. If they're Frostbitten, it deals 5 more for each Toxin they have.

history.why: Was Viper Strike with an extra Toxin against Suspended targets; now Ice's Frostbitten turns the target's Toxin stacks into Strike damage.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Toxin, or 2 Toxin if the target is Suspended.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and they're Suspended for 1 turn. When they Thaw, each of their allies takes half the Thaw's damage.

history.why: Was Plague Stomp with Suspended tacked on; now the splash comes later, as a share of the target's Thaw.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 1 Toxin and are Suspended for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey, and the user's next skill Suspends its targets for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Lunge with Numb tacked on; now it primes the user's next skill to freeze whoever it hits.

before.effect: 10 damage and Numb for 1 turn. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 2 Toxin and is Suspended for 1 turn, so the Toxin lands later as a Thaw.

history.why: Was tagged Suspended though its payoff is the delayed Thaw; now tagged Thaw, text unchanged, to even the core split.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 2 Toxin and is Suspended for 1 turn, so the Toxin lands later as a Thaw.

history.why: Was Frost Spines with Suspended in place of Frostborn, which did nothing to a target without Toxin; now the counter loads the Toxin it freezes.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Suspended for 2 turns.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and their skills don't go on cooldown. When it ends, each skill they used meanwhile goes on its full cooldown.

history.why: Was Viper Stance with durations added; now the only Rage that suspends the user's cooldowns, then bills them all at once.

before.effect: All Might in the battle turns into as much Weakness. On allies, it ends at the end of the turn; on enemies, it lasts 3 turns.

history.why: Was Viper Stance plus Absolute Zero's Swiftness; now it keeps Viper Stance's battle-wide conversion, but the cold makes it fade at once on allies and linger on enemies.

before.effect: All Swiftness and Might on enemies turn into as much Weakness.

rows.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, and each Frost debuff on them lasts 1 turn longer.

history.why: Gave Toxin per Frost debuff; now a cheap extender that keeps an Ice team's Frost debuffs up.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage to target enemy and 1 Toxin, +1 for each Frost debuff they have.

history.why: Was Sting plus Icicle's Chilled; now Ice's Frost debuffs decide how much Toxin the sting delivers.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, 1 Toxin, Weakness or Vulnerable at random, and Chilled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled. Target enemy is Suspended until it lands on the following turn: 30 Piercing damage, and then they Thaw.

history.why: Was Banewood Javelin with 5 more damage and a Thaw only for already-Suspended targets; now the channel freezes the target itself, trading the hidden target for a guaranteed Thaw.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 30 Affliction damage; a Suspended target Thaws at once.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time target enemy is healed, they gain 2 Toxin and are Suspended for 1 turn, stalling their Renew.

history.why: Was Snake Pit with Suspended added; now it springs on healing, answering the heal with poison and freezing any Renew.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. Each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Toxin; the first time, they're also Suspended for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and is Suspended for 2: their Buffs hold, and their Debuffs wait.
Summons an Ice Spider (30 HP) permanently. Frost Web (r): target enemy is Suspended for 1 turn. Frozen Fang (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin; a Suspended target Thaws at once instead.

history.why: Was a Spider whose Fang only added more Toxin to Suspended targets; now it webs, then cracks the web early, so the Companion plays both halves of the Thaw.

before.effect: Summons an Ice Spider (30 HP) permanently. Frost Web (r): target enemy is Suspended for 1 turn. Frozen Fang (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin, or 3 Toxin if the target is Suspended.

history.why: Was Emerald Asp with Constrict swapped for a Suspend; now the Spider webs a target and then loads it with Toxin for the Thaw.

before.effect: Summons an Ice Spider (30 HP) permanently. Frozen Fang (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin. Web of Stillness (rr): target enemy is Suspended for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, each time their Toxin ticks, they're Chilled for 1 more turn.

history.why: Was Frozen Acid, a Poison expansion that turned expiring Buffs into Toxin; now Poison's ticking Toxin keeps building Ice's Chilled.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Each of their Buffs loses 1 turn, and each Buff that ends this way leaves them 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Acid Orb plus Numb; now Ice's hostility to Buffs hurries them to expire, and Poison fills the gap with Toxin.

before.effect: 20 damage and Numb for 1 turn; Prey targets are also Marked and gain 1 Vulnerable.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Then every unit on both sides, the user included, is Suspended for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Cold Snap, a Suspend on Buffless enemies; now it stops the clock for the whole battlefield, freezing both teams' Buffs, Debuffs and ticks at once.

before.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Those with no Buffs gain 1 Toxin and are Suspended for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Acid Wash with Toxin and Suspended swapped in; now it freezes only enemies with no Buffs, so the freeze never extends theirs.

before.effect: 15 damage and 1 Toxin to all enemies; all are Suspended for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Target enemy's Toxin deals its damage at once, doubled, and the user heals as much as it deals.

history.why: Was Devour with a Thaw only for already-Suspended targets; now it Thaws any target on the spot and drinks the release.

before.effect: Executes target enemy below 15 HP (doubled for minions). A Suspended target Thaws first, then is executed if that leaves them below 15.

rows.effect: Summons a Cryo Sprite (15 HP) for 3 turns. Rime Sting (W): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin. If it lasts all 3 turns, every enemy with Toxin is Suspended for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Spriggan Harasser with a Suspend skill added; now the Sprite is a fragile timer the enemy must kill before it freezes their team.

before.effect: Summons a Cryo Sprite (15 HP) for 3 turns. Sting (W): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin. Stillness (rr): target enemy is Suspended for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. Every enemy is Suspended while it lasts, and each turn a random enemy gains 1 Toxin. When it ends, they all Thaw.

history.why: Was a shorter Nine Plagues with Suspended at the end; now it banks every tick instead of dealing it, for one doubled release when the channel stops.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 6 turns. 5 Affliction to all enemies each turn, and a random enemy gains 1 Toxin. When it ends, every enemy is Suspended for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 5 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, the user's player gains 1 random energy, and they're Suspended for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Pounce plus Piercing Cold's Frostbitten; now Prey targets are also frozen, holding their Debuffs in place for a Thaw.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, and Frostbitten until the end of the user's next turn. Against Prey, you gain 1 random energy.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 if they're Stunned. A Stunned target is also Suspended for 1 turn, so the Stun can't wear off.

history.why: Was Envenom with Suspended added to its condition; now it pays off a Stun and freezes it in place.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable. Prey or Suspended targets gain 2 Toxin.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and the user is Frostborn for as long as that enemy has a Frost debuff (max 3 turns).

history.why: Was Numbing Needle with a Prey rider; now a new way to earn Frostborn that lasts as long as the Ice team keeps the enemy frosted.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they gain 1 Toxin, 1 Weakness and 1 Vulnerable. These can't wear off while they're Prey.

history.why: Was Numbing Needle with Suspended added; now its stacks make the target Prey, and the cold keeps them from fading while they stay Prey.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they gain 1 Toxin, 1 Weakness and 1 Vulnerable, and are Suspended for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey. When the Stun ends, their Toxin deals its damage at once, doubled.

history.why: Was Lacerate with Suspended added; now the Stun ends in a Thaw-style release of their Toxin.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned and Suspended for 1 turn, or 2 turns if they're Prey.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus. Each enemy whose Toxin ticks meanwhile counts as Prey until the user's next turn.

history.why: Was Cobra Stance with Shield in place of Armor, and not a mobility skill; now a real Dance that turns any Toxin tick into Prey.

before.effect: All Shield on enemies turns into Toxin, 1 stack per 10 Shield.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 25 and loses their Toxin, then is Suspended for 1 turn.
Target ally gains 1 Might for each Buff they have, then is Suspended for 2 turns so their Buffs hold.

history.why: Was Viper's Crest lasting a turn longer through Suspended; now it rewards picking the ally with the most Buffs and freezes them all in place.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns, then is Suspended for 1 turn so they last longer.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Confused and Suspended for 2 turns. Each skill they use meanwhile adds 1 Toxin to them, held for the Thaw.

history.why: Was a Suspend whose length scaled with Debuffs; now a Thaw skill where the target's own actions load the Toxin that bursts when the freeze ends.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Toxin and 1 Confusion, and is Suspended for 1 turn for each Debuff they have (max 3).

history.why: Was Swamp Toxins with an extra Toxin and Suspended; now the freeze lengthens with every Debuff already on them, holding the whole set in place.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion and 2 Toxin, and is Suspended for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, each Frost debuff on them counts as 1 stack toward Prey.

history.why: Was Coldmark, a Suspend plus Toxin from allies' hits; now Ice's Frost debuffs make the target Prey for Poison's payoffs.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and Suspended for 1 turn. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them adds 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Preymark with Numb added; now the team loads Toxin into a frozen target so it all comes out in one doubled Thaw.

before.effect: 15 damage and Numb for 1 turn. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target give them 1 Vulnerable.

rows.effect: All allies heal 15 and lose their Toxin, gaining 10 Shield for each stack lost.

history.why: Was Serpentsong with Suspended added; now it cleanses the team's Toxin into Ice's Shield.

before.effect: All allies gain 2 Renew; all enemies gain 1 Toxin and are Suspended for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy, who gains as much Toxin as the target has (max 3) and is Suspended for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Tail Lash with Chilled added; now the lash carries the target's Toxin to a second enemy and freezes it there.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies, and Chilled for 1 turn. If it hits any Prey, its cooldown resets.

rows.effect: Every Suspended enemy Thaws now. If none were Suspended, all enemies gain 1 Toxin instead.
The user gains 10 Shield for 1 turn. At the start of their next turn, they heal all the HP they lost since using this, up to 40.

history.why: Shield leftovers became Toxin; now the only Withstand that rewinds the user's HP to where it stood.

before.effect: The user gains 1 Armor and 20 Shield for 2 turns. When the Shield expires, each 10 left gives a random enemy 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Coil plus Permafrost's Frostborn bonus; now a Shield the enemy leaves unbroken turns into Toxin on them.

before.effect: The user gains 1 Armor and 10 Shield, or 20 Shield if Frostborn.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Meanwhile, their Frostbitten stops all their Strategic skills, not just Harmful ones.

history.why: Was Stilling Gaze, a bland Taunt plus Suspend; now an Ice rule bend where Frostbitten also shuts off a Taunted enemy's Helpful Strategic skills, leaving them only attacks on the user.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and Suspended for 2 turns. Each Harmful skill they use on the user gives them 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Mesmerizing Glare with Suspended added; now every forced attack adds Toxin that waits for the Thaw.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and counts as Prey for 3 turns, and is Suspended for the first.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune, and damage they take is held instead of landing. When this ends, half of the held damage lands at once, as Affliction.

history.why: Was Stasis Field, Armor plus Suspend on enemies hit; now the user stands outside time and pays half the bill at the end, instead of taking Armor.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune. Enemies they damage gain 1 Toxin and stay Suspended until this ends.

history.why: Was base Titan with a one-turn team freeze and Frostborn attached; now every enemy the user hits is held until the form ends, then they Thaw together.

before.effect: Every enemy is Suspended for 1 turn; the user gains 2 Armor and Frostborn for 3 turns.

kits.name: Myth
kits.tagline: Ice and stone that remember: the old legends of the frozen north, and the hero who becomes one.
kits.taglineHtml: Ice and stone that remember: the old legends of the frozen north, and the hero who becomes one.
kits.introHtml:
• Legend (the user's, max 3): +1 each time the user uses a Myth skill or kills an enemy or minion. At 3, they become Mythic for 3 turns: +20 max HP (and 20 healing), 2 Armor, can't be Stunned, and their Myth skills gain their Mythic riders. Legend resets when Mythic ends.

One keyword with a payoff state: the rest is Earth's stones and minions and Ice's cold.

keywords.html: Legend (the user's, max 3): +1 each time the user uses a Myth skill or kills an enemy or minion. At 3, they become Mythic for 3 turns: +20 max HP (and 20 healing), 2 Armor, can't be Stunned, and their Myth skills gain their Mythic riders. Legend resets when Mythic ends.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, or 30 if the user has no allied minions. Mythic: it also hits a random other enemy for 15.

history.why: Was Worldfist with more damage and a Mythic damage bonus; now the lone giant hits hardest without minions, the reverse of Earth's army scaling, and Mythic makes it sweep.

before.effect: 20 damage, +5 per allied minion. Mythic: 15 more, and Frostbitten for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, +5 to each hit per allied Boulder. Mythic: the user creates a Boulder for each enemy it hits.

history.why: Was Worldquake with Chilled and a Mythic double; now Boulders power the stomp, and a Mythic stomp raises more of them.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, all Chilled for 1 turn. Costs 1 less per allied minion. Mythic: double damage.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Boulder, it's destroyed to add half its HP to the hit; if not, they create one. Mythic: the Boulder isn't destroyed.

history.why: Was Rolling Crash with more damage and a Mythic Stun; now it alternates between raising a Boulder and smashing it into the target.

before.effect: 15 damage, and creates a Boulder. Mythic: the target is also Stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and creates a Boulder when it does. Mythic: it reflects the skill instead of countering it.

history.why: Was Shale Guard with a Mythic Frostbitten; now the ward raises a Boulder, and the Mythic giant throws the skill back.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, dealing 10 Piercing damage to its user. Mythic: they're also Frostbitten for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user gains 2 Legend and creates a Boulder, then Immune for 2 turns.
15 damage to target enemy. Can instead target an allied Boulder to hurl it at a random enemy for its remaining HP. Mythic: it can hurl an enemy minion the same way.

history.why: Was Launch Stone with Chilled tacked on; now a Mythic user can seize an enemy minion and throw it, removing it from the fight.

before.effect: 15 damage. Can instead launch an allied Boulder at a random enemy for its remaining HP, Chilling them for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, growing by 20 at the end of each of the user's turns. It lands at 60, or as soon as the user takes damage.

history.why: Was Tunnelmaker with a Mythic speed-up; now the enemy chooses when it lands, since hitting the user early looses a smaller spear.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 60 Piercing damage to target enemy; a turn sooner if the user consumes a Boulder. Mythic: always a turn sooner.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, whenever any enemy uses the same skill they used on their previous turn, they take 20 damage.

history.why: Redirected a skill into a Boulder, then Chilled; now the only Trap that watches every enemy and taxes repeating a skill.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first Harmful skill target enemy uses strikes a new allied Boulder instead. If that destroys the Boulder, they're Chilled for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Boulder Trap with Chilled added; now the troll's Boulder takes the enemy's attack, and breaking it leaves them Chilled.

before.effect: For 2 turns, whenever target enemy creates a minion, it's destroyed, the user creates a Boulder, and the target is Chilled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user is Stunned and Invulnerable until the end of their next turn, and gains 1 more Legend.

history.why: Was Burrow with Frostborn in place of Ghosted; now the user gives up a turn in the barrow to rise closer to Mythic, and a Mythic user, who can't be Stunned, loses nothing.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable and Frostborn for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Summons a Mammoth (55 HP) permanently; while it stands, Frost debuffs on enemies can't be removed. Trample (r): 15 damage to all enemies.

history.why: Tusk Toss Stunned only Chilled targets; the Mammoth now protects an Ice team's Frost debuffs from cleanses while it lives.

before.effect: Summons a Mammoth (55 HP) permanently. Trample (r): 15 damage to all enemies. Tusk Toss (S): 20 damage, and a 1-turn Stun if the target is Chilled.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; the user gains 1 more Legend if the target has a Frost debuff. Mythic: the target's Frost debuffs also spread to a random ally of theirs.

history.why: Was Glacial Hammer's hit and Frostbitten at Bolt cost; now Frost debuffs feed the user's Legend, and a Mythic rune carves itself onto a second enemy.

before.effect: 25 damage and Frostbitten for 1 turn. Mythic: Frostbitten for 2 turns, and Numb.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Enemy minions it kills become allied Boulders. Mythic: every enemy minion it hits becomes one, dead or not.

history.why: Was Verdant Burst's damage with Glacial Burst's Chilled and a Mythic damage bump; now it turns enemy minions to stone on the user's side.

before.effect: 25 damage to all enemies; those without Buffs are Chilled for 2 turns. Mythic: 35 damage.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it and 5 more for each turn the battle has lasted (max 40).

history.why: Was Offering to the Old Ones, a Boulder and Seedling sacrifice for Legend; now a drain that grows with the length of the battle, weak early and legendary late.

before.effect: Sacrifices all allied Boulders and Seedlings; the user gains 1 Legend and 10 Shield for each.

rows.effect: Summons 2 Trolls (20 HP) for 3 turns. Club (r): 10 damage to target enemy. When a Troll dies or expires, it turns to stone: an allied Boulder with 20 HP.

history.why: Regrowing Trolls with a Chilling club; now a new source of Boulders for Earth players when the Trolls fall.

before.effect: Summons 2 Trolls (20 HP) for 3 turns; each regrows 5 HP at the end of your turns. Club (r): 10 damage and Chilled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. The user creates a Boulder at the end of each of their turns. When it ends, every allied Boulder awakens as a Rime Giant with its HP (Frost Maul (nc): 15 damage).

history.why: Was Worldcaller with Rime Giants and Legend; now the stones sleep until the channel completes, then every Boulder wakes as a giant.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they create a Rime Giant (30 HP, 1 Armor; Frost Maul (nc): 15 damage) and gain 1 Legend.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, +5 for each turn left on their Frost debuffs (max 25 in all).

history.why: Was Stonepierce with Frostbitten-to-Shattered added; now pays off how long an Ice team has kept the target frozen.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they have Shield or Armor. Frostbitten targets are also Shattered for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Stonepierce plus Piercing Cold's Frostbitten; now Ice's Frostbitten lets the blade Shatter the defenses Earth's version only punishes.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets with Shield or Armor, and Frostbitten until the end of the user's next turn.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +20 if they have more HP than the user. If it kills, the user gains 1 more Legend. Mythic: the bonus always applies.

history.why: Was Stone Drill with a Mythic bonus; now it rewards hitting the biggest enemy, and Mythic's extra HP no longer shrinks the list of giants.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might. Mythic: +20 more.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and its cooldown doesn't tick down while they have a Frost debuff.

history.why: Was Pitfall's Stun with a Frostbitten fallback; now locks the countered skill away for as long as the Ice team keeps them frosted.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn; if they don't, they're Frostbitten for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Pitfall with Chilled added; now it's a riddle with no safe answer: attack and be Stunned, or hold back and be Frostbitten.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn, and Chilled for 2.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Stunned and gains 25 Shield for 3 turns; the Stun ends if the Shield breaks. Mythic: it doesn't.

history.why: Was Earthwrap with a Mythic that removed its Shield; now the stone shell is the Stun, so the user's team must choose whether to break it.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 2 turns and gains 25 Shield. Mythic: they gain no Shield.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and 1 more of each for every earlier use of this skill in the battle.

history.why: Was Cairn Builder, a near-copy of Earth's Landslide; now a Dance that grows each time the tale is retold, weak on its first telling and mighty by its third.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from Cairn Builder, they also create a Boulder that gives them 1 Legend when it's destroyed.

history.why: Was Landslide plus a Legend; now its Boulders are cairns that feed Legend when they fall, so enemies pay for breaking them.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from this skill, they also create a Boulder and gain 1 Legend.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20, and the user creates a Boulder with 10 HP for each Frost debuff on the enemy team (max 40).

history.why: Was Warm Stone, an Earth-only Boulder crumble; now Ice's Frost debuffs on the enemy raise an Earth Boulder, so the cold builds the cover.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15. If the user has a Boulder, it crumbles into them: they heal half its HP more and gain 1 Armor for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Grovetender plus Freeze Wound's Armor; now it spends a Boulder for a bigger heal, as Worldcaller's Vitality Transfer spends a Worldsprout.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then target ally heals 15 and gains 2 Armor for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random; an allied minion gains both. Mythic: a non-minion ally also becomes Mythic until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Infuse Earth with a Mythic 'both'; now it favors minions, and a Mythic user can lend the giant's form to an ally.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random. Mythic: both.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. If they die before it ends, the doom falls on their kin: every ally of theirs is Confused for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Weight of Ages, Weakness scaled by Legend; now a saga curse that outlives its bearer and spreads to their whole team when they fall.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Weakness for 2 turns per Legend the user has (at least 1). Mythic: every enemy does.

history.why: Was Worldmute with Chilled added; now the curse grows with the user's Legend and falls on the whole team once they're Mythic.

before.effect: For each Might target ally has, a random enemy gains 1 Weakness and is Chilled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them gives the user 1 Legend. Mythic: those allies also gain 1 Armor.

history.why: Was Earth Pillar with a Mythic Frostbitten; now the team's follow-up hits write the user's saga, pushing them toward Mythic.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, if a Boulder damages the target, they're Stunned for 1 turn. Mythic: also Frostbitten for 2 turns.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20, and allied minions heal to full. Mythic: allies also gain 20 max HP while the user stays Mythic.

history.why: Was Verse of Nurturing with a Mythic Shield; now it restores the user's minions, and Mythic shares the giant's size with the team.

before.effect: Channel Growth twice; then all allies heal 25 and gain 2 Renew. Mythic: and 20 Shield.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and 10 to every other enemy who used a Harmful Strategic skill since the user's last turn; those are Frostbitten for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Sweep of the Giant, a Legend-tagged Cleave that never touched Legend; now an Ice expansion that seeks out whoever just used a Harmful Strategic skill and Frostbites them against the next one.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and 10 to every other enemy with less HP than the user.

history.why: Was Vine Whirl with Chilled tacked on; now the giant's sweep catches everyone smaller than the user, a list Mythic's extra HP widens.

before.effect: 5 damage to all enemies, Chilled for 1 turn. If there's an allied Boulder, a random one is launched.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, +1 per allied Boulder (up to 4). Mythic: they're also Frostbitten for as long.

history.why: Was Awakener's Roar plus a Legend; now it's a war horn whose fear lasts longer the more Boulders stand with the user.

before.effect: All allied Boulders gain 1 Armor and heal to full; the user gains 1 Legend.

rows.effect: The user gains 30 Shield, or doubles the Shield they have. Until it breaks, damage to allied minions hits this Shield instead.

history.why: Was Rampart plus Permafrost's Frostborn bonus; now the rampart shelters the user's minions too.

before.effect: The user gains 30 Shield (45 if Frostborn), or doubles the Shield they have.

rows.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time). Each time they damage the user, the user gains 1 Legend. Mythic: the user deals 10 more to them.

history.why: Was Ancient Grudge with a Mythic Frostbitten; now the feud feeds the user's Legend, so every blow the rival lands brings Mythic closer.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time). Mythic: they're Frostbitten while Taunted.

rows.effect: The user becomes Mythic now, for 3 turns +1 per Legend they had, and is Immune for as long.

history.why: Was Treant Form's minion scaling plus instant Mythic; now the Legend already banked decides how long the giant stays awake.

before.effect: The user becomes Mythic now, for 4 turns, and gains 1 Might per allied Seedling and 5 Shield per allied Boulder.

kits.name: Prism
kits.tagline: Light through ice: split it to reach everyone, or focus it to burn through one.
kits.taglineHtml: Light through ice: split it to reach everyone, or focus it to burn through one.
kits.introHtml:
• Refract: a Refracting skill also affects one more random unit on its target's side at half strength (half damage, healing or stacks, rounded down to 5 or 1; durations unchanged).
  • Lens (Buff): the bearer's next single-target skill doesn't Refract, and its damage or healing is 50% stronger. Using it spends the Lens.

keywords.html: Refract: a Refracting skill also affects one more random unit on its target's side at half strength (half damage, healing or stacks, rounded down to 5 or 1; durations unchanged).
Lens (Buff): the bearer's next single-target skill doesn't Refract, and its damage or healing is 50% stronger. Using it spends the Lens.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Refract; if the refracted hit lands on a Frostbitten enemy, it's full strength.

history.why: Was Righteous Blow with Refract in place of its heal; now Ice's Frostbitten turns the half-strength split into a full second hit.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, 10 more if the user is Anointed. Refract.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. At the start of the user's next turn, the light falls again: 10 more to each of them who still has a Frost debuff.

history.why: Condemned enemies with a Frost debuff; now a delayed second fall that rewards an Ice team for keeping the enemy frozen.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Enemies it hits with a Frost debuff are Condemned for 1 turn, and the user heals 5 for each.

history.why: Was Divine Storm plus Foot of the Mountain's Chilled; now Ice's Frost debuffs mark who gets Condemned and how much the user heals.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, all Chilled for 1 turn; the user heals 5 per target hit.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user's next skill costs nothing, but its cooldown is 2 turns longer.

history.why: Was Converge, a bare 15 damage and Lens; now a burst of light that makes the next skill free at the price of a much longer cooldown on it.

before.effect: 15 damage, and the user gains Lens.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, which Refracts instead: it hits a random ally of its user at half strength.

history.why: Was Retribution with its healing Refracted to an ally; now the countered attack splits back onto the attacker's own team.

before.effect: For 1 turn, Harmful skills used on the user heal them instead of damaging them; the healing Refracts to a random ally.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Anointed, and gains Lens each turn they damage the same enemy they damaged the turn before.

history.why: Was Divine Fury with a free Lens every turn; now the Lens comes only from holding the beam on one target.

before.effect: The user is Anointed for 3 turns and gains Lens at the start of each of their turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they use a Helpful skill on their next turn, they're Numb for 2 turns afterward.

history.why: Was Spectrum Shot, extra Refracts per Frost debuff; now an Ice expansion that gives new access to Numb by catching an enemy in the act of buffing.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Refract, once more for each Frost debuff they have.

history.why: Was Sunbeam with Refract tacked on; now the ice in the target splits the shot further, one extra beam per Frost debuff.

before.effect: 15 damage. Refract. Consumes the user's Anointed to heal them 15.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 50 Piercing damage to target enemy. If it kills them, the damage left over Refracts to a random ally of theirs at full strength.

history.why: Was Comet Shard's Piercing lance with a note that Lens boosts it; now a killing shot passes through and carries its overkill to the next enemy.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 50 Piercing damage (75 with Lens).

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, target enemy is Condemned; each time it triggers, it returns at the end of the user's next turn.

history.why: Chilled Helpful users and Sanctified their targets side by side; now a hidden Condemnation that keeps coming back, for Holy teams.

before.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, they're Chilled for 2 turns and everyone it helped is Sanctified for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Decree plus Frostbitten; now it springs on the enemy's support play, locking the healer's costs and Sanctifying whoever they helped.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Frostbitten for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. At the start of their next turn, the last skill they used before this one repeats on the same targets, at no cost.

history.why: Was Cloister plus immunity to Frostbitten or Condemned enemies; now the only Maneuver that echoes the user's previous skill.

before.effect: The user gains Immune for 1 turn, and for 2 turns can't be targeted by Frostbitten or Condemned enemies.

history.why: Was Cloister plus Frostborn; now Frostborn's shelter from the Frostbitten stretches to the Condemned, a longer but partial escape.

before.effect: The user gains Immune and Frostborn for 1 turn, and Invulnerable too if they're Anointed.

rows.effect: Summons a Lumen Elk (45 HP) permanently. Antler Glow (W): target ally gains Lens. Gore (r): 15 damage to target enemy, and Sanctified for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Sacred Lion with its second attack given Refract; now the Elk is a support that hands out Lens and sets up Sanctify.

before.effect: Summons a Lumen Elk (45 HP) permanently. Glare (W): 10 damage to all enemies and Sanctify. Gore (r): 15 damage, Refract.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Sanctified for 2 turns. Each time that Sanctify heals someone, the target gains 1 turn of Chilled.

history.why: Was Chroma Bolt, a Refract that handed out random Holy and Ice statuses side by side; now every heal Holy's Sanctify pays out also builds Ice's Chilled.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Refract. Each target also gets one of Sanctified, Condemned, Frostbitten or Numb at random for 1 turn, never the same one.

history.why: Was Rebuke with Refract tacked on; now the bolt splits into colors, a different Holy or Ice debuff on each target.

before.effect: 20 damage and Sanctify for 1 turn. Refract.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. Each of them loses the Buff with the most turns left.

history.why: Condemned enemies with no Buffs; now the only Blast that strips a Buff from the whole enemy team.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies; those with no Buffs are also Condemned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Holy Nova plus Glacial Burst's no-Buffs bonus; now Ice's no-Buffs test decides who gets Holy's Condemned.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies, 10 more to those with no Buffs. If the user is Anointed, it strikes again at the start of their next turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. Every Sanctify on the enemy side ends, and the user heals 15 for each.

history.why: Healed per Frost debuff and Sanctify on one target; now cashes in every Sanctify the Holy team has spread, a new outlet for it.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. The user heals 10 for each Frost debuff and Sanctify on them.

history.why: Was Ascension with Lens added; now it drains both parents' debuffs, healing more the more of them the target carries.

before.effect: 5 damage. If the target is Sanctified, the user becomes Anointed and gains Lens.

rows.effect: Summons a Hovering Prism (10 HP) for 3 turns. While it stands, the user's single-target skills Refract.
Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to target enemy and Sanctified for 1 turn; it Refracts to 1 more enemy each turn.

history.why: Was Consecration with Refract tacked on; now the beam spreads wider every turn it's held.

before.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to a random enemy without Sanctify, who is Sanctified. Refract.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're Condemned or Frostbitten. If it deals only 10, the user gains Lens.

history.why: Was Piercing Light under a Lens hook it never used; now a weak stab focuses the user's next skill instead.

before.effect: 10 damage, +10 if the target is Condemned or Sanctified. The bonus always applies if the user is Anointed.

rows.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy and every other Condemned enemy. Any it hits above 75 HP are Condemned afterward.

history.why: Was Crusade plus Glacial Burst's no-Buffs bonus; now it uses Shardstorm's shape, with Holy's Condemned choosing who it hits.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage. Targets above 75 HP are Condemned; targets with no Buffs take 10 more.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and every unit it targeted gains Lens.

history.why: Was Martyrdom with a shorter Anoint that also Refracted; now it counters and hands the would-be victims a focused reply.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, all its targets are Anointed until the end of their next turn, and one more ally is too.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. If they have Frost debuffs, those all end, and they're Stunned for 1 turn and Condemned for 1 turn per Frost debuff ended.

history.why: Was Frozen Awe, Holy's Condemned-only Stun with a Refract rider; now Ice's Frost debuffs shatter into a Stun and Holy's Condemned.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn if they're Condemned. If they're also Frostbitten, the Stun Refracts.

history.why: Was Repentance with Frostbitten added as a second trigger; now having both parents' debuffs spreads the Stun to a second enemy.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn if they're Condemned or Frostbitten.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains Lens at the start of each of their turns. While they have Lens, they're Invulnerable.

history.why: Was Angel's Grace with Frostborn and a free Lens; now every single-target attack spends the Lens and drops the Invulnerable until next turn.

before.effect: For 2 turns, the user is Invulnerable, Immune and Frostborn, and gains Lens at the start of each of their turns.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 40. It Refracts to the most injured other ally rather than a random one.

history.why: Was Hand of Light with less healing and Refract tacked on; now the split is aimed, reaching whoever needs it most.

before.effect: Target ally heals 40. Refract.

rows.effect: Target ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn; if they already were, they also gain Lens.

history.why: Was Holy Favor with Lens added; now Lens is the reward for blessing an ally who's already Anointed.

before.effect: Target ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn, and gains Lens.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Condemned until the end of the user's next turn. It Refracts as Sanctify: a random ally of theirs is Sanctified for as long.

history.why: Was Mark of Heresy with Refract tacked on; now the verdict splits, Condemning one enemy and Sanctifying another.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Sanctified until the end of the user's next turn. Refract.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Sanctified for 1 turn. The first ally who damages them before then gains Lens.

history.why: Was Karmic Marking plus Numb plus Refract; now it rewards the first ally to follow up with a focused next skill.

before.effect: 15 damage and Numb for 1 turn; Refract. If the user is Anointed, both targets are also Sanctified for 2 turns.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. Then the unit with the least HP on the field, whichever side, heals 40 more.

history.why: Was Hymn of Colors, a single heal Refracted to every ally; now a cheap Prayer whose big beam lands on the most wounded unit anywhere, which may be an enemy.

before.effect: Target ally heals 30 and gains 20 Shield. It Refracts to every other ally.

history.why: Was Northern Solace plus Saving Grace's repeat; now one ally gets the full hymn and the rest half, or a Lens pours it all into one.

before.effect: All allies heal 10, and gain 20 Shield and 1 Armor for 1 turn. If the user is Anointed, it repeats next turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. The first of them to use a skill afterward is Chilled for 2 turns.

history.why: Sanctified Frostbitten targets; now a delayed Chill on whichever of the two moves first.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. Each Frostbitten one it hits is Sanctified for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Guardian Strike with Refract as its second hit; now Ice's Frostbitten sets up Holy's Sanctify for the team's follow-ups.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Refract. If a Sanctified target is hit, all allies heal 5.

rows.effect: Every ally gains Lens. Every Frostbitten or Sanctified enemy is Condemned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Excoriate plus Frostbitten; now it's a team-wide focus that sets up one big burst turn.

before.effect: Bypass. Every Sanctified enemy is Condemned and Frostbitten for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. When it breaks, they gain Lens, and Immune for 1 turn if they're Anointed.

history.why: Was Shield of Faith plus Permafrost's Frostborn bonus plus Lens; now breaking the Shield is what focuses the user's reply.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield (35 if Frostborn) and Lens; if Anointed, Immune for 2 turns too.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy until they use a new Harmful skill. Refract: a random ally of theirs is Taunted by the user too.

history.why: Was Gleam with a refracted Condemned; now the Taunt itself splits, pulling two enemies onto the user.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and Condemned until they use a new Harmful skill; one more random enemy is Condemned too.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor and Immune. Half of each direct hit on them Refracts away, striking a random enemy instead.

history.why: Was Grand Crusader with a Refracted share of its buffs; now the colossus splits incoming blows, sending half back at the enemy.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Armor per Sanctified or Condemned enemy hit, and a random ally gains half as much.

kits.name: Lich
kits.tagline: Cold undeath: a sorcerer who hid their soul in a jar, and freezes the souls of others.
kits.taglineHtml: Cold undeath: a sorcerer who hid their soul in a jar, and freezes the souls of others.
kits.introHtml:
• Phylactery: a minion (30 HP, 2 Armor) that holds its creator's soul; each Lich has at most one, and creating another restores it to full instead. While it stands, its creator's HP can't drop below 1. Enemies can target it like any minion: break the jar first.
  • Soulfrost (Debuff; counts as a Frost debuff): when the bearer takes direct damage, whoever applied it gains a Soul Fragment (once per turn).

keywords.html: Phylactery: a minion (30 HP, 2 Armor) that holds its creator's soul; each Lich has at most one, and creating another restores it to full instead. While it stands, its creator's HP can't drop below 1. Enemies can target it like any minion: break the jar first.
Soulfrost (Debuff; counts as a Frost debuff): when the bearer takes direct damage, whoever applied it gains a Soul Fragment (once per turn).

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. The enemy with the lowest HP is Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Witchblade with Soulfrost in Glacial Hammer's Frostbitten slot; now it hits one enemy and plants the frost on whoever is closest to death.

before.effect: 25 damage and Soulfrost for 2 turns; Horrified targets take 10 more.

rows.effect: 35 damage to target enemy and Soulfrost for 2 turns. Each time it yields a Soul Fragment, their allies take 10.

history.why: Was Soulcrusher with Soulfrost tacked on; now the splash is delayed and repeats whenever the team hits the frosted target.

before.effect: 40 damage to target enemy; their allies are Horrified and Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Soulfrost for 2 turns. The user gains 1 Focus for their next skill, or 2 if it targets a Soulfrosted enemy.

history.why: Was Avalanche's Numb plus Wraithwalk's drain; now it plants Soulfrost and makes a follow-up on a frosted target cheaper, so the harvest comes sooner.

before.effect: 15 damage and Numb for 2 turns; the user's next Harmful skill drains a Soul Fragment.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user or an allied minion, such as their Phylactery; its user is Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Spiteful Retort plus a free Phylactery; now the counter also guards the jar and minions, so going for the jar first can backfire.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Horrified for 2 turns, and the user creates a Phylactery.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immortal and gains 1 Might for every 25 HP they're missing.

history.why: Was Undying Fury plus Chilled and Frostborn; now Unholy's Immortal meets Frost Giant's missing-HP scaling: the nearer death, the harder it hits.

before.effect: Consumes all the user's Soul Fragments: 10 damage to a random enemy for each, who is also Chilled for 1 turn. Then Immortal and Frostborn for that many turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Soul Fragment, they spend it for 10 more, and the target is Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Bone Shard plus Icicle's Chill and Soulfrost; now it loans out a Fragment as Soulfrost, which pays it back when the target is hit again.

before.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Soul Fragment the user has; Chilled and Soulfrosted for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 Piercing damage to target enemy. If it kills them, their soul becomes the user's Phylactery: one is created, or theirs is restored to full.

history.why: Was Comet Shard's Chill trigger plus Soul Lance's drain; now a kill traps the victim's soul as the user's Phylactery.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 Piercing damage (instantly if the target is Chilled). Below 50 HP after, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

rows.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they're Soulfrosted for 2 turns; the second time, they're also Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Soul Shackle with Soulfrost in place of Weakness; now it arms in two steps, and the visible frost warns the enemy that their next attack stuns them.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they're Stunned for 1 turn and Soulfrosted for 2.

rows.effect: If the user has no Phylactery, they create one. They become Invulnerable until it takes damage, for up to 2 turns.

history.why: Was Grave Step plus a Phylactery; now the Lich hides in the jar, and the enemy must crack it to reach them.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn and creates a Phylactery.

rows.effect: Summons a Frost Wight (30 HP) permanently. When a hit would kill it, the user spends a Soul Fragment instead and it's left at 1 HP. Rime Claw (S): 15 damage and Soulfrost for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Hellhound with Soulfrost; now the Wight farms souls and spends them to cheat death, a sink for the Lich's hoard.

before.effect: Summons a Frost Wight (35 HP) permanently. Grave Touch (S, Channeled): 10 Affliction damage to target enemy at the end of each of its turns, and Soulfrost.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. They lose all Swiftness and Focus, and are Horrified for 1 turn per stack lost (max 3).

history.why: Was Fel Bolt with Soulfrost; now Ice's Absolute Zero strip feeds Unholy's Horrify, so the faster the target, the longer the dread.

before.effect: 25 damage; Horrified and Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Those it leaves below 50 HP are Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Soul Blast plus Glacial Burst's no-Buff rider; now it marks the weakened for harvest instead of scaling with Fragments.

before.effect: 25 damage to all enemies, +10 per Soul Fragment the user has; those without Buffs are also Chilled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, draining a Soul Fragment. If they're Soulfrosted, it ends, and the user drains 1 more per turn it had left.

history.why: Was Drain Soul with Horrified swapped for a Frost debuff; now it cashes a Soulfrost early, trading the slow harvest for a lump sum.

before.effect: 5 damage and drains a Soul Fragment, or 2 if the target has a Frost debuff.

rows.effect: Summons a Skeletal Mage (25 HP) for 3 turns. While it stands, Frost debuffs on enemies don't count down. Bone Chill (r): 10 damage to target enemy.

history.why: Set Ice's no-Buffs volley beside Unholy's Soul Fragment sacrifice; now an Ice enabler that freezes every Frost debuff's clock while it stands.

before.effect: Summons a Skeletal Mage (25 HP) for 3 turns. Rime Volley (r): 10 damage to each enemy without Buffs. Final Offering (nc): it dies, giving the user 1 Soul Fragment per turn it had left.

history.why: Was Imp with a Chill; now its volley pays off Ice's no-Buff theme, and it can be sacrificed early for souls.

before.effect: Summons a Skeletal Mage (25 HP) for 3 turns. Frostbolt (r): 10 Affliction damage and Chilled for 1 turn. Dread Chill (I): target enemy is Horrified for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. Each turn, 10 damage to target enemy, poured into the user's Phylactery: its max HP rises by 10 and it heals 10. With no Phylactery, the first turn creates one at 10 HP.

history.why: Was a Soulfrost channel that healed the user per Soul Fragment yielded; now a Phylactery channel that grows the jar bigger than its normal size.

before.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. Each turn, 10 damage to target enemy and Soulfrost for 1 turn; the user heals 10 for each Soul Fragment it has yielded so far.

history.why: Was Drain Life with Soulfrost tacked on; now the drain ramps as the frost yields souls, and cleansing the target starves it.

before.effect: Channeled. Each turn, 10 damage to target enemy and the user heals 10; the target is Soulfrosted while it lasts. If they die, the user gains 2 Soul Fragments.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. For 2 turns, they can't be healed above 60 HP.

history.why: Paying HP for damage duplicated Evil's Mutual Ruin and Devil's Hellbent; now it keeps its victim in execute range by capping their healing.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. If the user is Frostborn, it ends, and this deals 15 more and is Piercing.

history.why: Paid off Numb and Horrified together; now a new outlet that cashes in the user's Frostborn for a Piercing finisher.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they're Numb or Horrified. If they're both, it's Piercing and the user heals 10.

history.why: Was Piercing Cold plus Blighted Dagger; now either parent's Buff lock opens the target up, and both together reward the full combo.

before.effect: 15 damage, and Frostbitten until the end of the user's next turn. At or above 70 HP, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each Frost debuff on them. Those debuffs end, and they're Horrified for 1 turn per debuff ended.

history.why: Was Lay Waste plus a Frostbite fork; now it shatters the target's frost for burst and turns it into dread.

before.effect: 35 Piercing damage. A target with Buffs is Horrified for 1 turn; one without is Frostbitten for 2.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Horrified for 2 turns. Meanwhile, the user is Invulnerable to Horrified enemies.

history.why: Was Mirage of Nightmares plus a Phylactery; now it applies Frostborn's rule to Horrify: the frightened can't touch the Lich.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Strategic skill, it's countered; the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn and creates a Phylactery.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Soulfrost for 2 turns. The first time it yields a Soul Fragment, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Cripple plus Soulfrost; now the Stun is armed on the frost and fires when anyone on the team hits them.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 permanent Vulnerable and Soulfrost for 2 turns; if Horrified, also 1 permanent Weakness.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus. Each time any unit or minion dies meanwhile, all the user's cooldowns reset.

history.why: Was Swiftness per Horrified and Focus per Chilled enemy; now a Dance that feeds on any death, on either side, by resetting every cooldown.

before.effect: For 3 turns, at the start of each of the user's turns, they gain 1 Swiftness per Horrified enemy and 1 Focus per Chilled one.

history.why: Was Grisly Spectacle with Frost debuffs extended too; now it's a real mobility Dance, fuelled by the enemy's dread and cold.

before.effect: 15 Piercing damage; every Horrify and Frost debuff on enemies lasts 1 turn longer. The user gains 1 Confusion for 1 turn (stacking).

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20. A minion, such as a Phylactery, heals 40 instead and gains 1 Armor for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Consume Lesser plus healing the jar; now it's a true ally heal that favors the Lich's minions and jar.

before.effect: Deals 15 damage to another ally or allied minion; the user and their Phylactery each heal 20.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their other Buffs don't count down.

history.why: Was Might plus healing against Buff-less enemies; now preserves an ally's Buffs in place, general utility no other Bless has.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and heals for half the damage they deal to enemies without Buffs.

history.why: Was Vampirism plus Boreal Aegis; now Lifesteal is gated by Ice's no-Buff condition, which Horrify helps keep true.

before.effect: Target ally gains Lifesteal and Frostborn for 2 turns.

rows.effect: For 2 turns, each Buff target enemy would gain is lost, and the user gains a Soul Fragment instead (max 3).

history.why: Was Cause Fear plus Soulfrost; now denied Buffs become the Lich's souls, so the enemy must choose whether to buff at all.

before.effect: Target enemy is Horrified until the end of the turn, and Soulfrosted for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. Each time its Sanctify heals an ally, the user's Phylactery heals 15 too, or is created at 15 HP.

history.why: Was a Soulfrost Smite that healed whoever made it yield a Fragment; now a Phylactery Smite where the team's hits also refill the jar.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Soulfrost for 2 turns. Each time it yields a Soul Fragment, the ally who dealt that damage heals 10.

history.why: Was Soul Sickness plus Soulfrost; now the frost works like Sanctify, healing whichever ally lands the harvesting hit.

before.effect: 20 damage and Soulfrost for 1 turn. For 1 turn, any ally who damages the target gains a Soul Fragment too.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain Frostborn for 1 turn. While it lasts, this Frostborn also makes them Invulnerable to Chilled and Numb enemies, not just Frostbitten ones.

history.why: Heal and Shield plus more per Horrified enemy; now bends Frostborn so Chill and Numb also shut enemies out.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield, plus 10 more Shield for each Horrified enemy.

history.why: Was Profane Chant plus Chilled; now it's a team heal whose Ice Shield grows with the enemy's Horrify.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, and 2 Weakness and Chilled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, who also gains a copy of each Frost debuff on the target, with its duration.

history.why: Hurt allies without Frostborn and handed out Soul Fragments; now spreads the target's Frost debuffs to a second enemy.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Each ally of the user without Frostborn loses 10 HP; every ally gains a Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Oathbreaker Strike with a Frostborn exception; now the betrayal pays: allies trade HP for Soul Fragments, and Frostborn ones pay nothing.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, then 10 to them and to each of the user's allies; allies with Frostborn are spared.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. The shriek echoes from the tomb: 3 turns later, all enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns again.

history.why: Was a short team Intimidate that also Soulfrosted; now a Shout that lands twice, with a gap between, so the enemy's slow turns come back just as they recover.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 1 turn and Soulfrosted until the end of the user's next turn.

history.why: Was Soulshriek plus Soulfrost; now it opens a team-wide harvest window where every enemy hit yields a Soul Fragment.

before.effect: 20 damage. If the user has a Soul Fragment, they spend one for 10 more, and the target is Horrified and Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, the damage it absorbed heals their Phylactery, or creates one with that much HP (at least 10).

history.why: Was Misery plus a Phylactery; now absorbed blows are stored in the jar, so attacking the Lich builds it.

before.effect: Drains 10 HP from each other ally; the user gains 20 Shield plus the total, and creates a Phylactery if they have none.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns toward the user's Phylactery instead of the user; one is created at 20 HP if they have none. The Taunted enemy's damage to it is halved.

history.why: Was a Taunt that Soulfrosted whoever hit the user; now a Phylactery Taunt that offers the jar as bait while keeping it hard to break.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user, they're Soulfrosted for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Unrelenting Horror plus Cold Shoulder's Frostbite; now every forced attack plants the frost the team then harvests.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, and they're Frostbitten; if they're Horrified, the user gains Lifesteal for that time.

rows.effect: Creates a Phylactery, or restores the user's to full. For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Frostborn, and every enemy who damages the Phylactery is Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Soul Colossus with Frostborn in place of Immortal; now the jar is bait: every enemy who goes for it is frosted for the harvest.

before.effect: Consumes all Soul Fragments to heal 5 each; then for that many turns, 2 Armor and Frostborn. Their Phylactery gains 2 Armor too.

kits.name: Night
kits.tagline: The cold that comes unseen, for enemies; chosen stillness, for allies. This is the earlier Night concept, reformatted.
kits.taglineHtml: The cold that comes unseen, for enemies; chosen stillness, for allies. This is the earlier Night concept, reformatted.
kits.introHtml:
• Dusk N (Debuff, hidden): N drops by 1 at the end of each of the bearer's turns, and at 0 it strikes Midnight. The Night player sees every count; the enemy sees none. Applying Dusk to someone who has it deepens it by 1 instead.
  • Midnight puts the bearer in Frozen Sleep for 1 turn: Asleep, damage doesn't wake them, and they count as Frostbitten, Chilled and Numb. Afterwards they have First Light for 2 turns and can't gain Dusk, so clocks can't chain into a lock.
  • Dormant (Buff): the bearer can't use skills and can't be targeted by enemies (ticking and triggered damage still land). They gain 10 Shield at the end of each of their turns, damage doesn't end it, and they wake with 1 Focus. Some skills make an enemy Dormant, taking them out of the fight (and out of reach) for a while.

The log still shows who used Evening Star on whom, so an attentive opponent can count clocks; cleansing and Immune stop them.

keywords.html: Dusk N (Debuff, hidden): N drops by 1 at the end of each of the bearer's turns, and at 0 it strikes Midnight. The Night player sees every count; the enemy sees none. Applying Dusk to someone who has it deepens it by 1 instead.

Midnight puts the bearer in Frozen Sleep for 1 turn: Asleep, damage doesn't wake them, and they count as Frostbitten, Chilled and Numb. Afterwards they have First Light for 2 turns and can't gain Dusk, so clocks can't chain into a lock.

Dormant (Buff): the bearer can't use skills and can't be targeted by enemies (ticking and triggered damage still land). They gain 10 Shield at the end of each of their turns, damage doesn't end it, and they wake with 1 Focus. Some skills make an enemy Dormant, taking them out of the fight (and out of reach) for a while.

rows.effect: 20 damage, and the target's Dusk deepens by 1. 15 more against Frozen Sleep.
25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. The user gains Frostborn for 1 turn, plus 1 turn for each enemy hit who has no Buffs.

history.why: Chilled Blinded enemies; now new access to Frostborn, fed by Ice's favorite condition, enemies without Buffs.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies; Blinded enemies hit are Chilled for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage and Dusk 3; if the user is Stealthed, they also gain 1 Focus.
Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. When it does, the user's ally with the least HP becomes Dormant for 1 turn.

history.why: Was a Dusk counter that started or deepened a clock; now a Dormant counter that tucks the team's weakest member away the moment the enemy commits.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains Dusk 2, or their Dusk deepens by 2.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and using skills doesn't end their Stealth.

history.why: Chilled every enemy hit from Stealth; now a Shadow rule bend that lets a Stealthed user attack freely for 3 turns.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Stealth; while Stealthed, every enemy they damage is Chilled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 10 damage and Dusk 4, or deepens it by 1. The cheap, repeatable clock.
Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage, or 70 Piercing if the target is in Frozen Sleep.
Invisible. For 3 turns, the first enemy to use a Harmful skill on target ally breaks through: they take 20 Piercing damage and are Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Countered one enemy's Harmful Strategic skill; now a Trap laid under an ally that catches whichever enemy comes for them.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a Harmful Strategic skill, it's countered and they're Chilled for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user becomes Dormant for 2 turns.
Summons a Snow Owl (25 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, a random enemy without Dusk gains Dusk 4. Silent Talons (A): 15 damage, 30 against Frozen Sleep.
20 damage to target enemy and Mark for 1 turn. Whoever spends the Mark also leaves them Frostbitten for 2 turns.

history.why: Isolated, with more if they had a Frost debuff; now the ally who follows up lands Frostbitten, a new trigger for an Ice status.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Isolated for 1 turn. If they have a Frost debuff, they take 10 more and the Isolation lasts 2 turns.

history.why: Was Icelance's Numb and Blackbolt's Blind side by side; now Ice's frost sets up Shadow's Isolation, cutting a frozen or Midnight-struck target off from their healers.

before.effect: 20 damage; Numb and Blinded for 1 turn, or 2 turns if the target has Dusk.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, and each gains Dusk 3 or deepens it.
5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. Then the user steals an hour: every Debuff on the user's side loses 1 turn, and every Debuff on target enemy gains 1.

history.why: Was a Dusk Consume that turned a target's clock into Shield; now it moves time itself, shortening the team's Debuffs and lengthening the target's.

before.effect: 10 damage, and the user heals 10. A target's Dusk is removed, and the user gains 10 Shield per turn it had left.

rows.effect: Summons a Rime Revenant (20 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, it deals 15 damage to the last enemy who damaged one of the user's allies.

history.why: A Wraith with Blind, Chill and Numb side by side; now a minion that always hunts the last enemy to hurt the team.

before.effect: Summons a Frost Wraith (20 HP) for 3 turns. Wail (r): Blinded and Chilled for 1 turn. Grave Chill (I): 15 damage; on a sleeper, it doesn't wake them, and Numbs for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Channeled, 2 turns. The user becomes Dormant for 2 turns and channels from inside the sleep: at the end of each of their turns, 10 damage to all enemies.

history.why: Was a channel that deepened every enemy's Dusk faster; now the longest night: the user sleeps out of reach, and the channel carries on without them.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns; while it channels, every enemy's Dusk deepens by 1 extra each turn.

rows.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the target is Asleep, without waking them. Pays off Shadow's Sleep as well as Midnight.
25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Their Blindness freezes over: it ends, and each turn of it they had left becomes a turn of Frostbitten and Numb.

history.why: Was a Ravage that put a near-dead target to Sleep, which Rime Stiletto already plays around; now a bridge where Shadow's Blinded sets up Ice's Frostbitten and Numb.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If it leaves them below 30 HP, they fall Asleep.

history.why: Traded Blinded for Frostbitten and Chilled for Blinded; now new access to Sleep that puts a wounded enemy down after the hit.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage. Blinded targets are also Frostbitten for 2 turns; Chilled ones are also Blinded for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and if they have Dusk, Midnight strikes now.
15 damage to target enemy, and they become Dormant for 1 turn: out of the fight, but out of the user's side's reach too.

history.why: Was a Stun that forced Midnight on a Dusk target, which False Dawn already does; now it puts an enemy into Dormancy, a Stun that also shelves them while the team works on someone else.

before.effect: If target enemy has Dusk, Midnight strikes now. Otherwise, 15 damage and Dusk 2.

rows.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 2 Swiftness. The first hit meanwhile that would leave them below 30 HP is prevented, and they become Dormant for 1 turn instead.

history.why: Was a Stealthy Dance that deepened Dusk on every hit; now a Dormant Dance whose escape lands on its own when the user nearly falls.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user's skills are Stealthy, and every enemy they damage has their Dusk deepened by 1.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15 and becomes Dormant for 1 turn: it pulls a dying ally out of the fight.
Nothing happens yet. 2 turns from now, target ally gains 2 Might, 2 Swiftness and 3 Renew for 3 turns.

history.why: Was a Stealth Bless that paid Shield when the Stealth ended; now a long-promised dawn: an empty turn now for a much bigger blessing later.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth. When it ends, they gain 10 Shield for each turn it lasted (max 30).

history.why: Was Nightwrap plus Boreal Aegis plus a Shield; now rime builds while the ally hides, so they choose when to break Stealth.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth and 15 Shield, and is Frostborn while Stealthed.

rows.effect: Target enemy gains Dusk 4, or deepens it by 1. For 2 turns, each skill they use deepens it by 1 more.

history.why: Was Blinding Powder plus Hypothermia's Chill plus Dusk; now acting in the dark hastens Midnight, so the target chooses between acting and sleeping sooner.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded and Chilled for 2 turns and gains Dusk 3.

rows.effect: Stealthy. 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. For 1 turn, allies who damage them keep their Stealth.

history.why: Chilled when used from Stealth; now lets Stealthed allies strike this target without breaking Stealth.

before.effect: Stealthy. 20 damage and Sanctify for 1 turn; used from Stealth, it also Chills for 2 turns.

rows.effect: All allies heal 15 and become Dormant for 1 turn: the whole team skips a turn to fortify.
25 damage to the target, and 15 to the enemy closest to Midnight (random if none has Dusk). Only you know who that is.
All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each Frost debuff they gain lasts 1 turn longer.

history.why: Blinded any enemy with Swiftness; now an Ice enabler that lengthens every Frost debuff the team lands.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Any with Swiftness lose it all and are Blinded for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Hunter's Howl's Blinded rider feeding Arctic Roar's Frostbite; now Ice's Absolute Zero idea hunts the swift with Shadow's Blind, and the kit drops a fourth Blind-into-Frost rider.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; Blinded ones are also Frostbitten for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. If an enemy breaks it, the user gains Stealth for 1 turn per Frost debuff that enemy has (max 3).

history.why: Was a Shield that Chilled attackers, an Ice expansion; now a bridge where Ice's Frost debuffs on the attacker buy Shadow's Stealth.

before.effect: 20 Shield for 2 turns; enemies who damage the user while it holds are Chilled for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, then the user becomes Dormant for 1 turn. While the user sleeps out of reach, the Taunted enemy has no one they may target.

history.why: Was a Lantern Taunt that gave Dusk; now a Dormant Taunt that trades the user's turn for a turn in which the Taunted enemy can't aim at anyone.

before.effect: Creates a Lantern (10 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn. If they damage it, they gain Dusk 2.

rows.effect: The user becomes Dormant for 2 turns, gaining 20 Shield per turn instead of 10. When they wake, every enemy gains Dusk 2.

kits.name: Current
kits.tagline: Water carries lightning: soak the enemy team, and one strike runs through all of them.
kits.taglineHtml: Water carries lightning: soak the enemy team, and one strike runs through all of them.
kits.introHtml:
• Soaked (Debuff): the bearer takes 5 more damage from Current skills. When a single-target Current skill damages a Soaked unit, the hit conducts: every other Soaked unit on that side takes the same damage. Skills that already hit everyone don't conduct.

One keyword: the rest is Water's Renew and Flow, and Lightning's Charge and Sapped.

keywords.html: Soaked (Debuff): the bearer takes 5 more damage from Current skills. When a single-target Current skill damages a Soaked unit, the hit conducts: every other Soaked unit on that side takes the same damage. Skills that already hit everyone don't conduct.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, then they're Soaked for 2 turns. The user gains 1 Charge for each other enemy the hit conducts to.

history.why: Was Flowing Fist with Soaked tacked on; now conduction charges the user, so soaking the team pays in energy.

before.effect: 20 damage and Soaked for 2 turns; the user gains 1 Renew.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Whatever Shield or Armor absorbs arcs back: it lands again as Affliction damage at the start of the user's next turn.

history.why: Was a Soaking Smash that cut cooldowns per Soaked enemy; now a Smash whose blocked damage comes back a turn later, so turtling only delays it.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies, all Soaked for 1 turn. The user's other cooldowns drop by 1 for each enemy that was already Soaked.

history.why: Was Static Slam with Soaked in place of Sapped; now Waterfall's cooldown rush scales with how wet the enemy team already is.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; their allies are Soaked for 2 turns, and take 15 if the user is Charged.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user gains 1 Focus, and their next single-target skill Soaks its target for 2 turns before it hits.

history.why: Was Charged Dash plus Renew; now the dash sets up the next hit to land on a Soaked target and conduct.

before.effect: 10 damage; the user gains 1 Charge and 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Soaked for 2 turns, then takes 15 damage, which conducts.

history.why: Was Riverbend plus Sapped and Soaked; now the counter's jolt runs through every Soaked enemy.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Strategic skill used on the user; its user is Sapped and Soaked for 2 turns, and the user gains Flow.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and their single-target hits conduct through Sapped enemies as if they were Soaked.

history.why: Was Quiet Fury plus Overcharge; now Lightning's Sapped becomes a conductor, so Sap-heavy teams feed the Current.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Flow, Stormborn and 1 Might.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and Soaked for 2 turns. If the user is Charged, they spend 1 Charge to Soak a random other enemy for 2 turns too.

history.why: Was Zap with Soaked tacked on; now Charge is spent to spread the Soak, trading energy progress for a conduction setup.

before.effect: 15 damage and Soaked for 1 turn; the user gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy. It conducts to each other Soaked enemy, whose Soak then ends; the user gains 1 Charge per Soak spent.

history.why: Was Particle Beam with Soaked for Sapped and 10 more damage; now the big conduction spends the Soaks for Charge, one burst instead of repeated chains.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage, conducted to every Soaked unit on their side.

rows.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they and every Soaked enemy take 15 damage, and each one hit is Sapped.

history.why: Was Tesla Coil plus Soaked; now the trap discharges through the water, draining energy from every Soaked enemy at once.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they take 15 damage, are Sapped, and are Soaked for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. When it ends, they spend all their Charge: each Soaked enemy takes 10 damage per Charge spent.

history.why: Was Dive plus a Charge; now the user surfaces with a discharge that turns stored Charge into damage across the Soaked team.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and gains 2 Renew and 1 Charge.

rows.effect: Summons an Electric Eel (30 HP) permanently. Eel Shock (r): 10 damage and Soaked for 2 turns. Static Coil (I): target ally gains 1 Charge per Soaked enemy (max 3).

history.why: Was Storm Hawk with Soaked for Sapped plus the Fish's Renew; now the Eel turns the enemy's Soak into Charge for an ally.

before.effect: Summons an Electric Eel (30 HP) permanently. Eel Shock (r): 10 damage and Soaked for 2 turns. Glimmering Scales (I): target ally gains 1 Charge and 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Soaked for 2 turns, then takes 20 damage. Every enemy it conducts to is Sapped.

history.why: Was Innervate with Soaked tacked on; now the Sap rides the conduction to every Soaked enemy.

before.effect: 20 damage, Sapped, and Soaked for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to all enemies, who are Soaked for 2 turns. The user's next single-target skill costs 1 less.

history.why: Was Deluge with its Flow requirement made a bonus, plus Soaked; now it soaks everyone and discounts the single hit that will chain through them.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies, and Soaked for 2 turns. With Flow, it also stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, and the user heals 10 per stack of Sapped on them (max 30).

history.why: Was Siphon Charge plus Renew; now Lightning's Sapped becomes Water's healing source, so draining their energy drains their life.

before.effect: 5 damage, and Saps; the user gains 1 Charge and 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Summons a Galvanic Elemental (20 HP) for 3 turns. When it dies, every Soaked enemy takes 15 damage. Static Lash (nc, Uncounterable): 10 damage and Soaked for 1 turn.
