history.why: Was Water Elemental plus the kit's automatic conduction; now it soaks as it lashes and bursts across the Soaked team when destroyed.

before.effect: Summons a Galvanic Elemental (20 HP) for 3 turns. Static Lash (nc, Uncounterable): 10 damage, conducted through Soaked units.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. Each turn, a random enemy is Soaked for 2 turns, then a random Soaked enemy takes 10 damage, which conducts.

history.why: Was Call Rain with a first-turn Soak; now the storm grows as the rain soaks more of the team, and each strike chains further.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. Each turn, 5 damage to all enemies and 1 Renew to all allies; the first turn also Soaks every enemy for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. For 1 turn, the user gains 1 Charge each time an enemy skill targets them.

history.why: Paid off Renew or Charge and stripped one of each; now new access to Charge from being targeted, for Lightning kits that spend it.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they have Renew or Charge; they lose 1 of each.

history.why: Paid off only Soaked, which needs another Current skill; now it shorts out the parents' own buffs, Water's Renew and Lightning's Charge.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against Soaked targets.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. The user spends up to 3 Renew, and each one spent cuts their other cooldowns by 1.

history.why: Sapped Stunned targets per turn of Stun; now a new outlet that turns the user's Renew into cooldown recovery.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Stunned, they also gain 1 Sapped per turn of Stun left.

history.why: Was Drown plus Malectrocute's Charged bonus; now Water's Stun becomes Lightning's Sapped, so a long Stun also costs them energy.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +10 if the user is Charged. Against Stunned targets, their Stuns last 1 turn longer.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and each Confusion on them becomes 1 Sapped.

history.why: Was a Soaked Mislead that Sapped every Soaked enemy; now a bridge where Water's Confusion grounds out as Lightning's Sapped.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and every Soaked enemy gains 1 Sapped.

history.why: Was Dunk plus Sapped and Soaked; now one counter drains energy from the whole Soaked team.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered; they gain 1 Confusion and are Sapped and Soaked.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun. Every other Soaked enemy has their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Undertow word for word; now the Stun itself conducts, as a partial Stun, through the Soaked team.

before.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun; if the target was already Stunned, their Stuns last 1 turn longer instead.

rows.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains Stormborn and 1 Swiftness; each Charge Stormborn gives them also brings 2 Renew.

history.why: Was Pull of the River plus Stormborn; now every exchange of blows charges the user and heals them in the same breath.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains Flow and Stormborn; now, 3 Renew and 1 Swiftness.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains 2 Renew. For 2 turns, their Renew heals without losing stacks.

history.why: Cleansed Sapped for extra healing; now a Water rule bend that holds every Renew stack on the ally for 2 turns.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains 2 Renew. Their Sapped is removed, and they heal 10 more per stack.

history.why: Was Defibrillate plus Renew; now it's a reboot that clears Lightning's Sapped and turns it into healing.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, +5 per Charge the user has, and gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally's single-target skills count as Current skills, so they conduct through Soaked enemies.

history.why: Was Touch of Grace plus Overclock; now it lends the Current to an ally, whose hits run through every Soaked enemy.

before.effect: Target ally gains Flow and Conduit for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Soaked for 2 turns and gains 1 Confusion; each time a conducted hit reaches them, they gain 1 more (max 3).

history.why: Was Airless Helm's Weakness plus Soaked; now Confusion builds each time conduction reaches them.

before.effect: Target enemy is Soaked for 3 turns and gains 2 Weakness for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each time an ally of the user damages them, every ally of the user heals 10.

history.why: Was a Soaking Smite that healed damagers per Soaked enemy; now a Sanctify-like mark that closes the circuit, so every hit on it heals the whole team.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Soaked for 2 turns. For 2 turns, allies who damage them heal 5 per Soaked enemy.

history.why: Was Aqua Ring with Apply Polarity's Charge in place of Flow; now it's a Sanctify-like heal that scales with the Soaked team.

before.effect: 15 damage and Soaked for 2 turns. For 2 turns, allies who damage the target gain 1 Charge.

rows.effect: All allies heal 10. The healing repeats at the start of each of the user's next 2 turns, 10 more each time (20, then 30), and stops once the user takes damage.

history.why: Healed on Charge gains, a bridge; now a team heal that swells over three turns unless the user is hit, which no other Prayer does.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 2 Renew. For 2 turns, each time an ally gains Charge, they heal 10.

history.why: Was Rainsong plus Signal Boost's Charge bonus; now gaining Charge is itself healing, so Stormborn allies mend as they fight.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 3 Renew; Charged allies heal 5 more per Charge.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and 15 to the Soaked enemy with the lowest HP (a random one if none is Soaked). Each is Soaked for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Arc with Soaked in place of Mark; now the second hit seeks the weakest Soaked enemy, as a true two-target Cleave.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and to every Soaked or Marked enemy.

rows.effect: All enemies are Soaked for 2 turns, and Intimidated for 1 turn per stack of Sapped they have (at least 1).

history.why: Was Whale Call with Soaked tacked on; now Lightning's Sapped sets how long each enemy stays Intimidated.

before.effect: All enemies are Soaked for 2 turns and gain 1 Vulnerable; Stunned or Taunted ones take 15 Affliction.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, they gain 1 Charge per 10 Shield left.

history.why: Was Lightning Cage plus Aqua Veil's Renew; now Shield the enemy doesn't break becomes Charge, so ignoring the user feeds them.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield plus 10 per Charge, and 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each time the user's Renew heals the user, the Taunted enemy takes as much damage.

history.why: Was a Soaking Taunt that hit every Soaked enemy when the user was damaged; now a Water expansion that turns the user's Renew into damage against the Taunted enemy.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns and Soaks them. Each time they damage the user, every Soaked enemy takes 10.

history.why: Was Tidal Pull with Soaked tacked on; now each forced attack shocks the whole Soaked team.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns and Soaks them. The cooldown resets if the user gains Flow.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and their player generates 1 extra energy each turn. At the end of each of those turns, the user takes 15 Affliction damage.

history.why: Was a Titan that gained Charge per Soaked enemy; now a generator that powers the whole team's energy at a real cost in the user's HP.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune. At the start of each of their turns, they gain 1 Charge per Soaked enemy.

history.why: Was EXO-Armor plus Naiad Form; now the dynamo draws power from the Soaked enemy team every turn.

before.effect: Consumes the user's Charge for 1 Swiftness each; then for 4 turns, 2 Armor, 2 Renew and Stormborn.

kits.name: Mist
kits.tagline: Water on the wind: a fog where nobody can tell who they're hitting.
kits.taglineHtml: Water on the wind: a fog where nobody can tell who they're hitting.
kits.introHtml:
• Fog (Buff): an enemy single-target skill aimed at a Fogged unit hits a random unit on that side instead (possibly the same one; it only counts as redirected if it lands on someone else). When Fog ends, the bearer condenses it into 2 Renew.

One keyword, defensive by design; Mist's offense is Water's Confusion and Renew and Wind's speed.

keywords.html: Fog (Buff): an enemy single-target skill aimed at a Fogged unit hits a random unit on that side instead (possibly the same one; it only counts as redirected if it lands on someone else). When Fog ends, the bearer condenses it into 2 Renew.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and the user gains Fog for 1 turn. If Fog redirected a skill away from the user since their last turn, this deals 15 more.

history.why: Was Leaping Strike plus Flowing Fist's Renew and Fog; now it's a counterpunch that hits harder after the fog made an enemy miss.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; the user gains 2 Renew, and Fog for 1 turn if they're Leaping.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. The user spends all their Swiftness; each stack spent adds 10 to every hit.

history.why: Confused Immobile enemies hit; now a new outlet that turns banked Swiftness into splash damage for Wind kits.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Each enemy hit who is Immobile gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Spiral Crash plus Waterfall; now Wind's Immobile sets up Water's Confusion across the enemy team.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to the others. The user Leaps if they aren't Leaping, and their other cooldowns drop by 1.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user gains 1 Focus, and their ally with the lowest HP gains Fog for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Launch with Fog tacked on; now the dash lays cover over whichever ally is most exposed.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing and gains Fog for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, the user has Fog and counters the first Harmful skill used on them or on any Fogged ally.

history.why: Was Riverbend plus team Fog on a trigger; now one counter guards every Fogged ally, so the fog hides a blade.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Strategic skill used on the user; the user's whole team gains Fog for 1 turn, and the user gains Flow.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user begins Rushing and gains 1 Might; each turn they stay Rushing, they gain 2 Renew.

history.why: Was Chainbreaker plus Flow; now Wind's Rushing, which ends if the user idles, feeds Water's Renew, rewarding nonstop action.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs; Immune and Flow for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user gains Fog for 1 turn, or theirs lasts 1 turn longer.

history.why: Was Air Bullet plus Splash's Renew; now each shot thickens the user's fog, the kit's cheap way to keep it up.

before.effect: 10 damage, and a random ally gains 2 Renew. If the user is Leaping, 5 more damage and they Leap again.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 damage to target enemy. The user has Fog while it channels; if a skill hits them anyway, the shot deals 15 less.

history.why: Was Elegant Sweep with Fog while channeling; now it's a single hidden shot guarded by fog, and the gamble on the fog sets its damage.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 25 Piercing damage to the enemy team; the user has Fog while it channels.

rows.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a single-target Harmful skill, it hits a random unit on its target's side instead, and they gain 1 Confusion.

history.why: Was Float Noose with Whirlpool's Confusion in place of its damage; now it's Fog as a trap, sending one attack astray.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they're Isolated for 1 turn and gain 1 Confusion.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and every ally gains Fog until the user's next turn.

history.why: Was Dive plus Fog; now the user vanishes and leaves the mist over the rest of the team.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and gains Fog for 2 turns and 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Summons a Mist Heron (35 HP) permanently. It always has Fog. Spear Beak (r): 15 damage to target enemy, +10 if they're Immobile.

history.why: Was Grand Eagle with Fog on its Soar; now the Heron is always fogged and hard to pin down, and it punishes Immobile prey.

before.effect: Summons a Mist Heron (35 HP) permanently. Spear Beak (r): 15 damage. Mist Wings (A): target ally gains Fog for 1 turn and Leaps.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Every ally's Renew heals once now, without losing a stack.

history.why: Stripped Swiftness or gave Confusion; now a Water timing trick that fires the whole team's Renew early for free.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. They lose 1 Swiftness, or gain 1 Confusion if they have none.

history.why: Was Compressed Bolt plus Splash's Renew; now it strips Wind's speed first and falls back on Water's Confusion.

before.effect: 15 damage; Immobile targets have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn. A random ally gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. For 2 turns, each Confusion an enemy gains comes with 1 Intimidated for as long.

history.why: Stripped Swiftness and Renew side by side; now a Water rule bend where Confusion also slows the enemy's cooldowns.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. Each loses all Swiftness and Renew, and takes 5 more per stack lost.

history.why: Was Spiral Burst with 5 more damage plus Fog; now the squall strips both parents' buffs from the enemy and hits harder for each.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies, +10 if the user is Leaping and +10 if Rushing; all allies gain Fog for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. The user also heals as much as that enemy was healed since the user's last turn, up to 30.

history.why: Paid off Immobile with Rushing; now a Consume that drinks back whatever healing the enemy just received.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. If they're Immobile, the user heals 15 more and begins Rushing.

history.why: Was Sap Speed that also stripped Renew; now it's a true Consume that feeds on an Immobile target and sets the user running.

before.effect: 5 damage. Removes the target's mobility buffs and Renew; the user gains 1 Swiftness per buff removed.

rows.effect: Summons 2 Will-o'-Mists (10 HP) for 3 turns; while any stands, every ally has Fog (and the Mists can be hit in their place). Pale Touch (nc): 5 Piercing damage.

history.why: Kept as it was; its minion skill is renamed from Bother, which Wind's Sprites already use.

before.effect: Summons 2 Will-o'-Mists (10 HP) for 3 turns; while any stands, every ally has Fog (and the Mists can be hit in their place). Bother (nc): 5 Piercing damage.

rows.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns. All allies have Fog while it lasts, and enemies whose skills it redirects gain 1 Confusion.

history.why: Was Vortex with a team Fog aura; now missing in the fog also Confuses the attacker.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, one more if the user is Leaping or Rushing when it ticks; all allies have Fog while it lasts.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. It comes out of the fog from no one: it can't be countered or reflected, and triggers nothing that reacts to damage.

history.why: Was a Stab that moved 1 Weakness off the target onto the user as Might; now an untraceable hit that slips past counters and every on-damage effect, such as Sanctify or thorns.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. The user takes 1 Weakness from them and gains it as 1 Might for 1 turn.

history.why: Paid off Confusion with Rushing; now a new outlet that steals Water's Weakness and turns it into the user's Might.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're Confused; on 20, the user begins Rushing.

history.why: Was Airknife plus Shell Knife; now Water's Confusion opens the target, and the finishing cut sets Wind's Rushing going.

before.effect: 10 damage; 20 if the user is Rushing, 25 if they also have 3 or more Renew.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +5 per Renew the user has (max 20). Then the user loses all Renew and Leaps.

history.why: Was Drown at Sonic Thrust's cost; now it burns the user's Renew for damage and launches them into a Leap.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage. Against Stunned targets, their Stuns last 1 turn longer.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and each unit it targeted gains Fog for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Dunk plus Wind Step's Rushing plus Fog; now the countered attack wraps its intended victims in fog.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain 1 Confusion; the user begins Rushing and gains Fog for 1 turn.

rows.effect: A random enemy takes 15 damage and is Stunned for 2 turns.

history.why: Was a Stun that stole any Swiftness spent to ignore it; now a Stun aimed into the fog: the user can't choose the target, but the Stun lasts twice as long.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun. Any Swiftness they spend to ignore it goes to the user.

history.why: Stunned all skills only when Confused; now a full Stun whose dodged Swiftness is stolen, new access for Wind kits.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and stuns their Strategic skills for 1 turn, or all their skills if they're Confused.

history.why: Was Buffet plus 1 Confusion; now Water's Confusion turns Wind's partial Stun into a full one.

before.effect: 10 damage, 1 Confusion, and stuns their Strategic skills for 1 turn.

rows.effect: For 4 turns, the user has Fog, and each time it redirects a skill, they gain 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus.

history.why: Was Pull of the River plus Fog; now every miss in the fog quickens the user.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains Flow and Fog; now, 3 Renew and 1 Swiftness.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20. If they have Fog, it condenses now, giving them 4 Renew instead of 2.

history.why: Was Invigorating Breeze plus Renewing Spring; now it cashes an ally's Fog early for double the Renew.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15 and gains 3 Renew; above 60 HP afterwards, they begin Rushing.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Renew, and has Fog whenever they're Rushing or Leaping.

history.why: Was Touch of Grace with Fog tacked on; now Wind's speed keeps the fog up, so the ally must keep moving to stay hidden.

before.effect: Target ally gains Fog and Flow for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy counts as Immobile for 2 turns, whatever skills or buffs they have, and gains 1 Weakness.

history.why: Turned stripped mobility buffs into Confusion; now a Wind enabler that makes anyone Immobile for Wind's many Immobile payoffs.

before.effect: Target enemy loses all mobility buffs and gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns, +1 per buff lost (max 3).

history.why: Was Headwind plus 1 Confusion; now the speed they lose turns into Confusion, stack for stack.

before.effect: Target enemy loses all mobility buffs, and gains 1 Weakness and 1 Confusion.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn; it gives allies who damage them 3 Renew instead of healing 15.

history.why: Gave Confusion beside Rushing for attackers; now reshapes Sanctify into Renew, new access for Water kits.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 1 Confusion for 1 turn. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them begins Rushing.

history.why: Was Feathermark plus Aqua Ring; now Water's Confusion slows the target while Wind's Rushing speeds up everyone who piles on.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 2 turns, allies who damage the target Leap and gain Flow.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain Fog for 1 turn; this Fog condenses into 3 Renew instead of 2.

history.why: Was Rainsong plus Fog; now the team heal is split between the heal now and a richer Renew the fog leaves behind.

before.effect: All allies heal 15, and gain 2 Renew and Fog for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Each loses 1 mobility buff, which the user gains.

history.why: Kept a Leap and added Confusion if Leaping; now steals mobility buffs off both enemies hit.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If the user is Leaping, the Leap isn't spent and both gain 1 Confusion.

history.why: Was Water Lash plus Falling Slam; now it's a two-target Cleave where Wind's Leap carries into Water's Confusion.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies; with Flow, each gains 1 Weakness. Costs 1 less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. For 1 turn, single-target skills they aim at the user hit a random ally of theirs instead.

history.why: Was Echoing Voice limited to allies, plus Fog; now the horn turns Fog's redirect outward, bouncing attacks on the user into their own team.

before.effect: Every ally gains Fog for 1 turn and 1 Swiftness.

rows.effect: The user gains 15 Shield for 1 turn. If they have Fog, it condenses now: 15 more Shield and its 2 Renew.

history.why: Was Slipstream with Aqua Veil's cooldown plus Fog; now it trades the user's Fog for an instant, doubled Shield.

before.effect: The user gains 15 Shield for 1 turn (30 if Rushing) and Fog.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, target enemy's single-target Harmful skills hit the user instead, whoever they aim at.

history.why: Taunt with Confusion beside Rushing; now the only Invisible Taunt: the enemy doesn't know their skills are being drawn to the user.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, and they gain 1 Confusion each time they damage the user. The user begins Rushing.

history.why: Was Piercing Cry plus Tidal Pull's reset; now every forced attack costs the enemy more, while the user keeps moving.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, or 3 if they're Immobile. The cooldown resets if the user gains Flow.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor, Immune and Fog. When it ends, the Fog condenses into 6 Renew instead of 2.

history.why: Was Djinnform plus Fog; now the form stores its mist for a large Renew when it ends, rather than a Leap.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 15 Shield, Immune and Fog; then they Leap.

kits.name: Serum
kits.tagline: Water and poison in one syringe: the dose makes the medicine, and the dose makes the poison.
kits.taglineHtml: Water and poison in one syringe: the dose makes the medicine, and the dose makes the poison.
kits.introHtml:
• Dose (a Buff, on any unit): at the end of its applier's turn, the bearer heals 5 per stack. A unit that reaches 4 Dose Overdoses: they take 10 Affliction per stack and lose all Dose. The art is keeping allies below 4 and pushing enemies past it. As a Buff, Immune doesn't stop it, but Horrified does.

One keyword: every Serum skill is a question of how many Doses, and on whom.

keywords.html: Dose (a Buff, on any unit): at the end of its applier's turn, the bearer heals 5 per stack. A unit that reaches 4 Dose Overdoses: they take 10 Affliction per stack and lose all Dose. The art is keeping allies below 4 and pushing enemies past it. As a Buff, Immune doesn't stop it, but Horrified does.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +5 per Dose they have. Then they gain 2 Dose.

history.why: Was Viper Strike with 2 Dose in place of Toxin; now the needle finds the vein, hitting harder the closer the target is to an Overdose.

before.effect: 20 damage and 2 Dose.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Each enemy hit who already has Dose gains 2 more; the rest gain 1.

history.why: Was Plague Stomp with Dose in place of Toxin; now it pushes existing Doses hardest, a team-wide Overdose trigger after setup.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 2 Dose.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user gains 1 Focus, and the next skill they use has its cooldown cut by 1.

history.why: Gave Renew only against Prey; now a Water-style cooldown push on the user's next skill, with no status needed.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user gains 1 Focus, or 2 Focus and 2 Renew if the target is Prey.

history.why: Was Lunge plus Renew; now Poison's Prey pays out Water's Renew and extra tempo, instead of making every enemy Prey.

before.effect: 10 damage. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey; the user gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 3 Dose.
For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and 1 Might at the start of each of their turns (max 3). If they use no damaging skill on a turn, it ends and they take 20 Affliction damage.

history.why: Its both-sides Might duplicated Ritual's Bonfire Revel; now a Rage that keeps building as long as the user keeps attacking.

before.effect: Every enemy's Might turns into Dose, stack for stack. For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and 1 Might per stack converted (max 3).

history.why: Was Quiet Fury plus Renew; now Viper Stance's conversion turns the enemy's Might into Dose, loading them toward Overdose while the user grows.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Flow, 1 Might and 1 Focus, and 2 Renew now.

rows.effect: 5 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each Debuff on the user. Those Debuffs are drawn out with the dart and end.

history.why: Was a plain Dose Shot; now a self-cleanse that fires the user's own Debuffs at an enemy as damage.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy and 1 Dose, or 2 if they're Prey.

history.why: Was Sting with Dose added to its random pool; now Poison's Prey decides how hard the Dose is pushed.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, and 1 Dose, Toxin, Weakness or Vulnerable at random.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 20 Affliction damage to target enemy, and they gain enough Dose to reach 4.

history.why: Was Banewood Javelin plus 3 Dose; now it guarantees an Overdose when it lands, trading direct damage for a certain 40 Affliction.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 25 Affliction damage and 3 Dose.

rows.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. Each time target enemy is healed, they gain 1 Dose.

history.why: Was Snake Pit with Dose in place of Toxin; now their own team's healing is what doses them.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. Each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Dose.

rows.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Their Dose moves to a random enemy; if they had none, they gain 2.

history.why: Was Slither plus 2 Dose; now the user injects their own Dose into an enemy as they slip away.

before.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains 1 Focus and 2 Dose.

rows.effect: Summons a Giant Leech (25 HP) permanently. Latch (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Dose. Bloodletting (rr): target ally loses 2 Dose and heals 10.
20 damage to target enemy and 2 Dose. While they have Dose, they count as Prey.

history.why: Was Acid Orb plus 2 Dose; now the Dose itself makes them Prey, opening every Poison payoff on the team.

before.effect: 20 damage and 2 Dose; Prey targets are also Marked.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, and each gains 1 Dose. Then all Dose on the enemy team moves to whichever enemy has the most.

history.why: Was Acid Wash plus Deluge's Flow stun; now it pools the enemy team's Doses on one target, often forcing an Overdose.

before.effect: 15 damage and 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns to all enemies. With Flow, it also stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Removes all Dose from target unit: an enemy takes 10 Affliction per stack; an ally heals 10 per stack.
Summons a Spriggan Nurse (15 HP) for 3 turns. Titrate (W): target ally gains 1 Dose; if they have 3, a random enemy gains 2 instead.

history.why: Was Spriggan Harasser with a 1-Dose sting; now the Nurse doses allies safely and diverts the excess into an enemy.

before.effect: Summons a Spriggan Nurse (15 HP) for 3 turns. Jab (W): target unit gains 1 Dose.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. Each turn, target enemy gains 1 Dose and takes 5 Affliction per Dose they have. It ends when they Overdose.

history.why: Was Call Rain plus 1 Dose a turn; now it's a single IV line whose damage ramps toward a guaranteed Overdose.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. Each turn, 5 damage to all enemies and 1 Renew to all allies; the channel's target gains 1 Dose.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy now and at the start of each of their next 3 turns. Each dose is 15 instead while they're at or below 60 HP.

history.why: Scaled with Toxin and Renew side by side; now a Stab split into four small doses over time, which no other Stab does.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, +5 per Toxin and Renew on them (max +15).

history.why: Was Pounce plus Shell Knife's Renew check; now it pays off both parents' stacks on the target, Toxin and Renew alike.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, or 20 if the user has 3 or more Renew. Against Prey, you gain 1 random energy.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, their Toxin ticks at the end of every turn, not only at the end of its applier's.

history.why: Was a Dose Ravage that turned Toxin into Dose; now a Poison expansion that doubles how often the target's Toxin ticks.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable. Their Toxin turns into Dose, stack for stack.

history.why: Was Envenom with Dose in place of Toxin; now it converts Poison's Toxin into Dose, pushing a poisoned target toward Overdose.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable; a target that has Dose gains 2 more.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered, and each of its targets gains 2 Dose.
15 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun, +1 turn per 2 Dose they have (max 3 turns).

history.why: Was Lacerate plus Confusion; now the Dose they carry sets how long they're sedated.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey, and gains 1 Confusion.

rows.effect: All Toxin on allies turns into Renew, and all Renew on enemies turns into Toxin.
Target unit heals 25. An ally gains 1 Dose; an enemy gains 3.

history.why: Was Moonglove Mixture with Dose in place of Toxin; now the Dose depends on the side, so healing an enemy leaves them one step from Overdose.

before.effect: Target unit, ally or enemy, heals 25 and gains 2 Dose.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Renew. Each time Renew heals them meanwhile, they lose 1 Debuff.

history.why: Was a Dose Bless that turned Debuffs into Dose; now a Water expansion where each Renew tick also flushes out a Debuff.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Swiftness, and each Debuff they'd gain becomes 1 Dose instead (max 2).

history.why: Was Viper's Crest plus 1 Dose; now incoming Debuffs turn into healing Doses, a kind of inoculation.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns, and 1 Dose.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. For as long, any Weakness on them makes them Prey, however few stacks they have.

history.why: Was a Dose Curse that dosed per Debuff; now a bridge where Water's Weakness sets up Poison's Prey.

before.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns and gains 1 Dose per Debuff they have (max 3).

history.why: Was Swamp Toxins plus 2 Dose; now the more the target already suffers, the closer the vial pushes them to an Overdose.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion, 1 Toxin and 2 Dose.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. For 1 turn, an ally who damages them executes them if it leaves them below 15 HP.

history.why: Gave Renew per Toxin to attackers; now new access to Poison's Execute for the whole team.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 1 Toxin. For 1 turn, allies who damage them gain 1 Renew per Toxin on them (max 3).

history.why: Was Preymark plus Aqua Ring's Flow; now Poison's Toxin on the target becomes Water's Renew for whoever hits it.

before.effect: 15 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target give them 1 Vulnerable and gain Flow.

rows.effect: All allies heal 10 per Dose they have (at least 10) and lose 1 Dose. All enemies gain 1 Dose.

history.why: Was Serpentsong plus Dose; now it cashes allies' Doses into healing while loading the enemy team.

before.effect: All allies gain 2 Renew and 1 Dose; all enemies gain 1 Dose and 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, who gains as many Dose as the target has.

history.why: Was Tail Lash plus Water Lash; now it's a two-target Cleave that copies the target's Dose onto a second enemy.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies; with Flow, each gains 1 Weakness. The cooldown resets if it hits Prey.

rows.effect: Every unit that has Dose gains 1 more, allies included. If no enemy has Dose, every enemy gains 1 instead.

history.why: Did nothing without Dose from another Serum skill; now it seeds a clean enemy team, keeping its all-units gamble.

before.effect: Every unit in the battle that has Dose gains 1 more, allies included.

rows.effect: The user gains 30 Shield for 2 turns. Unlike other Shield, it also absorbs Affliction damage.

history.why: Was a Shield that doubled the user's Dose healing; now the one Shield that stops Affliction, a counter to Toxin, Ignite and Overdoses alike.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns and 2 Dose; while the Shield holds, their Dose heals them double.

history.why: Was Coil plus Aqua Veil's Renew; now the Shield and the Dose work together, and breaking the Shield halves the healing.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield, 1 Armor and 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each time Renew heals an ally of the user, the Taunted enemy gains 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was a Dose Taunt that dosed the enemy when they hit the user; now a bridge where Water's Renew on the team feeds Poison's Toxin into the Taunted enemy.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user, they gain 1 Dose and the user heals 5.

history.why: Was Mesmerizing Glare plus a Dose each turn; now the Dose comes from attacking the user, so the Taunt drives them toward Overdose.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and counts as Prey for 3 turns, gaining 1 Dose at the start of each of their turns.

rows.effect: The user gains 3 Dose and can't Overdose for 3 turns; meanwhile, 2 Might and 2 Armor. When it ends, they Overdose if they have 4 or more.

history.why: Kept, and made explicit: the Dose it holds back comes due when the mutation ends.

before.effect: The user gains 3 Dose and can't Overdose for 3 turns; meanwhile, 2 Might and 2 Armor.

kits.name: Slime
kits.tagline: Water and earth become ooze: it splits when struck, swallows what it touches, and keeps coming back.
kits.taglineHtml: Water and earth become ooze: it splits when struck, swallows what it touches, and keeps coming back.
kits.introHtml:
• Oozes: minions that Split. When an Ooze takes damage and survives with 10 or more HP, a new Ooze appears and the two share its remaining HP. Max 4 Oozes per side. Skills that create an Ooze make one with 20 HP and Slap (nc): 5 damage.
  • Engulf (Debuff): the bearer is inside an Ooze. They're Stunned and take 5 Affliction at the end of each of its owner's turns, until that Ooze dies or 3 turns pass. Their allies can free them by killing the Ooze.

keywords.html: Oozes: minions that Split. When an Ooze takes damage and survives with 10 or more HP, a new Ooze appears and the two share its remaining HP. Max 4 Oozes per side. Skills that create an Ooze make one with 20 HP and Slap (nc): 5 damage.

Engulf (Debuff): the bearer is inside an Ooze. They're Stunned and take 5 Affliction at the end of each of its owner's turns, until that Ooze dies or 3 turns pass. Their allies can free them by killing the Ooze.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they're Engulfed, the blow drives them deeper: their Ooze heals 10 and the Engulf lasts 1 turn longer.

history.why: Was an Oozes Strike that chipped an allied Ooze to force a Split; now a cheap follow-up that keeps an Engulfed enemy swallowed longer.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; a random allied Ooze takes 5 damage, so it may Split.

history.why: Was Earth's Worldfist word for word; now it hits harder by knocking a glob off the user's own Ooze, spreading the swarm wider but thinner.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, +5 per allied minion.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. If the target is Stunned, the splatter sets around them: a new Ooze Engulfs them.

history.why: Was Earth's Worldquake plus a free Ooze; now it turns a Stun into an Engulf that the enemy must cut their ally out of.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, and creates an Ooze. Costs 1 less per allied minion.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and the user rolls behind an Ooze, creating one if they have none: for 1 turn, the next single-target skill aimed at them hits it instead.

history.why: Was Earth's Rolling Crash with an Ooze for the Boulder; now the Ooze is cover that takes the next hit meant for the user, and Splits from it.

before.effect: 10 damage, and creates an Ooze.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; the user creates an Ooze with HP equal to the damage it would have dealt (10 to 40).

history.why: Was Earth's Shale Guard with Engulf in place of its damage; now the countered hit becomes an Ooze, so the bigger the attack, the bigger the Ooze.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; if they have an Ooze, it Engulfs the skill's user.

rows.effect: The user creates an Ooze. For 3 turns, they're Immune and gain 1 Might whenever an allied Ooze Splits (max 3).

history.why: Was Earth's Nature's Wrath with Oozes for Seedlings; now every Split feeds the user's Might, so the enemy has to think before hitting the swarm.

before.effect: The user creates 2 Oozes, then gains Immune for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 1 Confusion for 2 turns. At 3 Confusion, the mud sets: they lose it all and are Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Earth's Launch Stone throwing an Ooze for a Boulder; now it stacks Water's Confusion until the mud sets into a Stun.

before.effect: 15 damage. Can instead throw an allied Ooze at a random enemy for damage equal to its HP (the Ooze dies).

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. Now, the user creates an Ooze. On the following turn, it's hurled at target enemy for 30 damage and Engulfs them, keeping the HP it has left.

history.why: Was an Oozes Snipe that added the Ooze's HP to the damage; now the landing Ooze swallows the target, and the enemy can shoot it down while it's still being readied.

before.effect: Channeled. Now, the user creates an Ooze. On the following turn, it's hurled at target enemy for 30 damage plus the HP it has left, and dies.

history.why: Was Water's 40-damage snipe with Engulf tacked on; now the shot is a live Ooze the enemy can blunt by hitting it, at the price of splitting it.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, and a new Ooze Engulfs them.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the next healing target enemy receives is swallowed instead: they're Engulfed by a new Ooze with that much HP (max 40).

history.why: Was Earth's Boulder Trap with an Ooze for the Boulder; now it swallows the target's next heal, and a bigger heal makes a sturdier prison.

before.effect: For 2 turns, whenever target enemy creates a minion, it's destroyed and the user creates an Ooze instead.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and their Renew sets like clay: every 2 stacks they have become 1 Armor for good.

history.why: Was an Oozes Maneuver that dumped Debuffs on an Ooze; now Water's Renew bakes into Earth's permanent Armor.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and creates an Ooze, which takes all of the user's Debuffs.

history.why: Was Earth's Burrow plus Water's Dive; now the user peels their Debuffs off into a new Ooze, which has to carry them.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable and Ghosted for 1 turn and gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Summons a Great Ooze (50 HP) permanently; it doesn't Split. Swallow (r): it Engulfs target enemy, and heals 10 at the end of each turn it holds them.

history.why: Was an Oozes companion that Split and had Engulf as a side skill; now a single, unsplitting gut built around Engulfing and outlasting the rescue.

before.effect: Summons a Great Ooze (50 HP) permanently; it Splits like any Ooze. Swallow (r): target enemy is Engulfed.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, the next time they take damage, a glob splits off them: the user creates an Ooze.

history.why: Was Earth's Vine Lash with an Ooze for the Seedling; now it slimes the target like a Mark, so the next hit on them splits off a new Ooze.

before.effect: 25 damage. If the user has no Ooze, they create one.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies, and the user creates an Ooze. For 2 turns, whenever an allied Ooze dies, it bursts for 10 damage to all enemies.

history.why: Was Earth's Verdant Burst healing Oozes instead of Seedlings; now dying Oozes burst, so clearing the swarm hurts the enemy.

before.effect: Every allied Ooze heals 10; then 25 damage to all enemies.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. If they're Engulfed, they're digested instead: 10 Affliction damage per turn they've been Engulfed (max 30), healing the user as much.

history.why: Was Reabsorb, which merged Oozes to heal; now the Engulf payoff, draining more the longer the enemy has been inside.

before.effect: All allied Oozes merge into one with their combined HP (max 80); target ally heals 10 per Ooze merged.

rows.effect: Summons a Slime Mother (30 HP) for 3 turns; she doesn't Split. Gloop (nc): 10 damage to target enemy. If she lasts all 3 turns, she leaves 2 Oozes.

history.why: Was Earth's Sprout Seedling with Oozes for Seedlings; now a temporary Mother becomes 2 permanent Oozes unless the enemy kills her in time.

before.effect: Creates 2 Oozes (15 HP each).

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. Now, the user creates an Ooze. Each turn, 5 damage to all enemies, and each allied Ooze that died since the last turn re-forms with 10 HP.

history.why: Was Earth's Worldcaller making an Ooze each turn; now the pool re-forms slain Oozes, so the enemy must break the channel before clearing the swarm.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they create an Ooze.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. The grit of every allied Boulder gets in their eyes: 1 Confusion for 1 turn per Boulder (max 3).

history.why: Was Corroding Touch, a neutral Armor and Shield stripper; now Earth's Boulders feed Water's Confusion.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP; the acid also strips 1 Armor and 10 Shield from them.

history.why: Was Earth's Stonepierce plus 10 Shield dissolved; now it ignores defenses and eats them away for the team instead of hitting harder against them.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets with Shield or Armor; it also dissolves 10 of their Shield.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Stunned, the user absorbs some of their mass: 1 Might and 1 Armor for good.

history.why: Was Earth's Stone Drill bonus keyed to Water's Stun condition, plus Engulf; now crushing a Stunned target grows the user for good, Earth's reward paid for by Water's Stuns.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the target is Engulfed or Stunned.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Engulfed by a new Ooze with 10 HP per energy the skill cost.

history.why: Swallowed the countered skill inside a new Ooze; now swallows the caster, and the bigger the skill they tried, the harder the Ooze is to break.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and swallowed by a new Ooze: they can't use it again until that Ooze dies.

history.why: Was Earth's Pitfall with Engulf for its Stun; now the countered skill is locked inside a new Ooze, and the enemy must kill it to get the skill back.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and a new Ooze Engulfs them.

rows.effect: Creates an Ooze (30 HP) that Engulfs target enemy.
For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 2 Swiftness, and they're too slick to hold: any Debuff they gain slides off at the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Wobble, which passed the user's Stuns to Oozes; now caps every Debuff on the user at about a turn, a general anti-control Dance no other kit has.

before.effect: The user creates an Ooze. For 3 turns, whenever the user would be Stunned, a random allied Ooze is Stunned instead.

history.why: Was Earth's Landslide with an Ooze for the Boulder; now the user wobbles out of Stuns by passing them to their Oozes.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from Wobble, they also create an Ooze.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20. For 3 turns, whenever Renew heals one of the user's allies, every allied Seedling and Boulder heals as much.

history.why: Was an overheal that made Oozes; now Water's Renew waters Earth's minions, so Boulders thrown later hit harder.

before.effect: Target ally heals 25; any healing past their max HP becomes an Ooze with that much HP, if it's 10 or more.

history.why: Was Earth's Grovetender plus Water's Renew; now overhealing grows a new Ooze, so topping up a healthy ally is a choice rather than a waste.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15 and gains 3 Renew; every allied Ooze heals 10.

rows.effect: Target ally gains 2 Renew. For 3 turns, each time Renew heals them, they gain 1 Might (max 2).

history.why: Was Earth's Infuse Earth with Renew in place of Might; now Water's Renew grows Earth's Might, so the blessing builds as it heals.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Armor or 2 Renew, at random.

rows.effect: Target enemy gains 2 Confusion for 2 turns. Meanwhile, every unit that uses a skill on them, from either side, gains 1 Confusion for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Confusion tied to the user's Oozes; now a sticky curse that gums up the target's healers and the user's own attackers alike.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 2 Confusion, which lasts until the user has no Oozes; if the user has none now, they create one.

history.why: Was base Curse plus Intimidate, with neither parent involved; now the Confusion lasts as long as the swarm, so the enemy must clear the Oozes to shake it.

before.effect: Target enemy is Intimidated and gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and silt settles on them for 2 turns: Swiftness can't stop Stuns on them, and those Stuns can't be removed.

history.why: Was the stock 'hit, then if they used a Helpful skill, Isolate and more'; now makes a Water player's Stuns stick against Swiftness and cleanses.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they used a Helpful skill since the user's last turn, they're Isolated for 1 turn and this deals 10 more.

history.why: Was Earth's Earth Pillar with an Ooze Engulf for the Boulder Stun; now it punishes support, Water's anti-Helpful edge landing as Earth's Isolate.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, if an Ooze damages the target, it Engulfs them.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. Every allied Ooze then melts into it: each adds 10 Shield to every ally, and dies.

history.why: Was Earth's Verse of Nurturing healing Oozes instead of Seedlings; now it cashes the swarm in, each Ooze melting into Shield for the whole team.

before.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 2 Renew; every allied Ooze heals to full.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Until the user's next turn, their Armor also reduces Piercing damage.

history.why: Turned Water's Weakness into Might; now bends Earth's Armor so an Armor-stacking Earth player is covered against Piercing hits too.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. For each Weakness either has, the user gains 1 Might for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Earth's Vine Whirl throwing an Ooze for a Boulder; now it soaks up Water's Weakness on its targets as Might for the user.

before.effect: 5 damage to all enemies. If there's an allied Ooze, a random one is thrown, as with Lob.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. For as long, each of their skills costs at least 2 energy; cheaper ones gain random costs to make up the difference.

history.why: Was a bridge that Isolated Stunned enemies; now a cost floor that bogs down every cheap, spammable enemy skill, which no other kit does.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Stunned ones are buried as well: Isolated for 2 turns, so their allies can't reach them.

history.why: Was Earth's Awakener's Roar splitting Oozes instead of arming Boulders; now it keeps Shout's Intimidate and buries Stunned enemies out of their allies' reach.

before.effect: Every allied Ooze heals to full and Splits once.

rows.effect: The user gains 40 Shield with no time limit. It melts by 10 at the end of each of their turns.

history.why: Was an Ooze-making Shield; now a big, slowly melting jelly wall that lasts until it's gone rather than for a set turn.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. If an enemy breaks it, the pieces become an Ooze.

history.why: Was Earth's Rampart plus Water's Renew; now a broken Shield turns into an Ooze, so breaking it feeds the swarm.

before.effect: The user gains 30 Shield, or doubles the Shield they have, and 2 Renew.

rows.effect: The user creates an Ooze (30 HP), and target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns. If it's still standing when the Taunt ends, it swallows them: they're Engulfed by it.

history.why: Was a plain Ooze decoy Taunt; now the Taunted enemy must chew through the bait in time or be swallowed by it.

before.effect: The user creates an Ooze, and target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Earth's permanent Taunt plus Affliction and a mobility lock; now the target must attack an Ooze, and every hit they land Splits it.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time); while Taunted, they take 5 Affliction each turn and can't gain mobility buffs.

rows.effect: For 4 turns, the user Splits like an Ooze when damaged (the new Oozes are separate minions, max 4) and gains 1 Armor per allied Ooze.

kits.name: Anointment
kits.tagline: Holy water: blessings that wash away what ails, and flow from one ally to the next.
kits.taglineHtml: Holy water: blessings that wash away what ails, and flow from one ally to the next.
kits.introHtml:
• Unction (Buff, stacks): at the end of the bearer's turn, one stack is used up to remove one of their Debuffs and heal them 10.
  • Chrism (Buff): counts as Anointed, and when the bearer uses a Helpful skill on an ally, that ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn. Holy's Anoint, made to flow.

keywords.html: Unction (Buff, stacks): at the end of the bearer's turn, one stack is used up to remove one of their Debuffs and heal them 10.
Chrism (Buff): counts as Anointed, and when the bearer uses a Helpful skill on an ally, that ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn. Holy's Anoint, made to flow.

rows.effect: Targets any unit. An enemy takes 20 damage; an ally instead heals 20 and loses 1 Debuff.

history.why: Was Font Strike, a plain Unction-scaling hit; now a free sprinkle of holy water that can land on either side, a Strike no other kit can aim at an ally.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +5 per Unction the user has (max 15 more). If they have none, they gain 1.

history.why: Was Water's Flowing Fist plus Holy's Righteous Blow; now it draws strength from the user's Unction reserve, so staying clean hits harder.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy; the user gains 2 Renew. If they're Anointed, 10 more damage and 1 Unction.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. If the user is Anointed, they spend it to cut their other cooldowns by 1 per enemy hit (max 2).

history.why: Was Holy's Divine Storm plus Water's Waterfall; now Water's cooldown cut is bought with Holy's Anointed and grows with each enemy hit.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. The user heals 5 per target hit, and their other cooldowns drop by 1.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Until the user's next turn, they have Chrism, and each ally they Anoint through it also gets 1 Focus for their next skill.

history.why: Was an Unction row that gave the user Focus; now the Charge's Focus flows down the Chrism chain to the allies the user supports.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. Until the user's next turn, each ally's first Helpful skill also gives its target 1 Unction.

history.why: Was base Charge with 1 Unction tacked on; now the pilgrim's passing blesses the team's next helping hands with Unction.

before.effect: 15 damage; the user gains 1 Unction, and 1 Focus for their next skill.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user or on any Anointed ally, and whoever it protected gains Flow for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Water's Riverbend with Anointed tacked on; now Holy's Anointed extends the counter's cover to every anointed ally.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Strategic skill used on the user; the user gains Flow and is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Chrism, and 1 Might for each ally they Anoint with it (max 3).

history.why: Was Holy's Divine Fury with Chrism for Anointed; now each ally the user anoints also stokes the user's own Might.

before.effect: The user gains Chrism for 3 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If the user has Unction, they fling 1 stack with it: 10 more damage, and the target is Condemned. If not, they gain 1.

history.why: Was Holy's Sunbeam with Unction for its heal; now Unction doubles as ammunition, trading a future cleanse for damage and a Condemn.

before.effect: 15 damage. Consumes the user's Anointed to give a random ally 2 Unction.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 30 damage to target enemy, +10 per Debuff on them; those Debuffs are washed away.

history.why: Was Holy's Spear of Light plus Water's Flow check; now it cashes in the Debuffs both parents lay on a target, washing them off as it lands.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 50 damage; if the user has Flow, it can't be countered and also Sanctifies for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, whenever target enemy gives an ally of the user a Debuff, they take 15 damage and that ally gains 1 Unction.

history.why: Was Water's Whirlpool Trap plus Holy's Decree; now it springs on whoever curses the user's team, and hands the victim Unction to wash it off.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Confusion and are Condemned.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Every enemy who uses a Harmful skill during it is Condemned.

history.why: Was Dive plus Cloister with an 'if they lost Debuffs, Anointed' rider; now a new way for a Holy player to spread Condemned while untouchable.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and loses all Debuffs; if they lost any, they're Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Water's Dive with Unction for Renew; now it's a baptism: the user comes up clean, and Anointed if the water washed anything away.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains 3 Unction.

rows.effect: Summons a Sacred Koi (35 HP) permanently. Golden Leap (r): target ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn, or gains Chrism for as long if they already were. Tail Slap (nc): 10 damage.

history.why: Was an Unction Koi that grew Might from cleanses; now it Anoints, and a second blessing on the same ally upgrades it to Chrism.

before.effect: Summons a Sacred Koi (35 HP) permanently; it gains 1 Might for good (max 3) whenever an ally's Unction removes a Debuff. Cleansing Kiss (r): target ally gains 1 Unction. Tail Slap (nc): 10 damage.

history.why: Was Water's Rainbow Scale Fish with Unction for Renew and Chrism for Flow; now the Koi feeds on the Debuffs its team washes off and hits harder for it.

before.effect: Summons a Sacred Koi (35 HP) permanently. Blessing Splash (r): target ally gains 2 Unction; with 3 or more, they also gain Chrism for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. If they were already Sanctified, it bursts instead: every ally heals 15 and gains 1 Unction.

history.why: Was Holy's Rebuke plus Water's Splash; now a second vial on a Sanctified target bursts it into healing and Unction for the whole team.

before.effect: 20 damage and Sanctify for 1 turn; a random ally gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, +10 for each Anointed ally, the user included.

history.why: Was Holy's Holy Nova with Unction tacked on; now the flood swells with every Anointed ally, rewarding the team for spreading Chrism first.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies, and all allies gain 1 Unction. If the user is Anointed, it repeats at the start of their next turn.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy; the user and every Anointed ally heal for the damage dealt.

history.why: Was Water's Drink Deeply with bigger heals and Anointed tacked on; now it drains an enemy and shares the draught with every Anointed ally.

before.effect: Removes all Unction and Renew from allies; target ally heals 10 per stack removed and is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: Summons a Baptismal Font (25 HP) for 3 turns. Pour (nc): target ally heals 10. While it stands, no unit on either side can gain Debuffs.

history.why: Was a healer that Anointed the team on death; now a killable font that freezes every Debuff in the fight while it stands.

before.effect: Summons a Font Spirit (20 HP) for 3 turns. Pour (nc): target ally heals 10. If the Spirit is killed, every ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Holy's Divine Blessing with Chrism for Anointed; now the Spirit heals every turn, and killing it anoints the whole team, so the enemy must choose.

before.effect: Summons a Font Spirit (15 HP) for 3 turns. Blessing Drops (W): target ally gains Chrism until the end of their next turn and 1 Unction; then the Spirit dies.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. Each turn, 5 damage to all enemies, and each loses a Buff; for each Buff washed away, a random ally gains 1 Unction.

history.why: Was Water's Call Rain with Unction for Renew; now the rain strips the enemy's Buffs each turn and turns them into Unction for the user's team.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. Each turn, 5 damage to all enemies, and all allies gain 1 Unction.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Each Weakness on them lasts 1 turn longer.

history.why: Was a neutral 'more Debuffs than the user' check; now keeps a Water player's short Weakness bursts on the target longer.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they have more Debuffs than the user.

history.why: Was Water's Shell Knife plus Holy's Piercing Light; now it weighs purity, striking hard when the target carries more Debuffs than the user.

before.effect: 10 damage, +10 if the target is Condemned or Sanctified, or if the user has 3 or more Renew.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, the user's Flow also lets their skills ignore Shield.

history.why: Was a generic Buff-stripper close to other kits' Ravages; now bends Water's Flow so it also cuts through Shield.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each Buff it washes off them (up to 2).

history.why: Was Holy's Crusade plus Water's Drown; now the flood strips up to 2 Buffs from the target, hitting harder for each.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage. Targets above 75 HP are Condemned; Stunned targets' Stuns last 1 turn longer.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and its targets heal the damage it would have dealt.

history.why: Was Water's Dunk with Holy's Condemned added; now it borrows Holy's Retribution, so the countered attack heals everyone it was aimed at.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered, and they're Condemned and gain 1 Confusion.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn. While they are, Anointed allies deal 10 more damage to them.

history.why: Was Holy's Repentance plus Water's Undertow; now the Stun needs no Condemn, and it's the user's Anointed allies who punish it.

before.effect: Target Condemned enemy is Stunned for 1 turn; if they're already Stunned, their Stuns last 1 turn longer instead.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Chrism and 2 Swiftness, and allies they Anoint through it gain Chrism too until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Water's Pull of the River plus Holy's Immune with Chrism added; now Chrism passes from ally to ally, so one helping hand can anoint a chain.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Chrism, Flow and Immune; now, 3 Unction.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15 and gains 1 Unction, +1 for each Debuff they have.

history.why: Was Water's Renewing Spring with Unction for Renew; now the dose matches the ailment, so it's best spent on the most cursed ally.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15 and gains 3 Unction.

rows.effect: For 2 turns, any Debuff target ally would gain becomes 1 Unction instead.

history.why: Was Holy's Holy Favor with Chrism for Anointed; now the oil turns every Debuff the ally would catch into Unction.

before.effect: Target ally gains Chrism until the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. Each time Confusion raises the cost of a skill they use, the user's player gains 1 random energy per energy it added.

history.why: Was a bridge that Condemned them if a Debuff was cleansed; now tithes the extra energy any Confusion costs them to the user's player.

before.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. If any of their Debuffs is removed before then, they're Condemned.

history.why: Was Holy's Mark of Heresy plus Water's Airless Helm; now Water's Confusion guards itself, as cleansing the target brings Holy's Condemned down on them.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Sanctified until the end of the user's next turn, and gains 2 Weakness for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If the user is Anointed, the anointing flows downstream: it leaves them, and the ally with the least HP gains Chrism until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Ring of Grace, an Unction drip on hits; now spends the user's own Anointing to pass Chrism to whoever needs it most.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, each time an ally damages them, the ally with the most Debuffs gains 1 Unction.

history.why: Was Water's Aqua Ring with Anointed added under Chrism; now every hit the team lands on the target sends Unction to whoever needs it most.

before.effect: 15 damage. For 2 turns, allies who damage the target gain Flow, and are Anointed too if the user has Chrism.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20. The user then takes on every ally's Debuffs and gains 1 Unction for each.

history.why: Was Holy's Saving Grace with Unction for Shield; now the user takes the whole team's Debuffs onto themselves, with Unction to wash each away.

before.effect: All allies heal 10 and gain 2 Unction. If the user is Anointed, it repeats at the start of their next two turns.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Any Sanctify or Condemned on the first flows onto the second.

history.why: Was Water's Water Lash plus Holy's Guardian Strike with Unction for heals; now Water carries Holy's Sanctify and Condemned from the target to the second enemy.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies; if it hits a Sanctified enemy, all allies gain 1 Unction.

rows.effect: Every unit in the battle, on both sides, loses all its Debuffs. Then all enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Bell of the Font, a fiddly Unction-to-Intimidate link; now a clean slate for the whole battle that also wipes the user's own team's Debuffs on the enemy.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and all allies gain 1 Unction. Each Debuff that Unction removes adds 1 turn to a random enemy's Intimidation.

history.why: Was Water's Whale Call plus Holy's Excoriate; now it restores Shout's Intimidate, and the team's cleansing keeps the enemy Intimidated longer.

before.effect: Bypass. Every Sanctified enemy is Condemned for 1 turn and gains 1 Vulnerable; Stunned or Taunted ones also take 15 Affliction.

rows.effect: The user gains 2 Unction, then all their Unction works at once: each stack removes a Debuff and gives 15 Shield instead of healing.

history.why: Was Holy's Shield of Faith plus Water's Aqua Veil with Unction for Renew; now it burns the user's whole Unction reserve at once into cleanses and Shield.

before.effect: The user gains 15 Shield and 2 Unction, and Immune for 1 turn if they're Anointed.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user meanwhile, the user gains Chrism until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Gave random allies Unction when the user was hit; now each blow the tank absorbs lets their next Helpful skill Anoint an ally.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user, a random ally gains 1 Unction.

history.why: Was Holy's Gleam plus Water's Tidal Pull; now every blow the Taunted enemy lands on the user sends Unction to the team.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns; they're Condemned until they use a Harmful skill. The cooldown resets if the user gains Flow.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and 1 Unction at the start of each of their turns, and their Unction cleanses and heals every ally, not just them.

history.why: Was Water's Naiad Form with Chrism and Unction swapped in; now the user becomes a font whose Unction washes and heals the whole team each turn.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Chrism, and 1 Unction at the start of each of their turns.

kits.name: Blood
kits.tagline: The one liquid in every body: spent like energy, and spilled until someone treats it.
kits.taglineHtml: The one liquid in every body: spent like energy, and spilled until someone treats it.
kits.introHtml:
• Blood Price: the skill's random (r) costs are paid with 10 HP each instead of energy; its colored costs are paid as normal. It can't be used if the HP would kill the user.
  • Hemorrhage (Debuff, max 5): at the end of its applier's turn, the bearer takes 5 Affliction per stack, then gains another stack. Any healing the bearer receives removes it entirely.

keywords.html: Blood Price: the skill's random (r) costs are paid with 10 HP each instead of energy; its colored costs are paid as normal. It can't be used if the HP would kill the user.
Hemorrhage (Debuff, max 5): at the end of its applier's turn, the bearer takes 5 Affliction per stack, then gains another stack. Any healing the bearer receives removes it entirely.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. The cut wrings their weakness out as soul: the user removes up to 2 Weakness from them and drains a Soul Fragment for each.

history.why: Was Opening Cut, a Hemorrhage opener; now Water's Weakness is cashed out as Unholy Soul Fragments.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they're at or above 70 HP, the cut opens them up: they gain 2 Hemorrhage.

history.why: Was Unholy's Witchblade with 1 Hemorrhage tacked on; now it's a true opener that bleeds healthy targets hardest.

before.effect: 25 damage and 1 Hemorrhage; Horrified targets take 10 more.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. The target gains 1 Hemorrhage, then each of their allies gains half the target's Hemorrhage, rounded up.

history.why: Was Water's Waterfall with 5 more damage and Blood Price; now the wave splashes the target's Hemorrhage across their whole team.

before.effect: Blood Price. 35 damage to target enemy and 10 to the others; the user's other cooldowns drop by 1.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. Until the end of their next turn, every 10 HP their Lifesteal heals also gives them 1 Renew.

history.why: Was Blood Rush, which gave the user Hemorrhage and Focus; now Unholy's Lifesteal banks its healing as Water's Renew.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user's blood rushes: they gain 1 Hemorrhage and 2 Focus for their next skill.

history.why: Was Unholy's Wraithwalk plus Water's Renew; now the user bleeds themselves for a burst of speed, and needs healing to stop it.

before.effect: 15 damage; the user gains 2 Renew, and their next Harmful skill drains a Soul Fragment.

rows.effect: Blood Price. Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 1 Hemorrhage for every 20 HP the user is missing.

history.why: Unchanged text; it's already paid in blood and scales with HP the user has spent, so its hook moves from Hemorrhage to Blood Price to even the split.

before.effect: Blood Price. Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 1 Hemorrhage for every 20 HP the user is missing.

history.why: Was Unholy's Spiteful Retort with Hemorrhage and Blood Price tacked on; now the counter's bleed grows with the user's own wounds.

before.effect: Blood Price. Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 2 Hemorrhage and is Horrified for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Blood Price. For 3 turns, the user gains Lifesteal and 1 Might for every 20 HP they're missing, rechecked each turn.

history.why: Was Water's Quiet Fury with Lifesteal and Blood Price swapped in; now the frenzy grows as the user bleeds, and every Lifesteal heal cools it.

before.effect: Blood Price. For 3 turns, the user gains Lifesteal, Flow and 1 Might.

rows.effect: Blood Price. 15 damage to target enemy and 1 Hemorrhage. If they were already bleeding, the user heals back the HP they paid.

history.why: Was base Shot with both kit keywords tacked on; now Blood Price becomes a bet, and the dart is free against a target that's already bleeding.

before.effect: Blood Price. 15 damage and 1 Hemorrhage.

rows.effect: Blood Price. Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, plus the damage the user took in between (max 30 more).

history.why: Was Unholy's Soul Lance word for word with Blood Price added; now every wound the user takes while aiming is added to the shot.

before.effect: Blood Price. Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage; if the target ends below 50 HP, the user drains a Soul Fragment.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the next healing target enemy receives becomes Hemorrhage instead: 1 stack per 10 HP it would have healed (max 5).

history.why: Was Unholy's Soul Shackle with Hemorrhage for Weakness; now it poisons the target's next heal, turning it into Hemorrhage.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they're Stunned for 1 turn and gain 2 Hemorrhage.

rows.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn and drains a Soul Fragment from each enemy who damages them during it.

history.why: Was Grave Step plus Water's Renew side by side; now a new way for an Unholy player to harvest Soul Fragments from whoever hits them.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn, then gains 1 Renew for every 10 HP they lost during it.

history.why: Was Unholy's Grave Step plus Water's Renew; now the Renew is earned by the blows the Immortal user soaks, so the harder they're hit, the more they mend.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn and gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Summons a Bloodbound Familiar permanently. It has no HP of its own and shares the user's: damage and healing to it go to the user, and it dies only with them. Bite (r): 15 damage.

history.why: Was Vampire Bat, a Hemorrhage biter; now a companion that can't be picked off, only paid for out of the user's own veins.

before.effect: Summons a Vampire Bat (30 HP) permanently. Bite (r): 10 damage and 1 Hemorrhage; the Bat heals the damage dealt.

rows.effect: Blood Price. 25 damage to target enemy, and the HP the user paid heals their lowest-HP ally, doubled.

history.why: Was Unholy's Fel Bolt with Blood Price added; now the blood the user pays isn't lost but flows to their weakest ally, doubled.

before.effect: Blood Price. 25 damage, and Horrified for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Blood Price. 25 damage to all enemies. The user spends all their Soul Fragments: each one gives every enemy 1 Hemorrhage.

history.why: Was Unholy's Soul Blast with Blood Price and 1 Hemorrhage added; now it trades the user's Soul Fragments for Hemorrhage on every enemy instead of burst.

before.effect: Blood Price. 25 damage to all enemies, +10 per Soul Fragment the user has; each gains 1 Hemorrhage.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. If they have Hemorrhage, the user drinks it: it ends, and they heal 10 per stack. If not, the target gains 1 Hemorrhage.

history.why: Was Unholy's Drain Soul plus a heal per Hemorrhage stack; now it asks whether to let the bleed grow or drink it all at once, ending it.

before.effect: 5 damage, and drains a Soul Fragment; the user heals 10 per Hemorrhage stack on the target.

rows.effect: Blood Price. Summons a Blood Elemental for 3 turns, with HP equal to what the user paid. Blood Lash (nc): 10 damage and 1 Hemorrhage. When it expires, the user heals its remaining HP.

history.why: Was Water's Water Elemental with Hemorrhage and more HP; now it's built from the user's own blood, which they get back if it survives.

before.effect: Summons a Blood Elemental (25 HP) for 3 turns. Lash (nc, Uncounterable): 10 damage and 1 Hemorrhage.

rows.effect: Blood Price. Channeled, up to 3 turns. Each turn, target enemy gains 1 Hemorrhage, and the user heals for what their Hemorrhage deals.

history.why: Was Unholy's Drain Life with bigger numbers, Hemorrhage and Blood Price; now it drains through the bleed itself, healing more as the Hemorrhage grows.

before.effect: Blood Price. Channeled. Each turn, 10 damage to target enemy, who gains 1 Hemorrhage, and the user heals 15. If they die, the user gains 2 Soul Fragments.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. The user's Renew heals them once now, without losing a stack.

history.why: Spent Water's Renew to drain an Unholy Soul Fragment; now an extra, free Renew tick for any Water player who keeps Renew up.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. If the user has 3 or more Renew, they spend 3 to deal 15 more and drain a Soul Fragment from them.

history.why: Was Unholy's Blighted Dagger with 1 Hemorrhage added; now it spends Water's Renew to fuel Unholy's drain.

before.effect: 15 damage and 1 Hemorrhage. At or above 70 HP, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

rows.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy and 2 Hemorrhage. If they're healed before the user's next turn, the healer takes the Hemorrhage instead.

history.why: Was Unholy's Lay Waste with 2 Hemorrhage added; now the wound is catching, and whoever heals it takes the bleed.

before.effect: 35 Piercing damage and 2 Hemorrhage; a target with Buffs is Horrified for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Blood Price. Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they pay its cost again in blood: 10 HP per energy.

history.why: Was Unholy's Mirage of Nightmares with Renew for Swiftness; now it turns Blood Price on the enemy, so a countered skill costs them 10 HP per energy.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Strategic skill, it's countered; the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn and gains 1 Might and 2 Renew.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and they faint: Stunned until they're healed, up to 2 turns.

history.why: Was a bridge that tied the Stun to Unholy's Horrify; now a Stun the enemy can only end early by spending a heal on the fainted unit.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun. If they're Horrified, the Stun lasts as long as the Horrify does.

history.why: Was Unholy's Cripple with its stats swapped, Hemorrhage added and no Stun; now it's a real Stun that Unholy's Horrify stretches.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 permanent Weakness and 2 Hemorrhage; if Horrified, also 1 permanent Vulnerable.

rows.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Hemorrhage. For 3 turns, each time the user damages a bleeding enemy, that Hemorrhage grows by 1 and the user gains 1 Swiftness (max 2).

history.why: Was Unholy's Grisly Spectacle plus a stack for every Hemorrhage; now the user dances on the enemy's wounds, deepening each one they strike and gaining Swiftness.

before.effect: 15 Piercing damage; every enemy Hemorrhage gains a stack, and every Horrify lasts 1 turn longer. The user gains 1 Confusion for 1 turn (stacking).

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20, and the enemy who damaged them most recently loses as much HP.

history.why: Was a bland Blood Price heal; now the ally's last attacker pays for the healing in their own blood.

before.effect: Blood Price. Target ally heals 30.

rows.effect: For 2 turns, target ally gains 2 Might and 2 Swiftness. When it ends, they crash: Stunned for 1 turn, which Swiftness can't stop.

history.why: Was Blooded Edge, a Might-and-Hemorrhage Bless; now a big two-turn surge with a guaranteed crash, so the timing is the whole decision.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their direct hits give 1 Hemorrhage, once per target each turn.

history.why: Was Unholy's Vampirism plus Water's Renew; now the ally's own hits open Hemorrhage, spreading the kit's bleed through a teammate.

before.effect: Target ally gains Lifesteal for 2 turns and 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Target enemy gains 2 Hemorrhage, which healing can't remove for 2 turns.
