20 damage to target enemy and 1 Hemorrhage. For 2 turns, allies who damage them heal 5 per Hemorrhage stack they have.

history.why: Was Unholy's Soul Sickness with Hemorrhage added; now the mark lets allies feed on the target's bleeding, healing more as it grows.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Hemorrhage. For 1 turn, any ally who damages the target gains a Soul Fragment.

rows.effect: Blood Price. All allies heal 20. Until the user's next turn, their allies' random costs are paid with the user's HP instead, 10 each.

history.why: Was Unholy's Profane Chant with Hemorrhage, Renew and Blood Price added; now it heals the team and lets the user pay their allies' random costs in blood for a turn.

before.effect: Blood Price. 20 damage and 1 Hemorrhage to all enemies; all allies gain 2 Renew.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. For 2 turns, the user's Lifesteal also heals them for their ticking and Affliction damage.

history.why: Was 'hit, then heal off targets with Weakness or Confusion'; now bends Unholy's Lifesteal to feed on damage over time as well.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. The user heals for the damage dealt to any that have Weakness or Confusion.

history.why: Was Unholy's Oathbreaker Strike plus Water's Renew; now Water's Weakness and Confusion open its targets to an Unholy leech.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, then 10 to them and to each of the user's allies; allies hit gain 2 Renew.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, the user drains a Soul Fragment from each of them who uses a Helpful skill.

history.why: Gave Horrified enemies Hemorrhage; now an Unholy expansion that harvests Soul Fragments from enemies who try to recover.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Horrified ones also gain 2 Hemorrhage.

history.why: Was Unholy's Soulshriek with Hemorrhage in place of Horrify; now it restores Shout's Intimidate, and Unholy's Horrify marks which enemies start to bleed.

before.effect: 20 damage. If the user has a Soul Fragment, they spend it for 10 more damage and 2 Hemorrhage.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. While it holds, their Renew also heals at the end of each enemy turn.

history.why: Was Unholy's Misery with Water's Renew stitched on; now bends Renew for a Water player so it ticks on the enemy's turns too.

before.effect: The user drains 10 HP from each other ally and gains 20 Shield plus the total. At the end of the user's next turn, each of those allies gains 3 Renew.

history.why: Was Unholy's Misery with twice the payoff and Blood Price; now the blood is a loan the user repays as Water's Renew.

before.effect: Blood Price. The user drains 10 HP from each other ally, and gains 20 Shield plus twice the amount drained.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each skill they aim at the user meanwhile gives them 1 Confusion for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Scent of Blood, which moved the user's Hemorrhage onto them; now a Water expansion that muddies every attack the Taunted enemy is forced to make.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user, the user's Hemorrhage moves onto them; if the user has none, they gain 1 Hemorrhage.

history.why: Was Unholy's Unrelenting Horror with free Lifesteal and a Hemorrhage bonus; now the user's own bleeding pours into whoever is forced to strike them.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Meanwhile the user has Lifesteal, and deals 10 more to enemies with Hemorrhage.

rows.effect: Blood Price. For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immortal, and all of their skills' random costs are paid in HP.

history.why: Was Water's Naiad Form with Lifesteal and a 30 HP price; now the colossus runs on blood, Immortal for 3 turns and paying every random cost in HP.

before.effect: Blood Price (30 HP). For 4 turns, the user gains 3 Armor, Lifesteal, and 2 Renew at the start of each of their turns.

kits.name: Mirror
kits.tagline: Still water in the dark: whatever the enemy does comes back at them, or is copied.
kits.taglineHtml: Still water in the dark: whatever the enemy does comes back at them, or is copied.
kits.introHtml:
• Reflect: Mirror skills set up the game's existing Reflect (a counter that applies the skill to its user, or their team) against the next skill of a given kind: Harmful skills aimed at your side, or even the enemy's Helpful skills, whose effects then land on your side instead. Water's Flow still ignores it.
  • Mimic: the user uses a copy of the last skill a given enemy used, as its user, choosing any targets it needs. It costs nothing extra.

keywords.html: Reflect: Mirror skills set up the game's existing Reflect (a counter that applies the skill to its user, or their team) against the next skill of a given kind: Harmful skills aimed at your side, or even the enemy's Helpful skills, whose effects then land on your side instead. Water's Flow still ignores it.
Mimic: the user uses a copy of the last skill a given enemy used, as its user, choosing any targets it needs. It costs nothing extra.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they're Blinded, their next single-target skill is Reflected back at them.

history.why: Was base Strike with a Reflect tacked on; now it pays off Shadow's Blind, turning the target's next blind swing back on themselves.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy; for 1 turn, the next Harmful skill aimed at the user is Reflected.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Until the user's next turn, the first enemy skill that hits more than one of the user's allies is Reflected onto the enemy team.

history.why: Was Shattering Glass, a neutral Texture counter-breaker close to Thunder's Crackling Rend; now a Reflect core row that answers the enemy's area skills with their own.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Any counter, Reflect or Trap on the enemies it hits shatters: it ends, and its owner takes 10 more.

history.why: Was Shadow's Shadow Crash spending Reflects instead of Stealth; now it breaks the enemy's hidden counters, Reflects and Traps, Water's Flow made into a hammer.

before.effect: Breaks the user's Reflects: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies, +10 to each per Reflect broken.

rows.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, Helpful skills the user uses don't break their Stealth.

history.why: Was 'if Stealthed, cut cooldowns'; now bends Shadow's Stealth so a Stealthed user can support allies without being revealed.

before.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy. If the user is Stealthed, their other cooldowns drop by 1.

history.why: Was Shadow's Long Shadow plus Flow's counter-proofing; now Shadow's Stealth quickens the user's cooldowns the way Water's Waterfall does.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage, and the user's next skill is Stealthy and ignores counters and reflects.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, every Debuff aimed at the user is Reflected onto whoever sent it; the damage still lands.

history.why: Was Shadow's Mirage Blade with Reflect for its counter; now it lets the blows land but turns every curse back on its sender.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, the first Harmful skill used on the user is Reflected.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, and their Debuffs work in reverse: each Weakness counts as 1 Might, and each Vulnerable as 1 Armor.

history.why: Was Quicksilver Fury, which Mimicked enemies' self-Buffs; now a mirror-world Rage that turns the enemy's Weakness and Vulnerable into strength, instead of blocking them with Immune.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, and whenever an enemy uses a Helpful skill on themselves, the user Mimics it.

history.why: Was Shadow's Night of Knives plus Water's Flow; now the fury mirrors every self-buff the enemy casts, Rage for Rage.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and Flow.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. For 3 turns, the first single hit of 30 or more damage they take shatters them: it lands a second time.

history.why: Was Needle of Glass, which Mimicked cheap skills; now a cheap crack that doubles the team's next big hit on the target.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. If the last skill they used cost 1 energy or less, the user Mimics it too.

history.why: Was Shadow's Shadow Spine plus Water's Renew; now it copies the target's cheap attacks straight back at them.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage, +5 for each of Blinded, Isolated and Asleep the target is; a random ally gains 1 Renew.

rows.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, the user Mimics the last skill target enemy used, aimed back at them where it can be.
Invisible, 2 turns. The first Helpful skill target enemy uses is Reflected: its effects land on a random unit of yours instead.
The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, watching from the glass: the first single-target Harmful skill aimed at an ally in that time is Reflected.

history.why: Was Shadow's Shadowstep plus Water's Dive; now the user slips out of reach but turns the next attack on an ally back at its user.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted and gains Stealth for 1 turn, and 2 Renew.

rows.effect: Summons a Doppelganger (30 HP) permanently. Mimicry (r): it uses a copy of the last skill its summoner used.
25 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. The ally who spends the Mark has their other cooldowns cut by 1.

history.why: Was Blackbolt plus 'if already Blinded, stun'; now a new way to earn Water's cooldown cuts by following up on the Mark.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Blinded for 2 turns. If they were already Blinded, the glare also stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Shadow's Blackbolt plus Water's Splash; now a second dose of Shadow's Blind sets up a Water-style stun.

before.effect: 20 damage and Blinded for 2 turns; a random ally gains 2 Renew.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. The user then Mimics the last enemy skill that hit more than one of their allies.

history.why: Was Shadow's Wave of Darkness plus Water's Deluge; now the tide returns the enemy's last area attack in kind.

before.effect: 25 damage and 1 Confusion to all enemies. With Flow, it also stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. Then the user and they trade HP totals, each capped at their own max HP.

history.why: Was Still Pool, a small drain that Mimicked Helpful skills; now a looking-glass swap of HP with an enemy, huge when the user is low and useless when they're not.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. If their last skill was Helpful, the user Mimics it.

history.why: Was Shadow's Drink Darkness with a Reflect tacked on; now it drinks the target's last blessing and Mimics it for the user's team.

before.effect: 5 Affliction to all enemies; Blinded ones lose Blind and take 10 more. For 1 turn, the next Harmful skill aimed at the user is Reflected.

rows.effect: Summons a Mirror Shade (20 HP) for 3 turns. Glass Shard (nc): 10 damage to target enemy. When it's killed, the skill that killed it is Reflected onto its user.

history.why: Was Shadow's Call Shade with a Reflect-granting skill in place of its Blind; now the Shade is a trap itself, Reflecting whatever kills it.

before.effect: Summons a Mirror Shade (15 HP) for 3 turns. Silver Veil (r): for 1 turn, the next Harmful skill aimed at target ally is Reflected.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns. Each turn, 10 damage to all enemies. While it channels, enemy single-target skills aimed at the user hit a random enemy instead.

history.why: Was Shadow's Nightsong with a team Reflect in place of its Sleep; now the hall bends every attack on the user onto a random enemy while it lasts.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns; while it channels, the first Harmful skill aimed at each ally each turn is Reflected.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Any Confusion on them shatters: it ends, and they take 10 Affliction per stack.

history.why: Was the same 'bonus on Asleep, doesn't wake them' Stab as Night's; now a new outlet that cashes a Water player's Confusion into damage.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they're Asleep; it doesn't wake them.

history.why: Was Shadow's Backstab word for word; now it strikes Shadow's sleepers and, like Water's Drown, keeps them under.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or the target is Blinded.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, doubled if one of their skills was countered or Reflected since the user's last turn.

history.why: Was Shadow's Ambush plus Water's Drown; now it punishes a foiled attacker, paying off any counter or Reflect that caught them.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the user is Stealthed. Against Stunned targets, their Stuns last 1 turn longer.

rows.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and the user Mimics it.
10 damage to target enemy and Sleep. When they wake, the ripple spreads: a random ally of theirs falls Asleep.

history.why: Turned Shadow's Sleep into Water's Confusion; now each wake-up passes the Sleep along, so a Shadow player's Sleep keeps rolling.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and Sleep. When they wake, they're groggy: 2 Confusion for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Shadow's Sap plus Water's Undertow rule; now Shadow's Sleep hands off to Water's Confusion when it breaks, so waking them has a cost.

before.effect: 10 damage, and Sleep; a target already Asleep gains 2 Confusion instead.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness at the start of each of their turns. Each time Swiftness stops a Stun, the user Mimics the skill that tried it.

history.why: Was Shadow's Hall of Phantoms with Reflect in place of Immune; now the dancer slips each Stun and copies the skill that tried it.

before.effect: The user gains Stealth. If they were already Stealthed, for 1 turn they're Ghosted and every Harmful skill aimed at them is Reflected.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20. The next Helpful skill an enemy uses to heal is Reflected, landing on that ally instead.

history.why: Was Shadow's Touch of Slumber plus Water's Renew; now it heals an ally and diverts the enemy's next heal onto them.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, gains 2 Renew, and falls Asleep.

rows.effect: Target ally gains Stealth, and Flow for 2 turns; while they have Flow, their skills are Stealthy.

history.why: Was Shadow's Nightwrap with a Reflect tacked on; now Water's Flow keeps Shadow's Stealth from breaking, so the ally can act unseen.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth; for 2 turns, the first Harmful skill aimed at them is Reflected.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 2 turns and gains 1 Confusion. Each time their Blind sends a skill astray, they gain 1 more Confusion.

history.why: Was Shadow's Blinding Powder plus a Helpful Reflect that copied the kit's Trap; now Shadow's Blind feeds Water's Confusion each time it misdirects them.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 2 turns, and the next Helpful skill aimed at them is Reflected onto a random unit of yours.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, the first ally who damages them also Mimics the last skill they used.

history.why: Was Shadow's Shadowbrand plus Water's Aqua Ring; now the brand lets a teammate turn the target's own last skill against them.

before.effect: 10 damage and Sanctify for 2 turns; for 2 turns, allies who damage the target gain Flow. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20. For 2 turns, each ally who takes no damage in a turn gains Stealth at its end.

history.why: Was Nightfall and Rainsong split by a Stealth check; now a new, board-reading way for a Shadow team to earn Stealth.

before.effect: All allies heal 20. Each ally already Stealthed gains 3 Renew; the rest gain Stealth.

history.why: Was Shadow's Nightfall with a Reflect tacked on; now allies already hidden by Shadow get Water's Renew, and the rest are hidden.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain Stealth; next turn, the first Harmful skill aimed at each of them is Reflected.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Each ally with Renew gives up 1 stack to add 5 to both hits.

history.why: Was 'hit, then Blinded ones gain Weakness'; now a trade-off that turns a Water team's spare Renew into damage.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy; any Blinded one it hits also gains 2 Weakness for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Shadow's Shadow Pulse plus Water's Water Lash; now Shadow's Blind sets up Water's Weakness on whoever the shards find.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies; with Flow, each gains 1 Weakness.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Each enemy's cooldowns are mirrored: their ready skills go on cooldown for 1 turn, and those on cooldown become ready.

history.why: Was the stock 'Intimidate, then Blinded or Asleep ones take more'; now flips every enemy's cooldowns, a gamble no other kit offers.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; those already Blinded or Asleep also take 15 Affliction.

history.why: Was Shadow's Hunter's Howl plus Water's Whale Call; now it keeps Shout's Intimidate, and Shadow's Blind and Sleep set up Water's Affliction.

before.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 2 turns (Intimidated instead if already Blinded) and gain 1 Vulnerable.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. If an enemy breaks it, the user Mimics the skill that did.

history.why: Was Shadow's Veiled Guard with Reflect in place of Stealth; now breaking the guard hands the user a copy of the skill that broke it.

before.effect: The user gains 1 permanent Armor; with 3 or more, the next Harmful skill aimed at them is Reflected.

rows.effect: Creates a Reflection (5 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn. When they damage it, the user Mimics that skill.
For 3 turns, the user wears target enemy's face: 2 Armor and copies of their Buffs, refreshed at the start of each of the user's turns. When it begins, the user Mimics that enemy's last skill.

history.why: Was Shadow's Faceless One with Reflect in place of Isolate; now the user takes on one enemy's face, copying their Buffs throughout and their last skill once.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor and all enemies are Taunted by them; the first Harmful skill each enemy uses on the user each turn is Reflected.

kits.name: Storm
kits.tagline: Lightning on the wind: a storm your team keeps fed turn after turn, until it breaks over everyone.
kits.taglineHtml: Lightning on the wind: a storm your team keeps fed turn after turn, until it breaks over everyone.
kits.introHtml:
• Tempest (your team's, max 5, visible to both): +1 each time your team uses a Storm skill; −1 at the end of each of your turns in which none was used. Storm skills scale with it where they say so. At 5, the Eye of the Storm: your next Storm skill also hits every other enemy with its damage and effects, and Tempest drops to 3.

One keyword: a cheap Storm skill used every turn keeps the storm alive on its own, and Lightning and Wind supply the rest.

keywords.html: Tempest (your team's, max 5, visible to both): +1 each time your team uses a Storm skill; −1 at the end of each of your turns in which none was used. Storm skills scale with it where they say so. At 5, the Eye of the Storm: your next Storm skill also hits every other enemy with its damage and effects, and Tempest drops to 3.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, +5 for each Storm skill the user's team used last turn (max +15).

history.why: Was Lightning's Jolt scaling with Tempest plus Wind's Leaping Strike stun; now it rewards keeping the storm fed turn after turn, the user's own included.

before.effect: 20 damage, +5 per Tempest. If the user is Leaping, it also stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. For 2 turns, the user's Swiftness stops Stuns without being spent.

history.why: Turned Wind's Leaping into Lightning's Sapped; now lets a Wind player's Swiftness block every Stun for 2 turns without running out.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. If the user is Leaping, they come down hard: every enemy it hits is Sapped.

history.why: Was Wind's Spiral Crash with Tempest damage tacked on; now Wind's Leap lands as Lightning's Sapped on everyone it hits.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +5 per Tempest. If the user isn't Leaping, they Leap; if they are, every other enemy takes 10.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and the user begins Rushing. Each turn they start Rushing, they also gain 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Wind's Launch plus Lightning's Charged Dash; now Wind's Rushing keeps generating Lightning's Charge for as long as the user keeps moving.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing and gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Sapped once for each energy it cost.

history.why: Reflected instead of countering if the user was Rushing; now a new way for a Lightning player to Sap, scaled to what the enemy spent.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; if the user is Rushing, it's Reflected back at its user instead.

history.why: Was Wind's Zephyr Blade with Sapped added; now it's a true counter that Wind's Rushing turns into Lightning's Reflect.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage to target enemy. If this skill is countered, the counterer takes 25 Piercing damage and is Sapped.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Stormborn and 1 Might, and each time their Charge fills to 3, Tempest rises by 1.

history.why: Was Wind's Chainbreaker with Tempest set to 5 (and named after the Eye); now Lightning's Stormborn Charge cycle feeds the team's Tempest every time it fills.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs; Tempest rises to 5, and the user is Immune for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Until the user's next turn, each time one of their allies takes damage, the user gains 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Spark Gust, a Tempest formula on Sapped targets; now a Lightning expansion that gives the user Stormborn-style Charge from hits on the team.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they're Sapped, the spark jumps: Tempest rises by 1 more.

history.why: Was Lightning's Zap with Tempest damage added; now it feeds the storm faster off a Sapped target instead of hitting harder.

before.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Tempest; the user gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 15 Piercing damage to all enemies, +5 for each Tempest; it spends all of it.

history.why: Was Wind's Elegant Sweep plus Lightning's Particle Beam with Tempest damage; now it breaks the storm on purpose, spending all Tempest on one sweeping front.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 20 Piercing damage to all enemies, +5 per Tempest; Sapped ones take 10 more.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, the user's team gains 1 Tempest, and they take 5 Piercing damage per Tempest.

history.why: Was Float Noose plus Tesla Coil side by side; now every skill the snared enemy uses feeds the storm that hits them.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage, are Sapped, and are Isolated for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user Leaps, and gains Conduit until their Leap ends, so their landing blow steals the target's Charge.

history.why: Was Wind's Bound plus 1 Charge; now the Leap carries Lightning's Conduit, so the landing blow steals the target's Charge.

before.effect: The user Leaps and gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: Summons a Storm Roc (40 HP) permanently; its skills are Storm skills. Gale Wing (nc): 5 damage to target enemy. Thunder Talon (r, only at 3 or more Tempest): 20 damage, and Saps.

history.why: Was Wind's Grand Eagle plus Lightning's Storm Hawk; now the Roc keeps the storm fed with a free wingbeat and unlocks its talons once Tempest is high.

before.effect: Summons a Storm Roc (45 HP) permanently; its skills count as Storm skills. Talon Bolt (r): 15 damage, and Saps. Lift Off (A): target ally Leaps and gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Saps them. It then arcs to 1 other enemy for every 2 Tempest, dealing 10 to each.

history.why: Was Lightning's Innervate plus Wind's Compressed Bolt with Tempest damage; now Tempest makes it arc to more enemies instead of hitting harder.

before.effect: 20 damage, +5 per Tempest, and Saps. Immobile targets also have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. The storm discharges: Tempest falls by 1, and each ally gains 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Wind's Spiral Burst with Tempest damage added; now it discharges the storm into the team, trading Tempest for Lightning's Charge.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies, +5 per Tempest, +10 if the user is Leaping and +10 if Rushing.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. The storm calms: Tempest falls by up to 2, and the user heals the damage dealt plus 10 for each point it fell.

history.why: Was Lightning's Siphon Charge plus Wind's Sap Speed; now it drinks from the storm itself, trading Tempest for healing.

before.effect: 5 damage. The user takes all of the target's Charge and removes their mobility buffs, gaining 1 Swiftness per buff.

rows.effect: Summons a Squall Cloud (20 HP) for 3 turns; its skills are Storm skills. Rumble (nc): 5 damage to target enemy. When it expires, it breaks: 5 damage per Tempest to all enemies.

history.why: Was Wind's Wind Sprites with Sap for their counter-punish and a Storm tag; now one cloud feeds the storm and breaks over the enemy when it expires.

before.effect: Summons 2 Storm Sprites (10 HP) for 3 turns. Zap (nc, a Storm skill): 5 Piercing damage, and Saps.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. Each turn, 10 damage to all enemies, +5 per Tempest, and Tempest rises by 1; it ends early once Tempest reaches 5.
10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP, and they count as Immobile until the end of the user's next turn.

history.why: Paid Lightning Charge for stabbing Immobile targets; now an enabler that lets any Wind skill's Immobile payoff land on anyone.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they're Immobile; stabbing an Immobile target also gives the user 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Wind's Airknife with Tempest damage added; now it punishes Wind's Immobile targets and turns each such stab into Lightning's Charge.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 if the user is Rushing, +5 per Tempest.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to the enemy with the most HP, +15 if they're Stunned. It ignores Stealth, Untargetable and redirection.

history.why: Was nearly Wind's Sonic Thrust with a Charge rider; now lightning that always finds the tallest enemy, wherever they hide.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user isn't Rushing, they spend 1 Charge for 15 more damage, or are Stunned for 1 turn if they have none.

history.why: Was Wind's Sonic Thrust plus Lightning's Charged bonus with a muddled trade; now Lightning's Charge clearly pays Wind's Stun price, and hits harder for it.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +10 if the user is Charged. If the user isn't Rushing, they lose their Charge instead of being Stunned.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they're Sapped once for every 2 Tempest (at least once).

history.why: Was Wind's Wind Step plus Sapped and 1 Tempest; now it's a true counter whose Sapping deepens with the storm.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they're Marked and Sapped, the user begins Rushing, and Tempest rises by 1.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Static builds in them for 2 turns: each skill they use adds 1 turn to a Stun that lands when it ends (max 3).

history.why: Was Crackling Buffet, a neutral Texture close to Aurora's Lightshow; now a delayed Stun the enemy grows with every skill they use, so they must choose between acting and staying free.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and a 1-turn stun on whichever kind of skill they used last: Strategic or non-Strategic.

history.why: Was Lightning's System Shock with its Sapped bonus made a full Stun; now it reads the target and stuns whichever half of their kit they just used, Wind's Strategic stun or Lightning's non-Strategic one.

before.effect: 15 damage, and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn; Sapped targets are fully Stunned.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and begins Rushing; while they're Rushing, all their skills count as Storm skills.

history.why: Was Wind's Top Speed plus Stormborn and 2 Tempest; now riding the storm turns every skill the user has into fuel for Tempest and the Eye.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, Ghosted and Stormborn, and begins Rushing; Tempest rises by 2.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 25. The current then arcs to the other ally with the least HP, then to the last, 10 less at each jump.

history.why: Was Calm of the Eye, a Tempest heal; now chain lightning in reverse, a heal that jumps across the whole team and weakens as it goes.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20. At 5 Tempest, it heals every ally instead, without using up the Eye of the Storm.

history.why: Was Lightning's Defibrillate plus Wind's Invigorating Breeze; now it's the calm at the Eye: at 5 Tempest it heals the whole team and saves the Eye for a strike.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, +5 per Charge the user has; above 60 HP afterwards, they begin Rushing.

rows.effect: For 2 turns, target ally's skills count as Storm skills, and they gain 1 Swiftness.

history.why: Was Wind's Swiftwind plus Lightning's Overclock; now the ally joins the storm, so their own skills feed Tempest and can ride the Eye.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Swiftness, and Conduit for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy loses all their Charge. For 2 turns, any Charge they would gain feeds the user's team Tempest instead.

history.why: Was Headwind plus Power Drain; now the enemy's own Lightning is blown into the user's storm.

before.effect: Target enemy loses all mobility buffs, is Sapped, and gains 1 Weakness.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each time an ally damages them, Tempest rises by 1.

history.why: Was Wind's Feathermark plus Lightning's Apply Polarity; now the target is a lightning rod, and every ally's hit on them feeds the storm.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target Leap and gain 1 Charge.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. For 2 turns, the team's Tempest doesn't fall.

history.why: Was Wind's Uplifting Verse plus Charge and 1 Tempest; now the song holds the storm up for 2 turns, so the team can pause without losing it.

before.effect: All allies heal 15, Leap and gain 1 Charge; Tempest rises by 1.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. It doesn't end the user's Leap, and while they're Leaping, both hits gain the Leap's bonus.

history.why: Was Gale Slam, a Tempest catch-up; now a Cleave a Leaping Wind user can swing without landing.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If Tempest fell at the end of the team's last turn, it rises by 2 more.

history.why: Was Wind's Falling Slam with Tempest damage added; now it's the storm's comeback, restoring 2 extra Tempest after a quiet turn.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, +5 per Tempest. Costs 1 less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. It never uses up the Eye of the Storm; at 5 Tempest, it also Saps every enemy.

history.why: Was Wind's Echoing Voice for allies plus Charge and 2 Tempest; now it restores Shout's Intimidate and can be cast at the Eye without wasting it.

before.effect: Every ally gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Charge; Tempest rises by 2.

rows.effect: Every ally, the user included, gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. The user gains 3 Sapped.

history.why: Was Stormwall, a Shield that fed Tempest; now shelters the whole team at the price of the user's next turn's energy.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn, and each enemy hit it absorbs raises Tempest by 1.

history.why: Was Wind's Slipstream plus Lightning's Lightning Cage with Tempest added; now the wall turns every blow it catches into Tempest for the team.

before.effect: The user gains 15 Shield, +15 if Rushing and +5 per Tempest, and gains Charge whenever it's hit.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. While they're Taunted, reaching 3 Sapped doesn't use it up: they generate 1 less energy every turn it lasts.

history.why: Stole both Charge and mobility buffs side by side; now bends Lightning's Sapped so a Lightning player's drain keeps biting.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. While Taunted, any Charge or mobility buff they would gain goes to the user instead.

history.why: Was Wind's Piercing Cry plus Lightning's Aggro Signal; now the provoked enemy's Lightning Charge and Wind momentum flow to the user.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn, or 3 if they're Immobile; the first Harmful skill they use while Taunted is Reflected.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains 1 Armor per 2 Tempest, rechecked each turn; Tempest rises by 1 at the start of each of their turns.

history.why: Was Wind's Djinnform plus Stormborn with Tempest set to 5; now the djinn feeds the storm every turn and hardens as it grows.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 15 Shield, Immune and Stormborn, then Leaps; Tempest rises to 5.

kits.name: Battery
kits.tagline: Stored lightning in a leaking cell: charge up slowly, let it all out at once, and let the acid eat through defenses.
kits.taglineHtml: Stored lightning in a leaking cell: charge up slowly, let it all out at once, and let the acid eat through defenses.
kits.introHtml:
• Cells (the user's, max 5): stored charge that never decays. Battery skills store Cells as listed, and Charge the user would gain while already at 3 becomes a Cell instead. Discharge skills spend all Cells for the effect they list per Cell.
  • Corroded (Debuff): the bearer's Shield loses 10 at the end of each of their turns, and they can't gain Armor.

keywords.html: Cells (the user's, max 5): stored charge that never decays. Battery skills store Cells as listed, and Charge the user would gain while already at 3 becomes a Cell instead. Discharge skills spend all Cells for the effect they list per Cell.
Corroded (Debuff): the bearer's Shield loses 10 at the end of each of their turns, and they can't gain Armor.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If the user has no Cells, they store 1; if they have any, they spend 1 and the target gains 2 Toxin.

history.why: Was Jolt's Charge scaling plus Viper Strike's Toxin plus a Cell; now it alternates between storing a Cell and spending one to inject 2 Toxin.

before.effect: 15 damage, +5 per Charge the user has, and 1 Toxin. The user stores 1 Cell.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to each of their allies. For 2 turns, whenever one of them loses Toxin, each other enemy it hit gains 1 Toxin.

history.why: Scaled its splash by the target's Toxin; now wires the enemies hit into one circuit, so cleansing Toxin from one spreads it to the rest.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and 10 to each of their allies, +5 per Toxin the target has.

history.why: Was Plague Stomp with Corroded tacked on; now the target's Toxin conducts the splash, so it asks which enemy is most poisoned.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 1 Toxin and are Corroded for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user's player gains 2 random energy now and generates 2 less next turn.

history.why: Was Spark Lunge, a Prey-marking Cell store; now an energy loan that front-loads a turn at the cost of the next, a tempo swing no other Charge offers.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, who is Prey through the user's next turn. The user's next skill stores 1 Cell for each Prey enemy it damages.

history.why: Was Lunge plus a flat Cell; now it makes one target Prey and pays the follow-up hit on Prey in Cells, a sequencing reward.

before.effect: 10 damage. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey; the user stores 1 Cell.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user; the user stores 1 Cell for each energy that skill cost.

history.why: Was a counter with Toxin, Sap and 2 Cells tacked on; now it absorbs the countered skill's energy, so it's best saved for the enemy's big skill.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 1 Toxin and is Sapped, and the user stores 2 Cells.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might and Immune. Each skill they use meanwhile gives them 1 more Might for as long and deals them 10 Affliction damage.

history.why: Was Fast Charge, Stormborn plus Might per Cell; now a runaway cell that grows stronger with every skill and burns its user just as fast.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user has Stormborn and 1 Might per Cell they hold.

history.why: Was Overcharge plus a Cell each turn; now held Cells become Might, so every Discharge during it costs the Rage some power.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Stormborn and stores 1 Cell at the start of each of their turns.

rows.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. It strikes again at the start of the user's next turn if they gained any Charge in between.

history.why: Paid Charge only off Prey targets; now echoes for a Lightning user who gains Charge off-turn, as Stormborn does.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, the user gains 2 Charge; if not, they gain 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Zap plus Sting's Toxin side by side; now it poisons until the target is Prey, then feeds on them for Charge.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin; the user gains 1 Charge. Costs r instead while the user has Charge.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. Discharge: 10 more per Cell; if it kills them, the Cells are stored again.

history.why: Was Particle Beam with Discharge added; now a kill refunds the Cells, so it rewards aiming at a target it can finish.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to target enemy and every Sapped enemy. Discharge: 10 more to the target per Cell.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Helpful skill, they take 15 Piercing damage and every unit it affects is Corroded for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Tesla Coil with Corroded added; now it springs on a Helpful skill and corrodes whoever that skill was shielding.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a skill, they take 15 damage, are Sapped, and are Corroded for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and their Toxin and Sapped turn into Cells, stack for stack.

history.why: Was Slither plus a Cell; now the escape also turns the user's own Toxin and Sapped into stored charge.

before.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, gains 1 Focus, and stores 1 Cell.

rows.effect: Summons a Bombardier Beetle (30 HP) permanently; enemies who damage it are Corroded for 2 turns. Acid Jet (r): 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 if they're Corroded.

history.why: Was Storm Hawk's ally Charge plus an Asp bite with Corroded for Toxin; now it's a retaliating beetle whose Acid Jet pays off its own spray.

before.effect: Summons a Bombardier Beetle (30 HP) permanently. Acid Spray (r): 5 Piercing damage and Corroded for 1 turn. Static Spark (I): target ally gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Corroded for 2 turns. Each Armor they have turns into 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Innervate plus Acid Orb's Prey rider with Corroded swapped in; now it dissolves Armor into Toxin, and Corroded stops the Armor coming back.

before.effect: 20 damage, and Saps. Prey targets are also Marked and Corroded for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Discharge: 10 more to each per Cell, and the user is Sapped once per Cell spent.

history.why: Was Static Burst with Cells added; now emptying the battery also drains the user's energy, so the dump is a timing call.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Consumes the user's Charge for 10 more each per Charge; Discharge: 5 more each per Cell.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. If they're then at or below 5 HP per Cell the user has (10 for minions), Discharge: they're executed; if not, the user stores 1 Cell.

history.why: Was Siphon Charge storing Cells instead of Charge; now it's an execute whose threshold is the Cells it burns, and a miss charges the battery instead.

before.effect: 5 damage, and Saps. The user stores 1 Cell, or 2 if the target is Prey.

rows.effect: Summons a Voltaic Wasp swarm (15 HP) for 3 turns. Arc Sting (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin to target enemy, then 5 Piercing to every other enemy with Toxin.

history.why: Was Spriggan Harasser's Sting with Sap and Corroded riders; now the shock arcs through every poisoned enemy, so spreading Toxin widens it.

before.effect: Summons a Voltaic Wasp swarm (15 HP) for 3 turns. Sting (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin; Prey targets are also Sapped and Corroded for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, and each is Corroded for 1 turn. If no enemy has Shield or Armor when a tick lands, a turn is added, once.

history.why: Was Slow Leak, a Cells channel; now a Corroded channel that lasts longer once it has stripped every enemy's protection.

before.effect: Channeled. The user stores 2 Cells. At the end of each of their turns, they spend 1 Cell for 10 Affliction to all enemies; it ends when they have none.

history.why: Was Lightningrod plus a Cell each turn; now it meters Cells out as a poison drip that lasts as long as the battery does.

before.effect: Channeled. The user has Stormborn while channeling, and stores 1 Cell at the end of each of their turns.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're Corroded; then they're Corroded for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Stun Baton's hit with Pounce's Prey check paying a Cell; now it's a two-beat shiv, the first Corroding and the next hitting double.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the target is Prey or Sapped, the user stores 1 Cell.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. The next time their Sapped reaches 3, it isn't spent, so it cuts their energy for 2 turns in a row.

history.why: Sapped Prey targets up to 3; now bends Sapped itself so its next trigger lasts two turns.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, they're also Sapped until they have 3.

history.why: Was Malectrocute with Discharge added; now Poison's Prey opens the target to a full Sap, turning the hunt into energy denial.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, +10 if the user is Charged and +10 if the target is Sapped. Discharge: 10 more per Cell.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Corroded for 2 turns; their Shield dissolves at once, dealing them 5 Affliction damage per 10 lost.

history.why: Was Live Needle, a Texture counter turning Buffs into Debuffs; now a Corroded counter that melts the enemy's Shield into damage.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and their Charge, Might and Focus turn into Sapped, Weakness and Confusion.

history.why: Was Numbing Needle with Sapped and Corroded in place of its riders; now the counter inverts the enemy's Charge, Might and Focus, stance-style.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they gain 1 Toxin, are Sapped, and are Corroded for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, and their Toxin deals its damage now as well.

history.why: Was Lacerate's Prey condition and System Shock's Sapped condition stitched together; now the shock makes their Toxin surge, paying off a poisoned target.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey or Sapped.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 2 Swiftness; at the end of each of their turns, they gain 1 Charge per enemy with Toxin.

history.why: Was Cobra Stance plus a Charge-to-Sapped twin; now it's a mobility buff that draws Charge from every poisoned enemy.

before.effect: All Armor on enemies turns into Vulnerable, and all their Charge into Sapped.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20, and the user moves up to 3 of their Cells to them as Charge.

history.why: Was Defibrillate with Cells in place of Charge; now it pours stored Cells into the ally as Charge, jump-starting their energy.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20. Discharge: 10 more healing per Cell.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and 2 Renew, and each Renew heal also gives them 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Overclock plus Viper's Crest side by side; now Poison's Renew charges the ally as it heals them.

before.effect: Target ally gains Conduit for 2 turns, and 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns, and their Sapped counts toward Prey for as long.

history.why: Was Idle Drain, a Lightning expansion that Sapped idle enemies; now a bridge where Lightning's Sapped makes the target Poison's Prey.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns. At the end of each of their turns meanwhile, they're Sapped if they have unspent energy.

history.why: Was Power Drain plus Swamp Toxins' Toxin plus Corroded; now Confusion squeezes their energy and Sapped punishes any they hoard.

before.effect: Target enemy is Sapped, gains 1 Toxin, and is Corroded for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Corroded for 2 turns. For 1 turn, allies who damage them heal 10, or 20 once they have no Shield or Armor.

history.why: Was Charged Mark, a Discharge set up for an ally's hit; now a Corroded Smite whose ally healing grows as the acid strips the target bare.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, the next ally who damages them Discharges the user's Cells into that hit: 10 more damage per Cell.

history.why: Was Apply Polarity with Corroded added; now an ally cashes the user's battery, so one character banks and another spends.

before.effect: 15 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain 1 Charge and Corrode them for 1 turn.

rows.effect: All allies heal 15. Then their HP is pooled: each ally's HP becomes the average of the team's.

history.why: Was a plain heal with a Discharge bonus; now pools the team's HP like cells in one battery, which no other Prayer does.

before.effect: All allies heal 15. Discharge: each heals 5 more per Cell.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, who catches the target's Corroded for as long as it has left. If the target had none, both are Corroded for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Arcing Lash, a Discharge Cleave; now spreads Corroded from the target to the second enemy it hits.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. Discharge: 10 more to a random enemy per Cell.

history.why: Was Arc plus Tail Lash's Prey check; now each stored Cell leaps out as its own random bolt.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and to every Marked or Prey enemy; then the target is Marked.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each skill they use that costs 3 or more energy deals them 15 Affliction damage.

history.why: Sapped everyone and fed Toxin to Sapped users (a bridge); now punishes any expensive skill, a trigger no other Shout reads.

before.effect: All enemies are Sapped. For 2 turns, each Sapped enemy who uses a skill gains 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Crackle with Corroded added; now Sapped sets up Snake Pit-style Toxin on every skill the enemy uses.

before.effect: Saps all targetable enemies; if the user has any Cells, they're also Corroded for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user gains 30 Shield for 1 turn; whatever is left of it at the end becomes Cells, 1 per 10.

history.why: Was Lightning Cage with Cells added; now unused Shield is banked as Cells, so it pays whether or not the enemy attacks.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield, +10 per Charge and +5 per Cell (not spent), and stores 1 Cell when it's hit.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, and they're Corroded for as long; the Shield they lose to it goes to the user.

history.why: Was Charged Glare, a Cells Taunt storing 1 per hit; now a Corroded Taunt whose leaking Shield feeds the tank it's forced to hit.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user meanwhile, the user stores 1 Cell.

history.why: Was Mesmerizing Glare plus Aggro Signal's Reflect; now the forced attacks charge the user's battery.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and counts as Prey for 3 turns; the first Harmful skill they use is Reflected.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor, Immune and Stormborn. When it ends, Discharge: 10 damage to all enemies per Cell.

history.why: Was EXO-Armor with Cells in place of Charge; now it charges while enemies hit it, then discharges into their whole team.

before.effect: Discharge: 1 Armor and 1 Swiftness per Cell. Then the user gains Stormborn for 3 turns.

kits.name: Magnet
kits.tagline: Lightning in iron and stone: pull what the enemy relies on toward you, and push your problems onto them.
kits.taglineHtml: Lightning in iron and stone: pull what the enemy relies on toward you, and push your problems onto them.
kits.introHtml:
• Attract: moves effects from an enemy to the user (or the ally named), stack for stack: Armor, Might, Charge, or Shield by amount.
  • Repel: moves Debuffs from an ally onto an enemy, as they are, with their remaining duration.

keywords.html: Attract: moves effects from an enemy to the user (or the ally named), stack for stack: Armor, Might, Charge, or Shield by amount.
Repel: moves Debuffs from an ally onto an enemy, as they are, with their remaining duration.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they have more Might than the user, the user Attracts Might from them until the two are even.

history.why: Was Worldfist with an Armor Attract tacked on; now it's an equalizer that pulls Might off whoever is ahead.

before.effect: 15 damage, +5 per allied minion; Attracts 1 Armor from the target.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies; the user Repels one of their own Debuffs onto each enemy hit.

history.why: Was Worldquake with a Shield Attract added; now the quake throws the user's Debuffs across the enemy team, one per enemy hit.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, Attracting 10 Shield from each. Costs 1 less per allied minion.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. Until the end of the user's next turn, any Armor, Shield, Might or Charge they gain is Attracted to the user.

history.why: Was Charged Dash stealing Charge instead of making it; now it locks on, so whatever the target gains next goes to the user.

before.effect: 10 damage; Attracts all the target's Charge and 1 Might.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, the first Harmful skill used on the user is Reflected, and the user Repels one Debuff onto its user.

history.why: Was Shale Guard with a Repel added; now like poles push the skill itself back, Reflecting it rather than countering it.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, dealing 10 Piercing damage to its user and Repelling one of the user's Debuffs onto them.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might. At the start of each of their turns, they Repel all their Debuffs onto the enemy who last damaged them.

history.why: Was Field Generator, a slow Attract of Armor or Might; now a Repel Rage that trades Immune for throwing each Debuff back at whoever hit the user last.

before.effect: For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, they Attract 1 Armor or 1 Might from a random enemy. Immune for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If there's an allied Boulder, it sheds 15 HP to add 15 damage.

history.why: Was Launch Stone plus a Sap; now the magnet strips shrapnel off a Boulder each shot, spending cover as ammunition a piece at a time.

before.effect: 15 damage. Can instead launch an allied Boulder at a random enemy for its remaining HP, Sapping them.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. The user creates a Boulder; on the following turn, it's launched at target enemy for 20 damage plus its remaining HP.

history.why: Was Tunnelmaker with a Shield Attract added; now the shell is a Boulder the enemy can shoot down to shrink the hit.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 65 damage to target enemy, after Attracting all their Shield; a turn sooner if the user consumes a Boulder.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they take 15 damage and the user Attracts all their Armor and Shield.

history.why: Was Tesla Coil with a team-wide Repel added; now the snare magnetizes the attacker, pulling their defenses onto the user.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they take 15 damage, are Sapped, and every Debuff on the user's team is Repelled onto them.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and Repels all their Debuffs onto a random enemy.
Summons a Lodestone Golem (50 HP) permanently. Magnetize (r): Attracts 1 Armor or 10 Shield from target enemy to the Golem. Iron Fist (nc): 10 damage.
20 damage to target enemy. The user first Repels up to 2 of their own Debuffs onto them, and it deals 10 more per Debuff moved.

history.why: Was Innervate's Sap and Vine Lash's damage with a Might Attract added; now the user's own Debuffs charge the bolt, cleansing them for damage.

before.effect: 25 damage, and Saps; Attracts 1 Might from the target.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. The user spends all their Charge, and each enemy is Sapped once per Charge spent.

history.why: Sapped enemies once per Armor they held; now a new Lightning outlet that turns the user's own Charge into Sapped on every enemy.

before.effect: 25 damage to all enemies, and each is Sapped once per Armor they have.

history.why: Was Verdant Burst's damage with a Shield Attract added; now Earth's Armor conducts Lightning, draining energy from the best-armored enemies.

before.effect: 25 damage to all enemies, Attracting 10 Shield from each.

rows.effect: 5 Piercing damage to every enemy and enemy minion that has Armor or Shield; the user heals 10 for each one hit.

history.why: Was Degauss, which Attracted a target's Armor, Shield and Charge without draining at all; now a drain that pulls from every armored enemy at once, strongest against tank-heavy teams.

before.effect: Attracts all Armor, Shield and Charge from target enemy.

rows.effect: Summons an Iron Filing swarm (20 HP) for 3 turns, clinging to target enemy: only skills that also hit that enemy can damage it. Grind (r): 10 Piercing damage to that enemy.

history.why: Was a Sapping swarm with a mobility lock; now a minion stuck to one enemy that can't be picked off on its own, which no other Summon does.

before.effect: Summons 2 Iron Filing swarms (15 HP) for 3 turns. Cling (r): target enemy is Sapped and can't gain mobility buffs for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to all enemies, Attracting 10 Shield from each. It ends early if an enemy damages the user.

history.why: Was Worldcaller's spawn each turn plus an Attract; now it's a drain field the enemy has to hit the user to switch off.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they Attract 1 Armor or 10 Shield from a random enemy and create a Boulder.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP; then all their Sapped is spent for 10 more damage per stack.

history.why: Was Magnetic Awl, an Attract on a kill; now a Lightning expansion that grounds the target's Sapped for burst instead of the energy cut.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If it kills them, the user Attracts all their Armor, Might, Charge and Shield.

history.why: Was Stonepierce with an Armor Attract added; now it's a finisher that loots the fallen enemy's Buffs.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets with Shield or Armor; Attracts 1 Armor.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, after the user Attracts all their Armor; 10 more per Armor taken.

history.why: Was Stone Drill plus Malectrocute's Charged bonus; now it rips the target's Armor onto the user and hits harder the more it takes.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might, and +10 if they're Charged.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they swap Armor, Might, Charge and Shield with the user.

history.why: Was Pitfall with a mass Repel added; now the counter reverses polarity, trading the user's defenses and power for theirs.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn, and all the user's Debuffs are Repelled onto them.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, and the user Attracts their Armor and Shield until it ends, when what's left goes back.

history.why: Was System Shock's Sapped extension plus a no-Shield rider; now the clamp borrows their defenses only while it holds them.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if Sapped, and can't gain Shield or Armor meanwhile.

rows.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and Stormborn; each time they reach 3 Charge, they also create a Boulder.

history.why: Was Landslide with an Attract in place of its Boulder; now Stormborn's Charge builds Boulders, so trading blows raises cover.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from this skill, they also Attract 10 Shield from a random enemy.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15 and Repels one Debuff onto a random enemy.
For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Armor, and the first Debuff put on them each turn is Repelled onto a random enemy.

history.why: Was Infuse Earth with Charge swapped in for Might; now it's a ward that bounces each turn's first Debuff back to the enemy.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Armor or 1 Charge, at random.

rows.effect: Each ally Repels one Debuff onto target enemy.
20 damage to target enemy. Until the user's next turn, every effect of the user's side that would pick a random enemy picks them instead.

history.why: Was Lodestone Pillar, an Attract set up for an ally's hit; now a lodestone that pulls every random hit on the team (minions, second hits, Blinded skills) onto one enemy.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, the next ally who damages them Attracts all their Armor, Might and Shield.

history.why: Was Apply Polarity with an Armor Attract instead of Charge; now it sets up one ally to loot the target's Buffs in a single hit.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target Attract 1 Armor from them.

rows.effect: The user Attracts every enemy's Shield and splits it evenly among their allies; then all allies heal 20.

history.why: Was Draw Out's heal-and-Repel applied to every ally; now it pools the enemy team's Shield and shares it out.

before.effect: All allies heal 20, and each Repels one Debuff onto a random enemy.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Until the user's next turn, they gain 1 Charge each time an ally takes damage.

history.why: Hit every enemy holding Armor or Charge, reading both parents' statuses; now gives a Lightning user a new way to earn Charge from hits on the team.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and to every enemy with Armor or Charge.

history.why: Was Vine Whirl plus a Sap; now it chains like Arc, but Earth's Armor and Lightning's Charge are what draw the current.

before.effect: 5 damage to all enemies, and Saps them. If there's an allied Boulder, a random one is launched.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and Sapped once for each allied Boulder.

history.why: Was Iron Call, an Attract of Might; now a bridge where Earth's Boulders set up Lightning's Sapped.

before.effect: The user Attracts 1 Might from every enemy; each who has none is Intimidated for 2 turns instead.

history.why: Was Awakener's Roar with an Attract in place of its Armor; now every enemy either loses Might to the user or is Intimidated.

before.effect: Every allied Boulder heals to full and Attracts 1 Armor from a random enemy.

rows.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, they Repel one Debuff onto each enemy who damaged them meanwhile.

history.why: Was Magnetic Rampart, an Attract of Shield or Armor from attackers; now a Repel Withstand that answers each attacker with one of the user's Debuffs.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. Each enemy who damages them meanwhile has 10 Shield or 1 Armor Attracted to the user.

history.why: Was Rampart with a Shield Attract added; now attacking the user pulls the attacker's own defenses onto them.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield, or doubles theirs, then Attracts 10 Shield from each enemy.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 2 turns, and the user's Harmful skills can target only them for as long.

history.why: Was a Taunting Boulder that Sapped its attacker (both parents side by side); now a two-way lock that pins the user and one enemy to each other.

before.effect: Creates a Boulder; target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns, and is Sapped each time they damage it.

history.why: Was Ancient Grudge with an anti-escape rider; now a Boulder holds the Taunt and drains energy from every hit it soaks.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time); while Taunted, they can't gain mobility buffs or become Untargetable.

rows.effect: The user creates a Boulder, then absorbs every allied Boulder for 1 Armor per 15 HP it had, and is Immune, for 3 turns. When it ends, the Armor falls away as one Boulder with 10 HP per stack.

history.why: Absorbed Boulders with Stormborn tacked on; now the armor crumbles back into a Boulder when it ends, recycling Earth's ammunition.

before.effect: The user creates a Boulder, then absorbs every allied Boulder for 1 Armor per 15 HP it had, for 3 turns; they're Immune and Stormborn meanwhile.

history.why: Was Treant Form with a periodic Attract added; now the user wears their Boulders as plating, trading cover for Armor.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user Attracts 1 Armor from every enemy at the start of each of their turns, and gains 1 Might per allied Boulder.

kits.name: Vengeance
kits.tagline: Holy lightning that answers every blow: hurt us, and the strike comes back harder.
kits.taglineHtml: Holy lightning that answers every blow: hurt us, and the strike comes back harder.
kits.introHtml:
• Vow (Buff): while it lasts, each time an enemy damages the bearer with a skill, the bearer gains 1 Wrath.
  • Wrath (Buff, max 3, kept until spent): the bearer's next direct damage deals 10 more per Wrath (to each target, for skills that hit several), and spending it gives 1 Charge per stack.

keywords.html: Vow (Buff): while it lasts, each time an enemy damages the bearer with a skill, the bearer gains 1 Wrath.
Wrath (Buff, max 3, kept until spent): the bearer's next direct damage deals 10 more per Wrath (to each target, for skills that hit several), and spending it gives 1 Charge per stack.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy; it doesn't spend Wrath. If they damaged the user since the user's last turn, the user gains 1 Wrath.

history.why: Was Righteous Blow's hit with a Vow tacked on; now it banks Wrath against whoever just hit the user instead of wasting it on a cheap hit.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy; the user takes a Vow for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. For 2 turns, when any enemy it hit has their Condemnation trigger, they gain two of its Debuffs instead of one.

history.why: Copied the target's Condemned and Sapped side by side; now bends Condemned so everyone it hit pays double when it triggers.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies; the target's Condemned and Sapped are copied onto each ally hit.

history.why: Was Divine Storm plus Static Slam's Charged Sap; now the blow carries the target's Holy and Lightning debuffs to the whole enemy team.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies; the user heals 5 per target hit. If the user is Charged, the allies are also Sapped.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user gains 1 Focus for their next skill, +1 per Wrath spent on this.

history.why: Was Charged Dash with a Vow added; now it turns stored Wrath into tempo, so a hit taken becomes a cheaper next skill.

before.effect: 15 damage; the user takes a Vow for 2 turns and gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user, and the user gains 1 Charge. If that fills their Charge, it's spent to Anoint them for 2 turns instead of giving energy.

history.why: Was Righteous Feedback, a counter with delayed damage that used neither parent's statuses; now a bridge where Lightning's Charge becomes Holy's Anointed.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user; at the start of the user's next turn, its user takes the damage it would have dealt.

history.why: Was Feedback Loop's counter with Wrath in place of its Charge refund; now the countered blow comes back a turn later, like Holy Nova's second strike.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user, and the user gains 2 Wrath.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user has a Vow, and their damage doesn't spend Wrath; when it ends, all their Wrath is spent for Charge.

history.why: Was Overcharge's Stormborn plus Divine Fury's Anointed plus a Vow; now every hit taken is a lasting damage bonus for the Rage.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user has a Vow, is Anointed and has Stormborn.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and Sanctified until the user's next turn; the user gains 1 Charge each time that Sanctify heals someone.

history.why: Was Zap with Wrath added to its cost discount; now Holy's Sanctify powers Lightning's Charge whenever allies hit the target.

before.effect: 15 damage; the user gains 1 Charge. Costs r instead while the user has Wrath or Charge.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy. If an ally of the user dies before then, it strikes at once instead, as 80 Piercing damage.

history.why: Was Spear of Retribution, a Snipe with +20 if the target hit the user; now a spear held for the fallen: an ally's death fires it at once, doubled.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage, +20 if the target damaged the user while it channeled.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, every ally of the user takes a Vow for 1 turn before it lands.

history.why: Was Decree with a Sap added; now the enemy's own attack arms everyone it hits with Wrath.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned for 2 turns; when it triggers, they're also Sapped.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and gains 1 Wrath each time an enemy damages one of their allies meanwhile.

history.why: Was Blink or Cloister followed by a Vow; now the user steps out of harm and takes their allies' wounds as Wrath.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, then has a Vow for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Summons a Storm Griffin (45 HP) permanently, under a Vow that never ends. Righteous Strike (W): 15 damage and Sanctify.

history.why: Was hooked Wrath though its engine is a standing Vow ('as if under a Vow'); now says so and counts as Vow.

before.effect: Summons a Storm Griffin (45 HP) permanently; it gains Wrath when damaged, as if under a Vow. Righteous Strike (W): 15 damage and Sanctify.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Marked for 1 turn. If Wrath adds to it, their non-Strategic skills are also stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Innervate plus Rebuke side by side; now spending Wrath on it adds a stun, a new payoff for Wrath.

before.effect: 20 damage, and Saps; Sanctify for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. The user's Charge triggers at 2 instead of 3 until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Holy Nova with Sapped in place of Anointed; now a rule bend that lets a Lightning user cash in Charge early.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies; Sapped ones take it again at the start of the user's next turn.

history.why: Was Holy Nova with the keyword's own Wrath bonus restated; now Lightning's Sapped decides who gets Holy Nova's second strike.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage to all enemies; the user's Wrath adds to each.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, and the user heals 10. Their Wrath is spent on healing instead of damage: 15 more per stack.

history.why: Was Siphon Charge plus Ascension; now it's the kit's release valve, turning stored Wrath into healing.

before.effect: 5 damage, and Saps. If the target is Sanctified, the user becomes Anointed and gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: Summons a Herald (20 HP) for 3 turns with a Vow; when it dies or expires, the user gains its Wrath. Denounce (r): 10 damage to target enemy.

history.why: Was Divine Blessing with a Vow in place of Anointed; now it's bait whose Wrath passes to the user when the enemy kills it.

before.effect: Summons a Herald (15 HP) for 3 turns. Swear (W): target ally takes a Vow for 2 turns; then the Herald dies.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns. The user has a Vow while channeling, and at the end of each of their turns deals 5 damage to all enemies, with Wrath adding.

history.why: Was Lightningrod plus a Wrath each turn; now whatever the enemy does to the channeler comes back on their whole team.

before.effect: Channeled. While channeling, the user has Stormborn and gains 1 Wrath at the end of each of their turns.

rows.effect: Executes target enemy at or below 25 HP. If they're above that, it deals 10 damage and the user loses 20 HP.

history.why: Was Justice Baton, a Stab that gained Wrath against healthier targets; now a pure verdict: a free execute that costs the user dearly when they misjudge.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they have more HP than the user, who then also gains 1 Wrath.

history.why: Was Piercing Light's bonus plus Stun Baton's HP check with Wrath for Charge; now it's an underdog's jab that rewards being behind.

before.effect: 15 damage, +10 if the target is Condemned or Sanctified. If the target was at or above 80 HP, the user gains 1 Wrath.

rows.effect: 45 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they use no Harmful skill on their next turn, they heal 25.

history.why: Was Crusader's Current, a self-damaging Ravage that gained Wrath; now a huge blow with mercy attached: the target can win back HP only by holding their fire.

before.effect: 35 Piercing damage to target enemy; the user takes 10 Affliction damage and gains 1 Wrath.

history.why: Was Malectrocute plus Crusade's Condemn; now it's a heavy blow the user pays for in blood, which stokes their next one.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, +10 if the user is Charged and +10 if the target is Sapped; targets above 75 HP are Condemned.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and the user deals them 15 damage at once, with Wrath adding.

history.why: Was Martyrdom with Wrath and a brief Anoint in place of its lasting one; now the counter cashes Wrath in an instant reply.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, all its targets gain 2 Wrath and are Anointed until the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and Condemned. When the Condemnation triggers, they're also Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was System Shock with Repentance's Condemned check added; now Holy's Condemned carries a delayed Lightning stun that lands after their next skill.

before.effect: 15 damage, and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Sapped or Condemned.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 2 Swiftness and a Vow; reaching 3 Wrath makes them Invulnerable for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Angel's Grace minus Invulnerable plus Stormborn and a Vow; now full Wrath briefly lifts the user out of reach.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune and Ghosted, and has Stormborn and a Vow.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20. Each time they spend Charge in the next 2 turns, they heal 10.

history.why: Turned an ally's 3 Charge into Anointed; now gives Charge spending a healing outlet, whatever spends it.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains 1 Charge; if that brings them to 3 Charge, they're also Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Defibrillate with 5 more healing; now a full Charge on the ally Anoints them, so Lightning's resource empowers Holy skills.

before.effect: Target ally heals 25, +5 per Charge the user has.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally and the user share a Vow: whenever an enemy damages either of them, both gain 1 Wrath.

history.why: Was Holy Favor with a Vow added; now two allies are bound, so hurting either one arms both.

before.effect: Target ally takes a Vow, and is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each time they deal damage, they take half of it back as Affliction damage.

history.why: Sapped and Condemned the target side by side on each hit; now a recoil curse that makes any damage they deal cost them, which no other Curse does.

before.effect: For 2 turns, whenever target enemy damages the user or an ally, they're Sapped and Condemned.

history.why: Was Mark of Heresy plus Apply Polarity; now each attack they make costs them energy and draws a Condemnation.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Sanctified until the end of the user's next turn; allies who damage them meanwhile gain 1 Charge.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Sanctified for 1 turn; an ally at full HP who damages them gains 1 Wrath instead of healing.

history.why: Was Apply Polarity with Wrath in place of Charge; now Sanctify's healing turns into Wrath for allies who don't need it.

before.effect: 15 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain 1 Wrath.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. Then every ally's Charge moves to whichever ally has the most.

history.why: Was Saving Grace's repeat paid with 3 Charge instead of Anointed; now pools the team's scattered Charge into one ally so it triggers.

before.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. If the user has 3 Charge, it's spent to repeat this at the start of their next turn.

history.why: Was Saving Grace with a Vow in place of its Shield; now a full Charge buys the repeat Saving Grace gets from Anointed, at the cost of the energy.

before.effect: All allies heal 10 and take a Vow for 1 turn. If the user is Anointed, it repeats next turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and to every Condemned enemy, or to a random other enemy if none is; each Condemned enemy hit has their Condemnation trigger now.

history.why: Was Arc plus Sanctified targets and the keyword's Wrath; now the current chains through Condemned enemies and springs their Condemnation early.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and to every Marked or Sanctified enemy; the user's Wrath adds to each.

rows.effect: Every ally takes a Vow for 2 turns; each enemy who gives one of them Wrath is Intimidated for 1 turn.

history.why: Was a bare team Vow that dropped Shout's enemy debuff; now striking any of the user's team also slows the attacker's cooldowns.

before.effect: Every ally takes a Vow for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. If it breaks, they gain 3 Wrath.

history.why: Was Lightning Cage with Wrath in place of Charge; now the enemy must choose between breaking the Shield and arming the user.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield plus 10 per Charge, and 1 Wrath each time it's hit.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, and the user has a Vow for as long; each hit from that enemy gives 2 Wrath.

history.why: Was Gleam's Taunt plus Aggro Signal's Reflect plus Wrath; now it forces the enemy to feed the user's Wrath at double rate.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn. The first Harmful skill they use on the user is Reflected, and the user gains 2 Wrath.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor, Immune and a Vow; each Wrath the Vow gives them also gives them 1 Armor until it ends.

history.why: Was a Wrath Titan that gained Armor when spending Wrath; now its Vow is the engine, so each blow taken hardens the user as it builds Wrath.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor, Immune and a Vow; each Wrath they spend also gives them 1 Armor until it ends.

history.why: Was Grand Crusader with a Vow in place of its Might; now every retaliation hardens the user further.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies. For 3 turns, the user has a Vow and gains 1 Armor per Sanctified or Condemned enemy hit.

kits.name: Reanimation
kits.tagline: Lightning in dead flesh: death is a setback, not an ending.
kits.taglineHtml: Lightning in dead flesh: death is a setback, not an ending.
kits.introHtml:
• Galvanized (Buff): if the bearer dies while Galvanized, they return at the end of that turn with 30 HP, Reanimated. Each character can be Reanimated once per match.
  • Reanimated: the unit is back for good, but can't be healed or gain Renew, and loses 5 HP at the end of each of their turns. Several skills hit harder when their user is Reanimated.

keywords.html: Galvanized (Buff): if the bearer dies while Galvanized, they return at the end of that turn with 30 HP, Reanimated. Each character can be Reanimated once per match.
Reanimated: the unit is back for good, but can't be healed or gain Renew, and loses 5 HP at the end of each of their turns. Several skills hit harder when their user is Reanimated.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. A Reanimated user deals 10 more and skips their next 5 HP loss.

history.why: Was a Galvanized Strike that cost 10 HP for 15 damage; now a Reanimated Strike that lets a returned user fight off their decay.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. If the user is Galvanized, they lose 10 HP and it deals 15 more.
