history.why: Was Witchblade's hit plus Jolt's Charge scaling and a Reanimated bonus; now a Galvanized user spends their own HP freely, since death isn't the end.

before.effect: 25 damage, +5 per Charge the user has. If the user is Reanimated, 15 more.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies; if it kills any of them, the user is Galvanized for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Static Slam plus Soulcrusher's Horrify, gated on Charge and Reanimated; now a kill buys the user a second life.

before.effect: 30 damage to target enemy. If the user is Charged, their allies take 15 and are Sapped; if Reanimated, the allies are also Horrified for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy; the user loses 10 HP and gains 3 Charge.

history.why: Was Charged Dash with a Galvanize added; now Unholy's self-harm pays for a full Lightning Charge, trading blood for next turn's energy.

before.effect: 10 damage; the user gains 1 Charge and is Galvanized for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user; if the user is Galvanized, it's spent to Reflect the skill instead.

history.why: Was Spiteful Retort with a Galvanize added; now the user can burn their second life to send the skill back.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Horrified for 2 turns, and the user is Galvanized for 2 turns.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user has Stormborn, and Charge they'd gain while at 3 becomes Soul Fragments instead.

history.why: Was Undying Fury with Stormborn added; now Stormborn's overflow Charge becomes Soul Fragments, a ramp neither parent's Rage has.

before.effect: Consumes all the user's Soul Fragments: 10 damage to a random enemy for each. Then Immortal and Stormborn for that many turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and Marked; whoever spends the Mark also drains a Soul Fragment from them.

history.why: Was Bone Shard plus Zap; now Lightning's Mark lets any ally's follow-up drain a Soul Fragment.

before.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Soul Fragment the user has; the user gains 1 Charge. Costs r instead while the user has Charge.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. Until it lands, the user is Immortal. On the following turn, 30 damage to target enemy, plus half the HP the user is missing.

history.why: Was Soul Beam, a Snipe that spent Galvanized for Piercing; now a sniper who can't die mid-channel and turns every wound taken meanwhile into beam power.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 damage to target enemy; if the user is Galvanized then, it's spent to make the hit Piercing and 25 stronger.

history.why: Was Particle Beam plus Soul Lance; now the user can cash in their second life for a far bigger shot.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 35 Piercing damage to target enemy and every Sapped enemy; each that ends below 50 HP gives the user a Soul Fragment.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they take 15 damage and suffer Reanimated's drawbacks for 2 turns: no healing, and 5 HP lost each turn.

history.why: Was Tesla Coil plus Soul Shackle's Stun; now it curses a living enemy with the undead's rot.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they take 15 damage, are Sapped, and are Stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Usable while Stunned. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and any Stun on them jumps to a random enemy for the turns it had left.

history.why: Was Immortal with Charge and Horrify side by side; now a jolt that throws off a Stun and passes it to an enemy.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn; each hit that leaves them at 5 HP gives them 1 Charge and Horrifies its user for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Grave Step with a Galvanize added; now Immortal's floor turns would-be killing blows into Charge and Horror.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn and is Galvanized for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Summons a Flesh Golem (40 HP) permanently; the first time it dies, it returns with 20 HP, Reanimated. Slam (S): 15 damage, and Saps.
20 damage to target enemy, and Marked for 1 turn. A Reanimated user deals 10 more for each turn they've been back, up to 30.

history.why: Was Fel Bolt plus a Sap and a flat Reanimated bonus; now it grows as the rot sets in, rewarding a Reanimated user who stays in the fight.

before.effect: 25 damage, Horrified for 2 turns and Sapped. If the user is Reanimated, 10 more and Horrified for 3 turns.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies, +10 for each Galvanized or Reanimated unit on the user's team.

history.why: Was Soul Blast plus Static Burst plus a Reanimated bonus; now it scales with how much of the user's team is cheating death.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, +10 per Soul Fragment the user has (+20 each if the user is Reanimated). Consumes Charge for 10 more each per Charge.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and the user heals 10, +10 if the target is Horrified. A Reanimated user gains the healing as Shield instead.

history.why: Was Drain Soul plus Siphon Charge plus a rider; now a Reanimated user, who can't be healed, drains Shield instead.

before.effect: 5 damage; drains a Soul Fragment and takes all the target's Charge. A Reanimated user doesn't lose HP at the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: Summons a Patchwork Revenant (25 HP) for 3 turns with one random skill of the last unit to die, from either side, paid from the user's energy. If no one has died, it has Gnash (r): 10 Affliction damage.

history.why: Was an Imp that Sapped on death; now a minion stitched from the fallen that borrows a dead unit's skill, which no other Summon does.

before.effect: Summons a Stitched Horror (25 HP) for 3 turns. Gnash (r): 10 Affliction damage to target enemy. When it dies or expires, every enemy takes 10 damage and is Sapped.

history.why: Was the Flesh Golem's revive trick on an Imp; now it's built to die, bursting with Lightning when it goes.

before.effect: Summons a Stitched Horror (25 HP) for 3 turns; the first time it dies, it returns with 15 HP. Claw (r): 10 Affliction damage. Shock (I): target enemy is Sapped.

rows.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns: 10 damage to all enemies at the end of each of the user's turns. The user is Galvanized while channeling, and returning doesn't end it.

history.why: Was Lightningrod plus a random ally Galvanized each turn; now the channel runs straight through the user's death.

before.effect: Channeled. While channeling, the user has Stormborn, and at the end of each of their turns a random ally is Galvanized for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If the user is at or below 40 HP, it also drains a Soul Fragment from them.

history.why: Stunned Horrified targets, the stock formula; now a user near death drains Soul Fragments, a new way into Unholy's resource.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP; if they're Horrified, their non-Strategic skills are also stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Blighted Dagger plus Stun Baton's HP check and a Reanimated bonus; now Unholy's Horrified sets up a Lightning stun.

before.effect: 15 damage, or 25 if the user is Reanimated. At or above 70 HP, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user, who gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: 35 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user is Reanimated, it executes a target it leaves at or below 25 HP.

history.why: Was Lay Waste plus Malectrocute's Charged bonus and a Reanimated bonus; now the undead user finishes anyone it brings low.

before.effect: 35 Piercing damage, +10 if the user is Charged and +15 if Reanimated. A target with Buffs is Horrified for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and each ally it targeted is Galvanized for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Mirage of Nightmares with a Galvanize in place of its Might and Swiftness; now the enemy's attempt gives its would-be victims a second life.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Strategic skill, it's countered; the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn and is Galvanized for 2.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun. While they're Stunned, each Sapped they gain counts twice.

history.why: Gave Sapped targets permanent Vulnerable; now the Stun opens a window where a Lightning user's Saps land double.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun; if they're Sapped, they also gain 1 permanent Vulnerable.

history.why: Was System Shock with Horrified added to its condition; now Lightning's Sapped sets up Cripple's permanent Vulnerable.

before.effect: 15 damage, and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Sapped or Horrified.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 2 Swiftness and Lifesteal; healing they can't receive (at full HP or while Reanimated) becomes 1 Charge per 10.

history.why: Was Three Storm Breaths plus Vampirism's Lifesteal; now wasted Lifesteal, including a Reanimated user's, turns into Charge.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Stormborn, Conduit and Lifesteal.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains 1 Charge; if that brings them to 3 Charge, they're also Galvanized for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Defibrillate with a low-HP Galvanize tacked on; now it's a defibrillator: build the ally's Charge, and a full Charge restarts their heart.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, +5 per Charge the user has. Below 30 HP, they're also Galvanized for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target ally is Galvanized for 3 turns.
Target enemy is Horrified for 2 turns. If they die before it ends, every ally of the user gains 1 Soul Fragment.

history.why: Turned Buffs that Horrify blocked into Sapped; now a Horrified death feeds Soul Fragments to the whole team.

before.effect: Target enemy is Horrified for 2 turns; each Buff it stops them gaining Saps them instead.

history.why: Was Cause Fear plus Power Drain side by side; now every Buff the Horror blocks drains their energy.

before.effect: Target enemy is Horrified until the end of the turn, and Sapped.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, allies who damage them gain 10 Shield, or 20 if they're Reanimated.

history.why: Was Soul Sickness plus Apply Polarity; now the mark feeds Shield, the one sustain Reanimated allies can still use.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain a Soul Fragment and 1 Charge.

rows.effect: Every dead ally who hasn't been Reanimated yet returns with 30 HP, Reanimated; living allies heal 15.
20 damage to target enemy and to a random other enemy; whenever it kills one, it jumps to another random enemy.

history.why: Was a Texture row that used neither parent's statuses; its kill-chaining Cleave is already a standout, so it's now counted as Unique, unchanged.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and to a random other enemy; whenever it kills one, it jumps to another random enemy.

history.why: Was Arc with Horrified added to its targets; now the current jumps on each kill, a chain of deaths.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and to every Marked or Horrified enemy; then the target is Marked.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, whenever a unit on either side dies, the user's Charge fills to 3.

history.why: Sapped enemies and Horrified the already Sapped; now any death charges the user to full, a new way to earn Charge.

before.effect: All enemies are Sapped; those already Sapped are Horrified for 2 turns instead.

history.why: Was Soulshriek plus a Sap on one enemy; now it's a team-wide wail where Lightning's Sapped sets up Unholy's Horror.

before.effect: 20 damage. If the user has a Soul Fragment, they spend it for 10 more damage, and the target is Sapped and Horrified for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn; if it breaks, they're Galvanized for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Lightning Cage plus Misery; now the Shield is the first layer and a second life the backup.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield plus 10 per Charge, and drains 5 HP from each other ally for 10 more Shield each.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, or until the user dies if they're Galvanized; when that happens, the enemy is Horrified for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Unrelenting Horror plus Aggro Signal's Reflect; now a Galvanized user baits the enemy into killing them.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns; the first Harmful skill they use on the user is Reflected. If they're Horrified, the user gains Lifesteal meanwhile.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor, Immune and Galvanized. If they return during it, they're Stormborn and gain 1 Might for the rest of the match.

history.why: Was Soul Colossus with Galvanized in place of Immortal; now dying mid-transformation brings the monster back stronger.

before.effect: Consumes all Soul Fragments to heal 5 each; then for 3 turns, 2 Armor, Stormborn, and Galvanized.

kits.name: Ion
kits.tagline: Lightning in the dark: a pulse that switches the enemy off.
kits.taglineHtml: Lightning in the dark: a pulse that switches the enemy off.
kits.introHtml:
• Suppressed (Debuff): the bearer's Buffs have no effect while it lasts; they still tick down and can still be removed.
  • Blackout (Debuff): the bearer's minions can't use skills and their ticking effects pause, and any channel the bearer holds pauses (it neither ticks nor ends). A minion with Blackout can't act.

keywords.html: Suppressed (Debuff): the bearer's Buffs have no effect while it lasts; they still tick down and can still be removed.
Blackout (Debuff): the bearer's minions can't use skills and their ticking effects pause, and any channel the bearer holds pauses (it neither ticks nor ends). A minion with Blackout can't act.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Their next skill is cut to its bare damage: its statuses, healing, summons and other effects don't happen.

history.why: Was Pulse Blade, a Suppressed hit scaling with the target's Buffs; now a Strike that switches off everything but the damage of the enemy's next skill.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, +5 per Buff they have; then they're Suppressed for 1 turn.

history.why: Was a plain hit with Suppressed tacked on; now it punishes a buffed-up target first, then switches those Buffs off.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Suppressed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Each ally passes the user their Charge; then 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, +5 to each hit per Charge passed.

history.why: Was Shadow Crash plus Static Slam's Charged Sap; now it spends the team's Charge the way Shadow Crash spends their Stealth.

before.effect: Removes Stealth from every Stealthed ally; then 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to the others, +10 to each per Stealth removed. If the user is Charged, all are Sapped.

rows.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to target enemy, who has Blackout until the user's next turn; the user gains 1 Focus.

history.why: Was Long Shadow plus a Charge; now the dash cuts the target's minions and channel for a turn.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage; the user gains 1 Charge, and their next skill is Stealthy.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Suppressed for 1 turn per Buff they have, up to 3.

history.why: Was Mirage Blade with Suppressed added; now the more buffed the attacker is, the longer their Buffs go dark.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Suppressed for 2 turns, and the user gains 1 Focus.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might, and each enemy they damage is Suppressed until the user's next turn.

history.why: Was Night of Knives plus Stormborn; now every hit the user lands keeps the victim's Buffs switched off.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and Stormborn.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, or to a Stealthed enemy instead if there is one, ending their Stealth.

history.why: Was Shadow Spine with Sapped added to its list; now Lightning finds what Shadow hides, pinging Stealthed enemies out.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, striking once more for each of Blinded, Isolated, Asleep and Sapped that the target is.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy; any Buff they gained after it was aimed is Suppressed first.

history.why: Was Dream Seeker with Suppressed added; now it punishes the target's reaction, switching off whatever they raise in time.

before.effect: On the following turn, 35 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable, and Suppressed for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time target enemy summons a minion or starts a channel, they take 15 damage and have Blackout for 3 turns.

history.why: Was Tesla Coil with Blackout added; now it waits for a summon or a channel and shuts it down at once.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they take 15 damage, are Sapped, and have Blackout for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn. Until their next turn, a Blinded enemy's skill can't land on them and goes to another target.

history.why: Spent 3 Charge for Stealth; now lets a Shadow user who Blinds the enemy slip out of their random aim.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn; if they have 3 Charge, it's spent to give them Stealth as well.

history.why: Was Shadowstep plus a Charge; now a full Charge can be traded for Stealth, energy for invisibility.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn and gains 1 Charge.

rows.effect: Summons a Shadow Drone (20 HP) permanently, Stealthed. Scramble (r, Stealthy): target enemy is Suppressed for 1 turn. Needle Arc (r): 15 Piercing damage to target enemy; it ends the Drone's Stealth.

history.why: Was Storm Hawk's attack plus a Suppress skill; now it's a hidden drone that chooses between staying unseen and striking.

before.effect: Summons a Shadow Drone (25 HP) permanently. Zap (r): 10 Piercing damage, and Saps. Scramble (r): target enemy is Suppressed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Blackout for 2 turns; 15 more if they're channeling or have a minion.

history.why: Was Blackbolt plus Innervate side by side; now it's a shutdown shot that hits hardest when there's something to shut down.

before.effect: 20 damage; Blinded for 2 turns and Sapped.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, and each is Suppressed for 1 turn, +1 per Charge the user spends on it.

history.why: Was a plain AoE with Suppressed added; now Static Burst's Charge buys a longer Suppression instead of more damage.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, and all are Suppressed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy and 10 to each of their minions, which have Blackout for 1 turn; the user heals for all the damage dealt.

history.why: Was Drink Darkness with a Blackout rider; now it feeds on the enemy's minions, draining the grid to heal.

before.effect: 5 Affliction to all enemies; Blinded ones lose Blind and take 10 more. Every enemy minion has Blackout for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Summons a Jammer (15 HP) for 3 turns; while it stands, every enemy has Blackout. Static Hiss (r): 10 damage to target enemy.

history.why: Was Call Shade with Blackout in place of Blind; now it's a fragile jamming tower the enemy must kill to restart their minions and channels.

before.effect: Summons a Jammer (15 HP) for 3 turns. Static Choke (r): target enemy takes 5 Affliction and has Blackout for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled and Stealthy, up to 3 turns: 10 damage to all enemies at the end of each of the user's turns, plus 10 for each time the user's Charge has triggered since it began.

history.why: Dealt 10 more to Sapped enemies; now grows with the user's own Charge rhythm, rewarding a Lightning user who keeps hitting 3.

before.effect: Channeled and Stealthy, up to 3 turns: 10 damage to all enemies at the end of each of the user's turns, +10 to Sapped ones.

history.why: Was Nightsong with Sapped and Blackout in place of Sleep; now it hums from Stealth, and Lightning's Sapped marks who it hits hardest.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns; if it completes, every enemy is Sapped and has Blackout for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If they're Suppressed, one of their Buffs also ends.

history.why: Was Backstab with Suppressed added to its conditions; now it trips a breaker, turning a Suppressed Buff off for good.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or the target is Blinded or Suppressed.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy; it doesn't wake a Sleeping target, and Saps them twice instead.

history.why: Was Ambush plus Malectrocute's Sapped bonus; now it hits a sleeper without waking them and drains their energy.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the user is Stealthed, and 10 more if the target is Sapped.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy or one of their minions uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and all their minions have Blackout for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Illusory Lure with Suppressed added; now the jam covers their minions too and grounds them afterwards.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Isolated for 2 turns and Suppressed for 1.

rows.effect: Target enemy falls Asleep; until they wake, they're also Suppressed and have Blackout.

history.why: Was Sap with Blackout added; now it's a full shutdown that lasts exactly as long as nobody hits them.

before.effect: 10 damage; the target falls Asleep and has Blackout for 1 turn.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Swiftness. The enemy with the most Buffs is Suppressed for 2 turns, and the user gains their Buffs' effects meanwhile.

history.why: Was Hall of Phantoms with Stormborn in place of Immune; now it switches off the most-buffed enemy and runs on their Buffs instead.

before.effect: The user gains Stealth. If they were already Stealthed, Ghosted, Stormborn and 1 Focus for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15 and falls Asleep; at the start of each of their turns while Asleep, they heal 15 and gain 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Touch of Slumber plus a Charge; now the sleep keeps recharging them, so the enemy must decide whether to wake them.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, gains 1 Charge, and falls Asleep.

rows.effect: Target ally gains Stealth. For 2 turns, Helpful skills they use don't break it.

history.why: Was Nightwrap plus Charge per Stealthy skill; now bends Stealth so a hidden support can heal and buff without showing itself.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth; each Stealthy skill they use while it lasts gives them 1 Charge.

history.why: Was Nightwrap plus Overclock side by side; now staying hidden is what charges the ally.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth, and Conduit for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns, and for as long, their skills can't target their own allies.

history.why: Destroying Invisible effects duplicated Divine's Revelation and Ocean's Whalesong; now it cuts the target off from helping their own team.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 2 turns; while they're Blinded, they're also Suppressed.

history.why: Was Blinding Powder with Blackout added; now Shadow's Blind carries Suppressed with it, so cleansing one clears both.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded and has Blackout for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and Suppressed for 1 turn; allies who damage them meanwhile gain 1 Charge per Buff they have.

history.why: Was Shadowbrand with Suppressed added; now the target's dead Buffs leak Charge to the allies who hit them.

before.effect: 10 damage, Sanctify for 2 turns, and Suppressed for 1. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20. Every enemy has Blackout for 2 turns, and allies heal 10 more for each enemy minion or channel it pauses.

history.why: Was Nightfall plus Signal Boost; now it heals more the more of the enemy's machinery it shuts off.

before.effect: All allies gain Stealth and heal 15; Charged allies heal 10 more per Charge.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to the enemy with the most Buffs, who is Suppressed for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Shadow Pulse with Suppressed on Sapped enemies; now the second hit homes in on the most-buffed enemy and switches them off.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies; Sapped ones are Suppressed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, none of them can use the skill they used most recently.

history.why: Blinded all enemies and Sapped them as they acted (both parents side by side); now jams each enemy's last skill, a denial no other Shout has.

before.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 1 turn; each skill a Blinded enemy uses Saps them.

history.why: Was Hunter's Howl with Suppressed in place of Intimidated; now Shadow's Blind costs them energy every time they flail.

before.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 2 turns; those already Blinded are Suppressed for 2 turns instead.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. While it holds, any Sapped they would gain becomes Charge instead.

history.why: Was the common Shield-survives-into-Stealth pattern; now grounds incoming Sapped and turns it into the user's Charge.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn; if any of it is left at the end, they gain Stealth.

history.why: Was Veiled Guard with a Sapped and Suppressed immunity added; now a Lightning Shield that holds lets the user slip into Stealth.

before.effect: The user gains 1 permanent Armor; with 3 or more, they also gain Stealth and can't be Sapped or Suppressed.

rows.effect: Creates a Signal Ghost (10 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns. If they destroy it, they have Blackout for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Shadow Mockery plus Aggro Signal's Reflect; now the decoy is rigged, shutting down whoever breaks it.

before.effect: Creates a Decoy (5 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn. If they damage it, that skill is Reflected.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor, and every other unit's Buffs, allies' included, are Suppressed.

history.why: Was a Suppressed core row that already had a both-sides dynamic (it switches off the user's allies' Buffs too); now counted as Unique, unchanged.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor, and every other unit's Buffs, allies' included, are Suppressed.

history.why: Was Faceless One with Suppressed added; now the user becomes a null zone where no one else's Buffs work, a trade the team must plan around.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor, and all enemies are Taunted by them and Isolated; they're also Suppressed for the first turn.

kits.name: Faerie
kits.tagline: Wind and poison: fae mischief, pixie dust, and charms that turn friends on each other.
kits.taglineHtml: Wind and poison: fae mischief, pixie dust, and charms that turn friends on each other.
kits.introHtml:
• Charmed (Debuff): the bearer's single-target skills pick their target at random from every other unit in the battle, friend or foe. A Charmed enemy's attack can land on their own ally, and their heal on yours.

One keyword: Faerie's other half is Poison's afflictions carried on Wind's speed.

keywords.html: Charmed (Debuff): the bearer's single-target skills pick their target at random from every other unit in the battle, friend or foe. A Charmed enemy's attack can land on their own ally, and their heal on yours.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 1 Toxin. If that makes them Prey, they're Charmed for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Viper Strike plus a Leaping condition; now the kiss that tips a target into Prey charms them, a threshold neither parent's Strike reads.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Toxin. If the user is Leaping, the target is also Charmed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Each one hit who has a mobility buff loses them all and is Charmed for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Spiral Crash with Charmed on its splash; now the ring traps whoever dances through it, turning the enemy's speed into their undoing.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If the user isn't Leaping, they Leap; if they are, every enemy takes 10 and is Charmed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, then the user Leaps. The first damaging skill they use afterwards doesn't end the Leap.

history.why: Was Rushing with a Toxin rider side by side; now a Wind Leap that survives one extra hit, so a Leap player gets its bonus twice.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing. For 2 turns, each enemy they damage also gains 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Launch plus Lunge's Prey clause; now Wind's speed carries Poison, so every skill the user rushes out spreads Toxin.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing; through their next turn, every enemy is Prey.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, the first single-target Harmful skill used on the user hits a random ally of its user instead; then its user is Charmed for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Zephyr Blade's bait with Charmed in place of damage; now it's a real counter that turns the attack onto the attacker's own friend.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin to target enemy. If this skill is countered, the counterer is Charmed for 2 turns.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains 1 Might. Whenever their Leap ends on a hit, the enemy it hit is marked as Prey for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Might per Prey or Immobile enemy, which either parent fed alone; now Wind's Leap sets up Poison's Prey, marking whoever the user pounces on.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains 1 Might for each enemy that is Prey or Immobile, rechecked at the start of each of their turns.

history.why: Was Viper Stance plus Launch; now a real Rage whose Might counts the quarry, with Wind's Immobile and Poison's Prey both marking the hunted.

before.effect: All Might in the battle turns into Weakness, and the user begins Rushing.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and 1 Confusion. If they already had Confusion, they're Charmed for 1 turn instead.

history.why: Was Poison's Sting with Charmed added to its random pool; now a two-step dusting: the first muddles, the second charms.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, and at random 1 Toxin, 1 Weakness, 1 Vulnerable, or Charmed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 30 Affliction damage to target enemy; if another enemy has more Toxin by then, it veers to them instead.

history.why: Was Banewood Javelin with Charmed tacked on; now the wind carries the shot to whoever is sickest when it lands.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 25 Affliction damage, and Charmed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, whenever target enemy uses a Helpful skill, they're Charmed for 1 turn first, so it picks its target at random; they also gain 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Float Noose with Toxin for damage and a late Charm; now it springs on the enemy's heals and buffs, which may land on the wrong side.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they gain 1 Toxin and are Isolated for 1 turn; the second time, they're also Charmed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user Leaps; their Leap's bonus damage is 5 per Toxin on the target it hits instead of 5.

history.why: Was Slither with a Leap for Invulnerable; now Wind's Leap is weighted by Poison, so the escape sets up a strike on the most poisoned foe.

before.effect: Unstunnable. The user Leaps and gains 1 Focus.

rows.effect: Summons a Pixie (25 HP) permanently; it's Untargetable while any enemy is Charmed. Befuddle (A): target enemy is Charmed for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey.

history.why: Was Emerald Asp's fang (and Poison's Sting name) plus an Eagle's Leap; now a trickster that hides while its mischief is working.

before.effect: Summons a Pixie (25 HP) permanently; it Leaps at the start of each of your turns. Sting (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin. Befuddle (A): target enemy is Charmed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. For 2 turns, whenever the user's Rushing grants them Swiftness and Focus, a random ally gains the same.

history.why: Turned Immobile targets into Prey; now bends Wind's Rushing so its turn-start gifts are shared with the team.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. If they're Immobile, they also count as Prey for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Compressed Bolt and Acid Orb side by side; now Wind's Immobile feeds Poison's Prey, so the slow become the hunted.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the target is Immobile or Prey, they gain 1 Vulnerable and their non-Strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 15 damage to all enemies; each is Charmed for their next skill.

history.why: Was Spiral Burst plus Acid Wash plus a random Charm; now trades Blast damage for one misfire from every enemy.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies, +10 if the user is Leaping; each gains 1 Vulnerable, and a random one is Charmed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. Then a changeling swap: the user's newest Debuff moves to them, and their newest Buff moves to the user.

history.why: Was a Toxin cash-in gated on Rushing; now a drain that trades a Debuff for a Buff, which no other Consume does.

before.effect: Target enemy takes 5 Affliction damage per Toxin on them and loses it; the user heals that much. If the user is Rushing, the Toxin stays.

history.why: Was Devour plus Sap Speed; now it drinks the target's Toxin as a drain, and Rushing lets the user sip without spilling it.

before.effect: Executes target enemy below 15 HP (doubled for minions); otherwise they lose their mobility buffs.

rows.effect: Summons 2 Sprites (10 HP) for 3 turns; an enemy who damages a Sprite is Charmed for 1 turn. Pinch (nc): 5 Piercing damage.

history.why: Was Wind Sprites with Charmed in place of Stun; now the Sprites are bait, and swatting one charms the swatter.

before.effect: Summons 2 Sprites (10 HP) for 3 turns. Pinch (nc): 5 Piercing damage; if it's countered, the counterer is Charmed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled. For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, a random enemy is Charmed for 1 turn, and every Charmed enemy takes 10 Affliction damage.

history.why: Was Vortex plus Nine Plagues' random rider; now the revel spreads Charm and hurts only those it has swept in.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, one more if the user is Leaping or Rushing when it ticks; each turn, a random enemy is Charmed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Target enemy takes 10 Piercing damage, and until the user's next turn their Toxin ticks at the end of each of their own turns as well.

history.why: Ticked Toxin now, twice if Rushing; now a Poison rule bend that makes any team's Toxin tick on the victim's turn too.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, and their Toxin ticks once now, or twice if the user is Rushing.

history.why: Was Airknife plus Pounce; now it cashes Toxin early, and Wind's Rushing doubles the payout.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, or 15 if the user is Rushing. Against Prey, you gain 1 random energy.

rows.effect: The user spends all their Swiftness, then deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 per stack spent.

history.why: Was 'Leap if Prey, else Toxin'; now a new outlet that turns Wind's stockpiled Swiftness into damage.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, the user Leaps; otherwise they gain 2 Toxin.

history.why: Was Envenom plus Rushing; now a fork: dive on Prey and escape with a Leap, or dive on the healthy and poison them.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable; Prey or Invulnerable targets gain 2 Toxin. The user begins Rushing.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus. If they don't, the fae collect: the user is Charmed for 1 turn.

history.why: Was False Friend, a counter that stole Helpful skills and used no parent status; now a cheap, fast-cycling bet on the enemy's next move that pays well but charms the user if they guess wrong.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; if they use a Helpful skill on an ally, it lands on the user instead.

history.why: Was Numbing Needle with Charmed for its debuffs; now the user poses as the enemy's friend and steals the help meant for others.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they gain 1 Toxin and are Charmed for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy falls Asleep for 3 turns. Damage doesn't wake them; instead, each hit they take cuts 1 turn from the Sleep.

history.why: Was Sleep Dust, a 1-turn Sleep that Charmed on waking; now a fairy-tale sleep that shrugs off the first blows, so the enemy team loses a unit for up to 3 turns unless it's hit repeatedly.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and they fall Asleep for 1 turn. When the Sleep ends, they're Charmed for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Lacerate with an Immobile clause; now they wake up charmed, so waking them early is a choice.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey or Immobile.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might, 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and is Charmed.

history.why: Was Cobra Stance with a Charm tacked on; now a real Dance with a fae price: big buffs, but the user's own single-target skills go wild.

before.effect: All Armor on enemies turns into Vulnerable; then a random enemy with Vulnerable is Charmed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Target unit heals 20. An ally also loses all Toxin; an enemy is Charmed for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Moonglove Mixture plus Invigorating Breeze; now each use asks whether to cleanse a friend or buy a Charm by healing a foe.

before.effect: Target unit, ally or enemy, heals 20 and gains 2 Toxin; an ally above 60 HP afterwards begins Rushing.

rows.effect: Target ally gains 2 Swiftness. For 3 turns, each Stun their Swiftness shrugs off Charms its source for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Swiftwind plus Viper's Crest; now Wind's Swiftness bites back, charming whoever tries to Stun the ally.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Swiftness, and 1 Might for 3 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Charmed for 2 turns. Each ally of theirs they damage while Charmed is Charmed for 1 turn too.

history.why: Was Swamp Toxins with Charmed for Toxin; now the Charm is contagious, spreading through the team it turns on.

before.effect: Target enemy is Charmed for 2 turns and gains 1 Confusion.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Each ally of theirs who healed or buffed them since the user's last turn is Charmed for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Feathermark plus Preymark; now it punishes the target's supporters, charming whoever just helped them.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target Leap and give them 1 Vulnerable.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and lose their Toxin; each stack removed goes to a random enemy.

history.why: Was Serpentsong plus Uplifting Verse's Leap and a Charm; now the song lifts the poison off allies and blows it onto foes.

before.effect: All allies gain 2 Renew and Leap; all enemies gain 1 Toxin, and a random one is Charmed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. The target is Charmed for 1 turn, and meanwhile their random picks can land only on their own allies.

history.why: Was Whirling Petals, a Poison texture that marked the weaker enemy as Prey; now a Charm that can only turn inward, which is deadly on an attacker but wasted on a healer, so choosing the target matters.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy; whichever of the two has less HP afterwards is marked as Prey for 2 turns.

history.why: Paid extra damage off Prey; now a new way to create Prey, reading the board instead of stacks.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy; each Prey it hits sends another 10 at a random enemy.

history.why: Was Falling Slam plus Tail Lash; now Prey keeps the petals whirling from foe to foe.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies; the cooldown resets if it hits Prey. Costs 1 less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; the first of them to use a single-target skill is Charmed for 1 turn first, so it picks at random.

history.why: Was Echoing Voice plus a Toxin-gated Charm; now a real Shout whose laughter trips the first enemy to act.

before.effect: Every ally gains 1 Swiftness; every enemy with 2 or more Toxin is Charmed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. When it's gone, each enemy who hit it is Charmed for 1 turn; if none did, the next enemy the user damages is Charmed for 1 turn.

history.why: Was a Wind texture that turned leftover Shield into a Leap; now a Charmed row that charms whoever strikes the veil, or else the user's next victim, so it Charms either way.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. If any of it is left when the turn ends, the user Leaps.

history.why: Gave Toxin to attackers, doubled if Rushing; now an untouched shield becomes a Leap, new Leap access for Wind players.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn; each enemy who damages it gains 1 Toxin, or 2 if the user is Rushing.

history.why: Was Coil plus Slipstream; now the Shield has thorns, and Rushing sharpens them.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield and 1 Armor, and 10 more Shield if they're Rushing.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Taunted by a random ally of theirs for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey, so that ally is all they can target.

history.why: Was a Texture row whose only parent tie was a Prey duration rider; the skill itself, a Taunt whose source is the target's own ally, is a unique dynamic, so it's now Unique, text unchanged.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted by a random ally of theirs for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey, so that ally is all they can target.

history.why: Was Mesmerizing Glare with Piercing Cry's Immobile extension; now the Taunt points them at their own friend.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and counts as Prey for 3 turns, or 4 if they're Immobile.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune; each enemy who uses a single-target skill on them is Charmed for 1 turn afterwards.

history.why: Was Constrictor Stance with a Charm, not a transformation; now a real Titan whose court enthralls anyone who dares to strike her.

before.effect: All Focus in the battle turns into Confusion; then every enemy with Confusion is Charmed for 1 turn.

kits.name: Nomad
kits.tagline: Wind over open ground: a wanderer who never stays in one place, and grows stronger for it.
kits.taglineHtml: Wind over open ground: a wanderer who never stays in one place, and grows stronger for it.
kits.introHtml:
• Trek (the user's, max 3): +1 at the end of each of the user's turns in which they used a different skill than on their previous turn. Repeating a skill, or using none, resets it to 0. Nomad skills list their bonus per Trek. Evolution rewards repetition; Nomad rewards variety.

One keyword: the rest is Wind's movement and Earth's stones and camp.

keywords.html: Trek (the user's, max 3): +1 at the end of each of the user's turns in which they used a different skill than on their previous turn. Repeating a skill, or using none, resets it to 0. Nomad skills list their bonus per Trek. Evolution rewards repetition; Nomad rewards variety.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user spends all their Trek for 10 more per Trek spent.

history.why: Was Worldfist's +5 per minion with Trek in its place; now it cashes the whole journey in, so the user chooses between one big blow and keeping Trek.

before.effect: 20 damage, +5 per Trek.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. At 3 Trek, each one hit is also buried: they lose their mobility buffs and are Isolated for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Worldquake's split with +5 per Trek and a Leap; now a full journey buries the enemy team, making them Immobile for Wind's payoffs.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, +5 to each per Trek; the user Leaps.

rows.effect: The user begins Rushing. If they have an allied Boulder or Seedling, they pack one up: it's removed, and they gain 2 Trek.

history.why: Was Launch with a Focus at 3 Trek; now the user can trade Earth's camp (a minion) for a head start on the road.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing; at 3 Trek, they also gain 1 Focus for their next skill.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Taunted for 1 turn by a Boulder the user creates.

history.why: Was Shale Guard with Isolated added; now the counter raises a stone decoy that soaks the attacker's next blows.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, dealing 10 Piercing damage to its user, who is Isolated for 1 turn.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune, and each time their Trek rises they gain 1 Might, which lasts until their Trek next resets.

history.why: Was Chainbreaker plus Trek set to 3; now the Rage grows only while the user keeps moving, and one repeat throws it away.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs; they're Immune for 2 turns, and Trek becomes 3.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user Leaps if no enemy has damaged them since their last turn.

history.why: Was '15 damage; against a Leaper, Bypass and end the Leap'; now new Leap access for a Wind player who stays untouched.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Against a Leaping target, it Bypasses and ends their Leap.

history.why: Was Launch Stone with +5 per Trek; now Earth's stone knocks Wind's leapers out of the air.

before.effect: 15 damage, +5 per Trek. Can instead launch an allied Boulder at a random enemy for its remaining HP.

rows.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 25 Piercing damage to the enemy team; any enemy who repeated their last skill in the meantime takes 15 more.

history.why: Was Elegant Sweep with more damage at 3 Trek (and named like the kit's suggested rename); now Trek's rule turns outward: the storm punishes enemies who stay put.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 25 Piercing damage to the enemy team, or 40 at 3 Trek.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, target enemy has Trap 15, which grows by 10 at the end of each of the user's turns in which their Trek rises.

history.why: Was Float Noose with a mobility lock; now the quicksand deepens the farther the user travels before it's sprung.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage, are Isolated for 1 turn, and can't gain mobility buffs.

rows.effect: The user Leaps. If their Trek is 0, it becomes 2.

history.why: Was Bound plus Armor, and its Trek clause never mattered on a 3-turn cooldown; now it restarts a journey broken by a Stun or a rest.

before.effect: The user Leaps and gains 1 Armor. Using this skill never resets Trek.

rows.effect: Summons a Pack Camel (50 HP) permanently; while it stands, a turn in which the user uses no skill doesn't reset their Trek. Kick (r): 15 damage.

history.why: Was Grand Eagle with Trek for allies who can't use it; now the camel carries the user through rests and Stuns without losing the road.

before.effect: Summons a Pack Camel (50 HP) permanently. Kick (r): 15 damage. Carry (A): target ally Leaps and gains 1 Trek.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. When an allied minion's hit spends the Mark, it deals 20 more instead of 10.

history.why: Armor or Shield stripped mobility buffs; now an Earth minion payoff that turns Seedlings and Boulder launches into a finisher.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. If they have Armor or Shield, they're weighed down: they lose their mobility buffs and can't gain any for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Compressed Bolt plus Isolated; now Earth's defenses become Wind's weakness, turning armored targets Immobile.

before.effect: 20 damage. Immobile targets are Isolated and have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies; each one hit loses 1 mobility buff, and the user gains 1 Trek per buff removed.

history.why: Was Spiral Burst plus +5 per Trek; now it steals the enemy's momentum and turns it into the user's journey.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, +10 if the user is Leaping, +10 if Rushing, and +5 per Trek.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. Every ally of the user heals 10 for each different skill they've used this battle, up to 30.

history.why: Its heal for the lowest-HP unit anywhere duplicated Prism's Beacon of Mercy; now a Consume that rewards allies for having used their whole kit.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy; the user heals 10 per Trek, then loses 1 Trek.

history.why: Was Worldmarch's sacrifice plus a Worldsprout-style heal, with no drain; now a real drain that pays for a rest stop with 1 Trek.

before.effect: Sacrifices all allied Seedlings and Boulders; target ally heals 15 per minion, and the user gains 1 Trek.

rows.effect: Summons a Pack Mule (25 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, it stores 1 unspent energy (max 3); when it expires, the user's player gets it all back. If killed, it's lost.

history.why: Was guards that leave Boulders; now a minion that banks unspent energy for later, an escort the enemy must choose to kill.

before.effect: Summons 2 Caravan Guards (20 HP) for 3 turns; a Guard that dies leaves a Boulder. Spear (r): 10 damage.

history.why: Was a plain base Summon with nothing from either parent; now the fallen guards become Earth's cover and ammunition.

before.effect: Summons 2 Caravan Guards (20 HP) for 3 turns. Spear (r): 10 damage.

rows.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies at the end of each of the user's turns; it continues only while their Trek keeps rising, up to 4 turns.

history.why: Was Worldcaller with Boulders and Trek; now a real Channel whose length depends on the user never repeating.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they gain 1 Trek (channeling doesn't reset it) and create a Boulder.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. Using it twice in a row doesn't reset Trek.

history.why: Was Airknife plus +5 per Trek; now it's the one filler a Nomad can repeat without breaking the journey.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 if the user is Rushing, +5 per Trek.

rows.effect: The user gives up all their mobility buffs; then 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each one given up.

history.why: Stripped Armor and Shield from Immobile targets; now a Wind trade-off that cashes the user's own speed into one hit.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Immobile, the sand scours them first: they lose all Armor and Shield.

history.why: Was Stone Drill plus Rushing; now Wind's Immobile opens Earth's defenses, stripping the stranded.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might; the user begins Rushing.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 4 turns, target enemy's Harmful skills flicker: the next one is countered, the one after lands, the one after that is countered, and so on.

history.why: Was a counter that lengthened the countered skill's cooldown and used no parent status; now a long, rhythmic counter that catches every other attack, so the enemy has to spend a cheap skill to clear it.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and that skill's cooldown grows by 2.

history.why: Was Wind Step plus Pitfall's counter plus Trek; now the false oasis pushes the enemy off their favorite skill.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Marked; the user begins Rushing and gains 1 Trek.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun that Swiftness can't ignore; they lose all Swiftness.

history.why: Was Buffet with a full Stun on the Immobile; now Earth's grit gets past Wind's Swiftness instead of reading it.

before.effect: 10 damage, and stuns their Strategic skills for 1 turn; Immobile targets are fully Stunned.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user's Trek can't reset; while it's at 3, their skills cost 1 less.

history.why: Was Top Speed plus a Trek lock; now the lock pays off at full Trek, letting the user repeat their best skill cheaply.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Ghosted, begins Rushing, and their Trek can't reset.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20, or 35 if they used a different skill than on their previous turn.

history.why: Was Invigorating Breeze plus +5 per Trek; now Trek's rule rewards the ally's own variety, so the heal works on any teammate.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15, +5 per Trek; above 60 HP afterwards, they begin Rushing.

rows.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might for 3 turns. Each time they use a mobility skill meanwhile, the user creates a Boulder.

history.why: Gave Earth's Might and Armor while Rushing; now each move a mobile ally makes gives an Earth player a Boulder.

before.effect: Target ally begins Rushing, and has 1 Might and 1 Armor for as long as their Rushing lasts.

history.why: Was Infuse Earth with Swiftness for Might; now Earth's gifts ride on Wind's Rushing and last as long as the ally keeps moving.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Swiftness or 1 Armor, at random.

rows.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns. If the user has an allied Boulder, they crumble it into the wind and vault off it: the target gains 1 more Confusion, and the user Leaps.

history.why: Was a denial Curse blocking Armor, Shield and mobility buffs side by side; now Earth's Boulder is spent to launch Wind's Leap and thicken the Confusion.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion; for 2 turns, they can't gain Armor, Shield or mobility buffs.

history.why: Was Headwind plus Worldmute on a second target; now a curse of no shelter, denying both Earth's cover and Wind's escape.

before.effect: Target enemy loses all mobility buffs and gains 1 Weakness, plus 1 more per Might that target ally has.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Until the user's Trek next resets, allies who damage them heal 10.

history.why: Was Feathermark plus 1 Trek; now the mark lasts as long as the journey does.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target Leap, and the user gains 1 Trek.

rows.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield. The user makes camp: their Trek resets, and allies heal 10 more per Trek it had.

history.why: Was Uplifting Verse with Trek set to 3; now it's the other way round: the user spends the journey on the team.

before.effect: All allies heal 20 and Leap; the user's Trek becomes 3.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Costs 1 less while the user has no Trek.

history.why: Was Falling Slam plus +5 per Trek; now it's the cheap way to restart after a reset, not a bigger version.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, +5 per Trek. Costs 1 less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and the user creates a Boulder. Each time an enemy damages that Boulder, they're Intimidated for 1 more turn.

history.why: Made Boulders from Immobile enemies; now an Earth Boulder used as bait that punishes whoever shoots at it.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and the user creates a Boulder for each enemy that is Immobile.

history.why: Was Echoing Voice plus Awakener's Roar; now a real Shout that turns Wind's stranded enemies into Earth's stones.

before.effect: Every unit in the battle gains 1 Swiftness, and allied Boulders gain 1 Armor.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. If nothing hits it, every ally heals 15 at the start of the user's next turn.

history.why: Was a Shield that stripped attackers' mobility buffs; now an undisturbed camp heals the whole team, a new 'no damage' trigger.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn; each enemy who damages it loses their mobility buffs.

history.why: Was Slipstream plus +5 per Trek; now the wall grounds whoever hits it.

before.effect: The user gains 15 Shield, +15 if Rushing and +5 per Trek.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns; each time they damage the user during it, the user's Trek rises by 1.

history.why: Was Piercing Cry plus Isolated; now the challenger turns the blows they draw into progress on the road.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn, or 3 if they're Immobile, and Isolates them for 1 turn.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune and their Trek is frozen, but they're Immobile: they lose their mobility buffs and can't gain any.

history.why: Was Djinnform plus Armor per Trek; now the wanderer stops to become a giant, holding their Trek but giving up Wind's speed.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 15 Shield, Immune, and 1 Armor per Trek (checked each turn); then they Leap.

kits.name: Angel
kits.tagline: Holy wings: a guardian that takes the blows meant for others and pulls the fallen back from the edge.
kits.taglineHtml: Holy wings: a guardian that takes the blows meant for others and pulls the fallen back from the edge.
kits.introHtml:
• Guardian: an ally Guarded by an Angel (a Buff) has the first Harmful skill aimed at them each turn redirected to that Angel, if the Angel can be targeted.
  • Halo (Buff): the first time the bearer would die, they heal to 25 HP instead, and the Halo is spent. It lasts until spent unless the skill gives it a duration.

keywords.html: Guardian: an ally Guarded by an Angel (a Buff) has the first Harmful skill aimed at them each turn redirected to that Angel, if the Angel can be targeted.
Halo (Buff): the first time the bearer would die, they heal to 25 HP instead, and the Halo is spent. It lasts until spent unless the skill gives it a duration.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, the user Guards the ally that enemy last targeted.

history.why: Was Righteous Blow plus a Leaping bonus; now it strikes the attacker and covers their victim, a question neither parent's Strike asks.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +10 if the user is Anointed. If the user is Leaping, 10 more and they heal 10.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. For each unit it kills, a random ally gains a Halo.

history.why: Was Divine Storm plus Spiral Crash's Leaping splash; now each life it takes, minions included, guards one of the user's.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies; the user heals 5 per target hit. If they're Leaping, every enemy takes 10 more.

rows.effect: The user begins Rushing and Guards target ally for 1 turn; the first hit redirected this way deals them half damage.

history.why: Was Launch with a random Guard tacked on; now a chosen, cushioned Guard, so the Angel can dive in front of a big hit.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing and Guards a random ally for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, the user Guards every ally and counters the first Harmful skill aimed at the user or redirected to them.

history.why: Only reached allies Guarded by another skill; now it sets up its own Guard, so one counter covers the whole team.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user or on an ally they Guard.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, Immune and a Halo. If the Halo saves them, they gain 2 Might and the Rage lasts 2 turns longer.

history.why: Was Chainbreaker with a Halo added; now a real Rage that comes back stronger from the brink.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs; Immune for 2 turns, and a Halo.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Until the user's next turn, a Sanctify on them heals the damager's whole team, not just the damager.

history.why: Was 'Leap if Sanctified'; now a Holy rule bend that turns one Sanctify into a team heal.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they're Sanctified, the user Leaps.

history.why: Was Air Bullet plus Sunbeam; now Holy's Sanctify lifts the user into Wind's Leap.

before.effect: 15 damage; if the user is Leaping, 5 more and they Leap again. Consumes the user's Anointed to heal them 15.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, +10 for each hit redirected to the user meanwhile; until it lands, the user Guards every ally.

history.why: Was Spear of Light with a Leaping bonus; now the spear grows with every blow the Angel takes for others.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 50 damage, or 65 if the user is Leaping when it lands.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy would kill an ally of the user, that ally gains a Halo first, and the enemy is Condemned for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Decree plus Float Noose's Isolated; now a hidden guardian that cheats one enemy of a kill.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned for 2 turns, and Isolated for 1 turn each time they use a skill.

rows.effect: The user Leaps. If they're below 40 HP, they also gain a Halo for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Bound plus Cloister with a Halo in place of Invulnerable; now the Halo is a last-ditch escape that only a wounded Angel earns.

before.effect: The user Leaps and gains Immune for 1 turn; if they're Anointed, a Halo too.

rows.effect: Summons a Cherub (35 HP) permanently. Shelter (W): the Cherub Guards target ally for 1 turn. Holy Arrow (r): 15 damage and Sanctify.
25 damage to target enemy and Mark for 1 turn. The last unit they used a skill on, from either side, heals 25.

history.why: Was a Bolt that redirected the target's next attack, a bland repeat of Guardian; now it heals whoever the enemy last touched, their victim or their own ally, so reading the enemy's last move decides the target.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. Until then, the first Harmful skill they aim at an ally is redirected to the user.

history.why: Was Rebuke plus Compressed Bolt's Immobile clause; now the Angel guards everyone against one chosen enemy.

before.effect: 20 damage and Sanctify for 1 turn; Immobile targets also have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 Piercing damage to all enemies. For 2 turns, their Condemnations don't end when they trigger.

history.why: Condemned enemies that were Leaping or Invulnerable; now lets a Holy player's Condemns fire on every skill for 2 turns.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage to all enemies, Bypassing Invulnerable; each one who was Leaping or Invulnerable loses it and is Condemned.

history.why: Was Spiral Burst plus Holy Nova's repeat; now Holy light finds whoever uses Wind's tricks to hide.

before.effect: 15 Piercing damage to all enemies, +10 if the user is Leaping and +10 if Rushing. If they're Anointed, it strikes again next turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it; the user also steals their Swiftness, healing 10 per stack.

history.why: Was Ascension with a Halo in place of Anointed; now it drains Wind's speed from the enemy as Holy healing.

before.effect: 5 damage. If the target is Sanctified, a random ally gains a Halo.

rows.effect: Summons 2 Lesser Angels (10 HP) for 3 turns. The first time an ally would die, a Lesser Angel dies in their place and they heal to 25. Soothe (r): target ally heals 10.

history.why: Its Sprites Guarded just as the Cherub does; now the Lesser Angels are living Halos that give themselves up for the team.

before.effect: Summons 2 Guardian Sprites (10 HP) for 3 turns; at the start of each of your turns, each Guards a random ally.

rows.effect: Channeled. For 3 turns, the user Guards the ally with the least HP, and at the end of each of their turns, every enemy whose hit was redirected to them takes 15 damage.

history.why: Was Consecration with a Guard tacked on; now a watch that punishes whoever tries to finish off the weakest ally.

before.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns, a random enemy without Sanctify takes 10 damage and is Sanctified; meanwhile the user Guards the ally with the least HP.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. An Anointed user trades it for a dive: they spend Anointed to Leap before the hit, so its bonus applies and they stay Invulnerable for 1 turn.

history.why: Was a Stab that punished enemies who used a mobility skill; now Holy's Anointed is spent to launch Wind's Leap, turning a blessing into a strike and an escape.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they used a mobility skill since the user's last turn.

history.why: Was Piercing Light plus Airknife; now Holy judgment falls on anyone who used Wind's tricks to dodge.

before.effect: 10 damage, +10 if the target is Condemned or Sanctified or the user is Rushing.

rows.effect: The user Leaps. At the start of their next turn, they dive onto target enemy for 30 Piercing damage, with the Leap's bonus.

history.why: Was +15 if Condemned and a Leap if Anointed; now a Wind sequencing hit: rise out of reach, then strike.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 if they're Condemned. If the user is Anointed, they spend it to Leap afterwards.

history.why: Was Crusade plus Rushing; now Holy's Anointed buys a Wind escape after the dive.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage; targets above 75 HP are Condemned. The user begins Rushing.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's redirected to the user, who gains a Halo first.

history.why: Was Martyrdom's Anointing with a redirect; now the martyr takes the blow and is saved by a Halo.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's redirected to the user, and its original targets are Anointed.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn. The first ally to damage them before it ends heals 15 and is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Condemned, stunning only Immobile targets; now a real Stun that hands Anointed to whichever ally follows up.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and they're Condemned; if they're Immobile, they're also Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Repentance plus Buffet's fallback; now it Condemns first, and Wind's Immobile decides whether the light also Stuns.

before.effect: A Condemned target is Stunned for 1 turn; any other target has their Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 2 Swiftness. Whenever an ally would be Stunned meanwhile, the user spends 1 Swiftness to shrug it off for them.

history.why: Made the user Anointed while Rushing; now the user's Swiftness protects the whole team from Stuns.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 2 Swiftness and begins Rushing; while they're Rushing, they're Anointed.

history.why: Was Angel's Grace plus a Halo; now a real Dance where Wind's Rushing keeps Holy's Anointed alive.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Invulnerable, Immune and Ghosted; they also gain a Halo.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains a Halo for 2 turns; if it's unspent when it fades, they heal 20 more.

history.why: Was Hand of Light with a Halo tacked on; now the Halo pays off either way: it saves them, or heals them later.

before.effect: Target ally heals 40 and gains a Halo.

rows.effect: The user Guards target ally for 2 turns; the ally gains 1 Swiftness.
Target enemy loses their mobility buffs; for 2 turns, each mobility buff they would gain Condemns them instead.

history.why: Was Headwind plus Mark of Heresy; now Wind's speed turns into Holy punishment for as long as the curse lasts.

before.effect: Target enemy loses their mobility buffs and is Condemned and Sanctified until the end of the user's next turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, allies who damage them are Guarded by the user for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Feathermark plus Karmic Marking; now the Angel shields whoever joins the attack.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target Leap; if the user is Anointed, the target is Sanctified for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Every living unit on the field, allies and enemies alike, gains 3 Renew, and 2 Armor for 3 turns.

history.why: Was Uplifting Hymn, a team heal that Guarded wounded allies; now the designer's cheap Prayer that blesses everyone, so it's a board-shaping call on when a slower, sturdier fight favors the user's side.

before.effect: All allies heal 20; for 1 turn, the user Guards each ally still below 50 HP.

history.why: Was Uplifting Verse with a Halo on the weakest; now it heals, then protects whoever the heal couldn't lift.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and Leap; the ally with the least HP gains a Halo.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. The downdraft lifts the ally with the least HP: they Leap.

history.why: Gave Swiftness for Sanctified hits; now new Leap access that shields the weakest ally with a Leap's Invulnerability.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy; for each Sanctified one hit, every ally gains 1 Swiftness.

history.why: Was Guardian Strike with a Guard in place of its heal; now Holy's Sanctify becomes Wind's speed for the team.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and a random other enemy; the user Guards the ally with the least HP for 1 turn.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and every ally below 30 HP gains a Halo for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Echoing Voice plus Excoriate; now a real Shout whose call pulls the dying back.

before.effect: Every ally gains 1 Swiftness; every Sanctified enemy is Condemned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield and Guards every ally for 1 turn; any Shield left at the end of the turn is split among the allies.

history.why: Was Slipstream with a Guard tacked on; now what the wings don't spend blocking is shared out.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield (35 if Rushing) and Guards every ally for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns; the user has a Halo while the Taunt lasts.

history.why: Was Piercing Cry plus Gleam; now the challenger can't be killed by the enemy they called out.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted for 1 turn (3 if they're Immobile) and Condemned.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and their single-target Helpful skills affect every ally at once. Meanwhile, they can't use Harmful skills.

history.why: Was Archangel, a Guardian Titan that grew Armor from redirected hits; now a transformation that turns every single-target heal and Buff into a team-wide one, at the cost of all offense.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune and Guards every ally; each hit redirected to them gives them 1 more Armor, up to 5.

history.why: Was Djinnform plus a Guard, a Halo and a Leap; now the Archangel hardens with every blow it takes for others.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 15 Shield and Immune and Guards every ally; they also gain a Halo, then Leap.

kits.name: Ghost
kits.tagline: Unholy on the wind: hard to touch, and haunting whoever it pleases.
kits.taglineHtml: Unholy on the wind: hard to touch, and haunting whoever it pleases.
kits.introHtml:
• Spectral (Buff): the bearer takes no Normal damage; Piercing and Affliction still hurt.
  • Haunt (Debuff, carries its own duration): at the end of its applier's turn, the bearer takes 10 Affliction, then the Haunt drifts to a random ally of theirs (it stays if they have none).

keywords.html: Spectral (Buff): the bearer takes no Normal damage; Piercing and Affliction still hurt.
Haunt (Debuff, carries its own duration): at the end of its applier's turn, the bearer takes 10 Affliction, then the Haunt drifts to a random ally of theirs (it stays if they have none).

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and Haunted for 1 turn. A Haunt already on them ticks now and doesn't drift this turn.

history.why: Was Witchblade with a Haunt tacked on its Horrified branch; now the second cut pins the Haunt in place and cashes it early.

before.effect: 25 damage. A Horrified target takes 10 more and is Haunted for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, and the target is Haunted for 2 turns. If they already were, the Haunt splits: a second one lands on a random ally of theirs.

history.why: Was Spiral Crash with Horrify on its splash; now repeated crashes multiply the Haunts in the enemy team.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If the user isn't Leaping, they Leap; if they are, every enemy takes 10 and is Horrified for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user is Spectral until they next use a skill, and that skill Bypasses.

history.why: Was Launch with Spectral tacked on; now the ghost phases in, safe until it strikes straight through Invulnerable and Isolated.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing and is Spectral for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, the user is Spectral, and the first Normal damage that passes through them hits its source instead, as Affliction.

history.why: Was Zephyr Blade's bait with Haunt and Horrify for damage; now a real counter where the blow passes through the ghost and turns back.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage to target enemy. If this skill is countered, the counterer is Haunted for 3 turns and Horrified for 2.

rows.effect: Usable while Stunned. For 3 turns, the user is Immortal, and each Debuff they would gain becomes 1 Might instead.

history.why: Was Chainbreaker plus Spectral and Immortal; now Wind's shrugging off Debuffs feeds an Unholy fury that refuses to die.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs; for 2 turns, they're Immune, Spectral and Immortal.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, whenever one of their allies takes direct damage, they take 5 Affliction damage too.

history.why: Gummed up a mobility buff for a Soul Fragment; now links the target to their team's pain, so every hit on any enemy also reaches them.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. If they have a mobility buff, it's gummed up: they lose it, and the user gains a Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Bone Shard plus Air Bullet's Leap; now Wind's speed on the target becomes Unholy's soul for the user.

before.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Soul Fragment the user has. If the user is Leaping, 5 more and they Leap again.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. The user is Spectral until it lands; on the following turn, 35 Piercing damage to target enemy.

history.why: Was Elegant Sweep with a random Haunt; now the ghost is hard to touch while it tolls, so the channel is safe to hold.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 25 Piercing damage to the enemy team, and a random enemy is Haunted for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy gains a Buff, it's removed, and they're Haunted for 3 turns.

history.why: Was Float Noose with a Haunt on first use; now it springs on the enemy's buffs, an Unholy denial neither parent's Trap reads.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage and are Isolated for 1 turn; the first time, they're also Haunted for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user becomes Spectral for 2 turns; it ends early if they deal damage.

history.why: Was Grave Step with Spectral added; now a longer but softer escape that asks whether to stay safe or strike.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal and Spectral for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Summons a Poltergeist (30 HP, always Spectral) permanently. Rattle (S): 10 Affliction damage, and Haunted for 2 turns.
20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. Whoever spends the Mark drains a Soul Fragment from them.

history.why: Was Horrify plus mobility-buff denial side by side; now new Soul Fragment access for any ally who follows up.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Horrified for 2 turns; they lose their mobility buffs and, being Horrified, can't regain them.

history.why: Was Fel Bolt plus Compressed Bolt's Immobile clause; now Unholy's Horrify locks out Wind's buffs, leaving the target Immobile.

before.effect: 20 damage and Horrified for 2 turns; Immobile targets also have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, +10 for each character on either side who has died this battle (max +40).

history.why: Was a Blast that Haunted Horrified enemies; now the dead of both sides fuel the storm, a Blast that starts modest and becomes the strongest in the game as the battle turns bloody.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies; each one who is Horrified is also Haunted for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Soul Blast with a random Haunt; now Unholy's Horrify decides who the spirits follow.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, +10 per Soul Fragment the user has; a random enemy is Haunted for 3 turns.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, and they're Haunted for 2 turns; that Haunt's damage heals the user wherever it drifts.

history.why: Was Drain Soul plus Sap Speed; now a drain that keeps feeding the user as it wanders the enemy team.

before.effect: 5 damage, and drains a Soul Fragment; removes the target's mobility buffs, and the user gains 1 Swiftness per buff.

rows.effect: Summons 2 Wraiths (10 HP) for 3 turns; when a Wraith dies, its killer is Haunted for 2 turns. Cold Grasp (nc): 5 Affliction damage.

history.why: Was Wind Sprites made Spectral with a Haunt, like the Poltergeist; now killing a Wraith lets it haunt you.

before.effect: Summons 2 Wraiths (10 HP, always Spectral) for 3 turns. Moan (nc): target enemy is Haunted for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns. A random enemy is Haunted for 3 turns, and each time that Haunt drifts, the user gains a Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Vortex with a random Haunt each turn; now the wandering spirit harvests souls for Unholy.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, one more if the user is Leaping or Rushing when it ticks; each turn, a random enemy is Haunted for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. It ignores Taunt, and it can target Stealthed or Untargetable enemies.

history.why: Was Affliction plus a drain against Immobile targets; now a cheap knife that reaches enemies no other skill can target.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. If they're Immobile, it's Affliction damage and drains a Soul Fragment.
