history.why: Was Airknife with Spectral beside Rushing; now Wind's Immobile opens the target to an Unholy soul-drain.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 if the user is Rushing or Spectral.

rows.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, a Horrify on them also stops them from being healed.

history.why: Healed the user if Leaping or Rushing; now an Unholy rule bend that stretches Horrified from blocking Buffs to blocking healing.

before.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy; if the user is Leaping or Rushing, they heal for the damage dealt.

history.why: Was Lay Waste plus Rushing; now Wind's speed turns the rending into Unholy lifesteal.

before.effect: 35 Piercing damage; a target with Buffs is Horrified for 1 turn. The user begins Rushing.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, all its targets are Spectral against it, so its Normal damage passes through them; its user is then Horrified for 2 turns.

history.why: Was a Haunt counter with Horrify; now a Spectral ward that lets an attack pass through every target it aimed at, even a multi-target one, though its other effects still land.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Horrified and Haunted for 2 turns, and this Haunt doesn't drift.

history.why: Was Mirage of Nightmares with a Haunt for its buffs; now a counter whose nightmare clings to one enemy.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Strategic skill, it's countered and they're Haunted for 3 turns; the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn and Haunted for 2 turns; the first ally of theirs it drifts to is Stunned for 1 turn too.

history.why: Was Buffet with Horrified in place of Immobile; now the fear drifts with the Haunt and freezes a second enemy.

before.effect: 10 damage, and stuns their Strategic skills for 1 turn; Horrified targets are fully Stunned.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Spectral and gains 1 Might and 2 Swiftness, but can't be healed.

history.why: Was Grisly Spectacle with Haunts extended; now a real Dance that trades healing for a ghost's body.

before.effect: 15 Piercing damage; every Haunt and Horrify on enemies lasts 1 turn longer. The user gains 1 Confusion for 1 turn (stacking).

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15, +10 per Soul Fragment the user spends, up to 2; with 2 spent, the ally also Leaps.

history.why: Was Consume Lesser word for word; now a real Heal that pours Unholy souls into an ally and lifts them on the wind.

before.effect: Deals 15 damage to another ally; the user heals 20.

rows.effect: Target ally is Spectral for 2 turns; each Normal hit that passes through them gives the user a Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Vampirism with Spectral in place of Lifesteal; now wasted blows on the ally feed the user's souls.

before.effect: Target ally is Spectral for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Haunted for 3 turns; each ally it drifts to is Horrified for 1 turn as it arrives.

history.why: Was Cause Fear with a Haunt tacked on; now the Haunt spreads Horrify through the team as it wanders.

before.effect: Target enemy is Horrified until the end of the turn, and Haunted for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and they're Horrified for 1 turn. Each Buff the Horror stops them from gaining goes to the user as 1 Swiftness instead.

history.why: Was Spectral Mark, where allies stole Buffs, with no parent status; now Unholy's Horrified feeds Wind's Swiftness, turning every blocked Buff into speed.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, allies who damage them steal one of their Buffs.

history.why: Was Soul Sickness plus Feathermark; now allies rob the marked target, Unholy's buff denial turned into theft.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain a Soul Fragment and Leap.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20. For 2 turns, each ally's Swiftness also shrugs off a Taunt, spending 1 stack.

history.why: Gave Soul Fragments to Leaping or Rushing allies; now a Wind rule bend that lets Swiftness break Taunts as well as Stuns.

before.effect: All allies heal 20; each one who is Leaping or Rushing also gains a Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Profane Chant with a random Haunt, and it didn't heal; now a real Prayer where Wind's speed earns Unholy souls.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies and 2 Weakness for 1 turn; a random enemy is Haunted for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy; whichever of them has more HP is Isolated for 1 turn.

history.why: Leapt if either was Horrified; now Wind's Isolation cuts the healthier enemy off from their allies' help.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy; if either is Horrified, the user Leaps.

history.why: Was Falling Slam with a Horrified bonus; now Unholy's fear lifts the ghost into a Wind Leap.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, 10 more to Horrified ones. Costs 1 less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. The wail carries the user's side along: for as long, their Rushing doesn't end after a turn in which they used no skill.

history.why: Was a bland Haunt Shout, Intimidated and Haunted for 1 turn; now a Wind rule bend that lets Rushing allies hold still and save energy without losing their speed.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated and Haunted for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Soulshriek with Haunt for Horrify, and single-target; now a real Shout that looses a Haunt on every enemy at once.

before.effect: 20 damage. If the user has a Soul Fragment, they spend it for 10 more damage and Haunt the target for 3 turns.

rows.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn; when it breaks, they become Spectral for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Slipstream with Spectral tacked on; now two layers: the Shield takes Piercing, then the ghost shrugs off the Normal hits that follow.

before.effect: The user gains 15 Shield (30 if Rushing) and is Spectral for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns; while Taunted, their Normal damage can't hurt the user.

history.why: Was Unrelenting Horror with a Haunt tacked on; now the spirit calls an enemy whose blows pass straight through it.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns and Haunts them (it drifts as usual). If they're Horrified, the user also gains Lifesteal for that time.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune. The first time they would die meanwhile, they vanish instead and return at the start of their next turn with 30 HP.

history.why: Its duel duplicated Magnet's Opposite Poles and Dimension's Pocket Arena; now a Titan that cheats death once.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune. A random enemy is Haunted for 3 turns, and the user's Haunts deal 20 instead of 10 while it lasts.

history.why: Was Djinnform with Spectral in place of Shield; now the revenant turns every Haunt it has loosed twice as cruel.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Spectral and Immune and gains 15 Shield; then they Leap.

kits.name: Ninja
kits.tagline: Wind and shadow: too quick to see, and never alone.
kits.taglineHtml: Wind and shadow: too quick to see, and never alone.
kits.introHtml:
• Shadow Clones (minions, 5 HP, no skills, max 3; they last until hit): each time the Ninja uses a Harmful skill on an enemy, every Clone also deals that target 5 Piercing (Flurry). Multi-target skills Flurry each target they hit. The first single-target enemy skill aimed at the Ninja each turn hits a Clone instead, destroying it (Substitution).

One keyword with two rules: the Clones are both the damage and the defense. The rest is Wind's speed and Shadow's stealth.

keywords.html: Shadow Clones (minions, 5 HP, no skills, max 3; they last until hit): each time the Ninja uses a Harmful skill on an enemy, every Clone also deals that target 5 Piercing (Flurry). Multi-target skills Flurry each target they hit. The first single-target enemy skill aimed at the Ninja each turn hits a Clone instead, destroying it (Substitution).

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy; the user creates a Clone if they have none.
20 damage to target enemy and 10 to the others. If the user has 3 Clones, they're thrown: each is destroyed and deals 10 to a random enemy; otherwise the user creates a Clone.

history.why: Was Shadow Crash's per-Stealth bonus with Clones in its place; now it builds a Clone each use until it can throw all three.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to the others, +5 to each per Clone.

rows.effect: The user begins Rushing and creates a Clone; until their next turn, every single-target skill aimed at them hits a Clone instead, while Clones last.

history.why: Was Launch plus Long Shadow plus a Clone; now every Clone becomes a decoy for a turn, not just the first.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing and creates a Clone; their next skill is Stealthy.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; the user creates a Clone, then every Clone strikes its user for 10 Piercing.

history.why: Was Mirage Blade with 2 Clones tacked on; now the Clones answer the counter together.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; the user creates 2 Clones and gains 1 Focus.

rows.effect: The user creates 2 Clones. For 3 turns, they're Immune and gain 1 Might whenever one of their Clones is destroyed.

history.why: Was Night of Knives plus a Clone each turn; now every decoy that falls makes the user stronger.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness, and creates a Clone at the start of each of their turns.

rows.effect: Three separate hits of 5 damage to target enemy. Everything that adds to or cuts a hit, like Might, Vulnerable or Armor, applies to each.

history.why: Was a Clone-making Shot; now a three-star volley whose worth depends on the board, tripling Might and Vulnerable but crumbling against Armor.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. The user creates a Clone if they have none, or if one Substituted for them since their last turn.

history.why: Was Air Bullet word for word; now it's how the user replaces the decoy they just lost.

before.effect: 10 damage; if the user is Leaping, 5 more and they Leap again.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, target enemy loses half their current HP as Affliction damage.

history.why: Was Kunai Rain, a Clone-count team hit; now a Snipe that cuts a healthy tank in half but does little to a wounded target, the reverse of an Execute.

before.effect: Channeled. The user creates Clones until they have 3; on the following turn, 25 Piercing damage to the enemy team, twice if all 3 are still standing.

history.why: Was Elegant Sweep plus per-Clone damage; now the enemy must break the Clones during the channel or take the rain twice.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 25 Piercing damage to the enemy team, +5 to each per Clone.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, whenever target enemy gains a Buff, they take 10 Piercing damage and the Buff lasts 1 turn less.

history.why: Punished mobility with Sleep; now a Trap that watches Buffs instead of skills, wearing down every Buff the target gains.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a mobility skill or gains a mobility buff, they take 20 Piercing damage and fall Asleep.

history.why: Was Float Noose with Blinded in place of Isolated; now it punishes Wind's movement with Shadow's Sleep.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage and are Blinded for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user destroys a Clone, if they have one, to gain Stealth; otherwise they become Invulnerable for 1 turn and create a Clone.

history.why: Was Shadowstep plus 2 Clones; now a Clone is spent to vanish, and with none left it makes one.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn and creates 2 Clones.

rows.effect: Summons a Ninken (30 HP) permanently. Snap (r): 10 Piercing damage. Track (r): target enemy loses Stealth and can't regain it for 1 turn.

history.why: Kept as it was; its minion skill is renamed from Bite, which Blood's Vampire Bat also uses.

before.effect: Summons a Ninken (30 HP) permanently. Bite (r): 10 Piercing damage. Track (r): target enemy loses Stealth and can't regain it for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. Until the Mark is spent, they can't gain mobility buffs, and their Swiftness doesn't stop Stuns.

history.why: Made Blinded targets count as Immobile; now pins them in place, feeding Wind's anti-mobility play without any Shadow status.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Blinded for 2 turns, during which they count as Immobile.

history.why: Was Blackbolt plus Compressed Bolt's Immobile clause; now Shadow's Blind turns on Wind's payoffs against the Immobile.

before.effect: 20 damage and Blinded for 2 turns; Immobile targets also have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. If the user has no Clones, they create 3 first.

history.why: Was Wave of Darkness plus per-Clone damage; now it rebuilds a spent army before the blades fall, so they join the Flurry.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Confusion for 1 turn to all enemies, +5 to each per Clone.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it; then the user absorbs their Clones, healing 10 per Clone, or creates one if they have none.

history.why: Was Drink Darkness with a Clone per Blind; now the user reabsorbs their shadows as healing, or leaves one to absorb next time.

before.effect: 5 Affliction to all enemies; Blinded ones lose Blind and take 10 more. The user creates a Clone per Blind removed.

rows.effect: The user creates 3 Clones.
Channeled. For 2 turns, the user creates a Clone at the start of each tick; then 10 damage to all enemies, and every Clone Flurries each of them.

history.why: Was Vortex plus per-Clone damage; now the tornado builds its own Clones, and they strike on every tick, not only when the user acts.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, one more if the user is Leaping or Rushing when it ticks; each Clone adds 5 to every hit.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If the user is still Rushing at the start of their next turn, it strikes the same enemy again for 10.

history.why: Was Backstab with a Rushing-into-Stealthy rider; now an echo that rewards keeping Wind's Rushing alive.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if the user is Stealthed. If the user is Rushing, it's Stealthy.

history.why: Was Backstab plus Airknife; now Wind's Rushing lets the user stay in Shadow's Stealth while they keep cutting.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or Rushing or the target is Blinded.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user was Leaping, they land in the shadows and gain Stealth.

history.why: Was Ambush plus Rushing; now Wind's Leap sets up Shadow's Stealth for the next strike.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the user is Stealthed; the user begins Rushing.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and the user creates Clones until they have 3.

history.why: Was Illusory Lure plus a Clone; now a successful feint rebuilds the whole decoy line.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Isolated for 2 turns, and the user creates a Clone.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun. If they were Rushing or Leaping, it ends, and their mobility skills go on cooldown for 1 turn.

history.why: Immobile targets couldn't be woken; now grounds a Rushing or Leaping target, a Wind player's answer to mobility.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and they fall Asleep; if they're Immobile, damage can't wake them for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Sap plus a Strategic stun on the Immobile; now Wind's Immobile deepens Shadow's Sleep.

before.effect: 10 damage, and Sleep; Immobile targets also have their Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user gains Stealth, 2 Clones and 1 Might for 3 turns; meanwhile, a skill that would end their Stealth destroys a Clone instead.

history.why: Was Hall of Phantoms plus 2 Clones; now the Clones are fuel that keeps the user hidden while attacking.

before.effect: The user gains Stealth. If they were already Stealthed, they gain Ghosted, Immune and 1 Focus for 2 turns, and create 2 Clones.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 30 and falls Asleep; when they wake, they begin Rushing and gain 1 Swiftness.

history.why: Was Invigorating Breeze plus a Stealthed bonus; now Shadow's Sleep is a rest that Wind wakes them from, running.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, or 30 if they're Stealthed; above 60 HP afterwards, they begin Rushing.

rows.effect: Target ally gains 1 Swiftness, and the user creates a Clone; for 2 turns, the user's Clones Substitute for that ally too.

history.why: Was Nightwrap plus Swiftwind; now the user lends their decoys to an ally.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth and 2 Swiftness.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 2 turns. Their Blind also scatters multi-target skills: each hits only one random unit.

history.why: Was Blind plus mobility-buff loss side by side; now a Shadow rule bend that stretches Blind over area skills.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 2 turns and loses a mobility buff each time they use a skill.

history.why: Was Blinding Powder plus Headwind; now each blind swing costs them Wind's speed.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 3 turns and loses their mobility buffs.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them gives the user a Clone.

history.why: Was Shadowbrand plus Feathermark; now the team's hits on the mark build the Ninja's decoys.

before.effect: 10 damage and Sanctify for 2 turns. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target Leap. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20. For 1 turn, each ally hit by a single-target enemy skill gains Stealth once it resolves.

history.why: Split allies into Stealth or Leap by mobility buffs; now reactive Stealth access that makes focus fire vanish into the shadows.

before.effect: All allies heal 20; each ally with no mobility buff gains Stealth, and the rest Leap.

history.why: Was Nightfall plus Uplifting Verse's Leap; now each ally gets Shadow's cover or Wind's lift, depending on their speed.

before.effect: All allies gain Stealth, heal 15, and Leap.

rows.effect: Stealthy. The user creates a Clone if they have none; then 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, and each Clone adds 10 to another random enemy.

history.why: Was Shadow Pulse plus per-Clone damage and Falling Slam's discount; now a real Cleave whose extra targets come from the Clones.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies, +5 to each per Clone. Costs 1 less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Then smoke fills the field: every character on both sides, the user included, gains Stealth for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Signal Smoke, Blind plus Clones; now a field-wide smoke screen in which whoever acts first gives themselves away, so both teams must decide who breaks cover.

before.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 1 turn; the user creates a Clone for each one who already was.

history.why: Was Echoing Voice plus a 1-turn Hunter's Howl; now the smoke hides new Clones among the already-blinded.

before.effect: Every ally gains 1 Swiftness; every enemy is Blinded for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn and creates a Clone; while the Shield lasts, a Clone that Substitutes for them spends the Shield instead of being destroyed.

history.why: Was Veiled Guard plus a Clone; now the Shield keeps the decoys standing through the hits they take.

before.effect: The user gains 1 permanent Armor and creates a Clone; with 3 or more Armor, they also gain Stealth.

rows.effect: The user creates a Clone. Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns, and each skill they use during it draws a Flurry from every Clone.

history.why: Was Shadow Mockery with a Clone as the decoy; now every move the taunted enemy makes brings the Clones down on them.

before.effect: The user creates a Clone; target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn, or 3 if they're Immobile.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune and creates a Clone at the start of each of their turns; their Clones Substitute for them against multi-target skills too.

history.why: Was Faceless One with a Clone refill in place of its Taunt; now the Clones cover the user even against sweeping attacks.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor, all enemies are Isolated, and the user's Clones refill to 3 at the start of each of their turns.

kits.name: Spore
kits.tagline: Poison in the soil: an infection that spreads from host to host and fruits into a colony.
kits.taglineHtml: Poison in the soil: an infection that spreads from host to host and fruits into a colony.
kits.introHtml:
• Spores (Debuff, stacks): at the end of each turn, a bearer with 2 or more Spores passes 1 to a random ally of theirs. When a unit reaches 3, a Mushroom sprouts from them for the Spore player and they lose the 3 Spores. A Mushroom is a 15 HP minion that counts as a Seedling; at the end of your turns it Puffs, giving a random enemy 1 Spore.

One keyword: the colony it grows plugs straight into Earth's Seedling skills.

keywords.html: Spores (Debuff, stacks): at the end of each turn, a bearer with 2 or more Spores passes 1 to a random ally of theirs. When a unit reaches 3, a Mushroom sprouts from them for the Spore player and they lose the 3 Spores. A Mushroom is a 15 HP minion that counts as a Seedling; at the end of your turns it Puffs, giving a random enemy 1 Spore.

rows.effect: 20 damage and 1 Spore to target enemy. If a Mushroom sprouts from them, the user also gains 1 Might and 1 Armor for good.

history.why: Was Worldfist's per-minion bonus plus Viper Strike's rider as a Spore; now the hit that completes a colony pays out Channel Earth's permanent stats.

before.effect: 15 damage, +5 per allied minion, and 1 Spore.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. If they have Spores, they lose them, and each of their allies gains that many.

history.why: Was Plague Stomp with Spores for Toxin; now it bursts one carrier's Spores across their whole team, so the player picks which carrier to stomp.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 1 Spore each.

rows.effect: 10 damage and 1 Spore to target enemy. Through the user's next turn, each enemy their skills damage gains 1 Spore.

history.why: Was Rolling Crash making a Mushroom instead of a Boulder; now the user carries Spores into their next skill, rewarding a follow-up that hits many.

before.effect: 10 damage, and the user creates a Mushroom.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 1 Spore per target the skill had.

history.why: Was Shed Skin with Spores for Renew; now a counter that infects in proportion to the countered skill's reach, so area attacks sprout Mushrooms.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if the user takes direct damage, they heal 15 and the attacker gains 2 Spores.

rows.effect: The user is Blinded for 3 turns, then gains 3 Might and Immune for as long: the frenzy hits very hard, but its single-target skills land on a random enemy.

history.why: Was Immune plus 1 Might per enemy with Spores; now a cheap, huge Rage whose price is losing control of its aim.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains 1 Might per enemy with Spores, counted at the start of each of their turns.

history.why: Was Nature's Wrath making Mushrooms instead of Seedlings; now a Rage whose strength tracks how far the infection has spread.

before.effect: The user creates 2 Mushrooms, then gains Immune for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, every Debuff on them counts toward Prey, not only Toxin, Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion.

history.why: Was a Spores core Shot scaling with infected enemies; now a Poison expansion that lets any Debuff, Spores included, push a target into Prey.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage to target enemy, +5 per enemy with Spores; then the target gains 1 Spore.

history.why: Was Sting with Spore added to its random pool; now a cheap shot that scales with the number of carriers.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, and at random 1 Spore, Toxin, Weakness or Vulnerable.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. In 2 turns, 50 damage to target enemy and 15 to each of their allies with Spores.

history.why: Was Tunnelmaker plus 2 Toxin; now the rot travels through the colony, so seeding the team before it lands widens the hit.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 55 damage and 2 Toxin to target enemy; a turn sooner if the user consumes a Boulder.

rows.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. Each time target enemy uses a Helpful skill, they and every ally it affects gain 1 Spore.

history.why: Was Snake Pit with Spores for Toxin; now it punishes support instead, turning the enemy's helping hands into carriers.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. Each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Spore.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and sheds their Debuffs; each stack shed becomes 1 Spore on a random enemy.

history.why: Was Burrow plus Slither's Focus; now an escape that cleanses the user and throws their afflictions back as Spores.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable and Ghosted for 1 turn and gains 1 Focus.

rows.effect: Summons a Sporeling (40 HP, counts as a Seedling) permanently. Infecting Lash (r): 10 damage and 1 Spore. It gains 10 max HP and heals 10 whenever a Mushroom sprouts from an enemy.

history.why: Was Forest Stalker with a Spore Cloud in place of Channel Earth; now a host that grows each time the colony fruits.

before.effect: Summons a Sporeling (50 HP, counts as a Seedling) permanently. Spore Cloud (r): all enemies gain 1 Spore. Rootlash (nc): 10 Piercing damage.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Mark for 1 turn. Until the Mark is spent, their Toxin can't be removed.

history.why: Turned allied Seedlings into Toxin; now locks a Poison player's Toxin onto the target until the Mark is spent.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and 1 Toxin per allied Seedling, Mushrooms included (max 3). If the user has no Seedling, they create one first.

history.why: Was Vine Lash plus a Spore; now Earth's Seedlings set the dose of Poison's Toxin, so the garden arms the lash.

before.effect: 25 damage and 1 Spore. If the user has no Mushroom, they create one.

rows.effect: Every allied Seedling, Mushrooms included, Puffs, giving a random enemy 1 Spore; then 25 damage to all enemies.

history.why: Was Verdant Burst with a Spore tacked on; now Earth's Seedlings become spore-makers before the blast lands.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then 20 damage and 1 Spore to all enemies.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. They lose their Spores, and the user heals 10 per Spore lost.

history.why: Was Devour plus a Mushroom; now it eats the target's Spores for healing, a choice between harvesting now and letting them fruit.

before.effect: Executes target enemy below 15 HP (doubled for minions); a Mushroom sprouts from them for the user.

rows.effect: Summons a Bloater (20 HP) for 3 turns. Rancid Spit (r): 10 damage. When the Bloater dies, every enemy gains 1 Spore.

history.why: Was Sprout Seedling making Mushrooms; now a minion the enemy must decide whether to pop, since killing it infects their whole team.

before.effect: The user creates 2 Mushrooms.

rows.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, every enemy with Spores gains 1 more.
10 Piercing damage to target enemy, or 20 against Prey. First, 1 of their Armor rots into 1 Vulnerable.

history.why: Was Pounce plus Stonepierce; now Poison's rot eats Earth's Armor, turning the target's defense into a weakness.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, or 15 against targets with Shield or Armor. Against Prey, you gain 1 random energy.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they have 3 or more Toxin, they lose it all, and the user gains 1 Might and 1 Armor for good.

history.why: Was Envenom plus Stone Drill; now it harvests heavy Toxin into Channel Earth's permanent stats, trading the poison's ticks for growth.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might. Prey targets gain 2 Toxin.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered: they're Stunned for 1 turn if they carry Spores, or gain 2 Spores if they don't.

history.why: Was Pitfall with 2 Spores tacked on; now it reads the target: a carrier is Stunned, a clean one is infected.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn and gain 2 Spores.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn and gains 1 Spore. If they have 2 or more Spores when it ends, a Mushroom sprouts from them.

history.why: Was Earthwrap with Spores for Shield; now a shorter Stun that fruits a carrier early, rewarding seeding first.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 2 turns and gains 2 Spores.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus. Whenever one of their minions takes damage meanwhile, it heals 5 and the user gains 1 Armor for 1 turn.

history.why: Hardened the user's Toxin into Armor; now an Earth summoner's minions feed the user Armor whenever they're hit.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus. First, all Toxin on the user hardens into as much Armor for those turns.

history.why: Was Landslide making a Mushroom instead of a Boulder; now Poison's Toxin on the user hardens into Earth's Armor while they move.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from this skill, they also create a Mushroom.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15, +15 for each allied minion that died since the user's last turn.

history.why: Was heal, then if Toxin make a Seedling; now rewards an Earth player for spending Boulders and Seedlings, since fallen minions feed the heal.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20 and loses 1 Toxin. If they had any, the user creates a Seedling from the rot.

history.why: Was Grovetender plus a Toxin cleanse; now the poison drawn out of the ally feeds the garden.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then target ally heals 15 and loses 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and they and the user share Buffs: each Buff either of them gains is copied to the other.

history.why: Was 1 Armor per Toxin on the ally; now a symbiosis that doubles every Buff the pair receives, a buff-sharing link no other Bless has.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and 1 Armor per Toxin on them (max 3).

history.why: Was Infuse Earth plus a Toxin cleanse; now Poison's Toxin armors the ally, so the more poisoned they are, the tougher they get.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random, and loses 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: Target enemy gains 2 Spores and is Confused for 2 turns; each ally they pass a Spore to is Confused for 2 turns too.

history.why: Was Swamp Toxins with Spores for Toxin; now the Confusion rides the Spores to whoever catches them.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 2 Spores and 1 Confusion.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, half of all healing they receive goes to a random ally of the user instead.

history.why: Was minions giving 2 Toxin; now a parasite that siphons the target's incoming healing to the user's team, a heal-theft brand no other Smite has.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each time a minion damages them, they gain 2 Toxin.

history.why: Was Preymark with a Spore for Vulnerable; now Earth's minions deliver Poison's Toxin.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target give them 1 Spore.

rows.effect: All allies heal 30 and gain 2 Spores each. The colony grows in them: Mushrooms that sprout from the user's allies are the user's.

history.why: Was a heal that counted Spores and Mushrooms; now a cheap full heal that seeds the user's own team, trading a Debuff on every ally for Mushrooms.

before.effect: All allies heal 15, +5 for each enemy with Spores and each allied Mushroom.

history.why: Was Verse of Nurturing plus Serpentsong's rider as a Spore; now the team's healing grows with the colony.

before.effect: Channel Growth twice; then all allies heal 20, and every enemy gains 1 Spore.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to the other enemy with the most Spores (random if tied), who gains 1 more.

history.why: Was Vine Whirl plus Tail Lash's reset and a Spore; now the second hit hunts the ripest carrier and pushes it toward fruiting.

before.effect: 5 damage and 1 Spore to all enemies; the cooldown resets if it hits Prey.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, the first time each of them becomes Prey, a Seedling sprouts for the user.

history.why: Was extra Intimidated per Spore; now a bridge where Poison's Prey grows Earth's Seedlings.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, with 1 extra stack per Spore they have.

history.why: Was Awakener's Roar aimed at Mushrooms and useless without them; now a Shout that weighs heaviest on carriers.

before.effect: Every allied Mushroom heals to full and Puffs at once.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. Each enemy hit it absorbs triggers Channel Growth for the user's Seedlings.

history.why: Was a Shield that gave Spores to attackers; now an Earth expansion that turns incoming hits into Seedling growth.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. Each enemy who damages them meanwhile gains 1 Spore.

history.why: Was Rampart plus Coil; now a wall that infects whoever strikes it.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield and 1 Armor, or doubles the Shield they have.

rows.effect: The user creates a Mushroom. Target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns and gains 1 Spore each time they damage it.

history.why: Was Ancient Grudge plus Mesmerizing Glare's Prey; now a reeking Mushroom lure that infects whoever it draws in.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time), who counts as Prey while Taunted.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and absorbs each Mushroom that sprouts: instead of the minion, they gain 1 Armor and heal 15.

history.why: Was Treant Form plus a Spore rider; now the user eats the colony's fruit, trading Mushrooms for bulk.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 1 Might per allied Seedling (Mushrooms included) and 5 Shield per allied Boulder; enemies who damage them gain 1 Spore.

kits.name: Antidote
kits.tagline: Poison made medicine by holy hands: protection that learns, and cleansing that strikes back.
kits.taglineHtml: Poison made medicine by holy hands: protection that learns, and cleansing that strikes back.
kits.introHtml:
• Inoculated (Buff): the next Debuff applied to the bearer is prevented, and they're immune to that Debuff for 3 turns. Then Inoculated is spent.
  • Purge: removes Debuffs from an ally, as the skill lists, and deals 10 Affliction to an enemy (the skill's target, or a random one) per Debuff removed. Each stack of a stacking Debuff counts.

keywords.html: Inoculated (Buff): the next Debuff applied to the bearer is prevented, and they're immune to that Debuff for 3 turns. Then Inoculated is spent.
Purge: removes Debuffs from an ally, as the skill lists, and deals 10 Affliction to an enemy (the skill's target, or a random one) per Debuff removed. Each stack of a stacking Debuff counts.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy; the user Purges one of their own Debuffs onto the target.
25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Until the user's next turn, Sanctify on any of them heals every ally of the damager, not only the damager.

history.why: Condemned enemies with Toxin; now bends Sanctify so a Holy team's brands heal the whole side for a turn.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Each one hit who has Toxin is Condemned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Divine Storm plus Plague Stomp's Toxin; now Poison's Toxin is what marks targets for Holy's Condemn.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies; each gains 1 Toxin, and the user heals 5 per target hit.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Until the end of their next turn, their Toxin also ticks each time they use a skill.

history.why: Anointed the user off Prey; now bends Toxin so a Poison stacker's stacks bite on the enemy's own turn too.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, the user is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Lunge plus Zealous Rush; now catching Prey is what Anoints the user, so Poison's setup fuels Holy's empowerment.

before.effect: 15 damage. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey, and the user's next Harmful skill Sanctifies.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and they become immune for 3 turns to each Debuff it would have applied.

history.why: Was Retribution with Inoculated tacked on; now a counter that learns, immunizing the user against whatever the countered skill carried.

before.effect: For 1 turn, Harmful skills used on the user heal them instead of damaging them, and the user is Inoculated.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might and their Debuffs have no effect. When it ends, they Purge all of them onto random enemies.

history.why: Was Divine Fury plus Inoculated every turn, a near-copy of the kit's Titan; now a fever that holds Debuffs in, then expels them all as damage.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Anointed and becomes Inoculated at the start of each of their turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and the ally they damaged most recently is Inoculated.

history.why: Was Sunbeam spending Anointed on a Purge instead of a heal; now it protects whoever the target is focusing, a question neither parent's Shot asks.

before.effect: 15 damage. Consumes the user's Anointed to Purge one Debuff from a random ally.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target; it can target an ally or an enemy. On the following turn, an enemy takes 50 damage, or an ally heals 40 and loses their Debuffs.

history.why: Was a kill shot that Purged the team on a kill; now the dose makes the poison: the enemy can't tell whether the hidden shot is an execution or a rescue.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 damage to target enemy. If it kills them, every ally Purges all their Debuffs onto random enemies.

history.why: Was Spear of Light with the user's Purge tacked on; now a kill cleanses the whole team, rewarding a snipe aimed at a finish.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 damage, and the user Purges all their Debuffs onto the target.

rows.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy gives one of the user's allies a Debuff, it's Purged at once, onto them.

history.why: Was Decree plus Isolation; now the enemy's own Debuffs rebound on them as Purge damage.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Isolated for 2 turns: their allies can't reach them.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Every enemy who uses a Harmful skill meanwhile counts as Prey for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Invulnerable, then if Toxin, Anointed; now marks every attacker as Prey, opening Poison's Prey payoffs without any Toxin.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. If they had Toxin, they lose it and are Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Slither with Inoculated in place of Focus; now sweating out Poison's Toxin Anoints the user the Holy way.

before.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and Inoculated.

rows.effect: Summons an Asclepian Serpent (40 HP) permanently. Cure (W): Purges one Debuff from target ally. Serpent's Kiss (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin.
25 damage to target enemy and Mark for 1 turn. Until the end of their next turn, their Buffs have no effect.

history.why: Resolved Condemned into all three Prey debuffs; now an antidote for Buffs: it switches off every Buff on the target without removing them.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they're Condemned, it resolves now with all three of Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion, making them Prey.

history.why: Was Rebuke plus Acid Orb; now Holy's Condemn resolves in full to create Poison's Prey.

before.effect: 20 damage and Sanctify for 1 turn; Prey targets are also Marked and gain 1 Vulnerable.

rows.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Then each ally Purges 1 Debuff, and each Purge hits every enemy.

history.why: Was Acid Wash with a team Purge tacked on; now every Purge lands on the whole enemy team, so a more afflicted team washes harder.

before.effect: 15 damage and 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns to all enemies; each ally Purges one Debuff.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy; a random ally Purges all their Toxin onto them.
Summons an Apothecary (15 HP) for 3 turns. Milk Venom (r): 10 damage to target enemy; if they have Toxin, a random ally is Inoculated.

history.why: Was Divine Blessing's one-shot buff with Inoculated for Anointed; now it brews antivenom out of a poisoned enemy.

before.effect: Summons an Apothecary (15 HP) for 3 turns. Inoculate (W): target ally is Inoculated.

rows.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. Each turn, 10 damage to all enemies, and the ally with the most Debuffs loses 1 and is immune to it for 3 turns.

history.why: Was Nine Plagues with a Purge in place of its Toxin; now a course of treatment that builds the team's immunities one Debuff at a time.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 6 turns. Each turn, 5 Affliction to all enemies, and a random ally Purges one Debuff.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. For 2 turns, being at or below 60 HP makes them Prey.

history.why: Gave Sanctified targets Toxin; now widens Prey's HP line for one target, so a Poison player's Prey payoffs start on the wounded.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. If they're Sanctified, they also gain 2 Toxin.

history.why: Was Piercing Light with Prey added to its condition; now Holy's Sanctify marks the wound for Poison's Toxin.

before.effect: 10 damage, +10 if the target is Condemned, Sanctified or Prey. The bonus always applies if the user is Anointed.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user is Inoculated, they spend it for 15 more damage; if not, they become Inoculated.

history.why: Was Crusade plus Envenom; now it alternates, building the user's Inoculation and then cashing it in for damage.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable. Targets above 75 HP are Condemned; Prey targets gain 2 Toxin.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and each of its targets Purges 1 Debuff onto them.

history.why: Was Martyrdom with Inoculated for Anointed; now the countered attack becomes a cleanse for everyone it aimed at.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and all its intended targets are Inoculated.

rows.effect: Target enemy and the user fall Asleep for 2 turns. Neither can take damage meanwhile, so nothing wakes them early.

history.why: Was a Stun that made allies immune to Stun; now a long, symmetrical anesthetic that trades the user's turns for a key enemy's.

before.effect: 10 damage and a 1-turn Stun to target enemy. For 2 turns, the user's allies are immune to Stun.

history.why: Was Lacerate plus Repentance's Condemned condition; now it stuns while making the team immune to the Stun it just used.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey or Condemned.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus. At the end of each of their turns, if they have no Debuffs, their other cooldowns drop by 1.

history.why: Turned allies' Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion into Buffs; now rewards staying clean with faster cooldowns, a tempo engine no other Dance has.

before.effect: All Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion on allies turn into as much Might, Armor and Focus.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 25 and is Inoculated. If that stops a Debuff, its source takes 10 Affliction.

history.why: Was a heal plus the same all-Toxin Purge as Draw the Venom; now the heal comes with a vaccine that bites back.

before.effect: Target ally heals 25 and Purges all their Toxin.

rows.effect: Target ally gains 1 Toxin. For 3 turns, they're immune to further Toxin and gain 1 Might and 1 Renew.

history.why: Was Viper's Crest with Inoculated tacked on; now a true vaccine, where a small dose of poison buys immunity to the rest.

before.effect: Target ally is Inoculated, and gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns and Condemned. Until the Confusion ends, their Condemned doesn't end when it resolves, so every skill they use costs them another random Debuff.

history.why: Was a Purge Curse that hurt the target when allies were cleansed; now a Holy expansion that makes Condemned keep resolving.

before.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each Debuff removed from the user's allies deals them 10 Affliction.

history.why: Was Mark of Heresy plus Swamp Toxins; now the target soaks the damage of every cleanse on the user's team.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Sanctified until the end of the user's next turn, and gains 1 Toxin and 1 Confusion.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. Their poison sweetens it: the Sanctify heals 5 more per Toxin on them.

history.why: Was a Purge Smite that moved allies' Debuffs onto the target; now a bridge where Poison's Toxin fuels Holy's Sanctify.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them Purges 1 of their own Debuffs onto them.

history.why: Was Karmic Marking plus Preymark; now striking the target cleanses the striker, a Sanctify that cures instead of heals.

before.effect: 15 damage; Sanctified for 2 turns if the user is Anointed. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target give them 1 Vulnerable.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. For 2 turns, when an enemy gives one of them a Debuff, every ally becomes immune to it for 3 turns.

history.why: Was Saving Grace with a Purge tacked on; now one ally's infection teaches the whole team immunity.

before.effect: All allies heal 10, gain 10 Shield, and Purge one Debuff each. If the user is Anointed, it repeats next turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. If one of them is Condemned, the other is marked as Prey for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Guardian Strike with Prey added to its condition; now Holy's Condemn on one fang makes Poison's Prey of the other.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and a random other enemy; if a Sanctified or Prey target is hit, all allies heal 5.

rows.effect: Every ally loses 1 Debuff. All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, with 1 stack per Debuff removed.

history.why: Was Excoriate plus a team Purge; now the team's cleansing slows the enemy's cooldowns instead of damaging them.

before.effect: Bypass. Every ally Purges one Debuff (onto random enemies), and every Sanctified enemy is Condemned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user Purges all their Debuffs onto random enemies, then gains 20 Shield for 1 turn, +10 per Debuff Purged.

history.why: Was Shield of Faith with Inoculated tacked on; now afflictions become damage and Shield at once, so a sicker user stands firmer.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield and is Inoculated; if Anointed, also Immune for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns. Each time they hit the user meanwhile, the user is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was an Inoculated Taunt that blocked the target's Debuffs; now a Holy expansion that earns Anointed by taking the blows.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns. The first Debuff they give the user is prevented, and the user is immune to all their Debuffs for 3 turns.

history.why: Was Gleam plus Mesmerizing Glare's Prey; now the user draws one enemy's fire and learns immunity to their whole toolkit.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and Condemned until they use a new Harmful skill, and counts as Prey meanwhile.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and becomes Inoculated at the start of each of their turns.

kits.name: Blight
kits.tagline: Poison and death: a rot that takes what never grows back.
kits.taglineHtml: Poison and death: a rot that takes what never grows back.
kits.introHtml:
• Withered (Debuff, max 5, until cleansed): the bearer's max HP is 5 lower per stack, and HP above the new max is lost.
  • Festering: while a unit is Withered, their Toxin gains 1 stack at the end of each turn. Rot feeds the poison, so cleansing is the only real answer.

keywords.html: Withered (Debuff, max 5, until cleansed): the bearer's max HP is 5 lower per stack, and HP above the new max is lost.
Festering: while a unit is Withered, their Toxin gains 1 stack at the end of each turn. Rot feeds the poison, so cleansing is the only real answer.

rows.effect: 20 damage and 1 Withered to target enemy. If they now have 3 or more Withered, the user drains a Soul Fragment from them.

history.why: Was Witchblade's 25 plus Viper Strike's Toxin and a Withered; now deep rot yields a Soul Fragment, so the Strike rewards working one target down.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, 1 Toxin, and 1 Withered.

rows.effect: 40 damage to target enemy. Each of their allies who has Toxin gains 1 Withered; the rest gain 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Soulcrusher with Withered and Toxin in place of Horrify; now it reads each ally, rotting the poisoned and poisoning the rest so Festering can start.

before.effect: 40 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 1 Withered and 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user's next skill treats them as Horrified, whether they are or not.

history.why: Drained a Soul Fragment from Prey or gave Toxin; now lets an Unholy player's Horrified payoffs fire without landing Horrify first.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, the user drains a Soul Fragment from them; if not, they gain 1 Toxin.

history.why: Was Lunge plus Wraithwalk; now Poison's Prey is the condition for Unholy's soul drain, with Toxin to build toward it otherwise.

before.effect: 10 damage. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey, and the user's next Harmful skill drains a Soul Fragment.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 1 Withered per 10 damage it would have dealt.

history.why: Was Spiteful Retort with 2 Withered tacked on; now the rot scales with how hard the countered skill would have hit.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 2 Withered and is Horrified for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user gains 2 Withered. Then, for 3 turns, they gain 1 Might per Withered on them and are Immortal.

history.why: Was Viper Stance plus a Renew-to-Toxin conversion; now a self-rotting frenzy that trades the user's max HP for Might, Unholy's pay-in-flesh style.

before.effect: All Might in the battle turns into Weakness, and all Renew on enemies turns into Toxin.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, they're Horrified whenever they have 2 or more Toxin.

history.why: Was a Withered Shot scaling with stacks; now a bridge where Poison's Toxin keeps Unholy's Horrified on the target.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, +5 per Withered they have. If they're Horrified, they gain 1 Withered first.

history.why: Was Bone Shard plus Toxin and Withered riders; now it scales off the target's rot, and Unholy's Horrify adds to it.

before.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Soul Fragment the user has, and 1 Toxin; a target that already has Toxin gains 1 Withered instead.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 25 Affliction damage to target enemy, +10 per Withered they have.

history.why: Was Banewood Javelin plus Soul Lance's drain and a Withered; now a single rot-scaled finisher.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 25 Affliction damage and 1 Withered; below 50 HP after, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

rows.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy would be healed, they aren't, and they gain 1 Withered per 10 it would have healed.

history.why: Was Snake Pit with a Withered tacked on; now it turns the enemy's next heal into rot.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. Each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Toxin; the first time, 1 Withered too.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Until it ends, Toxin the user applied ticks at the end of every turn, not only theirs.

history.why: Drained Soul Fragments from Prey; now bends Toxin timing so a Poison player's stacks tick an extra time while they hide.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. When it ends, they drain a Soul Fragment from each enemy that's Prey.

history.why: Was Grave Step plus Slither's Focus and Unstunnable; now lying low cashes Poison's Prey in for Unholy's Soul Fragments.

before.effect: Unstunnable, Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn and gains 1 Focus.

rows.effect: Summons a Plague Rat swarm (25 HP) permanently. Plague Bite (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Withered. Scurry (nc): 5 Piercing damage to each Withered enemy.

history.why: Was Emerald Asp with a Withered skill in place of Constrict; now the swarm spreads rot and then sweeps every rotting enemy.

before.effect: Summons a Plague Rat swarm (25 HP) permanently. Gnaw (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin. Spread (rr): target enemy gains 1 Withered.

rows.effect: 20 damage and 1 Withered to target enemy, and Horrified for 1 turn. While Horrified, their Withered can't be cleansed.

history.why: Was Fel Bolt with Withered on Prey; now Horrify locks the rot in, shutting out its only answer for a turn.

before.effect: 25 damage, and Horrified for 2 turns; Prey targets also gain 1 Withered.

rows.effect: 15 Affliction damage to the enemy with the least HP. Every other enemy takes Affliction damage equal to how much more HP they have than that enemy, up to 35.

history.why: Was a Blast with +5 per Withered stack; now a plague that takes rich and poor alike, hitting the healthiest enemies hardest.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, +5 to each for every Withered stack they have.

history.why: Was Soul Blast plus Toxin and Withered riders; now the storm hits hardest where the rot runs deepest.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, +10 per Soul Fragment the user has; each gains 1 Toxin, and those already Withered gain another stack.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. The user drinks their Toxin: it's removed, and the user gains 1 Soul Fragment per 3 stacks (max 2).

history.why: Was a Withered drain; now a bridge that cashes Poison's Toxin in for Unholy's Soul Fragments, at the cost of the Toxin.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, and the user heals 10 per Withered on them. At 3 or more Withered, the user also drains a Soul Fragment.

history.why: Was Devour with a Withered threshold plus Soul Fragments; now a drain that feeds on the target's rot.

before.effect: Executes target enemy below 15 HP, or below 25 if they're Withered (doubled for minions); the user gains 2 Soul Fragments on an execution.

rows.effect: Summons a Plague Imp (25 HP) for 3 turns. Rotbolt (r): 10 Affliction damage and 1 Toxin. When the Imp dies or leaves, each enemy it damaged gains 1 Withered.

history.why: Was Imp with Withered in place of Horrify; now it marks its victims and rots them all at once when it goes.

before.effect: Summons a Plague Imp (25 HP) for 3 turns. Rotbolt (r): 10 Affliction damage and 1 Toxin. Wither (I): target enemy gains 1 Withered.

rows.effect: Channeled, 2 turns, +1 turn per Withered enemy. Each turn, 10 Affliction to all enemies.

history.why: Was Nine Plagues with a Withered every third turn; now its length reads how many enemies are rotting.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 6 turns. 5 Affliction to all enemies each turn, and a random enemy gains 1 Toxin; every third turn, every enemy gains 1 Withered.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. Above 60 HP, they also gain 1 Withered.

history.why: Was Blighted Dagger plus Pounce; now it rots healthy targets and finishes weakened ones.

before.effect: 15 damage. At or above 70 HP, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user; against Prey, you gain 1 random energy.

rows.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. Each Buff on them is torn off and becomes 1 Withered.

history.why: Was Lay Waste with Toxin and Withered riders; now it converts the target's Buffs into rot.

before.effect: 35 Piercing damage; Prey or Horrified targets gain 2 Toxin and 1 Withered.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered, and each unit it would have helped gains 1 Withered.

history.why: Was Mirage of Nightmares plus Numbing Needle; now it guesses a support skill and rots everyone it was meant for.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Strategic skill, it's countered; they gain 1 Toxin, 1 Weakness and 1 Vulnerable, and the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 10 damage, a 1-turn Stun and 1 Withered to target enemy. Then their Toxin grows by 1 per Withered they have.

history.why: Was Cripple with 2 Withered tacked on; now it stuns and festers the target's Toxin in one burst.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 permanent Vulnerable and 2 Withered; if Horrified, also 1 permanent Weakness.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each skill they use gives its first target 1 Withered.

history.why: Was Cobra Stance plus Grisly Spectacle's Horrify extension; now a mobile stance that rots whatever it touches.

before.effect: All Armor on enemies turns into Vulnerable, and every Horrify on enemies lasts 1 turn longer.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 15, +10 for each Horrified enemy.

history.why: Cleansed Toxin into Soul Fragments; now a new outlet for an Unholy team's Horrify, turning the enemy's fear into healing.

before.effect: Target ally heals 25 and loses their Toxin; the user gains a Soul Fragment per 2 stacks removed.

history.why: Was Consume Lesser plus a Toxin cleanse; now a true ally heal whose cleanse of Poison's Toxin feeds Unholy's Soul Fragments.

before.effect: Deals 15 damage to another ally or allied minion; the user heals 20 and loses their Toxin.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and executes any Prey their skills leave at 15 HP or less.

history.why: Gave Lifesteal against Prey; now hands any ally Poison's Execute, so a Prey-building team gets a finisher on every skill.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and Lifesteal against Prey.

history.why: Was Vampirism plus Viper's Crest; now Unholy's Lifesteal feeds only on Poison's Prey.

before.effect: Target ally gains Lifesteal for 2 turns, and 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Withered and 1 Confusion; the Confusion lasts until the Withered is cleansed.

history.why: Was Cause Fear plus Swamp Toxins and a Withered; now the Confusion is bound to the rot, so only a cleanse ends it.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Withered and 1 Toxin, and is Horrified until the end of the turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them makes their Toxin tick once, healing that ally for it.

history.why: Was Soul Sickness with Withered for Soul Fragments; now allies' hits squeeze Poison's Toxin into Unholy-style lifesteal.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target give them 1 Withered.

rows.effect: Each enemy loses 15 HP. All allies heal twice the total lost, split evenly among them.

history.why: Was a small heal counting Withered on enemies; now a Prayer paid for entirely by the enemy team, strongest while all of them still stand.

before.effect: All allies heal 10, +5 for every Withered stack on the enemy team.

history.why: Was Profane Chant plus Toxin and Withered riders; now a real team heal that grows with the enemy's rot.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Toxin to all enemies, and 2 Weakness for 1 turn; Withered ones gain another Withered stack.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy, who gains as much Withered as the first has (max 2).

history.why: Was Tail Lash with Toxin on Prey; now the scythe carries rot from one enemy to the next.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies; Prey hit gain 1 Toxin, and the cooldown resets if it hits any Prey.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each Helpful skill they use deals 10 Affliction damage to each of its targets.

history.why: Horrified enemies with 3 Toxin; now the enemy team's support skills hurt whoever they help while it lasts.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; each one with 3 or more Toxin is also Horrified for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Soulshriek with Withered for Horrify; now a Shout where Poison's Toxin sets up Unholy's Horrify across the team.

before.effect: 20 damage. If the user has a Soul Fragment, they spend it for 10 more damage and 2 Withered.

rows.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. Whoever breaks it has a Soul Fragment drained by the user.

history.why: Drained HP from enemies with Toxin; now a new way for an Unholy player to earn Soul Fragments by being hit.

before.effect: The user drains 5 HP from each enemy with Toxin, then gains 20 Shield for 1 turn, plus twice the total drained.

history.why: Was Misery plus Coil's Armor; now it drains poisoned enemies instead of the user's own allies.

before.effect: The user drains 10 HP from each other ally, and gains 1 Armor and 20 Shield plus the total drained.

rows.effect: All enemies are Taunted by the user for 1 turn. Until the user's next turn, every hit on them deals 10 less, but they can't be healed.

history.why: Was a single Taunt that Withered whoever hit the user; now the whole enemy team is drawn onto a hardened but unhealable user.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns; each time they damage the user, they gain 1 Withered.

history.why: Was Unrelenting Horror plus Mesmerizing Glare and a Withered each turn; now the rot comes from every blow they're forced to land.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and counts as Prey for 2 turns, gaining 1 Withered each turn. If they're Horrified, the user gains Lifesteal meanwhile.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and 5 max HP per Withered stack on enemies, healing as it rises.

history.why: Was Soul Colossus with Withered on every enemy; now the user grows by the max HP the enemy team has lost.

before.effect: Consumes all Soul Fragments to heal 5 each; then 2 Armor and Immortal for that many turns. Every enemy gains 1 Withered.

kits.name: Assassin
kits.tagline: Poison from the dark: a contract only you can see, and a blade that ends it.
kits.taglineHtml: Poison from the dark: a contract only you can see, and a blade that ends it.
kits.introHtml:
• Death Mark (Debuff, hidden): the enemy can't see it. Assassin skills deal 10 more to the bearer, and any Assassin skill that leaves them at 25 HP or less executes them. It's revealed when it triggers or expires. Each Assassin has one Death Mark out at a time. Some skills raise its execute threshold (never above 40 HP) or move it to another enemy; a moved Mark stays hidden.

One keyword: like Night's clocks, the skill in playing against it is working out who is marked.

keywords.html: Death Mark (Debuff, hidden): the enemy can't see it. Assassin skills deal 10 more to the bearer, and any Assassin skill that leaves them at 25 HP or less executes them. It's revealed when it triggers or expires. Each Assassin has one Death Mark out at a time. Some skills raise its execute threshold (never above 40 HP) or move it to another enemy; a moved Mark stays hidden.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If this executes your Death Mark, a new one goes on a random enemy, hidden.

history.why: Was Black Axe word for word; now a closed contract passes itself on, keeping the enemy guessing who's next.

before.effect: 25 damage. If this kills the target, the user gains Stealth.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Each enemy hit gains 1 Toxin per Stealthed ally of the user, and no one's Stealth is spent.

history.why: Was Shadow Crash with Toxin tacked on; now hidden allies poison the targets instead of breaking cover to hit harder.

before.effect: Removes Stealth from every Stealthed ally; then 10 damage to target enemy and 5 to the others, +10 to each per Stealth removed. Each gains 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy and your Death Mark for 2 turns; while the user stays Stealthed, the Mark doesn't count down.

history.why: Was Long Shadow plus Lunge's Prey and a Death Mark; now staying hidden is what keeps the contract open.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage and your Death Mark for 3 turns; through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if the countered skill has a cooldown of 3 or more.

history.why: Was a counter that ticked the attacker's Toxin twice; now a counter that chokes hardest on the enemy's big, slow skills.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; all Toxin on its user ticks twice at once.

history.why: Blinded the attacker and made them Prey while Blinded; now a new outlet that detonates a Poison player's Toxin stacks on whoever swings.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Blinded for 2 turns and counts as Prey while Blinded.

history.why: Was Mirage Blade plus Numbing Needle's Debuffs; now Shadow's Blind is what makes the attacker Poison's Prey.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 1 Toxin, 1 Weakness and 1 Vulnerable, and the user gains 1 Focus.

rows.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness, and a random enemy gains your Death Mark. An execution meanwhile extends this by 2 turns.

history.why: Was Night of Knives with Toxin on every hit; now it opens a contract and keeps going for as long as contracts keep closing.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness, and their damaging skills also give 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, their Toxin, Weakness and Vulnerable can't be removed.

history.why: Was a dart, then if Blinded 2 Toxin; now locks a Poison player's stacks in place against cleanses.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Blinded, they also gain 2 Toxin.

history.why: Was Shadow Spine with Toxin tacked on; now Shadow's Blind sets up Poison's Toxin.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin, striking once more for each of Blinded, Isolated and Asleep that the target is.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy. If they have your Death Mark, this executes at 40 HP; if not, they gain it.

history.why: Was Banewood Javelin plus Dream Seeker's riders; now one shot places the contract and the next collects it at a higher threshold.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 30 Affliction damage; against your Death Mark, it Bypasses and doesn't end Sleep.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, all enemies take 5 Affliction damage whenever they use any skill.

history.why: Gave a healed ally the Death Mark; now the designer's trap that watches every enemy and punishes any skill at all.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a Helpful skill on an ally, that ally gains your Death Mark and 2 Toxin.

history.why: Was Snake Pit with a Death Mark tacked on; now the enemy unknowingly hands the contract to the ally they help.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Toxin and your Death Mark.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Meanwhile, Stealthed allies stay Stealthed whatever skills they use.

history.why: Gave attackers Toxin and Blind side by side; now bends Stealth so a Shadow team can attack from hiding for a turn.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Each enemy who damaged them since their last turn gains 1 Toxin and is Blinded for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Shadowstep plus Slither's Focus; now the vanish punishes whoever just hurt the user.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn and gains 1 Focus.

rows.effect: Summons a Shadow Viper (25 HP) permanently. Venom Fang (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin. Seek the Mark (rr): 15 Piercing damage to your Death Mark's bearer; if none has it, target enemy gains it.

history.why: Was Emerald Asp with a Death Mark bonus on its fang; now the Viper places a contract or strikes its bearer wherever they are.

before.effect: Summons a Shadow Viper (25 HP) permanently. Venom Fang (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin, or 15 against your Death Mark. Constrict (rr): 2 Weakness and 2 Vulnerable for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Mark for 2 turns. Each time the Mark is spent, the name is passed on: a random other enemy is Marked for 1 turn, up to 3 times.

history.why: Was a bland Bolt that extended Blind and Isolation; now a Mark that hops across the enemy team, so every ally's hit finds a fresh +10.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and every Blind and Isolation on the enemy team lasts 1 more turn.

history.why: Blinded 1 turn per 2 Toxin; now stretches a Shadow team's Blinds and Isolations across every enemy.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. They're Blinded for 1 turn per 2 Toxin they have (max 3).

history.why: Was Blackbolt plus Acid Orb and an Isolate; now Poison's Toxin sets how long Shadow's Blind lasts.

before.effect: 20 damage and Blinded for 2 turns. Prey targets are Marked and gain 1 Vulnerable; Death-Marked ones are also Isolated for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage and 1 Toxin to all enemies. Then your Death Mark moves, hidden, to the enemy with the least HP.

history.why: Was Wave of Darkness plus Acid Wash and a Death Mark bonus; now the smoke covers the contract as it shifts onto the weakest enemy.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, with 1 Confusion for 1 turn and 1 Vulnerable for 2; your Death-Marked target takes 15 more.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. If this executes them through your Death Mark, the user heals 30 more and gains Stealth.

history.why: Was Devour with a larger range against the Death Mark; now a drain that pays out a big heal and Stealth when it closes the contract.

before.effect: Executes target enemy below 15 HP, or below 30 if they have your Death Mark (doubled for minions).

rows.effect: Summons a Hired Blade (20 HP) for 3 turns. Shank (r): 10 Affliction damage. Whoever kills the Blade gains your Death Mark.

history.why: Was Call Shade placing a Death Mark instead of Blind; now killing the Blade signs the killer's contract, so the enemy must decide whether to.

before.effect: Summons a Hired Blade (15 HP) for 3 turns. Shank (r): 10 Affliction damage; if no enemy has your Death Mark, the target gains it.

rows.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. A random enemy gains your Death Mark if none has one. Each turn, 10 damage to all enemies; meanwhile your Death Mark executes at 35 HP.

history.why: Was Nightsong plus Nine Plagues' Toxin; now a sustained hunt that raises the contract's execute threshold while it lasts.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns, and a random enemy gains 1 Toxin each turn; if it completes, every enemy falls Asleep.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. Against your Death Mark, the Mark's execute threshold rises by 5 for good (max 40).

history.why: Was Backstab with the Death Mark added to its conditions; now each hidden stab quietly deepens the contract.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or the target is Blinded or has your Death Mark.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Against a Blinded or Sleeping target, it's Stealthy.

history.why: Ticked Toxin on Sleepers without waking them; now lets a Shadow player keep Stealth while carving up enemies who can't see them.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 if they're Asleep, and their Toxin ticks once now. None of this wakes them.

history.why: Was Ambush plus Envenom and a Death Mark execute; now it preys on Shadow's sleepers, cashing in Poison's Toxin without waking them.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the user is Stealthed, Bypassing Invulnerable. Prey targets gain 2 Toxin; against your Death Mark, it executes at 35 HP instead.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain your Death Mark; if they don't, they gain 2 Toxin.

history.why: Was Illusory Lure with Toxin tacked on; now either choice costs the target: a contract if they act, poison if they wait.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Isolated for 2 turns and gain 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and they fall Asleep. For 1 turn per 2 Toxin they have (max 2), damage doesn't wake them.

history.why: Was Sap with Prey and Death Mark conditions; now Poison's Toxin decides how deep Shadow's Sleep goes.

before.effect: 10 damage, and Sleep; Prey or Death-Marked targets don't wake from damage for 1 turn.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each skill they use also deals 5 Piercing damage to your Death Mark's bearer.

history.why: Was Hall of Phantoms with Toxin tacked on; now every move bleeds the hidden contract target.

before.effect: The user gains Stealth. If they were already Stealthed, Ghosted, Immune and 1 Focus for 2 turns, and their next skill gives 2 Toxin.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 25, and the enemy who damaged them most recently gains your Death Mark.

history.why: Was Touch of Slumber plus a Toxin cleanse; now healing an ally puts a contract on whoever hurt them.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, loses their Toxin, and falls Asleep.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their skills count as Assassin skills against your Death Mark.

history.why: Was Nightwrap plus Viper's Crest; now the ally can collect the contract, bonus damage and execute included.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth, and 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns.

rows.effect: Target enemy gains your Death Mark for 3 turns and is Confused for 2. The Mark executes 5 HP higher per Toxin on them.

history.why: Was Blinding Powder with a Death Mark added; now Poison's Toxin extends the contract's reach.

before.effect: Target enemy gains your Death Mark for 3 turns and is Blinded for 2.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them turns 1 of their Buffs into 1 Vulnerable.

history.why: Doubled Sanctify healing on Prey; now each ally's hit sours a Buff into Vulnerable, pushing the target toward Prey Poison-style.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 2 turns. While they're Prey, allies who damage them heal twice as much.

history.why: Was Shadowbrand with a Vulnerable rider on the Death Mark; now Poison's Prey doubles Shadow's Sanctify payout.

before.effect: 10 damage and Sanctify for 2 turns; a Death-Marked target also gains 1 Vulnerable. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20. For 2 turns, Toxin on the user's allies heals them instead of harming them.

history.why: Was Nightfall gated on Toxin; now bends Toxin so a Poison team's self-poisoning (Bad Stomach, Moonglove) becomes healing.

before.effect: All allies heal 20; those with Toxin lose it and gain Stealth.

history.why: Was Nightfall plus Serpentsong's Toxin; now purging Poison's Toxin is what hides an ally in Shadow.

before.effect: All allies gain Stealth and heal 15; all enemies gain 1 Toxin.

rows.effect: Stealthy. 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy; the second knife always finds your Death Mark's bearer if it's out.

history.why: Was Shadow Pulse plus Tail Lash's reset; now the second knife secretly homes in on the contract.

before.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to all enemies; the cooldown resets if it hits Prey or your Death Mark.

rows.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 2 turns. Your Death Mark's bearer (a random enemy, if none has it) is also Isolated for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Hunter's Howl with a Death Mark on the weakest; now it cuts the contract target off from their team's help.

before.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 2 turns, and the one with the least HP gains your Death Mark.

rows.effect: Invisible. The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. Each enemy skill that hits it has its cooldown raised by 1.

history.why: Gave Stealth or Toxin off a Shield; now a hidden Shield the enemy can't plan around that also slows the skills spent on it.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. If it's intact when their next turn starts, they gain Stealth; if it breaks, the breaker gains 2 Toxin.

history.why: Was Veiled Guard plus Coil; now the guard pays out Shadow's Stealth if it holds, or Poison's Toxin if it breaks.

before.effect: The user gains 1 permanent Armor and 5 Shield; with 3 or more Armor, they gain Stealth.

rows.effect: Stealthy. Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 1 turn, even while the user is Stealthed and can't be targeted.

history.why: Was a decoy giving Toxin and Blind side by side; now bends Stealth so a hidden Shadow player taunts, leaving the enemy's single-target skills nowhere to go.

before.effect: Creates a Venom Decoy (5 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn. If they hit it, they gain 2 Toxin and are Blinded for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Shadow Mockery plus Mesmerizing Glare's Prey; now the decoy is poisoned, so taking the bait costs them.

before.effect: Creates a Decoy (5 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn and counts as Prey.
