rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor and Ghosted, and every enemy counts as having their Death Mark.

kits.name: Sanctuary
kits.tagline: Holy ground: stone raised into a fortress that shelters the whole team.
kits.taglineHtml: Holy ground: stone raised into a fortress that shelters the whole team.
kits.introHtml:
• Sanctum (your team's, levels 1–3, lasts 3 turns; raising it refreshes the duration): each level gives every ally 1 Armor and heals them 5 at the end of each of your turns. At level 3, allies can't be Stunned. Some skills spend levels; at 0 the Sanctum ends.
  • Wardstone: a consecrated Boulder (45 HP, counts as a Boulder). While any allied Wardstone stands, your Sanctum doesn't expire.

keywords.html: Sanctum (your team's, levels 1–3, lasts 3 turns; raising it refreshes the duration): each level gives every ally 1 Armor and heals them 5 at the end of each of your turns. At level 3, allies can't be Stunned. Some skills spend levels; at 0 the Sanctum ends.
Wardstone: a consecrated Boulder (45 HP, counts as a Boulder). While any allied Wardstone stands, your Sanctum doesn't expire.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If an allied Boulder stands, the one with the least HP topples onto them: it dies, and they take 15 more and are Condemned.

history.why: Was a Sanctum Strike that fed on Condemned; now a bridge that spends Earth's Boulders to Condemn.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they're Condemned, your Sanctum rises by 1.

history.why: Was Worldfist's per-minion bonus with Sanctum levels in place of minions; now an enemy's condemnation is what raises the temple.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +5 per level of your Sanctum.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Each allied Boulder loses 15 HP and adds 5 to every hit.

history.why: Condemned enemies if a Boulder stood; now an Earth trade-off that spends Boulder HP as extra quake damage.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. If an allied Boulder stands, each enemy hit is Condemned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Worldquake plus Divine Storm's self-heal; now Earth's Boulders let the quake Condemn the Holy way.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies; the user heals 5 per target hit. Costs 1 less per allied minion.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If the user healed or shielded an ally since their last turn, they're Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Made a Boulder off Sanctified targets; now a new route to Anointed for a Holy healer who keeps supporting the team.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they're Sanctified, the user creates a Boulder.

history.why: Was Rolling Crash making a Wardstone instead of a Boulder; now the stone is only raised from a Sanctified target, so Holy's mark feeds Earth's arsenal.

before.effect: 15 damage, and creates a Wardstone.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, or on any ally if your Sanctum is at 3; its user takes 10 Piercing damage.

history.why: Was Retribution with a Sanctum rise tacked on; now a counter that covers the whole team once the Sanctum is at full strength.

before.effect: For 1 turn, Harmful skills used on the user heal them instead of damaging them; your Sanctum rises by 1.

rows.effect: The user takes in your Sanctum: it ends, and for 3 turns they gain Immune and 1 Might and 1 Armor per level it had (at least 1).

history.why: Was Divine Fury plus a Sanctum rise; now it trades the team's Sanctum for the user's own power.

before.effect: The user is Anointed for 3 turns, and your Sanctum rises by 2.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and one allied Seedling grows into a Worldsprout.

history.why: Anointed the user if they had a Seedling; now gives an Earth grower a one-at-a-time path to Worldsprouts without sacrificing the rest.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Seedling, they're Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Launch Stone plus Sunbeam and a Sanctify; now Earth's Seedlings Anoint the user for Holy's payoffs.

before.effect: 15 damage. Can instead launch an allied Boulder at a random enemy for its remaining HP, Sanctifying them. Consumes the user's Anointed to heal them 15.

rows.effect: Channeled. The user creates a Wardstone now; in 2 turns, 50 damage to target enemy, +20 if that Wardstone still stands.

history.why: Was Tunnelmaker with a Sanctify rider; now it raises a Wardstone the enemy must break to blunt the shot.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 60 damage to target enemy, who is Sanctified; a turn sooner if the user consumes a Boulder.

rows.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy damages one of the user's allies, they take 15 damage and your Sanctum rises by 1.

history.why: Was Boulder Trap plus Decree; now crossing the boundary hurts the attacker and strengthens the temple.

before.effect: For 2 turns, whenever target enemy creates a minion, it's destroyed and the user creates a Wardstone instead; the target is Condemned.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. If your Sanctum is at 3, it drops to 1 and every ally becomes Invulnerable instead.

history.why: Was Cloister with the Sanctum in place of Anointed; now a full Sanctum can be burned to shelter the whole team.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn; with your Sanctum at 2 or more, also Immune.

rows.effect: Summons a Temple Guardian (50 HP, counts as a Wardstone) permanently. Stone Fist (nc): 10 damage. Bless the Ground (r): your Sanctum rises by 1.
20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. The first ally who damages them meanwhile also raises your Sanctum by 1.

history.why: Was Rebuke plus Vine Lash; now the Sanctify's trigger also builds the temple.

before.effect: 20 damage and Sanctify for 1 turn. If the user has no Seedling, they create one.

rows.effect: 20 Piercing damage to all enemies, +10 per level of your Sanctum; then your Sanctum drops by 1.

history.why: Was Holy Nova with Sanctum 3 in place of Anointed; now it spends a level of the Sanctum for burst.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. With your Sanctum at 3, it strikes again at the start of the user's next turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. If they're Sanctified, the user creates a Wardstone.

history.why: Was Worldmarch making Wardstones instead of Worldsprouts; now a drain that harvests Holy's Sanctify into a Wardstone.

before.effect: Every allied Seedling becomes a Wardstone.

rows.effect: Summons a Stonemason (20 HP) for 3 turns. Carve (r): the user creates a Boulder, or a Wardstone if your Sanctum is at 2 or more.

history.why: Was Sprout Seedling plus a healing aura; now a builder whose work depends on the Sanctum's level.

before.effect: Creates 2 Seedlings (15 HP); at the end of your turns, each heals the ally with the least HP 5. Channel Earth (r): its creator gains 1 Might and 1 Armor.

rows.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, your Sanctum rises by 1; if it's already at 3, 10 damage to all enemies instead.

history.why: Was Worldcaller making Wardstones instead of Worldsprouts; now it builds the Sanctum up, then turns it on the enemy.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they create a Wardstone (max 2), or raise your Sanctum by 1 if they already have 2.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Their Condemned resolves now, as if they'd used a skill.

history.why: Chiseled Armor and Condemned side by side; now lets a Holy player cash in Condemned on their own timing.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. If they have Armor, 1 is chiseled off and they're Condemned.

history.why: Was Stonepierce plus Piercing Light; now it carves Earth's Armor off into Holy's Condemn.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets with Shield or Armor or who are Condemned or Sanctified.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +5 per Armor the user has. Then the user loses 1 Armor.

history.why: Was Piercing, then if Condemned +10 per Boulder; now an Earth outlet that turns stacked Armor into damage at the cost of 1 Armor.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Condemned, each allied Boulder and Wardstone adds 10.

history.why: Was Stone Drill plus Crusade; now Holy's Condemn calls Earth's stones down on the target.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might; targets above 75 HP are Condemned.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, any enemy who uses a Harmful skill on an ally of the user who used no Harmful skill on their last turn is countered.

history.why: Was a single-target counter that raised the Sanctum; now a counter that watches every enemy but only shelters allies who laid down their arms.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and your Sanctum rises by 1 for each ally it targeted.

history.why: Was Pitfall with a Sanctum rise tacked on; now the bigger the attack it stops, the higher the Sanctum rises.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn, and your Sanctum rises by 1.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, +1 turn for each allied Wardstone (up to 3 turns in all).

history.why: Was Earthwrap plus a Condemn; now the more consecrated stones stand, the longer the penance.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 2 turns and Condemned, and gains 25 Shield.

rows.effect: For 4 turns, at the start of each of the user's turns, they gain 1 Might, 1 Armor and 1 Focus (max 3 each). It all ends if they use a mobility skill.

history.why: Was Swiftness and Focus that raised the Sanctum on Helpful skills; now a slow processional that builds only while the user holds their ground.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each time they use a Helpful skill, your Sanctum rises by 1.

history.why: Was Landslide with a Sanctum rise in place of the Boulder; now a mobile stance that builds the Sanctum through support.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from this skill, your Sanctum rises by 1.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20. If they use no Harmful skill on their next turn, they heal 30 more at its end.

history.why: Anointed allies with 2 Armor; now a sanctuary's rest that pays out big for a turn spent not attacking, a condition no other Heal reads.

before.effect: Target ally heals 25. If they have 2 or more Armor, they're also Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Grovetender scaled by Sanctum level; now Earth's Armor on the ally opens Holy's Anointed.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then target ally heals 15, +5 per level of your Sanctum.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and while an allied Wardstone stands, it takes half the damage they would.

history.why: Was Infuse Earth doubled for Anointed allies; now a Wardstone shoulders the ally's wounds.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random, or both if they're Anointed.

rows.effect: Your Sanctum drops by 1. Target enemy is Isolated and Condemned for as long as your Sanctum stands, up to 3 turns.

history.why: Was Mark of Heresy with a Sanctum-gated Isolate; now it spends a level to cast the target out for as long as the temple lasts.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Sanctified until the end of the user's next turn; while your Sanctum stands, they're also Isolated.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. Each time that Sanctify heals someone, Channel Growth is triggered for the user's Seedlings.

history.why: Was a Sanctify that healed more per Sanctum level; now a bridge where Holy's Sanctify grows Earth's Seedlings.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn; it heals 5 more per level of your Sanctum.

history.why: Was Earth Pillar with Wardstones added; now Holy's Sanctify pays out more the higher the Sanctum stands.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, if a Boulder or Wardstone damages the target, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

rows.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 max HP for the rest of the match.

history.why: Was a stock heal that restarted a fallen Sanctum; now a small heal that permanently raises the team's foundations, on a long cooldown.

before.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. If your Sanctum is down, it rises straight to level 2.

history.why: Was Verse of Nurturing plus a Sanctum rise; now it rebuilds a fallen Sanctum in one step.

before.effect: Channel Growth twice; then all allies heal 20, and your Sanctum rises by 1.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. For 2 turns, Sanctify on either one gives its damager 15 Shield instead of healing.

history.why: Gave Armor per Condemned enemy hit; now bends Sanctify so a Holy team's brands still pay out to allies at full HP.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. Each one hit that's Condemned gives the user 1 Armor for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Guardian Strike plus Vine Whirl's launch; now Holy's Condemn on the targets turns into Earth's Armor for the user.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and a random other; if a Sanctified target is hit, all allies heal 5. If there's an allied Boulder, a random one is launched.

rows.effect: Every allied Boulder is consecrated into a Wardstone, and all enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Awakener's Roar plus a Sanctum rise; now it turns Earth's Boulders into anchors while cowing the enemy.

before.effect: Every allied Boulder and Wardstone heals to full and gains 1 Armor; your Sanctum rises by 1.

rows.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn, +10 per allied Boulder and Wardstone; each of those loses 10 HP.

history.why: Was Rampart with a Sanctum-gated Immune in place of Anointed; now the stones give up HP to wall the user, putting the Sanctum's anchors at risk.

before.effect: The user gains 30 Shield, or doubles theirs; with your Sanctum at 2 or more, they're also Immune for 1 turn.

rows.effect: The user creates a Wardstone. Target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns and Condemned each time they hit it.

history.why: Was Ancient Grudge plus a Condemn on every Harmful skill; now a Wardstone draws the enemy's blows and Condemns them while it anchors the Sanctum.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time), who is Condemned each time they use a Harmful skill while Taunted.

rows.effect: Your Sanctum rises by 1. For 3 turns, the user counts as a Wardstone and gains 2 Armor and Immune.

history.why: Was Treant Form plus a Sanctum lock; now the user becomes the anchor, so the enemy must bring them down to end the Sanctum.

before.effect: Your Sanctum rises by 1. For 4 turns, it can't expire, and the user gains 1 Might per allied Seedling and 10 Shield per allied Boulder or Wardstone.

kits.name: Grave
kits.tagline: Earth that keeps the dead: every fallen body, on either side, becomes another soldier.
kits.taglineHtml: Earth that keeps the dead: every fallen body, on either side, becomes another soldier.
kits.introHtml:
• Graves (your team's, max 6): +1 whenever any unit or minion dies, on either side. Some skills also dig a Grave directly.
  • Raise: spends Graves to create Undead minions, as the skill lists. A Skeleton has 20 HP and Rattle Blade (nc): 10 damage. A Ghoul has 30 HP and Gnaw (r): 10 damage, and it heals 10. Undead count as minions for Earth's skills, and leave a Grave when they fall.

keywords.html: Graves (your team's, max 6): +1 whenever any unit or minion dies, on either side. Some skills also dig a Grave directly.

Raise: spends Graves to create Undead minions, as the skill lists. A Skeleton has 20 HP and Rattle Blade (nc): 10 damage. A Ghoul has 30 HP and Gnaw (r): 10 damage, and it heals 10. Undead count as minions for Earth's skills, and leave a Grave when they fall.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. The user spends 1 Grave, if they have one, for 10 more; with none, they dig 1 Grave instead.

history.why: Was Worldfist with a dug Grave tacked on; now it alternates between digging and burying on its own, trading burst against the army's Graves.

before.effect: 15 damage, +5 per allied minion, and the user digs 1 Grave.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. If the user has a Boulder, one is ground into the blow, and the user drains a Soul Fragment from each enemy hit.

history.why: Was a Graves-tagged Smash that only hit enemy minions and never touched Graves; now an Earth Boulder is spent to harvest Unholy Soul Fragments.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Every enemy minion falls into the rift for 20 damage.

history.why: Was Worldquake with a Raise rider; now it sweeps the enemy's minions, whose deaths fill the user's Graves.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Raise: spend 1 Grave for a Skeleton. Costs 1 less per allied minion.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user spends up to 2 Graves, and their next skill costs 1 less per Grave spent.

history.why: Was Rolling Crash with a Boulder that left extra Graves; now it cashes Graves in for tempo, competing with Raise for them.

before.effect: 10 damage, and creates a Headstone: a Boulder (45 HP) that leaves 2 Graves when it's destroyed.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; a Skeleton claws up for the user, spending no Grave, and Taunts its user for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Shale Guard plus Spiteful Retort's Horrify plus a dug Grave; now the counter raises a Skeleton the attacker must hit, whose death feeds a Grave.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, dealing 10 Piercing damage; its user is Horrified for 1 turn, and the user digs 1 Grave.

rows.effect: Raise: spend up to 2 Graves for as many Skeletons. For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains 1 Might whenever one of their minions dies.

history.why: Was Nature's Wrath with Skeletons for Seedlings; now the lord grows stronger as the army falls, and every fallen minion also leaves a Grave.

before.effect: Raise: spend up to 3 Graves for as many Skeletons. The user gains Immune for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Until the user's next turn, the next allied minion to die leaves a Boulder where it fell.

history.why: Was a hit that drained a Soul Fragment if anything had died; now a fallen minion becomes a Boulder, new Boulder access for Earth players.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If a unit or minion died since the user's last turn, the user also drains a Soul Fragment from them.

history.why: Was Launch Stone plus Bone Shard; now any death on the board, often an Earth minion's, sets up Unholy's Soul Fragment drain.

before.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Soul Fragment the user has. Can instead launch an allied Boulder or Undead at a random enemy for its remaining HP.

rows.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 55 damage to target enemy. If any unit or minion dies before then, it lands at the end of that turn instead.

history.why: Was Tunnelmaker with Undead as extra fuel; now any death on either side speeds it up, so a kill or a spent minion times the hit.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 60 damage to target enemy; a turn sooner if the user consumes a Boulder or Undead (which leaves a Grave).

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy kills a unit or minion, they're Stunned for 1 turn and the fallen rises for the user as a Skeleton, spending no Grave.

history.why: Was Boulder Trap with a Skeleton for the Boulder; now it punishes the enemy's kills and turns their victim into the user's soldier.

before.effect: For 2 turns, whenever target enemy creates a minion, it's destroyed and the user Raises a Skeleton instead, spending no Grave.

rows.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. When it ends, they spend up to 2 Graves and rise with 15 Shield per Grave spent.

history.why: Was Burrow with a dug Grave tacked on; now it spends Graves to come back armored, a trade against raising Undead.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable and Ghosted for 1 turn, and digs 1 Grave.

rows.effect: Summons a Ghoul Gravedigger (40 HP) permanently. Gnaw (nc): 10 damage, and it heals 10. Unearth (r): spends 2 Graves to Raise a Skeleton; with fewer, it digs 1 Grave.

history.why: Was Forest Stalker with Dig for Channel Earth, useless without a spender; now it digs and raises on its own, building an army over time.

before.effect: Summons a Ghoul Gravedigger (40 HP) permanently. Dig (r): +1 Grave. Gnaw (nc): 10 damage, and it heals 10.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +10 for each Soul Fragment the user spends, up to 3. If it kills them, the spent fragments return to the user, with 1 more.

history.why: Was a bland Graves bolt that turned Piercing after a death; now an Unholy outlet that spends Soul Fragments and refunds them on a kill.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. If a unit or minion died since the user's last turn, it's Piercing and they're Horrified for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Fel Bolt plus Vine Lash's summon; now it reads the board and rewards casting right after a death.

before.effect: 25 damage, and Horrified for 2 turns. If the user has no minion, they Raise a Skeleton, spending no Grave.

rows.effect: Raise: spend up to 2 Graves for as many Skeletons, each bursting out under a random enemy for 15 damage. Then 20 damage to all enemies.

history.why: Was Verdant Burst and Soul Blast with Undead swapped in, needing an existing army; now the Graves it spends become both burst damage and soldiers.

before.effect: Every allied Undead heals 10; then 25 damage to all enemies, +5 per allied Undead.

rows.effect: Drains 10 HP from every minion on both sides; the user heals the total. Minions that die leave Graves as usual.

history.why: Was Worldmarch turning minions into Ghouls, with no drain; now Unholy's drain feeds on Earth's minions, on both sides, and culls the weak ones into Graves.

before.effect: Every allied Seedling and Boulder becomes a Ghoul.

rows.effect: Raise: spend up to 2 Graves for as many Skeletons. With no Graves, the user digs 1 instead.
Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to all enemies. Any unit or minion that dies while it channels rises for the user as a Skeleton.

history.why: Was Worldcaller with free Skeletons for Worldsprouts; now it's a damaging zone where every death, on either side, joins the user's army.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they Raise a Skeleton, spending no Grave.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If that leaves them at 15 HP or less, the user spends 2 Graves, if they have them, to kill them.

history.why: Was Stonepierce plus Blighted Dagger; now Graves buy an execution, and the kill gives one Grave back.

before.effect: 15 damage, or 25 against targets with Shield or Armor. At or above 70 HP, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. While the user is Immortal, it also costs them 20 HP and deals 20 more.

history.why: Was a Stun bonus plus Horrified stripping Armor; now an Unholy user turns Immortal into fuel, spending HP they can't lose.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 if they're Stunned. A Horrified target loses all their Shield and Armor first.

history.why: Was Stone Drill plus Lay Waste's Horrify; now Unholy's Horrify sets up Earth's armor-breaking, since a Horrified target can't rebuild it.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might; a target with Buffs is Horrified for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and buried: they can't use it again until a unit dies.

history.why: Was Earth's Pitfall with minion hits added; now the countered skill stays locked until someone dies.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn, and each allied minion deals them 10 damage.

history.why: Was Pitfall with a free Skeleton; now the user's minions pile into the pit on whoever falls in.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn, and the user Raises a Skeleton.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, plus 1 more turn for each Grave the user spends, up to 2.

history.why: Was Earthwrap plus Horrify and bonus Graves; now every Grave spent buries the enemy a turn deeper.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 2 turns and Horrified, and gains 15 Shield. If they die meanwhile, +2 Graves.

rows.effect: The user gains 5 Shield per Grave, up to 25. If they already had Shield from this skill, they dig 1 Grave first.

history.why: Was Landslide with a Grave for its Boulder; now it grows with the team's Graves and seeds its own, without spending them.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from this skill, they also dig 1 Grave.

rows.effect: Spends 1 Grave: target ally heals 30. With no Grave to spend, they heal 10.
Target ally gains 1 Might for 3 turns. If they die meanwhile, each of their allies gains a copy of every Buff they had, for its remaining duration.

history.why: Was Earth's Infuse Earth with an Immortal fallback; now a death passes the fallen ally's Buffs on as an inheritance.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random; below 30 HP, they're Immortal for 1 turn instead.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each time Horrified stops them from gaining a Buff, a Seedling sprouts for the user.

history.why: Was Tomb Curse, Confusion that grew with deaths; now Unholy's Horrified, by blocking Buffs, grows Earth's Seedlings.

before.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns, and gains 1 more Confusion for each unit or minion that dies meanwhile.

history.why: Was Worldmute plus Horrify; now every death on the board deepens the curse, so kills and sacrifices tax the enemy.

before.effect: For each Might target ally has, a random enemy gains 1 Weakness and is Horrified for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, each time they're healed, the user drains a Soul Fragment from them.

history.why: Was a Graves Sanctify variant (allies heal per Grave); now new Soul Fragment access for Unholy players, fed by the enemy's healers.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them heals 5 per Grave the user has.

history.why: Was Soul Sickness plus bonus Graves on a kill; now it's a Sanctify-like mark whose healing grows with the Graves the user saves.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain a Soul Fragment; if the target dies this turn, +2 Graves.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield, and heal 10 more for each unit or minion that died since the user's last turn.

history.why: Was Profane Chant with a Ghoul tacked on; now it's a team heal that swells after a bloody turn.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies and 2 Weakness for 1 turn. Raise: spend 2 Graves for a Ghoul.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Then every minion on the field, on both sides, takes 15 damage.

history.why: Its repeat-on-kill Cleave duplicated Reanimation's Chain of Souls; now it mows down every minion on the field, both sides'.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to whichever other enemy or minion has the least HP.

history.why: Was Vine Whirl with Undead as ammunition; now its second hit seeks the weakest body, usually a minion, to finish it for a Grave.

before.effect: 5 damage to all enemies. If there's an allied Boulder or Undead, a random one is launched, as with Bone Toss.

rows.effect: All units on both sides except the user are Intimidated for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Toll for the Dead, a Shout lengthened by 3 Graves; now a free Shout that slows everyone, the user's own team included, so only the user acts at full pace.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, or 3 if the user has 3 or more Graves.

history.why: Was Awakener's Roar extended to Undead plus a Raise; now the toll grows heavier with the dead the user keeps, without spending them.

before.effect: Every allied Undead and Boulder heals to full and gains 1 Armor. Raise: spend 1 Grave for a Skeleton.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. When it breaks, a Skeleton rises from the bones for the user, spending no Grave.

history.why: Was Rampart plus 5 Shield per Grave; now the broken wall stands back up as a soldier.

before.effect: The user gains 30 Shield, or doubles the Shield they have, +5 per Grave.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. If the user dies meanwhile, they rise as a Ghoul, spending no Grave, and the Taunt carries on to it.

history.why: Was Ancient Grudge plus Unrelenting Horror's Lifesteal; now the grudge literally outlives the user.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time); if they're Horrified, the user has Lifesteal while it lasts.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and allied minions are Immortal.

history.why: Was Treant Form with Undead and Graves swapped in; now Unholy's Immortal protects Earth's whole army while the lord stands.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 1 Might per allied Undead and 5 Shield per Grave, and is Immortal while there are 3 or more Graves.

kits.name: Moon
kits.tagline: Stone that shines in the dark: a four-beat rhythm of hiding, growing, striking and draining.
kits.taglineHtml: Stone that shines in the dark: a four-beat rhythm of hiding, growing, striking and draining.
kits.introHtml:
• Lunar Cycle (your team's phase, visible to both): it starts at New Moon and advances at the end of each of your turns: New (hide), Waxing (grow), Full (strike), Waning (drain), then New again. Moon skills add the rider for the current phase when they're used, and a few can skip a phase or hold it.

One keyword, and a predictable one: both players can plan around the Full Moon.

keywords.html: Lunar Cycle (your team's phase, visible to both): it starts at New Moon and advances at the end of each of your turns: New (hide), Waxing (grow), Full (strike), Waning (drain), then New again. Moon skills add the rider for the current phase when they're used, and a few can skip a phase or hold it.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. New: Stealthy. Waning: the user heals half the damage dealt.

history.why: Was Worldfist plus 15 at Full; now it's the free hit for the off-beats, hiding at New and draining at Waning.

before.effect: 15 damage, +5 per allied minion. Full: 15 more.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Then every allied Seedling uses Channel Earth at no cost.

history.why: Was a Boulder plus a Stun on Blinded enemies, side by side; now the quake wakes every Seedling's Channel Earth for free, a new outlet for Earth minion play.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. It creates a Boulder for the user, and Blinded enemies hit are Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was the base Smash with Stealthy and double-damage riders; now Earth's impact pays off Shadow's Blind and leaves ammunition behind.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. New: Stealthy. Full: double damage.

rows.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gains 1 Focus for their next skill. New: they gain Stealth instead of Focus.

history.why: Was Long Shadow plus Rolling Crash's Boulder; now the phase decides whether the rush buys tempo or cover.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage, and creates a Boulder; the user's next skill is Stealthy too.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. New: it counters every Harmful skill used on them instead.

history.why: Was Mirage Blade with a Waning Weakness tacked on; now the dark of the moon turns one counter into a full wall, so the user times it.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, who gains 1 Focus. Waning: its user also gains 2 Weakness for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Until the next Full Moon ends, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness; during the Full Moon, 3 Might and Immune instead.

history.why: Was Night of Knives with a Full upgrade; now its length depends on when the beast turns, trading a long hunt against an instant peak.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness. Full: 3 Might instead, and Immune.

rows.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. Waxing: the shard stays lodged, dealing 15 more at the start of the next Full Moon.

history.why: Was Shadow Spine with a Full upgrade; now a Waxing cast plants damage that blooms on the Full Moon.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage. New: it strikes once more for each of Blinded, Isolated and Asleep the target is. Full: 20 Piercing.

rows.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable. It uses the phase it lands in: Full, 20 more; Waning, the user heals half.

history.why: Was Dream Seeker with 20 more at Full; now it takes the phase it lands in, so the user aims it a turn ahead.

before.effect: On the following turn, 35 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable; it doesn't end Sleep. Full: 55.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill on a minion, they fall Asleep and are Isolated for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Dream Chains plus Isolation; now Earth's Boulders and Seedlings become bait that springs Shadow's Sleep.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy doesn't use a skill, they take 15 Affliction, fall Asleep, and are Isolated.

rows.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and the Lunar Cycle advances one extra phase at the end of the turn.

history.why: Was Shadowstep with Burrow's Invulnerable at New; now it skips a phase, pulling the Full Moon closer or past it.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn. New: Invulnerable too.

rows.effect: Summons a Lunar Wolf (35 HP) permanently. Moonfang (r): 10 Piercing damage. At the start of each Full Moon, it howls: it heals 20, and a random enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Spirit Raven with a Full damage bonus; now the wolf becomes a tank on schedule, drawing fire every Full Moon.

before.effect: Summons a Lunar Wolf (35 HP) permanently. Bite (r): 10 Piercing damage; Full: 25. Howl (r): target enemy is Taunted by the Wolf for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Blinded for 2 turns. Full: it also ends their Stealth, and they can't regain it until the next New Moon.

history.why: Was Blackbolt with Vine Lash's Seedling and a Full bonus; now full moonlight strips the enemy's hiding for the rest of the cycle.

before.effect: 20 damage and Blinded for 2 turns. Waxing: the user also creates a Seedling. Full: 30 damage.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Full: Blinded ones fall Asleep after the hit. Waning: the user heals 5 per enemy hit.

history.why: Was Verdant Burst with Wave of Darkness's Confusion at Full; now it sets up a mass Sleep at Full or sustains at Waning.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then 25 damage to all enemies. New: Stealthy. Full: each also gains 1 Confusion.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user for the damage dealt. Waning: it drains every enemy instead.

history.why: Was Drink Darkness with a Waning heal; now it's a true drain that widens to the whole team on the drain phase.

before.effect: 5 Affliction to all enemies; Blinded ones lose Blind and take 10 more. Waning: the user heals the total dealt.

rows.effect: Summons 2 Moon Moths (10 HP) for 3 turns. While one lives, Blinded enemies' single-target skills always strike a Moth. Flutter (r): 10 damage to target enemy.

history.why: Was Shadow's Blinding Shade plus Untargetable Earth minions; now the Moths bend Blind so a Blinded enemy's attacks are wasted on them, a rule bend for Shadow Blind play.

before.effect: Summons 2 Moon Moths (10 HP) for 3 turns. Dust (r): target enemy is Blinded for 1 turn. While a Moth lives, allied Boulders and Seedlings are Untargetable.

history.why: Was one Shade skill plus one Earth Armor skill; now Shadow's swarm hides Earth's minions from enemy skills.

before.effect: Summons 2 Moon Moths (10 HP) for 3 turns. Dust (r): target enemy is Blinded for 1 turn. Glow (r): target ally gains 1 Armor.

rows.effect: Channeled until the next New Moon: 10 damage to all enemies at the end of each of the user's turns. If it lasts to the New Moon, every enemy falls Asleep.

history.why: Was Nightsong with Seedlings on Waxing; now its length follows the cycle, trading a long channel against a quick mass Sleep.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns, and a Seedling for the user on each Waxing turn; if it completes, every enemy falls Asleep.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Their Blind ends, and they're Isolated for the turns it had left.

history.why: Was Shadow's Backstab with a Boulder in place of Blind; now it converts a Shadow Blind into Isolation, cutting a low target off from their healers.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or has an allied Boulder to strike from behind.

history.why: Was Backstab with a Full upgrade; now Earth's Boulders count as Shadow's cover for the backstab.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or the target is Blinded. Full: always 25.

rows.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, doubled if the user is Stealthed. Full: it doesn't end the user's Stealth.

history.why: Was Ambush doubled at Full too; now the Full Moon lets the user ambush from Stealth without leaving it.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the user is Stealthed or it's Full Moon.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and the user creates a Boulder; the enemy is Isolated while it stands, for up to 3 turns.

history.why: Was Pitfall exactly; now Shadow's Isolation lasts as long as an Earth Boulder survives, so the enemy must break it.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they're Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and Sleep. Full: damage doesn't wake them until the Full Moon ends.

history.why: Was Sap with debuff riders at Full and Waning; now a Full Moon sleep can't be broken, opening a free turn of hits.

before.effect: 10 damage, and Sleep. Full: 2 Confusion too. Waning: 2 Weakness for 2 turns too.

rows.effect: For 2 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and the phase's gift: New, Stealth; Waxing, 2 Armor; Full, 2 Might; Waning, 2 Renew.

history.why: Was Hall of Phantoms with Shield at Waxing; now it's a different buff in every phase, so the user picks when to dance.

before.effect: The user gains Stealth; if already Stealthed, Ghosted, Immune and 1 Focus for 2 turns. Waxing: 10 Shield as well.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 40. 3 turns later, the moonlight wanes and they lose 20 HP, which can't kill them.

history.why: Was Moonlit Rest, a heal with Waxing max HP; now a cheap, oversized heal on loan that is partly paid back later.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20. Waxing: they also gain 10 max HP until the next New Moon.

history.why: Was Grovetender plus Touch of Slumber at New; now the waxing moon grows the ally for the rest of the cycle.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then target ally heals 15. New: they heal 15 more and fall Asleep.

rows.effect: Target ally gains Stealth; while Stealthed, they gain 1 permanent Armor at the end of each of their turns.

history.why: Was Nightwrap plus Earth's buffs at Waxing; now Shadow's Stealth builds Earth's Armor for as long as the ally stays hidden.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth. Waxing: also 1 Might and 1 Armor.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, target enemy's skills are Stunned in alternation: non-Strategic ones on their first and third turns, Strategic ones on their second.

history.why: Was Shadow's Blinding Powder with a minion-Stun rider; now a tidal rhythm locks half the target's kit each turn, alternating which half.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 3 turns; each time their skill lands on a minion instead of their target, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Blinding Powder plus Worldmute; now Earth's minions become the walls that Shadow's Blind makes them stumble into.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 3 turns, and gains 1 Weakness for each Might that target ally has.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, every unit on both sides is Sanctified.

history.why: Was Silver Brand, a Sanctify that lost its cooldown at New Moon; now moonlight falls on everyone, so every hit on either side heals its dealer and the harder-hitting team pulls ahead.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 2 turns. New: Stealthy, and it has no cooldown.

history.why: Was Shadowbrand with 15 more at Full; now the New Moon, not the user's Stealth, frees the cooldown, and keeps them hidden.

before.effect: 10 damage and Sanctify for 2 turns. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown. Full: 25 damage.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20. New: they gain Stealth. Waxing: 2 Renew. Full: 1 Might for 2 turns. Waning: every enemy gains 1 Weakness.
25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Neither hit wakes a Sleeping enemy; each Sleeper it hits sleeps 1 turn longer instead.

history.why: Was Half-Moon Sweep, a Cleave with New and Full riders; now a Shadow expansion that deepens Sleep instead of breaking it.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other. New: Stealthy. Full: 10 to every other enemy instead.

history.why: Was Shadow Pulse plus Vine Whirl's Boulder launch; now it's a quiet two-target cut or a full sweep, by phase.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies, or 20 at Full Moon. If there's an allied Boulder, a random one is launched.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Full: every allied minion also attacks a random enemy for 10.

history.why: Was Hunter's Howl plus Awakener's Roar at Full; now the pack answers the Full Moon howl with an attack.

before.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 2 turns (Intimidated instead if already Blinded). Full: every allied minion heals to full and gains 1 Armor.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. Whatever is left of it when it ends becomes a Boulder for the user, with that much HP.

history.why: Was Moonstone Guard, 1 Armor made permanent at Full Moon; now an Earth expansion whose unbroken Shield piles up into a Boulder.

before.effect: The user gains 1 Armor until the next Full Moon ends. Full: it's permanent instead.

history.why: Was Veiled Guard with 10 Shield; now only Armor gained under the Full Moon lasts, so it's a timing choice.

before.effect: The user gains 1 permanent Armor; with 3 or more, they gain Stealth and 10 Shield.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time an ally of the user damages them, the Taunt passes to that ally.

history.why: Was Shadow Mockery with a bigger Boulder and Stealth; now the Taunt moves like moonlight to whoever struck last, so any teammate can pull the enemy.

before.effect: Creates a Stone Double: a Boulder (20 HP) in the user's likeness. Target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns, and the user gains Stealth.

history.why: Was Shadow Mockery with more HP and duration; now the decoy is Earth's Boulder, reusable as ammunition, and it covers the user's Stealth.

before.effect: Creates a Decoy (10 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune, and the Lunar Cycle holds at its current phase.

history.why: Was Faceless One with 3 Armor at Full; now it freezes the phase, so the team can hold a Full Moon or a New Moon for three turns.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor (3 if it's Full Moon), and all enemies are Taunted by them and Isolated.

kits.name: Zealot
kits.tagline: Holy and unholy in one soul: faith that feeds on suffering, and a death that serves the cause.
kits.taglineHtml: Holy and unholy in one soul: faith that feeds on suffering, and a death that serves the cause.
kits.introHtml:
• Fervor (Buff, max 5): Zealot skills grant it, and a unit that already has Fervor gains 1 more whenever an enemy damages them or gives them a Debuff. Each stack adds 5 damage and 5 healing to the bearer's Zealot skills.
  • Martyr: when a unit with Fervor dies, each of their allies heals 10 per stack and gains 1 Might per 2 stacks.

keywords.html: Fervor (Buff, max 5): Zealot skills grant it, and a unit that already has Fervor gains 1 more whenever an enemy damages them or gives them a Debuff. Each stack adds 5 damage and 5 healing to the bearer's Zealot skills.
Martyr: when a unit with Fervor dies, each of their allies heals 10 per stack and gains 1 Might per 2 stacks.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +5 for each Debuff on the user. The user gains 1 Fervor.

history.why: Was Witchblade with a self-hit and Fervor tacked on; now the user's own suffering is the damage bonus.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; the user takes 5 and gains 1 Fervor.

rows.effect: Spends all the user's Fervor: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, +10 to each hit per stack spent.

history.why: Was Soulcrusher plus Divine Storm's heal; now it's the kit's Fervor dump, trading future scaling and Martyr value for one big blow.

before.effect: 40 damage to target enemy; their allies are Horrified for 2 turns, and the user heals 5 per target hit.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user's next skill costs 1 less for every 25 HP they're missing.

history.why: Was a Charge that gave Fervor, Focus and Vulnerable; now the discount scales with the user's wounds, so a bleeding fanatic can fire a big skill for free.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user gains 1 Fervor and 1 Focus for their next skill, and 1 Vulnerable for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Zealous Rush with Fervor tacked on; now the user rushes in open to blows, and every blow feeds Fervor.

before.effect: 15 damage; the user gains 1 Fervor, and their next Harmful skill Sanctifies for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, who gains 2 Fervor as if it had landed.

history.why: Was Retribution with Fervor per hit; now the counter keeps the suffering's reward without the wound.

before.effect: For 1 turn, Harmful skills used on the user heal them instead of damaging them, and each gives them 1 Fervor.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might. Debuffs enemies would give them are prevented and give them 1 Fervor each instead.

history.why: Was Divine Fury plus Immortal plus Fervor; now Rage's Immune turns every blocked Debuff into faith.

before.effect: The user gains 3 Fervor, and is Anointed and Immortal for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user spends 1 Fervor, if they have one, to heal 15.

history.why: Was Sunbeam with less damage; now it burns Fervor instead of Anointed for sustain, a trade against scaling and Martyr.

before.effect: 10 damage. Consumes the user's Anointed to heal them 15.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 50 damage. If the user dies before it lands, it lands anyway, doubled.
Invisible. For 3 turns, target enemy has Trap 15, and each time their Condemned triggers, they're Condemned again for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Holy's Decree that Horrified when it triggered; now an invisible Trap that makes any Condemnation on the target renew itself, a loop for Holy Condemn play.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned for 2 turns; when it triggers, they're also Horrified for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn. If they're brought to 5 HP meanwhile, they gain 3 Fervor.

history.why: Was Grave Step with Fervor tacked on; now surviving at the brink is what fills the user with faith.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn and gains 1 Fervor.

rows.effect: Summons a Flagellant (40 HP, 1 Fervor) permanently. Self-Scourge (nc): it takes 10 Affliction and gains 1 Fervor. Blood Whip (r): 10 damage, +5 per Fervor it has.

history.why: Its Lash Self copied the kit's Heal; now it whips itself into a growing Martyr, so enemies must choose when to kill it.

before.effect: Summons a Flagellant (40 HP, starts with 2 Fervor) permanently. Lash Self (nc): it takes 10, and target ally heals 15. Holy Strike (r): 15 damage.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn; an ally who triggers the Sanctify also drains a Soul Fragment from them.

history.why: Was Rebuke plus Fel Bolt; now Holy's Sanctify sets up Unholy's Soul Fragment drain for whoever follows up.

before.effect: 25 damage; Sanctified for 1 turn and Horrified for 2.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. The user drains a Soul Fragment from each enemy it drops from above half HP to half or below.

history.why: Was Fervent Nova, which struck again at low HP and never used Fervor; now new Soul Fragment access for Unholy players, paid out when enemies cross half HP.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. If the user is at or below half HP, it strikes again at the start of their next turn.

history.why: Was Holy Nova with Unholy's cost; now suffering, not Anointed, makes it strike twice.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. If the user is Anointed, it strikes again at the start of their next turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. Then the user takes every Debuff their allies have onto themselves, for the turns each had left.

history.why: Was a drain that healed per Debuff and took a Soul Fragment from Horrified targets; now the user eats their allies' sins, taking every Debuff onto themselves.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user 10 per Debuff on them. A Horrified target also loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

history.why: Was Drain Soul plus Ascension; now it's a drain that feeds on Holy's Condemn debuffs and Unholy's Horrify.

before.effect: 5 damage, and drains a Soul Fragment. If the target is Sanctified, the user becomes Anointed and gains 1 Fervor.

rows.effect: Summons an Initiate (20 HP, 1 Fervor) for 3 turns. Take the Blow (nc): the next Harmful skill aimed at target ally hits the Initiate instead.

history.why: Was Divine Blessing plus a free Martyr heal; now it's a bodyguard whose Fervor grows with every hit it takes, so its Martyr heal grows too.

before.effect: Summons an Initiate (15 HP, 2 Fervor) for 3 turns. Blessing (W): target ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn; then the Initiate dies, a Martyr.

rows.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they take 10 Affliction, and a random enemy takes 10 damage per Fervor stack they have.

history.why: Was Consecration with self-harm and Fervor; now the channel converts the user's stored Fervor into damage every turn.

before.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns, they take 5 and gain 1 Fervor, and a random enemy without Sanctify takes 10 damage and is Sanctified.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If it kills them, the user's allies get the Martyr payout for the user's Fervor, and the user keeps it.

history.why: Was a Fervor-tagged Stab keyed only to the user's HP; now a kill is offered up as a sacrifice that pays the Martyr payout without anyone dying.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if the user is at or below half HP.

history.why: Was Piercing Light with Horrified added; now it's a finisher keyed to the user's own wounds instead of the target's.

before.effect: 10 damage, +10 if the target is Condemned, Sanctified or Horrified.

rows.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, each Horrified enemy loses a random Buff at the start of their turn.

history.why: Was a hit that healed if the target was Sanctified; now Horrified also strips Buffs the bearer already has, a rule bend for Unholy Horrify play.

before.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Sanctified, the user heals the damage dealt.

history.why: Was Lay Waste plus Crusade; now Holy's Sanctify becomes Unholy Lifesteal for the whole hit.

before.effect: 35 Piercing damage. Targets above 75 HP are Condemned; a target with Buffs is Horrified for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and each of its targets heals 10 per Fervor the user has.

history.why: Was Martyrdom with Fervor added and no counter; now it's a counter that pays out a Martyr heal without anyone dying.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, all its targets are Anointed until the end of their next turn and gain 2 Fervor.

rows.effect: All enemies are Stunned for 1 turn. The user takes 15 Affliction damage for each one Stunned.

history.why: Was Do Penance, Condemned with a Stun at 3 Fervor; now a team-wide Stun paid for in the user's own blood, one wound per penitent.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned for 2 turns. If the user has 3 or more Fervor, they're also Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Repentance with Horrified as a second condition; now the user's Fervor, not the target's state, earns the Stun.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn if they're Condemned or Horrified.

rows.effect: The user spends 1 Fervor for 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus until the end of their next turn. With none, they gain 1 Fervor and 1 Confusion for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Grisly Spectacle with Fervor tacked on; now it alternates between building faith and burning it for a burst of speed.

before.effect: 15 Piercing damage; every Horrify on enemies lasts 1 turn longer. The user gains 1 Fervor, and 1 Confusion for 1 turn (stacking).

rows.effect: The user takes 15 and gains 1 Fervor; target ally heals 20.
For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and healing they get from Lifesteal past their max HP becomes Shield.

history.why: Was Anoint the Suffering, Anointed plus Fervor per Debuff; now an Unholy expansion that turns wasted Lifesteal into Shield.

before.effect: Target ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn, and gains 1 Fervor per Debuff on them, up to 3.

history.why: Was Holy Favor plus Vampirism; now the blessing grows with what the ally is suffering.

before.effect: Target ally is Anointed and gains Lifesteal until the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Sanctified for 2 turns. Meanwhile, whenever any Sanctify on an enemy triggers, every ally of the damager heals 5 too.

history.why: Was Condemn that triggered twice on Horrified targets; now every Sanctify the team triggers heals the whole team a little, a rule bend for Holy Sanctify play.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned for 2 turns. If they're Horrified, it triggers twice.

history.why: Was Mark of Heresy plus Cause Fear; now Unholy's Horrify doubles Holy's Condemn.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned, Sanctified and Horrified until the end of the user's next turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 2 turns. An Anointed ally who triggers the Sanctify also gains Lifesteal for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Contagious Zeal, Sanctify that fed Fervor; now Holy's Anointed turns the Sanctify into Unholy Lifesteal for the ally who hits.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn; the user gains 1 Fervor each time it triggers.

history.why: Was Soul Sickness with Fervor for Soul Fragments; now the team's follow-up hits feed the user's Fervor through Sanctify.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain 1 Fervor.

rows.effect: All allies heal 25. Any ally who dies before the user's next turn is a Martyr as if they had 3 Fervor.

history.why: Was Profane Chant with Fervor tacked on; now it's a heal that guarantees a Martyr payout if it isn't enough.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies and 2 Weakness for 1 turn; all allies gain 1 Fervor.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and 15 to each other enemy who shares any Debuff with them.

history.why: Was Shared Suffering, a Cleave that passed Fervor on; now the second hit finds its targets by guilt by association, anyone marked with the same Debuff.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other; then 1 of the user's Fervor passes to a random ally.

history.why: Was Oathbreaker Strike with Fervor on the allies it hurt; now it spreads Fervor, and Martyr value, around the team.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, then 10 to them and to each of the user's allies; each ally hit gains 1 Fervor.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Each Horrified enemy is also Condemned, for as long as their Horrified lasts.

history.why: Was Sermon, 1-turn Condemned that fed Fervor; now Unholy's Horrified holds Holy's Condemned on each enemy for as long as it lasts.

before.effect: All enemies are Condemned for 1 turn; the user gains 1 Fervor each time one triggers.

history.why: Was Excoriate plus Fervor for allies; now the enemy's own actions under Condemn feed the preacher.

before.effect: Bypass. Every Sanctified enemy is Condemned for 1 turn, and every ally with Fervor gains 1 more.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. If an ally dies meanwhile, the user also inherits their Fervor, on top of their Martyr payout.

history.why: Was Shield scaled by the user's Fervor; now a Martyr skill that lets a fallen ally's Fervor carry on in the user.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield per Fervor stack, at least 10, for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Misery with Fervor for each drained ally; now the user's stored faith becomes their shield without spending it.

before.effect: The user drains 10 HP from each other ally (each gains 1 Fervor), gaining 20 Shield plus the total drained.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. If they kill the user meanwhile, the user's Martyr also deals them 10 Affliction damage per Fervor stack.

history.why: Was Strike Me, a Taunt that gained Fervor per hit; now dares the enemy to make a Martyr of the user, and the martyrdom strikes back at the killer.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns; each time they damage the user, the user gains 1 more Fervor.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune. When it ends, they're a Martyr without dying: their allies get the Martyr payout for the user's Fervor, which is then spent.

history.why: Was a Fervor Titan that paid 10 healing per stack at the end; now it pays the full Martyr payout, healing and Might, while the user lives.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune. When it ends, they spend all their Fervor: every ally heals 10 per stack.

history.why: Was Soul Colossus with Fervor for Soul Fragments; now it's a delayed, living Martyr that the enemy races to end.

before.effect: Consumes all the user's Fervor to heal 10 per stack; then 1 Armor per stack for 3 turns, and Immortal for 2.

kits.name: Vigilante
kits.tagline: Holy light from the shadows: justice outside the law, dragging hidden things into the open.
kits.taglineHtml: Holy light from the shadows: justice outside the law, dragging hidden things into the open.
kits.introHtml:
• Exposed (Debuff): the bearer can't become Stealthed, Invulnerable, Untargetable or Invisible (any they have ends), and the Invisible effects they own are revealed. Vigilante skills deal 10 more to them.

One keyword: the Vigilante hides in Shadow's Stealth while denying it to the enemy, and Holy supplies the verdicts.

keywords.html: Exposed (Debuff): the bearer can't become Stealthed, Invulnerable, Untargetable or Invisible (any they have ends), and the Invisible effects they own are revealed. Vigilante skills deal 10 more to them.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they damaged an ally of the user since the user's last turn, they're Exposed for 1 turn first, so this deals 10 more.

history.why: Was Black Axe plus Righteous Blow; now it asks who hurt the team and makes them pay through Exposed.

before.effect: 25 damage. If this kills the target, the user gains Stealth; if the user is Anointed, 10 more and they heal 10.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and 25 to each enemy who used a Helpful skill on them since the user's last turn.

history.why: Was Crackdown, a Smash that gave Stealth if any target was Exposed; now the splash hunts accomplices: it hits only, and fully, whoever helped the target.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. If any enemy hit is Exposed, the user gains Stealth.

history.why: Was Shadow Crash plus Divine Storm's heal; now hitting an Exposed enemy lets the user melt back into the shadows.

before.effect: Removes Stealth from every Stealthed ally; then 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to the others, +10 to each per Stealth removed. The user heals 5 per target hit.

rows.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage and Exposed for 2 turns; the user's next skill is Stealthy too.
Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on any ally of the user; its user is Exposed for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Mirage Blade with Exposed tacked on; now the counter guards the whole team, catching whoever strikes an ally.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Exposed for 2 turns, and the user gains 1 Focus.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness, and their skills are Stealthy when they target an Exposed enemy.

history.why: Was Night of Knives plus Divine Fury; now the user stays hidden for as long as they hunt Exposed prey.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness and is Anointed.

rows.effect: 10 damage to a random enemy, Stealthed ones included. If they had Stealth or an Invisible effect, they're Exposed for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Sunbeam plus Exposed; now it sweeps for hidden enemies at random and pins down whoever it finds.

before.effect: 10 damage and Exposed for 1 turn. Consumes the user's Anointed to heal them 15.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy; if they gained Stealth or used an Invisible skill meanwhile, 20 more and Exposed for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Dream Seeker with 5 more and Exposed; now it punishes a target who tries to hide from the shot.

before.effect: On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable, and Exposed for 2 turns.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a Stealthy or Invisible skill, it's countered and they're Exposed for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Decree with Exposed on trigger; now the trap springs on the enemy's own attempt to act unseen.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned for 2 turns; when it triggers, they're also Exposed for 2 turns.

rows.effect: The user and target ally become Invulnerable for 1 turn. The user can't use Harmful skills on their next turn.

history.why: Was an Invulnerable step that made skills Stealthy against Condemned or Sanctified enemies; now it gets an ally out too, at the cost of the user's next attack.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn; their next skill against a Condemned or Sanctified enemy is Stealthy too.

history.why: Was Shadowstep plus Cloister's Immune; now Holy's verdicts let the user keep Shadow's Stealth while carrying them out.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted and Immune for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Summons a Bloodhound (30 HP) permanently. Run Down (r): 10 Piercing damage. Scent (r): target enemy is Exposed for as long as the Bloodhound lives, until it uses Scent again.

history.why: Was Spirit Raven with Exposed for Taunt; now the scent holds until the enemy deals with the dog.

before.effect: Summons a Bloodhound (30 HP) permanently. Bite (r): 10 Piercing damage. Sniff Out (r): target enemy is Exposed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. The ally who spends the Mark is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was Blind-into-Condemn and Condemn-into-Blind; now following up on the Mark deputizes an ally with Anointed, new Anointed access for Holy play.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. A Blinded target is also Condemned for 2 turns; a Condemned one is also Blinded for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Blackbolt plus Rebuke; now each parent's status sets up the other's, so the bolt escalates what's already there.

before.effect: 20 damage; Blinded for 2 turns and Sanctified for 1.

rows.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Those with Stealth, an Invisible effect or Invulnerable are Exposed for 2 turns first, and take 10 more.

history.why: Was an AoE with Exposed on everyone; now it only lights up the enemies who were hiding.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, and all are Exposed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for the damage dealt. Their Invisible effects are revealed and end, and the user heals 10 more for each.

history.why: Was Ascension with Exposed as a condition; now Holy's drain feeds on Shadow's hidden tricks and dismantles them.

before.effect: 5 damage. If the target is Exposed or Sanctified, their Invisible effects end and the user becomes Anointed.

rows.effect: Summons an Informant (15 HP) for 3 turns. Whoever damages it is Exposed for 2 turns. Tip Off (r): the user's next skill on target enemy is Stealthy.

history.why: Was Call Shade with Exposed for Blind; now the informant sells out whoever silences it.

before.effect: Summons an Informant (15 HP) for 3 turns. Tip Off (r): target enemy is Exposed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, every enemy who used a Harmful skill since takes 10 damage and is Exposed for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Consecration with Exposed added; now the patrol only answers the enemies who acted.

before.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns, a random enemy without Sanctify takes 10 damage and is Sanctified and Exposed for 1 turn.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Used from Stealth, it makes their Condemned trigger at once, and doesn't end the Stealth.

history.why: Was Shiv, which kept Stealth against Exposed targets; now Shadow's Stealth is what springs Holy's Condemned early.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Against an Exposed target, it doesn't end the user's Stealth.

history.why: Was Backstab plus Piercing Light's Condemn; now Exposed prey can be knifed again and again from hiding.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or the target is Blinded or Condemned.

rows.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Exposed, it ends, and they're Stunned for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Ambush plus Crusade; now it cashes in Exposed for a Stun, a choice between the +10 and the lockdown.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the user is Stealthed; targets above 75 HP are Condemned.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Condemned for 2 turns; any ally of theirs who uses a Helpful skill on them meanwhile is Exposed for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Illusory Lure with Exposed tacked on; now the setup catches the target and exposes any accomplice who tries to help them.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Isolated and Exposed for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and Sleep. An Exposed target is Stunned for 2 turns instead, which damage doesn't end.

history.why: Was Sap plus Repentance; now catching an Exposed target turns the sleeper hold into a real lockdown.

before.effect: 10 damage, and Sleep; a Condemned target is Stunned for 1 turn instead, which damage doesn't end.

rows.effect: The user gains Stealth and 1 Swiftness. While they stay Stealthed, their skills deal 10 more to Exposed enemies.

history.why: Was Hall of Phantoms with Anointed added; now the mask is for the hunt: hidden, the vigilante hits Exposed enemies twice as hard.

before.effect: The user gains Stealth. If they were already Stealthed, they gain Ghosted, Immune and 1 Focus for 2 turns, and are Anointed.

rows.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains Stealth. If they're still Stealthed at the end of their next turn, they heal 15 more.

history.why: Was Nightfall for one ally; now the ally chooses between acting and lying low for Holy's second heal.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains Stealth.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time target ally takes damage, they gain 25 Shield and 2 Might for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Secret Blessing, Anointed that Exposed whoever targeted the ally; now a hidden blessing that holds back until the ally is hurt, then arrives all at once.

before.effect: Invisible. Target ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn; any enemy who targets them meanwhile is Exposed for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Nightwrap plus Holy Favor; now the hidden blessing is also bait that exposes whoever goes after the ally.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth, and is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

rows.effect: Target enemy is Exposed for 3 turns. The first ally of the user to damage them gains Stealth.

history.why: Was Blinding Powder with Exposed added; now it posts a bounty that rewards the team's hunter.

before.effect: Target enemy is Exposed and Blinded for 3 turns.

rows.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. The next time their Condemned triggers, within 3 turns, it gives all three of its Debuffs instead of one.

history.why: Was Mark of Justice, Sanctify that healed more on Exposed; now a Holy expansion that makes a Condemned trigger land in full.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 2 turns; while they're Exposed, it heals the damager 15 more.

history.why: Was Shadowbrand with Exposed tacked on; now Exposed doubles the Sanctify, rewarding the whole team for piling on.

before.effect: 10 damage, and Sanctify and Exposed for 2 turns. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown.

rows.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. Each Anointed ally spends their Anointed to remove all their Debuffs.

history.why: Was Vigil of the Watch, a heal that Exposed recent attackers; now a Holy expansion that gives Anointed a new use as a full cleanse.

before.effect: All allies heal 20. Each enemy who damaged one of them since the user's last turn is Exposed for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Nightfall plus a heal while Anointed; now the vigil heals the team and names who hurt it.

before.effect: All allies gain Stealth and heal 20; if the user is Anointed, they heal 10 more next turn.

rows.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. For 2 turns, each time either one's Condemned triggers, they're also Blinded for 1 turn.

history.why: Was a Cleave whose second hit sought Exposed enemies; now Holy's Condemned, when it triggers, sets up Shadow's Blind.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random Exposed enemy, or to a random enemy if none is.

history.why: Was Shadow Pulse plus Guardian Strike; now the second hit seeks out whoever is Exposed.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies; if it hits a Sanctified target, all allies heal 5.

rows.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each time one uses a Harmful skill, they're Exposed for 1 turn.

history.why: Was Hunter's Howl with Exposed for Intimidated; now the alarm exposes every enemy who acts while it rings.

before.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 2 turns; those already Blinded are Exposed for 2 turns instead.

rows.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. While it holds, each Debuff an enemy would give them is prevented and costs 10 of the Shield instead.

history.why: Was a Shield whose breaker was Condemned while the user gained Stealth; now the Shield also soaks up Debuffs, which no other Withstand does.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. If it breaks, its breaker is Condemned for 2 turns and the user gains Stealth.

history.why: Was Veiled Guard plus Immune if Anointed; now the broken coat condemns the attacker and lets the user vanish.

before.effect: The user gains 1 permanent Armor; with 3 or more, they gain Stealth, and Immune for 1 turn if Anointed.

rows.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. The first time they damage the user, the Taunt ends: the user gains Stealth, and they're Exposed for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Shadow Mockery plus Gleam and Exposed; now the vigilante takes the hit, vanishes, and leaves the attacker in the light.

before.effect: Creates a Decoy (5 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn. If they damage it, they're Exposed and Condemned for 2 turns.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune. Each time their Stealth ends meanwhile, they're Anointed until the end of their next turn.

history.why: Was a Titan that Exposed anyone who hit it; now each time the user steps out of Shadow's Stealth, it pays off in Holy's Anointed.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune, and every enemy who damages them is Exposed for 2 turns.

history.why: Was Faceless One with Exposed added; now the warden's armor marks everyone who tests it.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor, and all enemies are Taunted by them, Isolated and Exposed.

kits.name: Curse
kits.tagline: Unholy in the shadows: hexes that punish every kind of choice, and outlive their victims.
kits.taglineHtml: Unholy in the shadows: hexes that punish every kind of choice, and outlive their victims.
kits.introHtml:
• Hexes (Debuffs), each punishing one kind of action for its duration:
    • Hex of Pain: whenever the bearer deals damage, they take 10 Affliction.
    • Hex of Silence: the bearer's Strategic skills cost 1 more random energy.
    • Hex of Ruin: whenever the bearer gains a Buff, they take 10 Affliction.
  • Lingering: when a Hexed unit dies or has a Hex cleansed, that Hex jumps to a random ally of theirs with its remaining duration. Hexes that simply run out are gone.

keywords.html:

Lingering: when a Hexed unit dies or has a Hex cleansed, that Hex jumps to a random ally of theirs with its remaining duration. Hexes that simply run out are gone.

before.effect: 40 damage to target enemy; their allies gain Hex of Pain for 2 turns.

rows.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, without waking them. The user's next skill doesn't wake Sleeping enemies it damages either.

history.why: Was a Stealthy dash that drained a Soul Fragment only from Blinded targets; now lets a Shadow Sleep player hit Sleepers twice without waking them.

before.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy. A Blinded target also loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

history.why: Was Long Shadow plus Wraithwalk; now Shadow's Blind sets up Unholy's Soul Fragment drain.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters every Harmful skill used on the user by a Hexed enemy, and the first one from anyone else.

history.why: Was Spiteful Retort with Hex of Pain for Horrify; now Hexed enemies can't touch the user at all that turn.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains Hex of Pain for 2 turns.

rows.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Lifesteal, and 1 Might for each Hex on enemies, up to 3, counted each turn.

history.why: Was Night of Knives plus Lifesteal; now the user's strength rises and falls with the curses on the enemy team.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and Lifesteal.

rows.effect: 5 Piercing damage to target enemy; each Hex on them lasts 1 turn longer.

history.why: Was Shadow Spine counting Hexes too; now it's the cheap upkeep that keeps curses from running out.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, striking once more for each Hex on the target and each of Blinded, Isolated and Asleep.

rows.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy; it consumes their Hexes for 15 more each, and those Hexes don't Linger.

history.why: Was Soul Lance plus 10 per Hex; now it cashes the Hexes in, a choice between burst and lasting curses.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage, +10 per Hex; if the target ends below 50 HP, the user drains a Soul Fragment.

rows.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if a Debuff is removed from target enemy, they're Stunned for 1 turn and gain Hex of Ruin for 3 turns.

history.why: Was Soul Shackle with Hex of Silence for Weakness; now it punishes cleansing, backing up Lingering.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they're Stunned for 1 turn and gain Hex of Silence for 3 turns.
